countries.name: Colombia
countries.summary: Dogs and cats need an official health certificate from the origin country dated no more than 10 calendar days before entry, current vaccinations (rabies plus core vaccines) and deworming within 60 days; on arrival ICA inspects and issues the Certificado de Inspección Sanitaria (CIS). Pre-registration in ICA's SISPAP system is available to speed clearance.
countries.microchip: Not mentioned in ICA entry requirements.
countries.parasite_treatment: Internal and external antiparasitic treatment within 60 days before the trip; product name, active ingredient and date on the certificate.
countries.import_permit: No ICA import permit for personal pet dogs and cats; ICA issues the CIS on arrival after documentary and physical inspection. Fee paid online via SISPAP (Colombian bank account) or by card at the ICA office (no cash).
countries.quarantine: Only if non-compliant: retention, home quarantine, re-shipment or euthanasia at owner's cost.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated: deworming within 60 days, official health certificate within 10 days before entry, SISPAP Pre-CIS and payment, then ICA inspection on arrival. From scratch, plan at least 4 weeks (a first rabies dose at least 21 days before).
countries.private_aviation: ICA offices operate at international airports, border crossings and seaports; for arrivals outside ICA hours, Sundays or holidays, tick 'Servicio Especial' in the SISPAP Pre-CIS request.
countries.export: Leaving Colombia: ICA issues an export CIS only at its airport/port/border offices; the request is filed in SISPAP (by the owner or private vet) with health and vaccination certificates plus destination-specific annexes. Framework: ICA Res. 100164 of 2021. Five or more animals per user are treated as commercial.
countries.authority: ICA (Instituto Colombiano Agropecuario)
vaccinations: Rabies: vaccine name, lot, date and validity certified; primary vaccination at least 21 days before embarkation. If the origin country does not vaccinate against rabies, home quarantine and vaccination in Colombia.
Dogs: distemper, canine hepatitis, leptospirosis (canicola, icterohaemorrhagiae), parvovirus, coronavirus, parainfluenza.
Cats: panleukopenia, viral rhinotracheitis, calicivirus.
Minimum age for entry: 15 weeks.
documents: Health certificate issued or endorsed by the origin country's official veterinary authority (original seal/signature or electronic signature), dated ≤10 calendar days before entry, stating animal is free of infectious/parasitic disease and fit to travel
Current vaccination certificate
Pre-CIS request and payment receipt (if done in SISPAP); one request per species, up to 10 animals
From the US: APHIS-endorsed health certificate within 10 days of travel plus rabies certificate; no consular stamp needed (per USDA APHIS)

at_a_glance.permit: Not required; CIS issued on arrival

steps.what: Rabies and core vaccines (primary rabies at least 21 days before)
Internal and external parasite treatment
Official health certificate, APHIS-endorsed for US pets
Optional SISPAP Pre-CIS request and payment to speed clearance
ICA inspection; the CIS is issued

key_points: Minimum age 15 weeks
Arriving off-hours, Sunday or holiday: tick 'Servicio Especial' in the Pre-CIS
ICA fee by card or Colombian bank account only; no cash
export_points: ICA issues an export CIS at airport or port offices; file in SISPAP with health and vaccine records
5 or more animals per person are treated as commercial

at_a_glance.permit: غير مطلوب؛ تصدر CIS عند الوصول
at_a_glance.health_certificate: قبل الدخول بـ≤10 أيام، مصادق عليها

steps.what: لقاح داء الكلب واللقاحات الأساسية (الجرعة الأولى لداء الكلب قبل 21 يومًا على الأقل)
علاج الطفيليات الداخلية والخارجية
شهادة صحية رسمية، مصادق عليها من APHIS للحيوانات القادمة من الولايات المتحدة
طلب Pre-CIS اختياري عبر SISPAP ودفع الرسوم لتسريع التخليص
فحص ICA وإصدار شهادة CIS

key_points: الحد الأدنى للعمر 15 أسبوعًا
الوصول خارج ساعات الدوام أو يوم الأحد أو في عطلة: يُرجى اختيار 'Servicio Especial' في طلب Pre-CIS
رسوم ICA بالبطاقة أو عبر حساب مصرفي كولومبي فقط؛ ولا يُقبل النقد
export_points: تُصدر ICA شهادة CIS للتصدير في مكاتب المطارات أو الموانئ؛ ويُقدَّم الطلب عبر SISPAP مع السجلات الصحية وسجلات اللقاحات
يُعامل 5 حيوانات أو أكثر لكل شخص معاملة تجارية
ar.summary: تحتاج الكلاب والقطط إلى شهادة صحية رسمية من بلد المنشأ مؤرخة قبل الدخول بما لا يزيد على 10 أيام تقويمية، وتطعيمات سارية (داء الكلب إضافة إلى اللقاحات الأساسية)، وعلاج الديدان خلال 60 يومًا؛ وعند الوصول تُجري ICA الفحص وتُصدر شهادة الفحص الصحي (Certificado de Inspección Sanitaria – CIS). ويتوفر التسجيل المسبق في نظام SISPAP التابع لـICA لتسريع التخليص.

steps.what: Tollwut- und Grundimpfungen (Tollwut-Erstimpfung mindestens 21 Tage vorher)
Behandlung gegen Innen- und Außenparasiten
Amtliches Gesundheitszeugnis, für Tiere aus den USA APHIS-beglaubigt
Optional: SISPAP-Pre-CIS-Antrag und Zahlung zur schnelleren Abfertigung
ICA-Kontrolle; das CIS wird ausgestellt

key_points: Mindestalter 15 Wochen
Ankunft außerhalb der Dienstzeiten, sonntags oder an Feiertagen: im Pre-CIS „Servicio Especial“ ankreuzen
ICA-Gebühr nur per Karte oder kolumbianischem Bankkonto; keine Barzahlung
export_points: Das ICA stellt in Büros an Flughäfen oder Häfen ein Ausfuhr-CIS aus; Antrag im SISPAP mit Gesundheits- und Impfnachweisen
Ab 5 Tieren pro Person gilt die Verbringung als kommerziell
de.summary: Hunde und Katzen benötigen ein amtliches Gesundheitszeugnis des Herkunftslandes, datiert höchstens 10 Kalendertage vor der Einreise, gültige Impfungen (Tollwut plus Grundimpfungen) und eine Entwurmung innerhalb von 60 Tagen; bei Ankunft kontrolliert das ICA und stellt das Certificado de Inspección Sanitaria (CIS) aus. Eine Vorregistrierung im SISPAP-System des ICA ist möglich, um die Abfertigung zu beschleunigen.

at_a_glance.permit: No se requiere; CIS emitido a la llegada
at_a_glance.health_certificate: ≤10 días antes de la entrada, refrendado
at_a_glance.quarantine: Solo si no se cumplen los requisitos

steps.what: Vacuna antirrábica y vacunas básicas (primovacunación antirrábica al menos 21 días antes)
Tratamiento antiparasitario interno y externo
Certificado sanitario oficial, refrendado por APHIS para mascotas de EE. UU.
Solicitud y pago opcionales del Pre-CIS en SISPAP para agilizar el despacho
Inspección del ICA; se emite el CIS

key_points: Edad mínima: 15 semanas
Llegada fuera de horario, en domingo o festivo: marque «Servicio Especial» en el Pre-CIS
Tasa del ICA solo con tarjeta o cuenta bancaria colombiana; no se acepta efectivo
export_points: El ICA emite un CIS de exportación en sus oficinas de aeropuertos o puertos; tramítelo en SISPAP con los registros sanitarios y de vacunación
5 o más animales por persona se consideran envío comercial
es.summary: Perros y gatos necesitan un certificado sanitario oficial del país de origen con fecha no anterior a 10 días naturales antes de la entrada, vacunas vigentes (antirrábica y básicas) y desparasitación en los 60 días previos; a la llegada, el ICA inspecciona y emite el Certificado de Inspección Sanitaria (CIS). Existe un prerregistro en el sistema SISPAP del ICA para agilizar el despacho.

at_a_glance.permit: Non requis ; CIS délivré à l'arrivée

steps.what: Rage et vaccins essentiels (primovaccination antirabique au moins 21 jours avant)
Traitement antiparasitaire interne et externe
Certificat sanitaire officiel, visé par l'APHIS pour les animaux venant des États-Unis
Demande Pré-CIS facultative et paiement via SISPAP pour accélérer le dédouanement
Inspection ICA ; délivrance du CIS

key_points: Âge minimum : 15 semaines
Arrivée hors horaires, le dimanche ou un jour férié : cochez « Servicio Especial » dans le Pré-CIS
Frais ICA réglables uniquement par carte ou compte bancaire colombien ; espèces refusées
export_points: L'ICA délivre un CIS d'exportation dans ses bureaux d'aéroport ou de port ; dépôt dans SISPAP avec le dossier sanitaire et vaccinal
À partir de 5 animaux par personne, le transport est considéré comme commercial
fr.summary: Les chiens et chats doivent disposer d'un certificat sanitaire officiel du pays d'origine daté de 10 jours calendaires au plus avant l'entrée, de vaccinations à jour (rage et vaccins essentiels) et d'un traitement antiparasitaire dans les 60 jours ; à l'arrivée, l'ICA procède à l'inspection et délivre le Certificado de Inspección Sanitaria (CIS). Une pré-inscription dans le système SISPAP de l'ICA permet d'accélérer le dédouanement.

steps.what: Vaccino antirabbico e vaccini di base (primovaccinazione antirabbica almeno 21 giorni prima)
Trattamento antiparassitario interno ed esterno
Certificato sanitario ufficiale, vidimato APHIS per gli animali provenienti dagli USA
Richiesta facoltativa del Pre-CIS su SISPAP, con relativo pagamento, per accelerare lo sdoganamento
Ispezione ICA e rilascio del CIS

key_points: Età minima 15 settimane
Arrivo fuori orario, di domenica o in un giorno festivo: selezionare 'Servicio Especial' nel Pre-CIS
Tariffa ICA pagabile solo con carta o conto bancario colombiano; non si accettano contanti
export_points: L'ICA rilascia un CIS di esportazione presso gli uffici aeroportuali o portuali; presentare la pratica su SISPAP con la documentazione sanitaria e vaccinale
5 o più animali per persona sono considerati spedizione commerciale
it.summary: Cani e gatti necessitano di un certificato sanitario ufficiale del Paese di origine datato non più di 10 giorni di calendario prima dell'ingresso, delle vaccinazioni in corso di validità (antirabbica e vaccini di base) e di sverminazione entro 60 giorni; all'arrivo l'ICA effettua l'ispezione e rilascia il Certificado de Inspección Sanitaria (CIS). Per accelerare lo sdoganamento è disponibile la preregistrazione nel sistema SISPAP dell'ICA.

at_a_glance.permit: Не требуется; CIS выдаётся по прибытии

steps.what: Прививки от бешенства и основные (первичная от бешенства — не менее чем за 21 день)
Обработка от внутренних и внешних паразитов
Официальный ветеринарный сертификат, для животных из США — с заверением APHIS
По желанию: запрос Pre-CIS в SISPAP и оплата для ускорения оформления
Досмотр ICA; выдаётся CIS

key_points: Минимальный возраст — 15 недель
Прибытие в нерабочее время, в воскресенье или праздник: отметьте «Servicio Especial» в Pre-CIS
Сбор ICA — только картой или с колумбийского банковского счёта; наличные не принимаются
export_points: ICA выдаёт экспортный CIS в офисах аэропорта или порта; подайте заявку в SISPAP с ветеринарными документами и записями о прививках
5 и более животных на человека считаются коммерческой перевозкой
ru.summary: Собакам и кошкам нужны официальный ветеринарный сертификат страны отправления, выданный не более чем за 10 календарных дней до въезда, действующие прививки (от бешенства и основные) и дегельминтизация в пределах 60 дней; по прибытии ICA проводит досмотр и выдаёт Certificado de Inspección Sanitaria (CIS). Для ускорения оформления доступна предварительная регистрация в системе ICA SISPAP.

countries.name: Costa Rica
countries.summary: Pets need an APHIS-endorsed bilingual health certificate: exam within 2 weeks of departure, endo/ectoparasite treatment within 15 days, core vaccines, and rabies vaccination (current at entry) for animals over 3 months. An import permit is needed only for unaccompanied pets.
countries.parasite_treatment: Endo- and ectoparasite treatment within 15 days before export (product, active ingredient and lot recorded); free of ticks.
countries.import_permit: Required only for unaccompanied pets (MAG/SENASA importer process).
countries.timeline: Plan at least 3 weeks before travel: vaccines current, parasite treatment within 15 days, vet exam within 14 days, APHIS endorsement.
countries.export: Return to the US: Costa Rica is NOT on the CDC high-risk list. It is screwworm-affected, so dogs need a screwworm certificate.
countries.authority: Servicio Nacional de Salud Animal (SENASA), Ministerio de Agricultura y Ganadería
vaccinations: Rabies: dogs and cats over 3 months, vaccine valid on the day of entry.
Dogs: distemper, hepatitis, parvovirus and leptospirosis.
Cats: rhinotracheitis, calicivirus and panleukopenia.
documents: US health certificate for dogs and cats to Costa Rica (exam within 2 weeks of departure), endorsed by APHIS (digital via VEHCS).

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: Current at entry, pets over 3 months

steps.what: Bring rabies and core vaccines up to date
Treat for internal and external parasites; pet must be tick-free
Vet exam and bilingual US health certificate
APHIS endorsement (digital via VEHCS)

key_points: Dogs also need distemper, hepatitis, parvovirus and leptospirosis vaccines
Cats also need rhinotracheitis, calicivirus and panleukopenia vaccines
export_points: Return to the US: Costa Rica is not on the CDC high-risk rabies list
Screwworm-affected: dogs need a screwworm certificate to return to the US

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ساري عند الدخول، لمن تجاوز 3 أشهر

steps.what: تحديث لقاح داء الكلب واللقاحات الأساسية
علاج الطفيليات الداخلية والخارجية؛ ويجب أن يكون الحيوان خاليًا من القراد
فحص بيطري وشهادة صحية أمريكية ثنائية اللغة
مصادقة APHIS (رقميًا عبر VEHCS)

key_points: تحتاج الكلاب أيضًا إلى لقاحات السُّعار الكلبي (الديستمبر) والتهاب الكبد والبارفو وداء البريميات
تحتاج القطط أيضًا إلى لقاحات التهاب الأنف والرغامى، والفيروس الكأسي، وقلة الكريات البيض
export_points: العودة إلى الولايات المتحدة: كوستاريكا غير مُدرجة في قائمة CDC للدول عالية المخاطر لداء الكلب
متأثرة بدودة الحلزون: تحتاج الكلاب إلى شهادة بشأن دودة الحلزون للعودة إلى الولايات المتحدة
ar.summary: تحتاج الحيوانات الأليفة إلى شهادة صحية ثنائية اللغة مصادق عليها من APHIS: فحص خلال أسبوعين (2) من المغادرة، وعلاج الطفيليات الداخلية/الخارجية خلال 15 يومًا، واللقاحات الأساسية، والتطعيم ضد داء الكلب (ساري عند الدخول) للحيوانات التي يزيد عمرها على 3 أشهر. ولا يلزم تصريح استيراد إلا للحيوانات غير المرافقة.

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: Bei Einreise gültig, Tiere über 3 Monate

steps.what: Tollwut- und Grundimpfungen auf den aktuellen Stand bringen
Behandlung gegen Innen- und Außenparasiten; das Tier muss zeckenfrei sein
Tierärztliche Untersuchung und zweisprachiges US-Gesundheitszeugnis
APHIS-Beglaubigung (digital über VEHCS)

key_points: Hunde benötigen zudem Impfungen gegen Staupe, Hepatitis, Parvovirose und Leptospirose
Katzen benötigen zudem Impfungen gegen Rhinotracheitis, Calicivirus und Panleukopenie
export_points: Rückkehr in die USA: Costa Rica steht nicht auf der CDC-Liste der Länder mit hohem Tollwutrisiko
Vom Schraubenwurm betroffen: Hunde benötigen für die Rückkehr in die USA eine Schraubenwurm-Bescheinigung
de.summary: Heimtiere benötigen ein APHIS-beglaubigtes zweisprachiges Gesundheitszeugnis: Untersuchung innerhalb von 2 Wochen vor Abflug, Behandlung gegen Endo-/Ektoparasiten innerhalb von 15 Tagen, Grundimpfungen und eine (bei Einreise gültige) Tollwutimpfung für Tiere über 3 Monate. Eine Einfuhrgenehmigung ist nur für unbegleitete Heimtiere nötig.

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: Vigente a la entrada, mayores de 3 meses

steps.what: Ponga al día la vacuna antirrábica y las vacunas básicas
Tratamiento antiparasitario interno y externo; la mascota debe estar libre de garrapatas
Examen veterinario y certificado sanitario bilingüe de EE. UU.
Refrendo de APHIS (digital a través de VEHCS)

key_points: Los perros necesitan además vacunas contra moquillo, hepatitis, parvovirus y leptospirosis
Los gatos necesitan además vacunas contra rinotraqueítis, calicivirus y panleucopenia
export_points: Regreso a EE. UU.: Costa Rica no figura en la lista de alto riesgo de rabia de los CDC
Zona afectada por gusano barrenador: los perros necesitan un certificado de gusano barrenador para regresar a EE. UU.
es.summary: Las mascotas necesitan un certificado sanitario bilingüe refrendado por APHIS: examen en las 2 semanas previas a la salida, tratamiento contra endoparásitos y ectoparásitos en los 15 días previos, vacunas básicas y vacunación antirrábica (vigente a la entrada) para animales de más de 3 meses. Solo se necesita permiso de importación para mascotas no acompañadas.

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: À jour à l'entrée, animaux de plus de 3 mois

steps.what: Mettre à jour la vaccination antirabique et les vaccins essentiels
Traitement antiparasitaire interne et externe ; l'animal doit être exempt de tiques
Examen vétérinaire et certificat sanitaire américain bilingue
Visa APHIS (numérique via VEHCS)

key_points: Les chiens doivent aussi être vaccinés contre la maladie de Carré, l'hépatite, la parvovirose et la leptospirose
Les chats doivent aussi être vaccinés contre la rhinotrachéite, la calicivirose et la panleucopénie
export_points: Retour aux États-Unis : le Costa Rica ne figure pas sur la liste CDC des pays à haut risque de rage
Zone touchée par la lucilie bouchère (screwworm) : les chiens ont besoin d'un certificat screwworm pour revenir aux États-Unis
fr.summary: Les animaux doivent disposer d'un certificat sanitaire bilingue visé par l'APHIS : examen dans les 2 semaines précédant le départ, traitement endo/ectoparasitaire dans les 15 jours, vaccins essentiels et vaccination antirabique (à jour à l'entrée) pour les animaux de plus de 3 mois. Un permis d'importation n'est requis que pour les animaux non accompagnés.

steps.what: Aggiornare il vaccino antirabbico e i vaccini di base
Trattamento contro parassiti interni ed esterni; l'animale deve essere privo di zecche
Visita veterinaria e certificato sanitario USA bilingue
Vidimazione APHIS (digitale tramite VEHCS)

key_points: I cani necessitano anche dei vaccini contro cimurro, epatite, parvovirosi e leptospirosi
I gatti necessitano anche dei vaccini contro rinotracheite, calicivirus e panleucopenia
export_points: Rientro negli USA: il Costa Rica non figura nell'elenco CDC dei Paesi ad alto rischio di rabbia
Paese colpito dal verme avvitatore (Cochliomyia hominivorax): i cani necessitano di un certificato per il verme avvitatore per rientrare negli USA
it.summary: Gli animali necessitano di un certificato sanitario bilingue vidimato APHIS: visita entro 2 settimane dalla partenza, trattamento endo/ectoparassitario entro 15 giorni, vaccini di base e vaccinazione antirabbica (valida all'ingresso) per gli animali di oltre 3 mesi. Il permesso d'importazione è richiesto solo per gli animali non accompagnati.

steps.what: Обновите прививки от бешенства и основные
Обработайте от внутренних и внешних паразитов; на животном не должно быть клещей
Ветеринарный осмотр и двуязычный ветеринарный сертификат США
Заверение APHIS (электронное через VEHCS)

key_points: Собакам также нужны прививки от чумы плотоядных, гепатита, парвовироза и лептоспироза
Кошкам также нужны прививки от ринотрахеита, калицивироза и панлейкопении
export_points: Возвращение в США: Коста-Рика не входит в перечень CDC стран высокого риска по бешенству
Зона распространения винтовой мухи: собакам нужен сертификат об отсутствии винтовой мухи для возвращения в США
ru.summary: Животным нужен двуязычный ветеринарный сертификат с заверением APHIS: осмотр в пределах 2 недель до вылета, обработка от эндо-/эктопаразитов в пределах 15 дней, основные прививки и вакцинация против бешенства (действующая на дату въезда) для животных старше 3 месяцев. Разрешение на ввоз нужно только для несопровождаемых животных.

countries.name: Cuba
countries.summary: Under Resolución 165/2026 (MINAG, Gaceta Oficial No. 75 Ordinaria of 9 Sep 2026, regulation of Decreto-Ley 127), animal-health inspectors may admit domestic dogs and cats that are vaccinated against rabies and other diseases in the import requirements and that carry a veterinary certificate from the origin country. Entry can be refused for zoosanitary reasons tied to the origin country. Home quarantine under supervision is permitted. Certificate timing and the list of other vaccines are not published, so confirm with CENASA.
countries.microchip: Not mentioned in Resolución 165/2026.
countries.import_permit: Not specified for accompanied pets. CENASA's director publishes a resolution, after risk analysis, listing countries and products eligible for travellers' imports (art. 17).
countries.quarantine: Arrival inspection is mandatory at ports and airports (art. 16). Dogs and cats may do home quarantine under the territorial animal-health department's supervision, if CENASA's requirements are met (arts. 13 and 43). Duration is not published. Non-compliant animals may be held, confiscated or re-shipped (art. 24).
countries.timeline: Plan at least 1 month before travel: get CENASA's current requirements in writing (vaccines, certificate validity), then vaccinate, then get the origin veterinary certificate. Expect inspection and home quarantine on arrival.
countries.private_aviation: Aircraft arriving from abroad may not arrive with live animals unless authorised by CENASA, nor release animals, including pets, without animal-health control (Res. 165/2026, art. 42.3). The inspector briefs the captain on arrival. Get prior CENASA clearance for a private arrival. US sanctions and travel restrictions on Cuba also apply.
countries.export: Return to the US: Cuba is a CDC high-risk dog-rabies country. US dogs need the USDA-endorsed CDC rabies certification before leaving the US, and Cuba is on APHIS's screwworm-affected list.
countries.authority: Centro Nacional de Sanidad Animal (CENASA), Ministerio de la Agricultura, Cuba
vaccinations: Rabies: required (Res. 165/2026, art. 18.1a).
Other vaccines 'established in import requirements' are not listed in the regulation. Confirm with CENASA.
documents: Veterinary certificate issued in the country of origin (art. 18.1a). Its content is harmonised between CENASA and the origin authority (art. 20).

steps.what: Get CENASA's current requirements in writing
Vaccinate against rabies and any other required diseases
Obtain the origin-country veterinary certificate
Mandatory inspection; expect supervised home quarantine

key_points: Certificate timing and other vaccines are not published: confirm with CENASA
Entry can be refused for health reasons linked to the origin country
Non-compliant pets may be held, confiscated or re-shipped
export_points: Return to the US: Cuba is a CDC high-risk dog-rabies country
US dogs need the USDA-endorsed CDC rabies certification before leaving the US
Cuba is on the APHIS screwworm-affected list
countries.private_jet_note: Aircraft may not arrive with live animals without CENASA authorisation. Obtain CENASA clearance before the flight; US sanctions on Cuba also apply.

steps.what: الحصول على متطلبات CENASA الحالية كتابيًا
التطعيم ضد داء الكلب وأي أمراض أخرى مطلوبة
الحصول على الشهادة البيطرية من بلد المنشأ
فحص إلزامي؛ مع توقّع حجر صحي منزلي تحت الإشراف

key_points: توقيت الشهادة واللقاحات الأخرى غير منشورة: يُرجى التأكيد مع CENASA
يجوز رفض الدخول لأسباب صحية مرتبطة ببلد المنشأ
قد تُحتجز الحيوانات غير المستوفية أو تُصادر أو يُعاد شحنها
export_points: العودة إلى الولايات المتحدة: كوبا مصنفة لدى CDC دولةً عالية المخاطر لداء الكلب
تحتاج الكلاب الأمريكية إلى شهادة CDC لداء الكلب مصادق عليها من USDA قبل مغادرة الولايات المتحدة
كوبا مُدرجة في قائمة APHIS للدول المتأثرة بدودة الحلزون
ar.private_jet_note: لا يجوز للطائرات الوصول وعلى متنها حيوانات حية دون إذن من CENASA. يُرجى الحصول على موافقة CENASA قبل الرحلة؛ كما تُطبَّق العقوبات الأمريكية على كوبا.
ar.summary: بموجب القرار Resolución 165/2026 (MINAG، الجريدة الرسمية العدد 75 العادي بتاريخ 9 سبتمبر 2026، اللائحة التنفيذية للمرسوم بقانون Decreto-Ley 127)، يجوز لمفتشي الصحة الحيوانية قبول الكلاب والقطط المنزلية المطعّمة ضد داء الكلب وغيره من الأمراض الواردة في متطلبات الاستيراد، والتي تحمل شهادة بيطرية من بلد المنشأ. ويجوز رفض الدخول لأسباب صحية حيوانية مرتبطة ببلد المنشأ. ويُسمح بالحجر الصحي المنزلي تحت الإشراف. لا يُنشر توقيت الشهادة ولا قائمة اللقاحات الأخرى، لذا يُرجى التأكيد مع CENASA.

export_points: Rückkehr in die USA: Kuba ist bei der CDC ein Hochrisikoland für Hundetollwut
Hunde aus den USA benötigen vor der Ausreise aus den USA die USDA-beglaubigte CDC-Tollwutbescheinigung

de.summary: Gemäß Resolución 165/2026 (MINAG, Gaceta Oficial Nr. 75 Ordinaria vom 9. Sept. 2026, Durchführungsbestimmung zum Decreto-Ley 127) können Tiergesundheitsinspektoren Haushunde und -katzen zulassen, die gegen Tollwut und weitere in den Einfuhrbestimmungen genannte Krankheiten geimpft sind und ein tierärztliches Zeugnis des Herkunftslandes mitführen. Die Einreise kann aus zoosanitären Gründen im Zusammenhang mit dem Herkunftsland verweigert werden. Eine überwachte Heimquarantäne ist zulässig. Zeitvorgaben für das Zeugnis und die Liste weiterer Impfungen sind nicht veröffentlicht; bitte bei CENASA bestätigen lassen.

export_points: Regreso a EE. UU.: Cuba es un país de alto riesgo de rabia canina según los CDC
Los perros estadounidenses necesitan la certificación antirrábica de los CDC refrendada por el USDA antes de salir de EE. UU.

es.summary: Conforme a la Resolución 165/2026 (MINAG, Gaceta Oficial No. 75 Ordinaria de 9 de septiembre de 2026, reglamento del Decreto-Ley 127), los inspectores de sanidad animal pueden admitir perros y gatos domésticos vacunados contra la rabia y contra las demás enfermedades previstas en los requisitos de importación, que porten un certificado veterinario del país de origen. La entrada puede denegarse por motivos zoosanitarios relacionados con el país de origen. Se permite la cuarentena domiciliaria bajo supervisión. El plazo del certificado y la lista de otras vacunas no se publican, por lo que conviene confirmarlos con el CENASA.

countries.name: Cyprus
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the Veterinary Services before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Cyprus and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Points of entry: Larnaka and Pafos international airports, plus Limassol, Larnaka, Paphos and Latchi ports and Limassol, Larnaka and Saint Raphael marinas. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Veterinary Services, Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Environment
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Young animals: Cyprus does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

countries.name: Czechia
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the SVS before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by the Czech Republic and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Czech points of entry are published by the State Veterinary Administration (SVS); confirm with SVS before travel that the arrival airport is on the list. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: State Veterinary Administration (SVS)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

Young animals: The Czech Republic accepts non-commercial entry from other EU states of pets under 12 weeks that are unvaccinated, or 12–16 weeks old and vaccinated but before the 21-day wait ends, with the owner's declaration of no contact with rabies-susceptible wild animals, or accompanied by the vaccinated mother. Never allowed from outside the EU.

countries.name: Germany
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry. Import ban on four bull-terrier-type breeds except for stays up to 4 weeks.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Federal import ban (Dog Transfer and Import Restrictions Act) on Pit Bull Terrier, American Staffordshire Terrier, Staffordshire Bull Terrier, Bull Terrier and their crosses. Exceptions: visitors staying no longer than 4 weeks; dogs returning to the Land where owner is authorised to keep them; service/guide/rescue dogs (with documents). Länder may restrict further breeds.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City) may only use authorised entry points published by the Federal Ministry of Agriculture (BMLEH), where customs or the veterinary service read the microchip and check documents. Confirm with the airport customs office before routing that the arrival airport is an authorised entry point. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no border check.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Federal Ministry of Agriculture (BMLEH) / Länder veterinary authorities; German Customs (Zoll)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Young animals: Germany does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

countries.name: Denmark
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry. Denmark bans 13 dog breeds (and crosses), including for visitors.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: 13 prohibited breeds and their crosses: Pit Bull Terrier, Tosa Inu, American Staffordshire Terrier, Fila Brasileiro, Dogo Argentino, American Bulldog, Boerboel, Kangal, Central Asian Ovcharka, Caucasian Ovcharka, South Russian Ovcharka, Tornjak, Sarplaninac. Ban applies to tourists too (unless documented as acquired before the 2010 Act). Transit allowed if the dog stays in the vehicle with no unnecessary stops.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Denmark and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Only three points of entry for pets arriving directly from non-EU countries: Copenhagen Airport (Kastrup), Billund Airport and Aalborg Airport; entry through any other airport or port is not permitted. Pets from Andorra, the Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, Norway, San Marino, Switzerland and Vatican City may enter anywhere. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Danish Veterinary and Food Administration (Fødevarestyrelsen)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Young animals: Denmark does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

Max 5 animali per movimentazione; ciascuno viaggia con il proprietario o entro 5 giorni
Da Paesi non elencati (ad es. Turchia, Marocco, Israele, Thailandia, Sudafrica): titolazione più attesa di 3 mesi
I certificati UE del vecchio modello sono accettati solo se rilasciati prima del 1 ott 2026
export_points: Verso Paesi UE/SEE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia rilasciato da un veterinario autorizzato
I cani diretti in FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Nord necessitano anche del trattamento contro la tenia (Echinococcus)
Verso Paesi extra UE: rispettare le norme della destinazione; il servizio veterinario ufficiale vidima i certificati
it.private_jet_note: Dall'esterno dell'UE, gli animali possono entrare soltanto attraverso Copenaghen, Billund o Aalborg. Nessun altro aeroporto danese è consentito.
it.summary: Norme UE (Regolamento delegato (UE) 2026/131): da un altro Stato UE/SEE, animale con microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica valida e passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia; da fuori UE, certificato sanitario UE per animali (più titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici con attesa di 3 mesi se il Paese non è elencato) e controlli documentali e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori. La Danimarca vieta 13 razze canine (e i relativi incroci), anche per i visitatori.

at_a_glance.microchip: Чип ISO, до прививки от бешенства
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Паспорт или сертификат ЕС ≤10 дней (не из ЕС)

steps.what: Микрочип ISO, затем прививка от бешенства (животному 12+ недель)
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной
Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС, заверенный USDA APHIS; из ЕС: европейский паспорт животного
Имейте при себе подписанную декларацию о некоммерческом перемещении (не из ЕС)
Из-за пределов ЕС: проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников

key_points: Запрещены 13 пород, включая для туристов (например, питбуль, тоса, аргентинский дог, кангал, бурбуль)
Запрещённые породы могут следовать транзитом, только оставаясь в транспортном средстве
Не более 5 животных за одно перемещение; каждое следует с владельцем или в пределах 5 дней
Из стран вне перечня (например, Турция, Марокко, Израиль, Таиланд, ЮАР): тест на титр плюс ожидание 3 месяца
Сертификаты ЕС старого образца принимаются, только если выданы до 1 октября 2026 г.
export_points: В страны ЕС/ЕЭЗ: европейский паспорт животного от уполномоченного ветеринара
Собакам, направляющимся в FI, IE, MT, NO или Северную Ирландию, также нужна обработка от ленточных червей
В страны вне ЕС: соблюдайте правила страны назначения; сертификаты заверяет официальная ветеринарная служба
ru.private_jet_note: При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС животные могут въезжать только через Копенгаген, Биллунн или Ольборг. Другие аэропорты Дании не допускаются.
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников. Дания запрещает 13 пород собак (и их помеси), в том числе для приезжающих.

countries.name: Dominica
countries.summary: An import permit from the Veterinary Services (Livestock Development & Veterinary Unit) is required. To get it, a dog or cat needs rabies vaccination 30 days to 1 year before export, a FAVN/RNATT titer of at least 0.5 IU/ml drawn at least 1 month after vaccination (lab results sent direct to Veterinary Services), heartworm test and treatment, parasite freedom, DHLPP+C records and a vet health certificate. Official guidance dates from 2011, and the 1955 regulations limit dog and cat origins, so confirm before booking.
countries.microchip: Not mentioned in official guidance.
countries.rabies_titer: RNATT/FAVN at a reputable rabies reference laboratory, at least 0.5 IU/ml, sampled at least 1 month after vaccination. The lab sends results directly to Veterinary Services before the permit is issued. Results take 3–4 weeks or longer.
countries.parasite_treatment: The animal must be free of internal and external parasites, and tested and treated for heartworm, with heartworm-free certification for export.
countries.import_permit: Required for every animal (reg. 4), from the Chief Technical Officer / Veterinary Unit, Botanic Gardens, Roseau. 2011 contacts: tel. (767) 266-3827/3824; agrivet4@hotmail.com / forestvet@gmail.com. Processing and other fees may apply. Reg. 10(1) (as amended 1990) allows dogs and cats only directly from Great Britain, Northern Ireland, Ireland and Commonwealth Caribbean territories. The 2011 guidance covers 'all countries', so confirm in writing how US/EU-origin pets are permitted.
countries.quarantine: The inspector may order quarantine in an approved depot at the consignee's cost and risk (regs. 7–8). The 2011 guidance says the Quarantine Inspector examines the pet on arrival and may accept or reject it.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 30 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (at least 1 month earlier): FAVN blood draw with a 3–4 week result sent directly to Veterinary Services, then heartworm test, parasite treatment, import permit, health certificate and endorsement.
countries.private_aviation: Animals may be landed only at Roseau or Portsmouth ports or an official airport, unless the Chief Technical Officer gives a written permit for another place. No animal may be landed without the inspector's prior written permission (regs. 5–6). Coordinate the inspector for Douglas-Charles (DOM) or Canefield (DCF).
countries.authority: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Blue and Green Economy: Division of Agriculture, Livestock Development & Veterinary Unit (Chief Technical Officer / Veterinary Services)
vaccinations: Rabies: approved vaccine given by an official veterinarian, at least 30 days and not more than 1 year before export, recording type, serial number, expiry and date.
Current DHLPP+C immunisation record, or for other endemic diseases of importance.
documents: Import permit, sent by fax or email once the requirements are met.
Health certificate from a licensed, accredited veterinary authority in the exporting country.

Under the Animals Diseases (Importation) Control Regulations (Chap. 61:02, reg. 10, as amended 1990), the certificate must be by a government veterinary officer of the exporting country. It must state good health and that there has been no rabies among unquarantined animals in that country for the past 6 months.
Vaccination records and FAVN result.

steps.what: FAVN blood test ≥1 month after rabies vaccine; lab sends result to Dominica
Apply for import permit from the Veterinary Unit, Roseau
Heartworm test and parasite treatment
Government-vet health certificate
Quarantine Inspector examines the pet and may accept or reject it

key_points: Regulations allow pets only from GB, Ireland and Commonwealth Caribbean: confirm US/EU in writing
Current DHLPP+C vaccination record also required
countries.private_jet_note: No animal may be landed without the inspector's prior written permission. Arrange the inspector for Douglas-Charles (DOM) or Canefield (DCF) in advance.

at_a_glance.parasites: خلو من الطفيليات؛ فحص وعلاج الدودة القلبية

steps.what: فحص الدم FAVN بعد ≥1 شهر من لقاح داء الكلب؛ ويرسل المختبر النتيجة إلى دومينيكا
التقدّم بطلب تصريح الاستيراد من الوحدة البيطرية في روسو
فحص الدودة القلبية وعلاج الطفيليات
شهادة صحية من طبيب بيطري حكومي
يفحص مفتش الحجر الصحي الحيوان الأليف ويجوز له قبوله أو رفضه

key_points: تسمح اللوائح بالحيوانات الأليفة فقط من بريطانيا العظمى وأيرلندا ودول الكومنولث الكاريبية: يُرجى تأكيد الولايات المتحدة/الاتحاد الأوروبي كتابيًا
يلزم أيضًا سجل تطعيم DHLPP+C ساري المفعول
ar.private_jet_note: لا يجوز إنزال أي حيوان دون إذن كتابي مسبق من المفتش. يُرجى ترتيب حضور المفتش في مطار دوغلاس-تشارلز (DOM) أو كانفيلد (DCF) مسبقًا.
ar.summary: يلزم الحصول على تصريح استيراد من الخدمات البيطرية (وحدة تنمية الثروة الحيوانية والخدمات البيطرية). وللحصول عليه، يحتاج الكلب أو القطة إلى تطعيم ضد داء الكلب قبل التصدير بمدة من 30 يومًا إلى سنة 1، ومعايرة أجسام مضادة FAVN/RNATT لا تقل عن 0.5 IU/ml تُسحب عينتها بعد التطعيم بشهر 1 على الأقل (تُرسَل نتائج المختبر مباشرة إلى الخدمات البيطرية)، وفحص الدودة القلبية وعلاجها، والخلو من الطفيليات، وسجلات لقاح DHLPP+C، وشهادة صحية بيطرية. تعود الإرشادات الرسمية إلى عام 2011، وتُقيّد لوائح عام 1955 بلدان منشأ الكلاب والقطط، لذا يُرجى التأكيد قبل الحجز.

steps.what: FAVN-Bluttest ≥1 Monat nach Tollwutimpfung; das Labor sendet das Ergebnis nach Dominica
Einfuhrgenehmigung bei der Veterinary Unit in Roseau beantragen
Herzwurmtest und Parasitenbehandlung
Gesundheitszeugnis eines Amtstierarztes
Der Quarantäneinspektor untersucht das Tier und kann es zulassen oder abweisen

key_points: Die Verordnung erlaubt Heimtiere nur aus GB, Irland und der Commonwealth-Karibik: USA/EU schriftlich bestätigen lassen
Aktueller DHLPP+C-Impfnachweis ebenfalls erforderlich
de.private_jet_note: Ohne vorherige schriftliche Erlaubnis des Inspektors darf kein Tier an Land gebracht werden. Organisieren Sie den Inspektor für Douglas-Charles (DOM) oder Canefield (DCF) im Voraus.
de.summary: Eine Einfuhrgenehmigung der Veterinary Services (Livestock Development & Veterinary Unit) ist erforderlich. Dafür benötigt ein Hund oder eine Katze eine Tollwutimpfung 30 Tage bis 1 Jahr vor der Ausfuhr, einen FAVN/RNATT-Titer von mindestens 0,5 IE/ml aus einer Blutprobe mindestens 1 Monat nach der Impfung (Laborergebnisse direkt an die Veterinary Services), Herzwurmtest und -behandlung, Parasitenfreiheit, DHLPP+C-Nachweise und ein tierärztliches Gesundheitszeugnis. Die offiziellen Hinweise stammen von 2011, und die Verordnung von 1955 beschränkt die zulässigen Herkunftsländer für Hunde und Katzen; bitte vor der Buchung bestätigen lassen.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: Veterinario oficial del país de origen

Prueba de dirofilariosis y tratamiento antiparasitario
Certificado sanitario de un veterinario oficial

Se exige además el registro vigente de vacunación DHLPP+C
es.private_jet_note: Ningún animal puede desembarcarse sin el permiso previo y por escrito del inspector. Organice con antelación la presencia del inspector en Douglas-Charles (DOM) o Canefield (DCF).
es.summary: Se requiere un permiso de importación de los Servicios Veterinarios (Livestock Development & Veterinary Unit). Para obtenerlo, el perro o gato necesita vacunación antirrábica entre 30 días y 1 año antes de la exportación, una titulación FAVN/RNATT de al menos 0,5 UI/ml extraída al menos 1 mes después de la vacunación (resultados enviados directamente por el laboratorio a los Servicios Veterinarios), prueba y tratamiento de dirofilariosis, ausencia de parásitos, registro de vacunas DHLPP+C y un certificado sanitario veterinario. La guía oficial data de 2011 y el reglamento de 1955 limita los orígenes de perros y gatos, por lo que conviene confirmarlo antes de reservar.

steps.what: Prise de sang FAVN ≥ 1 mois après le vaccin antirabique ; le laboratoire envoie le résultat à la Dominique
Demander le permis d'importation auprès de la Veterinary Unit, à Roseau
Test de dirofilariose et traitement antiparasitaire
Certificat sanitaire d'un vétérinaire officiel
Le Quarantine Inspector examine l'animal et peut l'accepter ou le refuser

key_points: La réglementation n'admet que les animaux venant de GB, d'Irlande et des Caraïbes du Commonwealth : obtenez une confirmation écrite pour les États-Unis/l'UE
Un carnet de vaccination DHLPP+C à jour est également requis
fr.private_jet_note: Aucun animal ne peut être débarqué sans l'autorisation écrite préalable de l'inspecteur. Organisez à l'avance la présence de l'inspecteur à Douglas-Charles (DOM) ou Canefield (DCF).
fr.summary: Un permis d'importation des Veterinary Services (Livestock Development & Veterinary Unit) est requis. Pour l'obtenir, le chien ou chat doit disposer d'une vaccination antirabique effectuée entre 30 jours et 1 an avant l'export, d'un titrage FAVN/RNATT d'au moins 0,5 UI/ml prélevé au moins 1 mois après la vaccination (résultats envoyés directement par le laboratoire aux Veterinary Services), d'un test et d'un traitement contre la dirofilariose, d'une attestation d'absence de parasites, d'un carnet de vaccination DHLPP+C et d'un certificat sanitaire vétérinaire. Les recommandations officielles datent de 2011 et la réglementation de 1955 limite les provenances autorisées des chiens et chats : confirmez avant de réserver.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: Veterinario governativo del Paese di origine
at_a_glance.parasites: Senza parassiti; test e terapia filariosi

Richiedere il permesso d'importazione alla Veterinary Unit di Roseau
Test per la filariosi cardiopolmonare e trattamento antiparassitario
Certificato sanitario di un veterinario governativo

Richiesto anche il libretto vaccinale DHLPP+C aggiornato

it.summary: È richiesto un permesso d'importazione dei Servizi Veterinari (Livestock Development & Veterinary Unit). Per ottenerlo, cani e gatti necessitano di vaccinazione antirabbica tra 30 giorni e 1 anno prima dell'esportazione, di una titolazione FAVN/RNATT di almeno 0,5 UI/ml con prelievo effettuato almeno 1 mese dopo la vaccinazione (risultati inviati dal laboratorio direttamente ai Servizi Veterinari), di test e trattamento per la filariosi cardiopolmonare, dell'assenza di parassiti, del libretto vaccinale DHLPP+C e di un certificato sanitario veterinario. Le indicazioni ufficiali risalgono al 2011 e il regolamento del 1955 limita le provenienze di cani e gatti: si raccomanda quindi di verificare prima della prenotazione.

Карантинный инспектор осматривает животное и может допустить или не допустить его

key_points: Правила допускают животных только из Великобритании, Ирландии и стран Карибского Содружества: подтвердите США/ЕС письменно
Также требуется действующая запись о вакцинации DHLPP+C
ru.private_jet_note: Ни одно животное не может быть выгружено без предварительного письменного разрешения инспектора. Заранее договоритесь о присутствии инспектора в Дуглас-Чарльз (DOM) или Кейнфилд (DCF).
ru.summary: Требуется разрешение на ввоз от Ветеринарной службы (Livestock Development & Veterinary Unit). Для его получения собаке или кошке необходимы вакцинация против бешенства за 30 дней – 1 год до вывоза, титр FAVN/RNATT не ниже 0.5 МЕ/мл по крови, взятой не ранее чем через 1 месяц после вакцинации (результаты лаборатория направляет непосредственно в Ветеринарную службу), тест на дирофиляриоз и лечение, отсутствие паразитов, записи о прививках DHLPP+C и ветеринарный сертификат. Официальные рекомендации датированы 2011 годом, а правила 1955 года ограничивают страны происхождения собак и кошек, поэтому уточните до бронирования.

countries.name: Dominican Republic
countries.summary: Personal dogs and cats need an APHIS-endorsed health certificate (valid 10 days) showing current rabies vaccination; a first vaccination must be at least 30 days before travel. No import permit is needed for personal pets.
countries.import_permit: Not required for personal pets. Commercial imports need a permit from the Dirección General de Ganadería.
countries.timeline: Plan at least 5 weeks before travel for an unvaccinated pet (rabies vaccine at least 30 days before departure); otherwise about 2 weeks for the vet certificate (within 10 days) and APHIS endorsement.
countries.export: Return to the US: the Dominican Republic IS a CDC high-risk dog-rabies country. US dogs need the USDA-endorsed Certification of U.S.-issued Rabies Vaccination before leaving the US; foreign-vaccinated dogs must use an airport with a CDC-registered facility. Screwworm certificate required (APHIS-affected list).
countries.authority: Dirección General de Ganadería (DIGEGA), Ministerio de Agricultura
vaccinations: Rabies: required once old enough (12 weeks). Must be current per the manufacturer's validity; a first-time vaccine must be given at least 30 days before departure. The vet may certify too-young animals as unvaccinated.
documents: US health certificate for dogs and/or cats to the Dominican Republic (bilingual), valid 10 days after issuance, endorsed by APHIS (digital via VEHCS accepted).
No consular endorsement required for personal pets.

steps.what: First-time rabies vaccine (12+ weeks old) at least 30 days before departure
Vet issues bilingual US health certificate
APHIS endorsement (digital via VEHCS accepted)

key_points: No consular endorsement needed for personal pets
Pets too young for rabies vaccine can be certified as unvaccinated
export_points: Return to the US: CDC high-risk dog-rabies country; screwworm certificate required
US-vaccinated dogs need USDA-endorsed rabies certification before leaving the US
Foreign-vaccinated dogs must use a US airport with a CDC-registered facility

at_a_glance.health_certificate: ثنائية اللغة، صالحة 10 أيام، مصادقة APHIS

steps.what: أول لقاح لداء الكلب (بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا) قبل المغادرة بـ30 يومًا على الأقل
يُصدر الطبيب البيطري شهادة صحية أمريكية ثنائية اللغة
مصادقة APHIS (تُقبل المصادقة الرقمية عبر VEHCS)

يمكن إثبات أن الحيوانات الأصغر من سن لقاح داء الكلب غير مطعّمة
export_points: العودة إلى الولايات المتحدة: دولة عالية المخاطر لداء الكلب لدى CDC؛ وتلزم شهادة بشأن دودة الحلزون
تحتاج الكلاب المطعّمة في الولايات المتحدة إلى شهادة داء الكلب مصادق عليها من USDA قبل مغادرة الولايات المتحدة
يجب أن تستخدم الكلاب المطعّمة في الخارج مطارًا أمريكيًا فيه منشأة مسجلة لدى CDC
ar.summary: تحتاج الكلاب والقطط الشخصية إلى شهادة صحية مصادق عليها من APHIS (صالحة 10 أيام) تُثبت تطعيمًا ساريًا ضد داء الكلب؛ ويجب أن يكون التطعيم الأول قبل السفر بـ30 يومًا على الأقل. لا يلزم تصريح استيراد للحيوانات الأليفة الشخصية.

steps.what: Erste Tollwutimpfung (ab 12 Wochen) mindestens 30 Tage vor Abflug
Tierarzt stellt zweisprachiges US-Gesundheitszeugnis aus
APHIS-Beglaubigung (digital über VEHCS akzeptiert)

key_points: Keine konsularische Beglaubigung für private Heimtiere nötig
Für die Tollwutimpfung zu junge Tiere können als ungeimpft bescheinigt werden
export_points: Rückkehr in die USA: CDC-Hochrisikoland für Hundetollwut; Schraubenwurm-Bescheinigung erforderlich
In den USA geimpfte Hunde benötigen vor der Ausreise aus den USA eine USDA-beglaubigte Tollwutbescheinigung
Im Ausland geimpfte Hunde müssen einen US-Flughafen mit CDC-registrierter Einrichtung nutzen
de.summary: Private Hunde und Katzen benötigen ein APHIS-beglaubigtes Gesundheitszeugnis (10 Tage gültig) mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung; eine Erstimpfung muss mindestens 30 Tage vor der Reise erfolgen. Für private Heimtiere ist keine Einfuhrgenehmigung nötig.

steps.what: Primera vacuna antirrábica (12+ semanas de edad) al menos 30 días antes de la salida
El veterinario emite el certificado sanitario bilingüe de EE. UU.
Refrendo de APHIS (se acepta el digital a través de VEHCS)

es.summary: Los perros y gatos personales necesitan un certificado sanitario refrendado por APHIS (válido 10 días) que acredite la vacunación antirrábica vigente; una primovacunación debe realizarse al menos 30 días antes del viaje. No se necesita permiso de importación para mascotas personales.

Visa APHIS (numérique via VEHCS accepté)

countries.name: Estonia
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the Agriculture and Food Board before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Estonia and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Airport points of entry: Tallinn, Tartu, Pärnu, Kuressaare, Kärdla and Ämari (the Tax and Customs Board performs the checks). Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Agriculture and Food Board (PTA)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

Young animals: Estonia accepts non-commercial entry from other EU states of pets under 12 weeks that are unvaccinated, or 12–16 weeks old and vaccinated but before the 21-day wait ends, with the owner's declaration of no contact with rabies-susceptible wild animals, or accompanied by the vaccinated mother. Never allowed from outside the EU.

at_a_glance.microchip: شريحة ISO، قبل لقاح داء الكلب
