يصبح التطعيم الأولي ضد داء الكلب صالحًا
من الولايات المتحدة: شهادة صحية أوروبية مصادق عليها من USDA APHIS؛ ومن الاتحاد الأوروبي: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف
حمل الإقرار الموقّع بأن النقل غير تجاري (للقادمين من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي)
من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: تدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين

key_points: الحد الأقصى 5 حيوانات لكل تنقّل؛ ويسافر كل منها مع المالك أو خلال 5 أيام
من الدول غير المُدرجة (مثل تركيا والمغرب وإسرائيل وتايلاند وجنوب أفريقيا): اختبار الأجسام المضادة مع انتظار 3 أشهر
لا تُقبل الشهادات الأوروبية بالنموذج القديم إلا إذا صدرت قبل 1 أكتوبر 2026
export_points: إلى دول الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف من طبيب بيطري معتمد
تحتاج الكلاب المتجهة إلى FI أو IE أو MT أو NO أو أيرلندا الشمالية أيضًا إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية
إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات
ar.private_jet_note: عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، يجب الهبوط في نقطة دخول مُدرجة: تالين، تارتو، بارنو، كوريساري، كاردلا أو أماري. وتفحص الجمارك الحيوان الأليف عند الوصول.
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين.

Von außerhalb der EU: Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrolle an einem Eingangsort für Reisende

EU-Zeugnisse nach altem Muster werden nur akzeptiert, wenn sie vor dem 1. Okt. 2026 ausgestellt wurden
export_points: In EU-/EWR-Länder: EU-Heimtierausweis von einem ermächtigten Tierarzt
Hunde nach FI, IE, MT, NO oder Nordirland benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Bestimmungen des Ziellandes erfüllen; der amtliche Veterinärdienst beglaubigt die Zeugnisse

Munissez-vous de la déclaration signée attestant le caractère non commercial (origines hors UE)
Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE : contrôle documentaire et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs

ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников.

Rabies vaccination record

شهادة صحية من طبيب بيطري مرخّص أو حكومي

Certificado sanitario de un veterinario colegiado u oficial

Certificat sanitaire d'un vétérinaire agréé ou officiel

countries.name: Spain
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the Ministry of Agriculture (MAPA) before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories) must enter through a travellers' point of entry on MAPA's list (updated 2 Jun 2026). Airports listed: Madrid-Barajas (check at the Air Cargo Centre), Barcelona-El Prat (owner collects the animal's documents at the cargo warehouse, WFS or Swissport, then goes to the Animal Health office), Palma de Mallorca (Son Sant Joan), Málaga, Valencia, Alicante, Sevilla, Girona, Reus, Jerez, Santiago de Compostela, Vitoria, Santander, Bilbao, Gran Canaria, Tenerife Norte, Tenerife Sur, Lanzarote, Fuerteventura and La Palma, plus several ports. Ibiza, Menorca and Madrid-Torrejón are not on the list: a private jet arriving there from outside the EU with a pet is not compliant, so route the first EU landing via a listed airport (e.g. Palma, Barcelona, Madrid). Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no border check, documents must be carried. Non-compliant animals face re-dispatch, isolation or euthanasia.
countries.export: To EU: EU pet passport. To non-EU: destination rules; export certificates are issued/legalised by the Government 'Áreas de Agricultura' (appointment required for legalisation).
countries.authority: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food (MAPA)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Young animals: Spain does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

key_points: L'APHIS ne mentionne pas le permis : confirmer auprès du ministère avant le voyage
Certificat d'origine UE : primovaccination antirabique 6 à 12 mois avant, ou rappel au cours de la dernière année
fr.summary: Les chiens et les chats doivent être accompagnés d'un certificat sanitaire officiel, visé par les autorités, mentionnant l'identification par puce électronique et une vaccination antirabique à jour ; les directives officielles britanniques exigent également un permis d'importation du ministère éthiopien de l'Agriculture, qui accompagne l'animal. Les exigences varient selon le pays d'origine.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: USA: valido 30 giorni; Regno Unito: 10 giorni

steps.what: Impianto del microchip
Richiedere il permesso d'importazione etiope al Ministero dell'Agricoltura
Vaccino antirabbico (cani dal Regno Unito: anche leptospirosi)
Visita veterinaria; l'animale deve essere privo di parassiti
Certificato vidimato dalle autorità governative; portare il permesso e gli originali

key_points: L'APHIS non menziona il permesso: verificare con il Ministero prima del viaggio
Certificato per origine UE: vaccinazione antirabbica primaria 6–12 mesi prima, o richiamo nell'ultimo anno
it.summary: Cani e gatti necessitano di un certificato sanitario ufficiale vidimato dalle autorità governative, con codice del microchip e vaccinazione antirabbica in corso di validità; le indicazioni ufficiali del Regno Unito richiedono inoltre un permesso d'importazione del Ministero dell'Agricoltura etiope, che viaggia con l'animale. I requisiti variano secondo il paese d'origine.

steps.what: Установите микрочип
Подайте заявку на разрешение на ввоз в Эфиопию в Министерство сельского хозяйства
Прививка от бешенства (собакам из Великобритании — также от лептоспироза)
Ветеринарный осмотр; на животном не должно быть паразитов
Сертификат с государственным заверением; возьмите разрешение и оригиналы

Сертификат для животных из ЕС: первичная прививка от бешенства за 6–12 месяцев либо ревакцинация в течение последнего года
ru.summary: Собакам и кошкам нужен официальный ветеринарный сертификат с государственным заверением, с идентификацией по микрочипу и действующей прививкой от бешенства; согласно официальным рекомендациям Великобритании, также требуется разрешение на ввоз Министерства сельского хозяйства Эфиопии, сопровождающее животное. Требования зависят от страны отправления.

countries.name: Finland
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry. Dogs also need tapeworm treatment 24–120 h before entry. Requirements apply even for short visits (e.g. from Sweden or Estonia).
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: Dogs only: treatment against Echinococcus multilocularis (praziquantel or proven equivalent) given by a vet 24–120 hours before scheduled entry and recorded in the passport or certificate. Not required for dogs coming directly from Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland. Cats: none.
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued). Dogs: tapeworm treatment 24–120 hours before arrival.
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the Finnish Food Authority before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Finland and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Helsinki-Vantaa is the only airport point of entry on the published list (the other points are road and rail crossings and ports). Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Finnish Food Authority (Ruokavirasto)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

Young animals: Finland accepts non-commercial entry from other EU states of pets under 12 weeks that are unvaccinated, or 12–16 weeks old and vaccinated but before the 21-day wait ends, with the owner's declaration of no contact with rabies-susceptible wild animals, or accompanied by the vaccinated mother. Never allowed from outside the EU.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: EU passport, or EU certificate ≤10 days (non-EU)

steps.what: ISO microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12+ weeks old)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid
From the US: EU health certificate endorsed by USDA APHIS; from the EU: EU pet passport
Dogs: tapeworm treatment by a vet, recorded in the passport or certificate
Carry the signed non-commercial declaration (non-EU origins)
From outside the EU: document and identity check at a travellers' point of entry

key_points: Max 5 pets per movement; each travels with the owner or within 5 days
From unlisted countries (e.g. Türkiye, Morocco, Israel, Thailand, South Africa): titer test plus a 3-month wait
Old-model EU certificates are accepted only if issued before 1 Oct 2026
export_points: To EU/EEA countries: EU pet passport from an authorised vet
Dogs going to Ireland, Malta, Norway or N. Ireland also need tapeworm treatment
To non-EU countries: meet destination rules; the official vet service endorses certificates
countries.private_jet_note: From outside the EU, Helsinki-Vantaa is the only airport point of entry for pets. Route the first landing there.

at_a_glance.microchip: شريحة ISO، قبل لقاح داء الكلب
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: قبل الدخول بـ≥21 يومًا، بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا
at_a_glance.health_certificate: جواز أو شهادة أوروبية ≤10 أيام (خارج الاتحاد)

steps.what: شريحة ISO، ثم لقاح داء الكلب (للحيوان بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا)
يصبح التطعيم الأولي ضد داء الكلب صالحًا
من الولايات المتحدة: شهادة صحية أوروبية مصادق عليها من USDA APHIS؛ ومن الاتحاد الأوروبي: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف
الكلاب: علاج الدودة الشريطية على يد طبيب بيطري، مع تسجيله في الجواز أو الشهادة
حمل الإقرار الموقّع بأن النقل غير تجاري (للقادمين من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي)
من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: تدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين

key_points: الحد الأقصى 5 حيوانات لكل تنقّل؛ ويسافر كل منها مع المالك أو خلال 5 أيام
من الدول غير المُدرجة (مثل تركيا والمغرب وإسرائيل وتايلاند وجنوب أفريقيا): اختبار الأجسام المضادة مع انتظار 3 أشهر
لا تُقبل الشهادات الأوروبية بالنموذج القديم إلا إذا صدرت قبل 1 أكتوبر 2026
export_points: إلى دول الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف من طبيب بيطري معتمد
تحتاج الكلاب المتجهة إلى أيرلندا أو مالطا أو النرويج أو أيرلندا الشمالية أيضًا إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية
إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات
ar.private_jet_note: عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، يُعد مطار هلسنكي-فانتا نقطة الدخول الجوية الوحيدة للحيوانات الأليفة. يُرجى أن يكون أول هبوط هناك.
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين. كما تحتاج الكلاب إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية قبل الدخول بـ24–120 ساعة. وتُطبَّق المتطلبات حتى على الزيارات القصيرة (مثل القادمين من السويد أو إستونيا).

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
Die Tollwut-Erstimpfung wird gültig
Aus den USA: von USDA APHIS beglaubigtes EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; aus der EU: EU-Heimtierausweis
Hunde: Bandwurmbehandlung durch einen Tierarzt, eingetragen im Ausweis oder Zeugnis
Die unterschriebene Erklärung zur nicht kommerziellen Verbringung mitführen (Nicht-EU-Herkunft)
Von außerhalb der EU: Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrolle an einem Eingangsort für Reisende

key_points: Max. 5 Heimtiere pro Verbringung; jedes reist mit dem Halter oder innerhalb von 5 Tagen
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern (z. B. Türkei, Marokko, Israel, Thailand, Südafrika): Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit
EU-Zeugnisse nach altem Muster werden nur akzeptiert, wenn sie vor dem 1. Okt. 2026 ausgestellt wurden
export_points: In EU-/EWR-Länder: EU-Heimtierausweis von einem ermächtigten Tierarzt
Hunde nach Irland, Malta, Norwegen oder Nordirland benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Bestimmungen des Ziellandes erfüllen; der amtliche Veterinärdienst beglaubigt die Zeugnisse
de.private_jet_note: Von außerhalb der EU ist Helsinki-Vantaa der einzige Flughafen-Eingangsort für Heimtiere. Planen Sie die erste Landung dort.
de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende. Hunde benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung 24–120 Std. vor der Einreise. Die Anforderungen gelten auch für kurze Besuche (z. B. aus Schweden oder Estland).

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, antes de la vacuna antirrábica
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ≥21 días antes de entrar, con 12+ semanas
at_a_glance.titer: No se requiere desde EE. UU./UE
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Pasaporte UE o certif. UE ≤10 días (no UE)
at_a_glance.quarantine: Ninguna si se cumplen los requisitos

steps.what: Microchip ISO y, después, vacuna antirrábica (mascota de 12+ semanas)
La primovacunación antirrábica pasa a ser válida
Desde EE. UU.: certificado sanitario de la UE refrendado por USDA APHIS; desde la UE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas
Perros: tratamiento contra la tenia administrado por un veterinario y registrado en el pasaporte o el certificado
Lleve la declaración firmada de no comercialidad (orígenes fuera de la UE)
Desde fuera de la UE: control documental y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros

key_points: Máx. 5 mascotas por desplazamiento; cada una viaja con el propietario o en un plazo de 5 días
Desde países no incluidos en la lista (p. ej., Turquía, Marruecos, Israel, Tailandia, Sudáfrica): prueba de titulación más 3 meses de espera
Los certificados UE del modelo anterior solo se aceptan si se emitieron antes del 1 de octubre de 2026
export_points: A países de la UE/EEE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas de un veterinario autorizado
Los perros con destino a Irlanda, Malta, Noruega o Irlanda del Norte necesitan además tratamiento contra la tenia
A países fuera de la UE: cumpla las normas del destino; el servicio veterinario oficial refrenda los certificados
es.private_jet_note: Desde fuera de la UE, Helsinki-Vantaa es el único aeropuerto de entrada para mascotas. Planifique allí el primer aterrizaje.
es.summary: Normas de la UE (Reglamento Delegado (UE) 2026/131): desde otro Estado de la UE/EEE, mascota con microchip, vacunación antirrábica válida y pasaporte europeo para mascotas; desde fuera de la UE, certificado zoosanitario de la UE (más prueba de titulación antirrábica con 3 meses de espera si el país no figura en la lista) y controles documentales y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros. Los perros necesitan además tratamiento contra la tenia 24–120 h antes de la entrada. Los requisitos se aplican incluso a visitas breves (p. ej., desde Suecia o Estonia).

at_a_glance.microchip: Puce ISO, avant le vaccin antirabique
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passeport UE ; hors UE, certificat ≤10 jours

steps.what: Puce électronique ISO, puis vaccin antirabique (animal âgé d'au moins 12 semaines)
La primovaccination antirabique devient valable
Depuis les États-Unis : certificat sanitaire UE visé par l'USDA APHIS ; depuis l'UE : passeport européen pour animal de compagnie
Chiens : traitement contre le ténia par un vétérinaire, consigné dans le passeport ou le certificat
Munissez-vous de la déclaration signée attestant le caractère non commercial (origines hors UE)
Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE : contrôle documentaire et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs

key_points: 5 animaux max. par mouvement ; chacun voyage avec le propriétaire ou dans un délai de 5 jours
Depuis les pays non listés (p. ex. Turquie, Maroc, Israël, Thaïlande, Afrique du Sud) : titrage des anticorps antirabiques plus attente de 3 mois
Les certificats UE de l'ancien modèle ne sont acceptés que s'ils ont été délivrés avant le 1er oct. 2026
export_points: Vers les pays de l'UE/EEE : passeport européen délivré par un vétérinaire habilité
Les chiens à destination de l'Irlande, de Malte, de la Norvège ou de l'Irlande du Nord doivent aussi recevoir un traitement contre le ténia
Vers les pays hors UE : respecter les règles du pays de destination ; le service vétérinaire officiel vise les certificats
fr.private_jet_note: En provenance d'un pays hors UE, Helsinki-Vantaa est le seul aéroport d'entrée pour les animaux. Prévoyez-y le premier atterrissage.
fr.summary: Règles de l'UE (règlement délégué (UE) 2026/131) : depuis un autre État de l'UE/EEE, animal identifié par puce électronique, avec vaccination antirabique valide et passeport européen pour animal de compagnie ; depuis l'extérieur de l'UE, certificat sanitaire de l'UE (plus titrage des anticorps antirabiques avec attente de 3 mois si le pays n'est pas listé) et contrôles documentaires et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs. Les chiens doivent également recevoir un traitement contre le ténia 24 à 120 h avant l'entrée. Ces exigences s'appliquent même aux courts séjours (p. ex. depuis la Suède ou l'Estonie).

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, prima del vaccino antirabbico
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passaporto UE, o cert. UE ≤10 gg (extra UE)

steps.what: Microchip ISO, poi vaccino antirabbico (animale di 12+ settimane)
La vaccinazione antirabbica primaria diventa valida
Dagli Stati Uniti: certificato sanitario UE vidimato da USDA APHIS; dall'UE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia
Cani: trattamento contro la tenia effettuato da un veterinario e registrato nel passaporto o nel certificato
Portare con sé la dichiarazione firmata di movimentazione non commerciale (origini extra UE)
Da fuori UE: controllo documentale e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori

key_points: Max 5 animali per movimentazione; ciascuno viaggia con il proprietario o entro 5 giorni
Da Paesi non elencati (ad es. Turchia, Marocco, Israele, Thailandia, Sudafrica): titolazione più attesa di 3 mesi
I certificati UE del vecchio modello sono accettati solo se rilasciati prima del 1 ott 2026
export_points: Verso Paesi UE/SEE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia rilasciato da un veterinario autorizzato
I cani diretti in Irlanda, Malta, Norvegia o Irlanda del Nord necessitano anche del trattamento contro la tenia
Verso Paesi extra UE: rispettare le norme della destinazione; il servizio veterinario ufficiale vidima i certificati
it.private_jet_note: Da fuori UE, Helsinki-Vantaa è l'unico aeroporto punto d'ingresso per animali da compagnia. Prevedere lì il primo atterraggio.
it.summary: Norme UE (Regolamento delegato (UE) 2026/131): da un altro Stato UE/SEE, animale con microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica valida e passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia; da fuori UE, certificato sanitario UE per animali (più titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici con attesa di 3 mesi se il Paese non è elencato) e controlli documentali e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori. I cani necessitano inoltre di un trattamento contro la tenia 24–120 h prima dell'ingresso. I requisiti si applicano anche per brevi visite (ad es. dalla Svezia o dall'Estonia).

at_a_glance.microchip: Чип ISO, до прививки от бешенства
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Паспорт или сертификат ЕС ≤10 дней (не из ЕС)

steps.what: Микрочип ISO, затем прививка от бешенства (животному 12+ недель)
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной
Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС, заверенный USDA APHIS; из ЕС: европейский паспорт животного
Собаки: обработка от ленточных червей у ветеринара с отметкой в паспорте или сертификате
Имейте при себе подписанную декларацию о некоммерческом перемещении (не из ЕС)
Из-за пределов ЕС: проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников

key_points: Не более 5 животных за одно перемещение; каждое следует с владельцем или в пределах 5 дней
Из стран вне перечня (например, Турция, Марокко, Израиль, Таиланд, ЮАР): тест на титр плюс ожидание 3 месяца
Сертификаты ЕС старого образца принимаются, только если выданы до 1 октября 2026 г.
export_points: В страны ЕС/ЕЭЗ: европейский паспорт животного от уполномоченного ветеринара
Собакам, направляющимся в Ирландию, на Мальту, в Норвегию или Северную Ирландию, также нужна обработка от ленточных червей
В страны вне ЕС: соблюдайте правила страны назначения; сертификаты заверяет официальная ветеринарная служба
ru.private_jet_note: При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС Хельсинки-Вантаа — единственный аэропорт-пункт въезда для животных. Планируйте первую посадку там.
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников. countries.name: Fiji
countries.summary: A Biosecurity Authority of Fiji (BAF) import permit is required; the conditions in it depend on the origin country. Pets must go straight from arrival into mandatory Post Entry Quarantine (PEQ) at Koronivia, which must be booked at least 1 month ahead.
countries.microchip: Required: readable by AVID, TROVAN, DESTRON or an ISO-compatible reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Set by the permit according to origin; not stated on the BAF page.
countries.parasite_treatment: Treatments and their intervals are specified in the permit.
countries.import_permit: Yes. Apply to BAF (animalimports@baf.com.fj) and pay the fee on lodgement. Processing takes about 5 working days and the permit is valid 6 months.
countries.quarantine: Mandatory PEQ at Koronivia, Nausori. The minimum period is set by BAF/permit (not stated on the page). Book at least 1 month before arrival. Guide and service dogs may be exempt case by case.
countries.timeline: Plan at least 2-3 months (longer if origin requires rabies serology): apply for the permit, book PEQ 1+ month ahead, complete tests and treatments per the permit, notify BAF Nadi and the Chief Veterinary Officer before arrival.
countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited: Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, Japanese Tosa, Pit Bull Terriers (including American Pit Bull Terrier and crosses); serval cats and serval hybrids within 5 generations. Pets under 4 months and females more than 21 days pregnant are not allowed.
countries.private_aviation: BAF requires the most direct route, intact crate seals, and confirmation that the aircraft carries no animals from other countries. Notify BAF Nadi Airport (+679 6720053) and the CVO (+679 3312512) in advance. Confirm private-aircraft arrangements with BAF.

countries.name: Faroe Islands
countries.summary: Visitors cannot bring dogs or cats to the Faroe Islands. Only people with permanent residence in the Faroes, or people moving there, may import dogs and cats (Executive Order 82/2021 §6), with an HFS import permit (apply at least 6 business days before departure), microchip, full vaccinations at least 4 weeks old, parasite treatments and a health certificate no older than 2 days; from group B countries (most other EU states) also a rabies titer and a 12-week wait. Pets may not transit the Faroes, and pets carried on an aircraft or ship from abroad may not be landed (except in approved units of authorised carriers).
countries.microchip: Required: ISO 11784 microchip (HDX or FDX-B, readable with ISO 11785). The number must appear on the permit application, the permit and the health certificate.
countries.rabies_titer: Group A countries (Denmark excl. Greenland, Finland, Ireland, Iceland, Norway excl. Svalbard, UK, Sweden): not required. Group B countries (most other EU states, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Greenland, Svalbard): required, ≥0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved lab, sample at least 4 weeks after rabies vaccination; entry no earlier than 12 weeks after the sample. Other countries (e.g. USA): conditions set case by case by the Chief Veterinary Officer (§11).
countries.parasite_treatment: Required, within the product's validity when travel begins. Dogs: roundworm, French heartworm (Angiostrongylus vasorum), tapeworm incl. Echinococcus granulosus and E. multilocularis, scabies, lice, fleas, Ixodes ricinus ticks. Cats: same list except French heartworm. Must be certified in the health certificate.
countries.import_permit: Required for every dog/cat, issued by the Faroese Food and Veterinary Authority (HFS). Only for permanent residents or people moving to the Faroes. Apply at least 6 business days before departure. Carriers must refuse to transport a pet without a valid permit.
countries.quarantine: None for compliant pets. Non-compliant pets may be quarantined under HFS supervision, returned to the country of dispatch or euthanised at the owner's expense.
countries.timeline: Visitors: not possible. Residents and people moving to the Faroes, from group A countries: apply at least 6 business days before departure → health certificate no more than 2 days before departure, sent to HFS 2 business days ahead (so departures are only possible Wednesday–Saturday; HFS publishes special dates around holidays). From group B: add a titer test and 12 weeks from the blood sample. From other countries: case-by-case conditions.
countries.restricted_breeds: Dog breeds deemed dangerous are prohibited (list on hfs.fo). Hybrids are prohibited regardless of percentage, e.g. wolfdogs, Bengal and Savannah cats.
countries.private_aviation: Executive Order 82/2021 §6(3): dogs and cats taken on board aircraft or ships abroad may not be landed in the Faroes, and the crew must ensure they stay on board. This does not apply to approved transport units of an authorised carrier. §45: carriers transporting dogs/cats to the Faroes must hold an animal-transport authorisation, carry the valid permit and have a reception facility. §6(2): the owner or a designated escort must accompany the animal. Transit with a pet through the Faroes is prohibited.
countries.export: Faroese residents travelling abroad and returning need an HFS travel permit (ferðaloyvi), with separate forms for group A and group B countries. EU lists the Faroes as an Annex I territory for entry into the EU.
countries.authority: Heilsufrøðiliga Starvsstovan (HFS, Faroese Food and Veterinary Authority), Smyrilsvegur 7, FO-100 Tórshavn, +298 55 64 00, hfs@hfs.fo
vaccinations: Dogs: rabies, canine distemper, infectious canine hepatitis, parvovirus, parainfluenza, leptospirosis
Cats: rabies, feline panleukopenia, feline viral rhinotracheitis, feline calicivirus, feline leukaemia virus (FeLV)

All vaccinations at least 4 weeks old on arrival and within the manufacturer's validity. On-time boosters need no waiting period. Puppies/kittens must be at least 12 weeks old when vaccinated and arrive no earlier than 4 weeks after the last required vaccination.

ar.summary: لا يمكن للزوار إحضار الكلاب أو القطط إلى جزر فارو. ولا يجوز استيراد الكلاب والقطط إلا للمقيمين إقامة دائمة في جزر فارو أو للمنتقلين إليها (الأمر التنفيذي 82/2021 المادة 6)، وذلك بتصريح استيراد من HFS (يُقدَّم الطلب قبل المغادرة بـ6 أيام عمل على الأقل)، وشريحة إلكترونية، وتطعيمات كاملة لا يقل عمرها عن 4 أسابيع، وعلاجات للطفيليات، وشهادة صحية لا يتجاوز عمرها يومين (2)؛ ومن دول المجموعة B (معظم دول الاتحاد الأوروبي الأخرى) يلزم أيضًا اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب وانتظار 12 أسبوعًا. ولا يجوز عبور الحيوانات الأليفة بجزر فارو، ولا يجوز إنزال الحيوانات المحمولة على متن طائرة أو سفينة قادمة من الخارج (باستثناء الوحدات المعتمدة لدى الناقلين المرخّصين).

steps.what: HFS-Einfuhrgenehmigung beantragen (Gebühr ab DKK 750)
HFS-Gesundheitszeugnis an hfs@hfs.fo senden
Tierärztliche Untersuchung und Parasitenbehandlungen auf dem HFS-Zeugnis
Abreise nur Mittwoch–Samstag (Sondertermine um Feiertage)
Die unterschriebene Genehmigung dem Zoll vorzeigen

key_points: Besucher dürfen keine Hunde oder Katzen mitbringen; Einwohner und Zuziehende dürfen es mit einer HFS-Einfuhrgenehmigung
EU-Länder der Gruppe B: Titertest und 12 Wochen Wartezeit; Bedingungen für die USA im Einzelfall
Gefährliche Rassen und alle Hybriden (Wolfhunde, Bengal-, Savannah-Katzen) sind verboten
Die Durchreise mit einem Heimtier über die Färöer ist verboten
export_points: Einwohner benötigen eine HFS-Reisegenehmigung (ferðaloyvi) für Reisen ins Ausland und die Rückkehr
Die EU behandelt die Färöer bei der Einreise in die EU als Gebiet nach Anhang I
de.private_jet_note: Mit dem Flugzeug ankommende Heimtiere müssen an Bord bleiben, sofern sie nicht von einem von HFS ermächtigten Beförderer mit gültiger Genehmigung befördert werden. Bitte die Ermächtigung des Beförderers vor dem Flug bestätigen.
de.summary: Besucher dürfen keine Hunde oder Katzen auf die Färöer mitbringen. Nur Personen mit ständigem Wohnsitz auf den Färöern oder Zuziehende dürfen Hunde und Katzen einführen (Verordnung 82/2021 § 6), und zwar mit einer HFS-Einfuhrgenehmigung (mindestens 6 Werktage vor Abreise beantragen), Mikrochip, vollständigen Impfungen, die mindestens 4 Wochen alt sind, Parasitenbehandlungen und einem Gesundheitszeugnis, das nicht älter als 2 Tage ist; aus Ländern der Gruppe B (die meisten anderen EU-Staaten) zudem mit Tollwut-Titer und 12 Wochen Wartezeit. Heimtiere dürfen nicht durch die Färöer reisen, und Heimtiere, die mit Flugzeug oder Schiff aus dem Ausland ankommen, dürfen nicht an Land gebracht werden (außer in zugelassenen Einheiten ermächtigter Beförderer).

es.summary: Los visitantes no pueden llevar perros ni gatos a las Islas Feroe. Solo las personas con residencia permanente en las Feroe, o que se trasladen allí, pueden importar perros y gatos (Orden Ejecutiva 82/2021 §6), con un permiso de importación de la HFS (solicitar al menos 6 días hábiles antes de la salida), microchip, vacunaciones completas con al menos 4 semanas de antigüedad, tratamientos antiparasitarios y un certificado sanitario con una antigüedad máxima de 2 días; desde países del grupo B (la mayoría de los demás Estados de la UE), además, una titulación antirrábica y una espera de 12 semanas. Las mascotas no pueden transitar por las Feroe, y las transportadas en aeronave o buque desde el extranjero no pueden desembarcarse (salvo en unidades aprobadas de transportistas autorizados).

fr.summary: Les visiteurs ne peuvent pas emmener de chiens ni de chats aux îles Féroé. Seules les personnes résidant de façon permanente aux Féroé, ou s'y installant, peuvent importer des chiens et des chats (arrêté 82/2021 §6), avec un permis d'importation HFS (à demander au moins 6 jours ouvrés avant le départ), une puce électronique, des vaccinations complètes datant d'au moins 4 semaines, des traitements antiparasitaires et un certificat sanitaire datant de 2 jours au plus ; depuis les pays du groupe B (la plupart des autres États de l'UE), il faut également un titrage des anticorps antirabiques et une attente de 12 semaines. Les animaux ne peuvent pas transiter par les Féroé, et ceux transportés à bord d'un avion ou d'un navire venant de l'étranger ne peuvent pas être débarqués (sauf dans des unités agréées de transporteurs autorisés).

countries.name: France
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry. Pets from outside the EU are presented to French Customs on arrival. Category 1 attack dogs are banned outright, even in transit. Imported dogs must have at least one adult tooth.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Category 1 (attack dogs, import banned, including in transit): dogs of Staffordshire Terrier / American Staffordshire Terrier ('pit-bull'), Mastiff ('boerbull') or Tosa type WITHOUT registration in a recognised pedigree book. Category 2 (import allowed with proof of pedigree registration; leash, muzzle and owner obligations apply): pedigree Staffordshire Terrier, American Staffordshire Terrier and Tosa, and ALL Rottweilers or Rottweiler-type dogs with or without pedigree. Bengal and Savannah cats without proof of breed (pedigree/birth certificate) are treated as hybrids and need a prior import permit from the regional DREAL. Wolf-dog hybrids likewise. Any dog imported from a third country must have at least one adult tooth (Code rural L236-1), which in practice excludes very young puppies.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must present the pet to French Customs (red channel) for documentary and identity checks before leaving the international zone; no appointment is needed. French Customs carry out these checks at all points open to international passenger traffic, so customs-staffed international airports such as Paris-Le Bourget (LFPB) and Nice (LFMN) can receive pets travelling with their owners; ask the FBO to pre-notify the customs post at the airport. A small airfield without permanent customs does not qualify. More than 5 pets per person, or pets travelling more than 5 days apart from the owner, are commercial movements and must go through a border control post (Le Bourget is not one; Paris-CDG, Nice, Lyon, Marseille, Toulouse and Deauville are). EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliant animals can be re-exported, isolated at the owner's cost or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Ministry of Agriculture (DGAL) and French Customs (DGDDI)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

Young animals: France does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU. (French Customs: dogs under 16 weeks are not admitted.)

إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات
ar.private_jet_note: تفحص الجمارك الفرنسية الحيوانات الأليفة القادمة من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي في مطار الوصول (مثل لوبورجيه أو نيس)؛ يُرجى أن يُخطر مشغّل الخدمات الأرضية (FBO) مركز الجمارك مسبقًا.
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين. وتُقدَّم الحيوانات الأليفة القادمة من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي إلى الجمارك الفرنسية عند الوصول. كلاب الهجوم من الفئة 1 محظورة حظرًا تامًا، حتى في العبور. ويجب أن يكون للكلاب المستوردة سن بالغة واحدة على الأقل.

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
Die Tollwut-Erstimpfung wird gültig
Aus den USA: von USDA APHIS beglaubigtes EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; aus der EU: EU-Heimtierausweis
Die unterschriebene Erklärung zur nicht kommerziellen Verbringung mitführen (Nicht-EU-Herkunft)
Von außerhalb der EU: das Tier beim französischen Zoll vorführen (roter Kanal)

key_points: Hunde der Kategorie 1 (Pitbull-, Boerbull-, Tosa-Typen ohne Stammbaum) verboten, auch im Transit
Rottweiler sowie Staffs/Tosa mit Stammbaum benötigen einen Abstammungsnachweis; Leinen- und Maulkorbpflicht
Hunde unter 16 Wochen werden nicht zugelassen
Bengal- oder Savannah-Katzen ohne Abstammungsnachweis benötigen eine DREAL-Einfuhrgenehmigung
Max. 5 Heimtiere pro Verbringung; jedes reist mit dem Halter oder innerhalb von 5 Tagen
export_points: In EU-/EWR-Länder: EU-Heimtierausweis von einem ermächtigten Tierarzt
Hunde nach FI, IE, MT, NO oder Nordirland benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Bestimmungen des Ziellandes erfüllen; der amtliche Veterinärdienst beglaubigt die Zeugnisse
de.private_jet_note: Heimtiere von außerhalb der EU werden vom französischen Zoll am Ankunftsflughafen kontrolliert (z. B. Le Bourget oder Nizza); bitten Sie den FBO, die Zollstelle vorab zu informieren.
de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende. Heimtiere von außerhalb der EU werden bei Ankunft dem französischen Zoll vorgeführt. Kampfhunde der Kategorie 1 sind ausnahmslos verboten, auch im Transit. Eingeführte Hunde müssen mindestens einen bleibenden Zahn haben.

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, antes de la vacuna antirrábica
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ≥21 días antes de entrar, con 12+ semanas
at_a_glance.titer: No se requiere desde EE. UU./UE
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Pasaporte UE o certif. UE ≤10 días (no UE)
at_a_glance.quarantine: Ninguna si se cumplen los requisitos

steps.what: Microchip ISO y, después, vacuna antirrábica (mascota de 12+ semanas)
La primovacunación antirrábica pasa a ser válida
Desde EE. UU.: certificado sanitario de la UE refrendado por USDA APHIS; desde la UE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas
Lleve la declaración firmada de no comercialidad (orígenes fuera de la UE)
Desde fuera de la UE: presente la mascota a la Aduana francesa (canal rojo)

key_points: Perros de 1.ª categoría (tipos pit bull, boerbull y Tosa sin pedigrí) prohibidos, incluso en tránsito
Rottweilers y Staffs/Tosa con pedigrí necesitan acreditarlo; se aplican normas de correa y bozal
No se admiten perros menores de 16 semanas
Los gatos Bengalí o Savannah sin pedigrí acreditado necesitan un permiso de importación de la DREAL
Máx. 5 mascotas por desplazamiento; cada una viaja con el propietario o en un plazo de 5 días
export_points: A países de la UE/EEE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas de un veterinario autorizado
Los perros con destino a FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Norte necesitan además tratamiento contra la tenia
A países fuera de la UE: cumpla las normas del destino; el servicio veterinario oficial refrenda los certificados
es.private_jet_note: La Aduana francesa controla a las mascotas procedentes de fuera de la UE en el aeropuerto de llegada (p. ej., Le Bourget o Niza); pida al FBO que notifique previamente al puesto aduanero.
es.summary: Normas de la UE (Reglamento Delegado (UE) 2026/131): desde otro Estado de la UE/EEE, mascota con microchip, vacunación antirrábica válida y pasaporte europeo para mascotas; desde fuera de la UE, certificado zoosanitario de la UE (más prueba de titulación antirrábica con 3 meses de espera si el país no figura en la lista) y controles documentales y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros. Las mascotas procedentes de fuera de la UE se presentan a la Aduana francesa a la llegada. Los perros de ataque de 1.ª categoría están prohibidos sin excepción, incluso en tránsito. Los perros importados deben tener al menos un diente definitivo.

at_a_glance.microchip: Puce ISO, avant le vaccin antirabique
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passeport UE ; hors UE, certificat ≤10 jours

steps.what: Puce électronique ISO, puis vaccin antirabique (animal âgé d'au moins 12 semaines)
La primovaccination antirabique devient valable
Depuis les États-Unis : certificat sanitaire UE visé par l'USDA APHIS ; depuis l'UE : passeport européen pour animal de compagnie
Munissez-vous de la déclaration signée attestant le caractère non commercial (origines hors UE)
Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE : présenter l'animal à la douane française (circuit rouge)

key_points: Chiens de 1re catégorie (types pit-bull, boerbull, Tosa sans pedigree) interdits, même en transit
Rottweilers et Staffs/Tosa avec pedigree : preuve du pedigree exigée ; obligations de laisse et de muselière
Les chiens de moins de 16 semaines ne sont pas admis
Chats Bengal ou Savannah sans preuve de pedigree : permis d'importation DREAL requis
5 animaux max. par mouvement ; chacun voyage avec le propriétaire ou dans un délai de 5 jours
export_points: Vers les pays de l'UE/EEE : passeport européen délivré par un vétérinaire habilité
Les chiens à destination de FI, IE, MT, NO ou de l'Irlande du Nord nécessitent aussi un traitement contre le ténia
Vers les pays hors UE : respecter les règles du pays de destination ; le service vétérinaire officiel vise les certificats
fr.private_jet_note: Les animaux venant de l'extérieur de l'UE sont contrôlés par la douane française à l'aéroport d'arrivée (p. ex. Le Bourget ou Nice) ; demandez au FBO de prévenir le poste de douane à l'avance.
fr.summary: Règles de l'UE (règlement délégué (UE) 2026/131) : depuis un autre État de l'UE/EEE, animal identifié par puce électronique, avec vaccination antirabique valide et passeport européen pour animal de compagnie ; depuis l'extérieur de l'UE, certificat sanitaire de l'UE (plus titrage des anticorps antirabiques avec attente de 3 mois si le pays n'est pas listé) et contrôles documentaires et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs. Les animaux venant de l'extérieur de l'UE sont présentés à la douane française à l'arrivée. Les chiens d'attaque de 1re catégorie sont strictement interdits, même en transit. Les chiens importés doivent avoir au moins une dent adulte.

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, prima del vaccino antirabbico
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passaporto UE, o cert. UE ≤10 gg (extra UE)

steps.what: Microchip ISO, poi vaccino antirabbico (animale di 12+ settimane)
La vaccinazione antirabbica primaria diventa valida
Dagli Stati Uniti: certificato sanitario UE vidimato da USDA APHIS; dall'UE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia
Portare con sé la dichiarazione firmata di movimentazione non commerciale (origini extra UE)
Da fuori UE: presentare l'animale alla dogana francese (canale rosso)

key_points: Cani di categoria 1 (tipi pit-bull, boerbull, Tosa senza pedigree) vietati, anche in transito
Rottweiler e Staff/Tosa con pedigree richiedono prova del pedigree; si applicano obblighi di guinzaglio e museruola
I cani sotto le 16 settimane non sono ammessi
I gatti Bengal o Savannah senza prova del pedigree necessitano di un permesso d'importazione DREAL
Max 5 animali per movimentazione; ciascuno viaggia con il proprietario o entro 5 giorni
export_points: Verso Paesi UE/SEE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia rilasciato da un veterinario autorizzato
I cani diretti in FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Nord necessitano anche del trattamento contro la tenia (Echinococcus)
Verso Paesi extra UE: rispettare le norme della destinazione; il servizio veterinario ufficiale vidima i certificati
it.private_jet_note: Gli animali provenienti da fuori UE vengono controllati dalla dogana francese all'aeroporto di arrivo (ad es. Le Bourget o Nizza); chiedere all'FBO di preavvisare il posto doganale.
it.summary: Norme UE (Regolamento delegato (UE) 2026/131): da un altro Stato UE/SEE, animale con microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica valida e passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia; da fuori UE, certificato sanitario UE per animali (più titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici con attesa di 3 mesi se il Paese non è elencato) e controlli documentali e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori. Gli animali provenienti da fuori UE vengono presentati alla dogana francese all'arrivo. I cani d'attacco di categoria 1 sono vietati in modo assoluto, anche in transito. I cani importati devono avere almeno un dente permanente.

at_a_glance.microchip: Чип ISO, до прививки от бешенства
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Паспорт или сертификат ЕС ≤10 дней (не из ЕС)

steps.what: Микрочип ISO, затем прививка от бешенства (животному 12+ недель)
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной
Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС, заверенный USDA APHIS; из ЕС: европейский паспорт животного
Имейте при себе подписанную декларацию о некоммерческом перемещении (не из ЕС)
Из-за пределов ЕС: предъявите животное французской таможне (красный коридор)

key_points: Собаки Категории 1 (беспородные типов питбуль, бурбуль, тоса) запрещены, даже транзитом
Ротвейлерам и породистым стаффам/тоса нужно подтверждение родословной; действуют правила о поводке и наморднике
Собаки младше 16 недель не допускаются
Бенгальским кошкам и саваннам без подтверждения родословной нужно разрешение DREAL на ввоз
Не более 5 животных за одно перемещение; каждое следует с владельцем или в пределах 5 дней
export_points: В страны ЕС/ЕЭЗ: европейский паспорт животного от уполномоченного ветеринара
Собакам, направляющимся в FI, IE, MT, NO или Северную Ирландию, также нужна обработка от ленточных червей
В страны вне ЕС: соблюдайте правила страны назначения; сертификаты заверяет официальная ветеринарная служба
ru.private_jet_note: Животных из-за пределов ЕС проверяет французская таможня в аэропорту прибытия (например, Ле-Бурже или Ницца); попросите FBO заранее уведомить таможенный пост.
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников. Животные из-за пределов ЕС предъявляются французской таможне по прибытии. Бойцовые собаки Категории 1 полностью запрещены, даже транзитом. У ввозимых собак должен быть хотя бы один постоянный зуб.

countries.summary: No reliable official information found — check with Elysium Jet operations before booking.
countries.authority: Ministry of Agriculture / Livestock (veterinary services), Gabon

countries.name: United Kingdom (Great Britain and Northern Ireland)
countries.summary: Great Britain: microchip, rabies vaccination (21-day wait), correct document (EU pet passport, GB AHC or GB pet health certificate), tapeworm treatment for dogs, entry only via an approved route/carrier (no route needed from Ireland/within UK); unlisted countries also need a titer test and 3-month wait. Northern Ireland follows EU rules (see notes).
countries.microchip: Microchip before (or at the same time as) rabies vaccination; otherwise revaccination needed.
countries.rabies_titer: Great Britain: required only from unlisted countries (not EU and not listed): sample ≥30 days after vaccination, EU-approved lab, ≥0.5 IU/ml, wait 3 months from sample date; exception if vaccinated, tested and documented in the EU before going to the unlisted country. Northern Ireland: same (Category 3 = unlisted).
countries.parasite_treatment: Dogs: tapeworm (Echinococcus) treatment by a vet not less than 24 hours and not more than 5 days before arrival in GB (not needed for dogs coming directly from Ireland, Finland, Malta, Northern Ireland or Norway). Northern Ireland: dogs 24–120 h before arrival; not required from the Republic of Ireland.
countries.quarantine: None if compliant. Non-compliant pets may be quarantined for up to 4 months (or refused entry if arriving by sea), at owner's expense.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA or EU (listed countries): GB pet health certificate (or EU pet passport / AHC), dog tapeworm treatment 1–5 days before arrival, and a charter operator approved for the arrival airport. From scratch (EU/listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination at ≥ 12 weeks → 21 days → document → dog tapeworm 1–5 days before. Unlisted origin: at least 4 months (add blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3-month wait).
countries.restricted_breeds: Banned types (by appearance): Pit Bull Terrier, Japanese Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, XL Bully. Cannot be brought into GB without a valid Certificate of Exemption. Northern Ireland has its own XL Bully rules.
countries.private_aviation: GREAT BRITAIN: pets normally must travel as cargo by air, EXCEPT on a chartered private plane, but only with operators on the APHA 'approved air routes – charter airlines' list for the specific arrival airport (pets carried in the cabin). Charter-listed GB airports include Biggin Hill, Farnborough, London Luton, London Stansted, London Gatwick, London Heathrow, London Oxford, Blackbushe, Birmingham, Manchester, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Bristol, Cambridge, Cardiff, Bournemouth, Southampton, Liverpool, Newcastle, Leeds Bradford, East Midlands, Lydd, Blackpool, Gloucestershire, Humberside, Sheffield, often via named pet-check providers. Northolt, Doncaster and Prestwick are NOT on the list (gov.uk list updated 9 Oct 2026). No approved route needed from Ireland or within the UK. Check the operator/airport pairing on the gov.uk list before each flight. NORTHERN IRELAND: air points of entry Belfast International, Belfast City, City of Derry; for air arrivals notify DAERA at least 10 days before travel (daeratradeimports@daera-ni.gov.uk).
countries.export: Great Britain to EU (and to Northern Ireland outside NIPTS): Animal Health Certificate (AHC) issued by an Official Veterinarian, new AHC for each trip, used within 10 days of issue for EU entry; then valid 6 months for onward EU travel and re-entry to GB (if rabies vaccination stays valid). EU pet passports issued in GB cannot be used by GB residents to enter the EU. Northern Ireland residents can use EU pet passports. Max 5 pets in a private vehicle unless for events.
countries.authority: Defra / Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA) – Great Britain; DAERA – Northern Ireland
vaccinations: Rabies: pet ≥12 weeks; wait at least 21 full days after the first vaccination (or last dose of primary course); boosters within validity need no wait.
documents: GB from EU: EU pet passport, or GB AHC issued within previous 6 months, or GB pet health certificate (or GB pet passport issued before 1 Jan 2021).
GB from listed non-EU countries: GB pet health certificate (some listed territories, e.g. AD, IS, NO, CH, GI, also accept pet passport/AHC).
GB from unlisted countries: GB pet health certificate + rabies blood test result.
Pet travel declaration (non-commercial).
From Northern Ireland, Channel Islands, Isle of Man: no pet passport or health certificate needed for GB.
More than 5 pets (not for event), pet travelling >5 days apart from owner, or sale/rehoming: Balai commercial import rules.

NORTHERN IRELAND: from GB, UK-resident pets can use the NI Pet Travel Scheme (free NI Pet Travel Document + declaration not to travel on to EU); otherwise EU rules – EU pet passport or AHC (10 days from issue for entry); Part 2 listed countries (incl. GB not using NIPTS) and unlisted countries must enter via a Travellers' Point of Entry.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: GB health certificate or EU passport

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccine at 12+ weeks
Choose a charter operator approved for your GB arrival airport
GB pet health certificate (US) or valid EU pet passport
Vet gives dogs tapeworm treatment
Pet check at the approved arrival airport

key_points: Banned: Pit Bull, Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, XL Bully (exemption certificate only)
From unlisted countries: titer test plus 3-month wait (plan 4+ months)
Northern Ireland by air: notify DAERA ≥10 days ahead; Belfast or Derry airports only
Over 5 pets, or pet travelling >5 days from owner: commercial rules apply
export_points: To the EU: new animal health certificate per trip, used within 10 days of issue
Then valid 6 months for onward EU travel and return to GB
GB residents cannot use GB-issued EU pet passports to enter the EU
countries.private_jet_note: Pets may fly in the cabin only with a charter operator approved for the specific GB arrival airport. Northolt, Doncaster and Prestwick are not listed; check the gov.uk list before each flight.

at_a_glance.microchip: قبل لقاح داء الكلب أو معه
at_a_glance.health_certificate: شهادة صحية بريطانية أو جواز أوروبي

steps.what: الشريحة الإلكترونية، ثم لقاح داء الكلب بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا
اختيار مشغّل طيران عارض معتمد لمطار الوصول في بريطانيا
شهادة صحية بريطانية للحيوان الأليف (الولايات المتحدة) أو جواز سفر أوروبي ساري للحيوان الأليف
يُعطي الطبيب البيطري الكلاب علاج الدودة الشريطية
فحص الحيوان الأليف في مطار الوصول المعتمد

key_points: محظورة: البيتبول، والتوسا، والدوغو الأرجنتيني، والفيلا البرازيلي، والإكس إل بولي (بشهادة إعفاء فقط)
من الدول غير المُدرجة: اختبار أجسام مضادة إضافة إلى انتظار 3 أشهر (خطّط لـ4+ أشهر)
أيرلندا الشمالية جوًا: إخطار DAERA قبل ≥10 أيام؛ مطارا بلفاست أو ديري فقط
أكثر من 5 حيوانات، أو سفر الحيوان بفارق >5 أيام عن المالك: تُطبَّق القواعد التجارية
export_points: إلى الاتحاد الأوروبي: شهادة صحة حيوانية جديدة لكل رحلة، تُستخدم خلال 10 أيام من إصدارها
ثم تبقى صالحة 6 أشهر لمواصلة السفر داخل الاتحاد الأوروبي والعودة إلى بريطانيا
لا يمكن للمقيمين في بريطانيا استخدام جوازات السفر الأوروبية للحيوانات الأليفة الصادرة في بريطانيا لدخول الاتحاد الأوروبي
ar.private_jet_note: لا يجوز للحيوانات الأليفة السفر في المقصورة إلا مع مشغّل طيران عارض معتمد لمطار الوصول المحدد في بريطانيا. مطارات نورثولت ودونكاستر وبريستويك غير مُدرجة؛ يُرجى مراجعة القائمة على gov.uk قبل كل رحلة.
ar.summary: بريطانيا العظمى: شريحة إلكترونية، وتطعيم ضد داء الكلب (انتظار 21 يومًا)، والمستند الصحيح (جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف، أو GB AHC، أو شهادة صحية بريطانية للحيوان الأليف)، وعلاج الدودة الشريطية للكلاب، والدخول فقط عبر مسار/ناقل معتمد (لا حاجة إلى مسار عند القدوم من أيرلندا/داخل المملكة المتحدة)؛ وتحتاج الدول غير المُدرجة أيضًا إلى اختبار أجسام مضادة وانتظار 3 أشهر. تتبع أيرلندا الشمالية قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (انظر الملاحظات).

steps.what: Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung ab 12 Wochen
Einen für Ihren GB-Ankunftsflughafen zugelassenen Charterbetreiber wählen
GB Pet Health Certificate (USA) oder gültiger EU-Heimtierausweis
Tierarzt behandelt Hunde gegen Bandwürmer
Heimtierkontrolle am zugelassenen Ankunftsflughafen

key_points: Verboten: Pit Bull, Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, XL Bully (nur mit Ausnahmebescheinigung)
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern: Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit (mind. 4 Monate einplanen)
Nordirland per Flugzeug: DAERA ≥10 Tage vorab informieren; nur Flughäfen Belfast oder Derry
Mehr als 5 Heimtiere oder Tier reist >5 Tage getrennt vom Halter: es gelten kommerzielle Regeln
export_points: In die EU: neue Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung pro Reise, Nutzung innerhalb von 10 Tagen nach Ausstellung
Danach 6 Monate gültig für Weiterreisen in der EU und die Rückkehr nach GB
Einwohner GBs können in GB ausgestellte EU-Heimtierausweise nicht für die Einreise in die EU nutzen
de.private_jet_note: Heimtiere dürfen nur mit einem für den jeweiligen GB-Ankunftsflughafen zugelassenen Charterbetreiber in der Kabine fliegen. Northolt, Doncaster und Prestwick sind nicht gelistet; bitte vor jedem Flug die Liste auf gov.uk prüfen.
de.summary: Großbritannien: Mikrochip, Tollwutimpfung (21 Tage Wartezeit), korrektes Dokument (EU-Heimtierausweis, GB AHC oder GB Pet Health Certificate), Bandwurmbehandlung für Hunde, Einreise nur über eine zugelassene Route/einen zugelassenen Beförderer (aus Irland/innerhalb des Vereinigten Königreichs keine Route nötig); aus nicht gelisteten Ländern zusätzlich Titertest und 3 Monate Wartezeit. Nordirland folgt den EU-Regeln (siehe Hinweise).

at_a_glance.microchip: Antes o junto con la vacuna antirrábica
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ≥21 días antes, a partir de 12+ semanas
