Examen vétérinaire et certificat officiel d'exportation du pays d'origine
Présenter l'animal et ses documents au poste de quarantaine du SENASA

key_points: Les animaux sans documents subissent 10+ jours de quarantaine sous surveillance vétérinaire
S'il manque 1 ou 2 vaccins autres que la rage : le propriétaire s'engage par écrit à vacciner sous 5 jours
Prévoir un agent du SENASA pour l'arrivée au FBO
export_points: Certificat d'exportation du SENASA requis pour quitter le pays, sauf séjours ≤ 20 jours avec vaccins à jour
Retour aux États-Unis : pays à haut risque de rage canine selon le CDC ; certificat lucilie bouchère (screwworm) requis
fr.summary: Le règlement 2026 du SENASA (Acuerdo CD-SENASA-001-2026, La Gaceta n° 37 146, 20 mai 2026) s'applique aux chiens et chats voyageant avec leur propriétaire. Ils doivent disposer d'un certificat vétérinaire international d'exportation délivré par l'autorité compétente du pays d'origine et d'un carnet de vaccination à jour. La vaccination antirabique est de préférence administrée 30 jours avant l'expédition, et le traitement antiparasitaire interne et externe de préférence dans les 30 jours. Les agents de quarantaine inspectent les animaux au point d'entrée. Un permis d'importation n'est exigé qu'à partir de 3 animaux.

steps.what: Sverminazione (entro 30 giorni) e verifica che i vaccini siano in corso di validità
Visita veterinaria e certificato ufficiale di esportazione del Paese d'origine
Presentare animale e documenti al posto di quarantena SENASA

key_points: Gli animali privi di documenti sono soggetti a 10+ giorni di quarantena sotto controllo veterinario
Se mancano 1–2 vaccini diversi dall'antirabbico: il proprietario si impegna per iscritto a vaccinare entro 5 giorni
Predisporre la presenza di un funzionario SENASA per l'arrivo all'FBO
export_points: Per lasciare il Paese occorre il certificato di esportazione SENASA, salvo soggiorni ≤20 giorni con vaccini in corso di validità
Rientro negli Stati Uniti: Paese ad alto rischio di rabbia canina secondo il CDC; richiesto il certificato per il verme avvitatore (Cochliomyia hominivorax)
it.summary: Il regolamento SENASA del 2026 (Acuerdo CD-SENASA-001-2026, La Gaceta n. 37,146, 20 maggio 2026) si applica a cani e gatti che viaggiano con i proprietari. Sono necessari un certificato veterinario internazionale di esportazione rilasciato dall'autorità competente del Paese d'origine e un libretto vaccinale aggiornato. La vaccinazione antirabbica va preferibilmente effettuata 30 giorni prima della spedizione, e la sverminazione interna ed esterna preferibilmente entro 30 giorni. Gli ispettori della quarantena controllano gli animali al punto d'ingresso. Il permesso d'importazione è richiesto solo per 3 o più animali.

steps.what: Дегельминтизация (в пределах 30 дней) и проверка действия прививок
Ветеринарный осмотр и официальный экспортный сертификат страны отправления
Предъявите животное и документы на карантинном посту SENASA

key_points: Животным без документов нужен карантин 10+ дней под ветеринарным надзором
Нет 1–2 прививок (кроме бешенства): владелец подписывает обязательство привить в течение 5 дней
Договоритесь о присутствии сотрудника SENASA при прибытии в FBO
export_points: Для выезда нужен экспортный сертификат SENASA, кроме пребывания ≤20 дней с действующими прививками
Возвращение в США: страна высокого риска по собачьему бешенству по CDC; требуется сертификат об отсутствии винтовой мухи
ru.summary: Регламент SENASA 2026 года (Acuerdo CD-SENASA-001-2026, La Gaceta No. 37,146, 20 мая 2026 г.) распространяется на собак и кошек, путешествующих с владельцами. Им нужны Международный ветеринарный экспортный сертификат компетентного ведомства страны отправления и действующая запись о прививках. Вакцинацию против бешенства желательно провести за 30 дней до отправки, а внутреннюю и внешнюю дегельминтизацию — желательно в пределах 30 дней. Карантинные инспекторы осматривают животных в пункте въезда. Разрешение на ввоз нужно только для 3 и более животных.

countries.name: Croatia
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the Ministry of Agriculture before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Croatia and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Croatia's points of entry are published by the Ministry of Agriculture (veterinarstvo.hr); confirm with the Ministry before travel that the arrival airport is on the list. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries – Veterinary and Food Safety Directorate
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

Young animals: Croatia accepts non-commercial entry from other EU states of pets under 12 weeks that are unvaccinated, or 12–16 weeks old and vaccinated but before the 21-day wait ends, with the owner's declaration of no contact with rabies-susceptible wild animals, or accompanied by the vaccinated mother. Never allowed from outside the EU.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: EU passport, or EU certificate ≤10 days (non-EU)

steps.what: ISO microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12+ weeks old)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid
From the US: EU health certificate endorsed by USDA APHIS; from the EU: EU pet passport
Carry the signed non-commercial declaration (non-EU origins)
From outside the EU: document and identity check at a travellers' point of entry

key_points: Max 5 pets per movement; each travels with the owner or within 5 days
From unlisted countries (e.g. Türkiye, Morocco, Israel, Thailand, South Africa): titer test plus a 3-month wait
Old-model EU certificates are accepted only if issued before 1 Oct 2026
export_points: To EU/EEA countries: EU pet passport from an authorised vet
Dogs going to FI, IE, MT, NO or Northern Ireland also need tapeworm treatment
To non-EU countries: meet destination rules; the official vet service endorses certificates
countries.private_jet_note: From outside the EU, land only at a point of entry on the Ministry of Agriculture list (veterinarstvo.hr). Confirm the arrival airport before routing.

at_a_glance.microchip: شريحة ISO، قبل لقاح داء الكلب
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: قبل الدخول بـ≥21 يومًا، بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا
at_a_glance.health_certificate: جواز أو شهادة أوروبية ≤10 أيام (خارج الاتحاد)

steps.what: شريحة ISO، ثم لقاح داء الكلب (للحيوان بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا)
يصبح التطعيم الأولي ضد داء الكلب صالحًا
من الولايات المتحدة: شهادة صحية أوروبية مصادق عليها من USDA APHIS؛ ومن الاتحاد الأوروبي: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف
حمل الإقرار الموقّع بأن النقل غير تجاري (للقادمين من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي)
من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: تدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين

key_points: الحد الأقصى 5 حيوانات لكل تنقّل؛ ويسافر كل منها مع المالك أو خلال 5 أيام
من الدول غير المُدرجة (مثل تركيا والمغرب وإسرائيل وتايلاند وجنوب أفريقيا): اختبار الأجسام المضادة مع انتظار 3 أشهر
لا تُقبل الشهادات الأوروبية بالنموذج القديم إلا إذا صدرت قبل 1 أكتوبر 2026
export_points: إلى دول الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف من طبيب بيطري معتمد
تحتاج الكلاب المتجهة إلى FI أو IE أو MT أو NO أو أيرلندا الشمالية أيضًا إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية
إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات
ar.private_jet_note: عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، يجب الهبوط فقط في نقطة دخول مُدرجة في قائمة وزارة الزراعة (veterinarstvo.hr). يُرجى تأكيد مطار الوصول قبل تحديد المسار.
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين.

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
Die Tollwut-Erstimpfung wird gültig
Aus den USA: von USDA APHIS beglaubigtes EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; aus der EU: EU-Heimtierausweis
Die unterschriebene Erklärung zur nicht kommerziellen Verbringung mitführen (Nicht-EU-Herkunft)
Von außerhalb der EU: Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrolle an einem Eingangsort für Reisende

key_points: Max. 5 Heimtiere pro Verbringung; jedes reist mit dem Halter oder innerhalb von 5 Tagen
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern (z. B. Türkei, Marokko, Israel, Thailand, Südafrika): Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit
EU-Zeugnisse nach altem Muster werden nur akzeptiert, wenn sie vor dem 1. Okt. 2026 ausgestellt wurden
export_points: In EU-/EWR-Länder: EU-Heimtierausweis von einem ermächtigten Tierarzt
Hunde nach FI, IE, MT, NO oder Nordirland benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Bestimmungen des Ziellandes erfüllen; der amtliche Veterinärdienst beglaubigt die Zeugnisse
de.private_jet_note: Bei Anreise von außerhalb der EU landen Sie ausschließlich an einem Eingangsort auf der Liste des Landwirtschaftsministeriums (veterinarstvo.hr). Bitte den Ankunftsflughafen vor der Routenplanung bestätigen.
de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende.

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, antes de la vacuna antirrábica
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ≥21 días antes de entrar, con 12+ semanas
at_a_glance.titer: No se requiere desde EE. UU./UE
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Pasaporte UE o certif. UE ≤10 días (no UE)
at_a_glance.quarantine: Ninguna si se cumplen los requisitos

steps.what: Microchip ISO y, después, vacuna antirrábica (mascota de 12+ semanas)
La primovacunación antirrábica pasa a ser válida
Desde EE. UU.: certificado sanitario de la UE refrendado por USDA APHIS; desde la UE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas
Lleve la declaración firmada de no comercialidad (orígenes fuera de la UE)
Desde fuera de la UE: control documental y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros

key_points: Máx. 5 mascotas por desplazamiento; cada una viaja con el propietario o en un plazo de 5 días
Desde países no incluidos en la lista (p. ej., Turquía, Marruecos, Israel, Tailandia, Sudáfrica): prueba de titulación más 3 meses de espera
Los certificados UE del modelo anterior solo se aceptan si se emitieron antes del 1 de octubre de 2026
export_points: A países de la UE/EEE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas de un veterinario autorizado
Los perros con destino a FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Norte necesitan además tratamiento contra la tenia
A países fuera de la UE: cumpla las normas del destino; el servicio veterinario oficial refrenda los certificados
es.private_jet_note: Desde fuera de la UE, aterrice solo en un punto de entrada incluido en la lista del Ministerio de Agricultura (veterinarstvo.hr). Confirme el aeropuerto de llegada antes de planificar la ruta.
es.summary: Normas de la UE (Reglamento Delegado (UE) 2026/131): desde otro Estado de la UE/EEE, mascota con microchip, vacunación antirrábica válida y pasaporte europeo para mascotas; desde fuera de la UE, certificado zoosanitario de la UE (más prueba de titulación antirrábica con 3 meses de espera si el país no figura en la lista) y controles documentales y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros.

at_a_glance.microchip: Puce ISO, avant le vaccin antirabique
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passeport UE ; hors UE, certificat ≤10 jours

steps.what: Puce électronique ISO, puis vaccin antirabique (animal âgé d'au moins 12 semaines)
La primovaccination antirabique devient valable
Depuis les États-Unis : certificat sanitaire UE visé par l'USDA APHIS ; depuis l'UE : passeport européen pour animal de compagnie
Munissez-vous de la déclaration signée attestant le caractère non commercial (origines hors UE)
Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE : contrôle documentaire et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs

key_points: 5 animaux max. par mouvement ; chacun voyage avec le propriétaire ou dans un délai de 5 jours
Depuis les pays non listés (p. ex. Turquie, Maroc, Israël, Thaïlande, Afrique du Sud) : titrage des anticorps antirabiques plus attente de 3 mois
Les certificats UE de l'ancien modèle ne sont acceptés que s'ils ont été délivrés avant le 1er oct. 2026
export_points: Vers les pays de l'UE/EEE : passeport européen délivré par un vétérinaire habilité
Les chiens à destination de FI, IE, MT, NO ou de l'Irlande du Nord nécessitent aussi un traitement contre le ténia
Vers les pays hors UE : respecter les règles du pays de destination ; le service vétérinaire officiel vise les certificats
fr.private_jet_note: Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE, atterrissez uniquement à un point d'entrée figurant sur la liste du ministère de l'Agriculture (veterinarstvo.hr). Confirmez l'aéroport d'arrivée avant d'établir l'itinéraire.
fr.summary: Règles de l'UE (règlement délégué (UE) 2026/131) : depuis un autre État de l'UE/EEE, animal identifié par puce électronique, avec vaccination antirabique valide et passeport européen pour animal de compagnie ; depuis l'extérieur de l'UE, certificat sanitaire de l'UE (plus titrage des anticorps antirabiques avec attente de 3 mois si le pays n'est pas listé) et contrôles documentaires et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs.

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, prima del vaccino antirabbico
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passaporto UE, o cert. UE ≤10 gg (extra UE)

steps.what: Microchip ISO, poi vaccino antirabbico (animale di 12+ settimane)
La vaccinazione antirabbica primaria diventa valida
Dagli Stati Uniti: certificato sanitario UE vidimato da USDA APHIS; dall'UE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia
Portare con sé la dichiarazione firmata di movimentazione non commerciale (origini extra UE)
Da fuori UE: controllo documentale e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori

key_points: Max 5 animali per movimentazione; ciascuno viaggia con il proprietario o entro 5 giorni
Da Paesi non elencati (ad es. Turchia, Marocco, Israele, Thailandia, Sudafrica): titolazione più attesa di 3 mesi
I certificati UE del vecchio modello sono accettati solo se rilasciati prima del 1 ott 2026
export_points: Verso Paesi UE/SEE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia rilasciato da un veterinario autorizzato
I cani diretti in FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Nord necessitano anche del trattamento contro la tenia (Echinococcus)
Verso Paesi extra UE: rispettare le norme della destinazione; il servizio veterinario ufficiale vidima i certificati
it.private_jet_note: Provenendo da fuori UE, occorre atterrare solo in un punto d'ingresso incluso nell'elenco del Ministero dell'Agricoltura (veterinarstvo.hr). Si consiglia di confermare l'aeroporto di arrivo prima di definire la rotta.
it.summary: Norme UE (Regolamento delegato (UE) 2026/131): da un altro Stato UE/SEE, animale con microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica valida e passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia; da fuori UE, certificato sanitario UE per animali (più titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici con attesa di 3 mesi se il Paese non è elencato) e controlli documentali e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori.

at_a_glance.microchip: Чип ISO, до прививки от бешенства
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Паспорт или сертификат ЕС ≤10 дней (не из ЕС)

steps.what: Микрочип ISO, затем прививка от бешенства (животному 12+ недель)
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной
Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС, заверенный USDA APHIS; из ЕС: европейский паспорт животного
Имейте при себе подписанную декларацию о некоммерческом перемещении (не из ЕС)
Из-за пределов ЕС: проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников

key_points: Не более 5 животных за одно перемещение; каждое следует с владельцем или в пределах 5 дней
Из стран вне перечня (например, Турция, Марокко, Израиль, Таиланд, ЮАР): тест на титр плюс ожидание 3 месяца
Сертификаты ЕС старого образца принимаются, только если выданы до 1 октября 2026 г.
export_points: В страны ЕС/ЕЭЗ: европейский паспорт животного от уполномоченного ветеринара
Собакам, направляющимся в FI, IE, MT, NO или Северную Ирландию, также нужна обработка от ленточных червей
В страны вне ЕС: соблюдайте правила страны назначения; сертификаты заверяет официальная ветеринарная служба
ru.private_jet_note: При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС совершайте посадку только в пункте въезда из перечня Министерства сельского хозяйства (veterinarstvo.hr). Уточните аэропорт прибытия до построения маршрута.
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников.

countries.name: Hungary
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the National Food Chain Safety Office (Nébih) before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Hungary and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Airport points of entry: Budapest Liszt Ferenc (24 h), Debrecen and Sármellék (08:00–20:00). Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: National Food Chain Safety Office (Nébih)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Young animals: Hungary does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

تحتاج الكلاب المتجهة إلى FI أو IE أو MT أو NO أو أيرلندا الشمالية أيضًا إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية
إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات

ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين.

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)

de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende.

Desde países no incluidos en la lista (p. ej., Turquía, Marruecos, Israel, Tailandia, Sudáfrica): prueba de titulación más 3 meses de espera

Munissez-vous de la déclaration signée attestant le caractère non commercial (origines hors UE)

countries.name: Ireland
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry. Dogs also need tapeworm treatment 24–120 h before entry. Non-EU arrivals (including from Great Britain) need advance notice and must use a travellers' point of entry (Dublin, Cork or Shannon airports).
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: Dogs only: treatment against Echinococcus multilocularis (praziquantel or proven equivalent) given by a vet 24–120 hours before scheduled entry and recorded in the passport or certificate. Not required for dogs coming directly from Finland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland. Cats: none.
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued). Dogs: tapeworm treatment 24–120 hours before arrival. From outside the EU (including Great Britain): complete the DAFM Advance Notice Portal before travel.
countries.restricted_breeds: Restricted breeds (and crosses) under Control of Dogs Regulations must be muzzled and on a strong lead (max 2 m) held by a person over 16 in public: American Pit Bull Terrier, English Bull Terrier, Staffordshire Bull Terrier, Bull Mastiff, Dobermann, German Shepherd, Rhodesian Ridgeback, Rottweiler, Japanese Akita, Japanese Tosa, Bandog. XL Bully type: import, breeding, sale and rehoming banned since 1 Oct 2024; ownership requires a Certificate of Exemption since 1 Feb 2025.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Ireland and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Travellers' points of entry: Dublin Airport, Cork Airport and Shannon Airport (plus Dublin Port, Rosslare and Ringaskiddy). Advance notice via the DAFM Advance Notice Portal is required before bringing a pet from a non-EU country (including Great Britain); a compliance check is done on arrival. DAFM may facilitate the landing of pets by private aircraft where possible: contact the chosen point of entry in advance to ask whether a private arrival can be facilitated. Pets that do not comply must not disembark. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To EU: EU pet passport from your vet (no tapeworm needed to leave, but dogs returning need tapeworm treatment from a vet abroad 24-120 h before re-entry). To non-EU: destination requirements; certificate endorsed by the DAFM Regional Veterinary Office – contact the RVO at least 2 months before travel. Dublin Airport (DAA) does not accept pets outbound as excess baggage since 19 July 2021.
countries.authority: Department of Agriculture, Food and the Marine (DAFM)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Non-EU arrivals (incl. GB): complete DAFM Advance Notice Portal (www.pettravel.gov.ie) before travel; for assistance dogs at least 24 h before departure.
Young animals: Ireland does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

لا يقبل مطار دبلن الحيوانات الأليفة المغادرة كأمتعة زائدة
ar.private_jet_note: عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي (بما في ذلك بريطانيا)، يجب الهبوط في دبلن أو كورك أو شانون مع إخطار مسبق، والاستفسار من المطار مسبقًا عمّا إذا كان بإمكانه تسهيل وصول رحلة خاصة. ولا يجوز إنزال الحيوانات غير المستوفية.
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين. كما تحتاج الكلاب إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية قبل الدخول بـ24–120 ساعة. ويحتاج القادمون من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي (بما في ذلك من بريطانيا العظمى) إلى إخطار مسبق ويجب أن يستخدموا نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين (مطارات دبلن أو كورك أو شانون).

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
Die Tollwut-Erstimpfung wird gültig
Aus den USA: von USDA APHIS beglaubigtes EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; aus der EU: EU-Heimtierausweis
Von außerhalb der EU (inkl. GB): DAFM Advance Notice Portal ausfüllen
Hunde: Bandwurmbehandlung durch einen Tierarzt, eingetragen im Ausweis oder Zeugnis
Die unterschriebene Erklärung zur nicht kommerziellen Verbringung mitführen (Nicht-EU-Herkunft)
Von außerhalb der EU: Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrolle an einem Eingangsort für Reisende

key_points: XL-Bully-Typen: Einfuhr seit 1. Okt. 2024 verboten
11 eingeschränkte Rassen (z. B. Rottweiler, Deutscher Schäferhund) müssen in der Öffentlichkeit Maulkorb und Leine tragen
Max. 5 Heimtiere pro Verbringung; jedes reist mit dem Halter oder innerhalb von 5 Tagen
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern (z. B. Türkei, Marokko, Israel, Thailand, Südafrika): Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit
EU-Zeugnisse nach altem Muster werden nur akzeptiert, wenn sie vor dem 1. Okt. 2026 ausgestellt wurden
export_points: In die EU: EU-Heimtierausweis; zurückkehrende Hunde benötigen im Ausland eine Bandwurmbehandlung 24–120 Std. vor der Wiedereinreise
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Zeugnis vom DAFM Regional Veterinary Office beglaubigt; mind. 2 Monate vorab kontaktieren
Der Flughafen Dublin akzeptiert Heimtiere bei der Ausreise nicht als Übergepäck
de.private_jet_note: Bei Anreise von außerhalb der EU (inkl. GB) landen Sie mit Voranmeldung in Dublin, Cork oder Shannon und klären vorab mit dem Flughafen, ob er eine private Ankunft abwickeln kann. Nicht konforme Tiere dürfen nicht von Bord.
de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende. Hunde benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung 24–120 Std. vor der Einreise. Ankünfte von außerhalb der EU (einschließlich Großbritannien) erfordern eine Voranmeldung und müssen über einen Eingangsort für Reisende erfolgen (Flughäfen Dublin, Cork oder Shannon).

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, antes de la vacuna antirrábica
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ≥21 días antes de entrar, con 12+ semanas
at_a_glance.titer: No se requiere desde EE. UU./UE
at_a_glance.permit: Ninguno; aviso previo si viene de fuera UE
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Pasaporte UE o certif. UE ≤10 días (no UE)
at_a_glance.quarantine: Ninguna si se cumplen los requisitos

steps.what: Microchip ISO y, después, vacuna antirrábica (mascota de 12+ semanas)
La primovacunación antirrábica pasa a ser válida
Desde EE. UU.: certificado sanitario de la UE refrendado por USDA APHIS; desde la UE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas
Desde fuera de la UE (incl. GB): complete el Advance Notice Portal del DAFM
Perros: tratamiento contra la tenia administrado por un veterinario y registrado en el pasaporte o el certificado
Lleve la declaración firmada de no comercialidad (orígenes fuera de la UE)
Desde fuera de la UE: control documental y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros

key_points: Tipos XL Bully: importación prohibida desde el 1 de octubre de 2024
11 razas restringidas (p. ej., Rottweiler, Pastor Alemán) deben llevar bozal y correa en público
Máx. 5 mascotas por desplazamiento; cada una viaja con el propietario o en un plazo de 5 días
Desde países no incluidos en la lista (p. ej., Turquía, Marruecos, Israel, Tailandia, Sudáfrica): prueba de titulación más 3 meses de espera
Los certificados UE del modelo anterior solo se aceptan si se emitieron antes del 1 de octubre de 2026
export_points: A la UE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas; los perros que regresan necesitan tratamiento contra la tenia en el extranjero 24–120 h antes del reingreso
A países fuera de la UE: certificado refrendado por la Oficina Veterinaria Regional del DAFM; contacte con ella con 2+ meses de antelación
El aeropuerto de Dublín no acepta mascotas como exceso de equipaje en salidas
es.private_jet_note: Desde fuera de la UE (incl. GB), aterrice en Dublín, Cork o Shannon con notificación previa y consulte antes al aeropuerto si puede facilitar una llegada privada. Las mascotas no conformes no pueden desembarcar.
es.summary: Normas de la UE (Reglamento Delegado (UE) 2026/131): desde otro Estado de la UE/EEE, mascota con microchip, vacunación antirrábica válida y pasaporte europeo para mascotas; desde fuera de la UE, certificado zoosanitario de la UE (más prueba de titulación antirrábica con 3 meses de espera si el país no figura en la lista) y controles documentales y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros. Los perros necesitan además tratamiento contra la tenia 24–120 h antes de la entrada. Las llegadas desde fuera de la UE (incluida Gran Bretaña) requieren notificación previa y deben utilizar un punto de entrada de viajeros (aeropuertos de Dublín, Cork o Shannon).

at_a_glance.microchip: Puce ISO, avant le vaccin antirabique
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passeport UE ; hors UE, certificat ≤10 jours

steps.what: Puce électronique ISO, puis vaccin antirabique (animal âgé d'au moins 12 semaines)
La primovaccination antirabique devient valable
Depuis les États-Unis : certificat sanitaire UE visé par l'USDA APHIS ; depuis l'UE : passeport européen pour animal de compagnie
Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE (y compris GB) : remplir le formulaire du DAFM Advance Notice Portal
Chiens : traitement contre le ténia par un vétérinaire, consigné dans le passeport ou le certificat
Munissez-vous de la déclaration signée attestant le caractère non commercial (origines hors UE)
Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE : contrôle documentaire et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs

key_points: Types XL Bully : importation interdite depuis le 1er octobre 2024
11 races réglementées (p. ex. Rottweiler, Berger allemand) doivent être muselées et tenues en laisse en public
5 animaux max. par mouvement ; chacun voyage avec le propriétaire ou dans un délai de 5 jours
Depuis les pays non listés (p. ex. Turquie, Maroc, Israël, Thaïlande, Afrique du Sud) : titrage des anticorps antirabiques plus attente de 3 mois
Les certificats UE de l'ancien modèle ne sont acceptés que s'ils ont été délivrés avant le 1er oct. 2026
export_points: Vers l'UE : passeport européen ; au retour, les chiens doivent être traités contre le ténia à l'étranger 24 à 120 h avant la réentrée
Vers les pays hors UE : certificat visé par le Regional Veterinary Office du DAFM ; le contacter 2+ mois à l'avance
L'aéroport de Dublin n'accepte pas les animaux au départ en bagage excédentaire
fr.private_jet_note: En provenance de l'extérieur de l'UE (y compris GB), atterrissez à Dublin, Cork ou Shannon avec notification préalable, et demandez au préalable à l'aéroport s'il peut faciliter une arrivée privée. Les animaux non conformes peuvent se voir refuser le débarquement.
fr.summary: Règles de l'UE (règlement délégué (UE) 2026/131) : depuis un autre État de l'UE/EEE, animal identifié par puce électronique, avec vaccination antirabique valide et passeport européen pour animal de compagnie ; depuis l'extérieur de l'UE, certificat sanitaire de l'UE (plus titrage des anticorps antirabiques avec attente de 3 mois si le pays n'est pas listé) et contrôles documentaires et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs. Les chiens doivent également recevoir un traitement contre le ténia 24 à 120 h avant l'entrée. Les arrivées hors UE (y compris depuis la Grande-Bretagne) nécessitent une notification préalable et doivent passer par un point d'entrée des voyageurs (aéroports de Dublin, Cork ou Shannon).

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, prima del vaccino antirabbico
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passaporto UE, o cert. UE ≤10 gg (extra UE)

steps.what: Microchip ISO, poi vaccino antirabbico (animale di 12+ settimane)
La vaccinazione antirabbica primaria diventa valida
Dagli Stati Uniti: certificato sanitario UE vidimato da USDA APHIS; dall'UE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia
Da fuori UE (incl. GB): compilare il DAFM Advance Notice Portal
Cani: trattamento contro la tenia effettuato da un veterinario e registrato nel passaporto o nel certificato
Portare con sé la dichiarazione firmata di movimentazione non commerciale (origini extra UE)
Da fuori UE: controllo documentale e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori

key_points: Tipologie XL Bully: importazione vietata dal 1° ott 2024
11 razze soggette a restrizioni (es. Rottweiler, Pastore Tedesco) devono portare museruola e guinzaglio in pubblico
Max 5 animali per movimentazione; ciascuno viaggia con il proprietario o entro 5 giorni
Da Paesi non elencati (ad es. Turchia, Marocco, Israele, Thailandia, Sudafrica): titolazione più attesa di 3 mesi
I certificati UE del vecchio modello sono accettati solo se rilasciati prima del 1 ott 2026
export_points: Verso l'UE: passaporto europeo; i cani di rientro necessitano di un trattamento contro la tenia all'estero 24–120 h prima del rientro
Verso Paesi extra UE: certificato vidimato dal DAFM Regional Veterinary Office, da contattare con 2+ mesi di anticipo
L'aeroporto di Dublino non accetta animali in partenza come bagaglio in eccedenza
it.private_jet_note: Provenendo da fuori UE (incl. GB), occorre atterrare a Dublino, Cork o Shannon con preavviso, verificando in anticipo con l'aeroporto la possibilità di gestire un arrivo privato. Gli animali non in regola potrebbero non essere autorizzati a sbarcare.
it.summary: Norme UE (Regolamento delegato (UE) 2026/131): da un altro Stato UE/SEE, animale con microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica valida e passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia; da fuori UE, certificato sanitario UE per animali (più titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici con attesa di 3 mesi se il Paese non è elencato) e controlli documentali e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori. I cani necessitano inoltre di un trattamento contro la tenia 24–120 h prima dell'ingresso. Gli arrivi extra UE (inclusi quelli dalla Gran Bretagna) richiedono un preavviso e devono utilizzare un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori (aeroporti di Dublino, Cork o Shannon).

at_a_glance.microchip: Чип ISO, до прививки от бешенства
at_a_glance.permit: Нет; уведомление заранее, если не из ЕС
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Паспорт или сертификат ЕС ≤10 дней (не из ЕС)

steps.what: Микрочип ISO, затем прививка от бешенства (животному 12+ недель)
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной
Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС, заверенный USDA APHIS; из ЕС: европейский паспорт животного
Из-за пределов ЕС (включая Великобританию): заполните форму на портале предварительного уведомления DAFM
Собаки: обработка от ленточных червей у ветеринара с отметкой в паспорте или сертификате
Имейте при себе подписанную декларацию о некоммерческом перемещении (не из ЕС)
Из-за пределов ЕС: проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников

key_points: Типы XL-булли: ввоз запрещён с 1 октября 2024 г.
11 ограниченных пород (например, ротвейлер, немецкая овчарка) в общественных местах должны быть в наморднике и на поводке
Не более 5 животных за одно перемещение; каждое следует с владельцем или в пределах 5 дней
Из стран вне перечня (например, Турция, Марокко, Израиль, Таиланд, ЮАР): тест на титр плюс ожидание 3 месяца
Сертификаты ЕС старого образца принимаются, только если выданы до 1 октября 2026 г.
export_points: В ЕС: европейский паспорт животного; возвращающимся собакам нужна обработка от ленточных червей за рубежом за 24–120 ч до обратного въезда
В страны вне ЕС: сертификат, заверенный Региональной ветеринарной службой DAFM; обратитесь туда за 2+ месяца
Аэропорт Дублина не принимает животных к вылету в качестве сверхнормативного багажа
ru.private_jet_note: При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС (включая Великобританию) совершайте посадку в Дублине, Корке или Шанноне с предварительным уведомлением и заранее уточните в аэропорту возможность приёма частного рейса. Животным, не отвечающим требованиям, не разрешается сходить с борта.
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников. Собакам также нужна обработка от ленточных червей за 24–120 ч до въезда. Прибывающим не из ЕС (включая Великобританию) нужно предварительное уведомление и въезд через пункт въезда для путешественников (аэропорты Дублина, Корка или Шаннона).

countries.name: Israel
countries.summary: Up to two dogs or cats travelling with their owner on the same flight need no import permit, but must meet the health conditions: microchip, rabies vaccination, a titre of at least 0.5 IU/ml (except for pets born in listed rabies-free countries), and an Israeli-model certificate within 10 days. The Veterinary Services at the port must be notified in advance.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785 microchip (or tattoo), implanted before the rabies vaccine and blood test. If the chip is non-ISO, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Required at 0.5 IU/ml or more from a WOAH- and/or EU-approved lab. The sample must be taken at least 30 days after vaccination, or 14 days if the pet has had multiple vaccinations and more than 30 days have passed since the first. Per the 2020 USDA guidance, the result stays valid for life while rabies vaccinations remain current. Exempt: pets born in the rabies-free countries listed above.
countries.import_permit: Not required for up to 2 dogs or cats accompanying the owner on the same flight, provided the pet stays with the owner. Otherwise an import licence from the Director of Veterinary Services is required, and permit animals arrive as manifested cargo only (cargo inspections Sunday to Thursday, 06:00–24:00).
countries.quarantine: No quarantine for compliant pets.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 30 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA or EU: titre test on a currently vaccinated pet (no waiting period after the result), health certificate within 10 days of departure, and the Annex B notification at least 2 working days before departure. Pets born in listed rabies-free countries need about 10 days. From scratch, plan at least 2–3 months: microchip → rabies vaccination at 3 months or older → titre at least 30 days later → health certificate within 10 days of departure → Annex B notification → arrive at an approved port.
countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited unless a case-by-case import permit is granted (vs-ie@moag.gov.il): American Staffordshire Terrier, Bull Terrier, Dogo Argentino, Japanese Tosa, Staffordshire Bull Terrier, Pit Bull Terrier, Fila Brasileiro, Rottweiler, plus crosses and look-alikes. Minimum age 4 months on arrival (3 months for pets from rabies-free countries).
countries.private_aviation: Approved ports of entry: Ben Gurion Airport, Haifa, Ashdod and Eilat seaports. Private jets with pets must arrive at Ben Gurion (TLV); other airports (e.g. Ramon/ETM) are not approved ports of entry. A pet travelling with its owner on the same private flight fits the 'accompanied' route (2 pets or fewer, no permit). Send the pre-arrival notification to vs-airport@moag.gov.il at least 2 working days before departure. Shipments are not released until the Veterinary Services authorise them.
countries.export: Israel is on the CDC high-risk list and is not EU-listed: for return to the US or EU, prepare the US rabies certification / EU titer before leaving. Contact Israel's Veterinary Services for export certification.
countries.authority: Israeli Veterinary Services and Animal Health (IVSAH), Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security
vaccinations: Rabies: vaccinated at 3 months or older, not more than 1 year and not less than 30 days before arrival. No 30-day wait if the pet has had more than one vaccination and is still within validity.
Pets born in rabies-free countries (Australia, New Zealand, Sweden, Cyprus, Singapore, Japan, UK, Ireland): if not vaccinated, dogs must be vaccinated within 5 days of arrival.
documents: Veterinary health certificate on the Israeli model, signed or endorsed by a government veterinarian of the origin country, issued within 10 days before departure (USDA: no more than 10 days before arrival)
Owner declaration that the pet has been in their possession for at least 90 days (Annex C)
Notification of Pet Arrival (Annex B) plus a copy of the certificate, sent to the port's Veterinary Services
Import permit only for more than 2 animals, unaccompanied or cargo shipments, or restricted breeds

at_a_glance.microchip: ISO, before rabies shot and titer
at_a_glance.permit: Not required for up to 2 pets

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 3+ months old)
Blood draw for the rabies titer (≥0.5 IU/ml)
Israeli-model health certificate, government-endorsed
Email the Annex B arrival notice and certificate copy to port vets
Veterinary Services check at Ben Gurion before release

key_points: Max 2 pets travelling with the owner; more needs an import licence and cargo
Pit Bull types, Rottweiler, Dogo Argentino and other breeds banned unless a permit is granted
Minimum age 4 months on arrival (3 months from rabies-free countries)
Owner must declare the pet has been theirs for at least 90 days
export_points: Israel is CDC high-risk and not EU-listed: prepare US rabies papers or the EU titer before leaving
countries.private_jet_note: Pets may enter only via Ben Gurion (TLV); Ramon and other airports are not approved ports. Email the Annex B arrival notice to vs-airport@moag.gov.il at least 2 working days before departure.

at_a_glance.microchip: ISO، قبل لقاح داء الكلب واختبار المعايرة
at_a_glance.titer: مطلوب، إلا لمواليد الدول الخالية من الداء
at_a_glance.permit: غير مطلوب لما يصل إلى 2 من الحيوانات

steps.what: الشريحة الإلكترونية، ثم لقاح داء الكلب (للحيوان بعمر 3+ أشهر)
سحب عينة الدم لمعايرة الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب (≥0.5 IU/ml)
شهادة صحية وفق النموذج الإسرائيلي، مصادق عليها حكوميًا
إرسال إشعار الوصول (الملحق B) ونسخة من الشهادة بالبريد الإلكتروني إلى أطباء المنفذ البيطريين
فحص الخدمات البيطرية في مطار بن غوريون قبل الإفراج

key_points: الحد الأقصى 2 من الحيوانات المسافرة مع المالك؛ والعدد الأكبر يتطلب ترخيص استيراد وشحنًا
أنواع البيتبول والروت وايلر والدوغو الأرجنتيني وسلالات أخرى محظورة ما لم يُمنح تصريح
الحد الأدنى للعمر 4 أشهر عند الوصول (3 أشهر من الدول الخالية من داء الكلب)
يجب أن يُقر المالك بأن الحيوان في ملكيته منذ 90 يومًا على الأقل
export_points: إسرائيل مصنفة عالية المخاطر لدى CDC وغير مُدرجة لدى الاتحاد الأوروبي: يُرجى تجهيز مستندات داء الكلب الأمريكية أو اختبار الأجسام المضادة الأوروبي قبل المغادرة
ar.private_jet_note: لا يجوز دخول الحيوانات الأليفة إلا عبر مطار بن غوريون (TLV)؛ ومطار رامون والمطارات الأخرى ليست منافذ معتمدة. يُرجى إرسال إشعار الوصول (الملحق B) بالبريد الإلكتروني إلى vs-airport@moag.gov.il قبل المغادرة بيومَي عمل (2) على الأقل.
ar.summary: لا يحتاج ما يصل إلى كلبين أو قطتين مسافرَين مع المالك على الرحلة نفسها إلى تصريح استيراد، لكن يجب استيفاء الشروط الصحية: شريحة إلكترونية، وتطعيم ضد داء الكلب، ومعايرة أجسام مضادة لا تقل عن 0.5 IU/ml (باستثناء الحيوانات المولودة في دول مُدرجة خالية من داء الكلب)، وشهادة وفق النموذج الإسرائيلي خلال 10 أيام. ويجب إخطار الخدمات البيطرية في منفذ الدخول مسبقًا.

at_a_glance.titer: Pflicht, außer Geburt in tollwutfreiem Land
at_a_glance.permit: Nicht nötig für bis zu 2 Tiere

steps.what: Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier ab 3 Monaten)
Blutentnahme für den Tollwut-Titer (≥0,5 IE/ml)
Gesundheitszeugnis nach israelischem Muster, staatlich beglaubigt
Ankunftsmeldung nach Anlage B und Zeugniskopie per E-Mail an die Hafentierärzte senden
Kontrolle der Veterinärdienste in Ben Gurion vor der Freigabe

Pitbull-Typen, Rottweiler, Dogo Argentino und weitere Rassen verboten, sofern keine Genehmigung erteilt wird

Die Veterinärdienste am Eingangsort sind vorab zu benachrichtigen.

countries.name: Isle of Man
countries.summary: Free movement of most dogs/cats from Great Britain (no animal health requirements) and from Northern Ireland; pets from the EU cannot land directly by private plane or boat (except from Ireland with DEFA pre-notification) and generally come via GB with an approved transporter; direct import from non-EU countries is prohibited (must enter GB first).
countries.microchip: Required for routes via GB/EU per GB/EU rules; not required for GB-IoM movement.
countries.rabies_titer: Only as required by GB rules for unlisted countries (pets must clear GB first).
countries.parasite_treatment: Dogs from the EU: tapeworm treatment 24-120 h before arrival in the UK/IoM (per GB rules).
countries.import_permit: Direct import from non-EU countries prohibited.
countries.quarantine: None for compliant GB-cleared pets.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA or EU: the pet first enters Great Britain under GB rules (GB pet health certificate or EU pet passport/AHC, dog tapeworm treatment 1–5 days before), then moves freely to the Isle of Man. gov.im advises contacting your vet at least 4 months before travel.
countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited from import: XL Bully, Pit Bull Terrier, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, Japanese Tosa (by appearance); UK exemption certificates are not valid on IoM.
countries.private_aviation: Animals cannot be landed directly from an EU country to IoM by private aircraft (exception: Republic of Ireland with DEFA pre-notification). Non-EU origin: prohibited directly; enter GB via a Border Control Post first. GB to IoM by private jet: free movement for non-banned dogs/cats.
countries.export: To EU and Northern Ireland: Animal Health Certificate from a vet for each journey (Official Veterinarian), microchip, rabies, dog tapeworm, entry via Travellers' Point of Entry; EU pet passports issued to GB/IoM residents no longer valid from 22 Apr 2026. To Dublin Port: advance notice at least 24 h before arrival.
countries.authority: Department of Environment, Food and Agriculture (DEFA), Isle of Man
vaccinations: Rabies: required for pets coming from the EU/other countries via GB under GB rules; not for GB-IoM movement.
documents: GB/NI to IoM: none.
From Ireland direct: pre-notify DEFA.
EU via GB: GB entry documents (pet passport/AHC) and DEFRA-authorised pet transporter by prior arrangement with DEFA.

export_points: В ЕС или Северную Ирландию: ветеринарный сертификат (AHC) на каждую поездку, чип, бешенство, обработка собак от ленточных червей
Европейские паспорта животных, выданные резидентам Великобритании/о. Мэн, недействительны с 22 апреля 2026 г.
В порт Дублина: подайте предварительное уведомление не менее чем за 24 ч до прибытия
ru.private_jet_note: Прямая посадка частного самолёта с животными из ЕС (кроме Ирландии с уведомлением DEFA) или из-за пределов ЕС невозможна. Летите через Великобританию; между Великобританией и островом действует свободное перемещение.
ru.summary: Свободное перемещение большинства собак/кошек из Великобритании (без ветеринарных требований) и из Северной Ирландии; животные из ЕС не могут прибывать напрямую частным самолётом или судном (кроме как из Ирландии с предварительным уведомлением DEFA) и, как правило, следуют через Великобританию с одобренным перевозчиком; прямой ввоз из стран вне ЕС запрещён (сначала необходимо въехать в Великобританию).

countries.name: India
countries.summary: Up to 2 pet dogs or cats per passenger may be imported under the Baggage Rules: transfer of residence (2+ years abroad), re-import, or short stay (short stay needs a DGFT licence). An Advance NOC must be obtained from AQCS through the CBIC ATITHI 2.0 portal at least 7 working days before embarkation. Entry only through the notified ports: Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru and Hyderabad.
countries.microchip: Required. Microchip number goes on the NOC application, and a vaccination and microchip certificate is submitted.
countries.import_permit: Advance NOC (AQCS) for all pets. A DGFT import licence for pets not on transfer of residence or re-import (short stays). More than 2 pets needs a DAHD sanitary import permit or DGFT licence.
countries.quarantine: None if the pet is healthy and documents are in order (Final NOC at the port). Pets failing the examination or showing disease signs: 15 days at the AQCS quarantine station at the owner's cost.
countries.timeline: Plan at least 4–6 weeks before travel (longer if a DGFT licence is needed, about 1 month): rabies vaccine ≥30 days before → health certificate and endorsement → ATITHI 2.0 application ≥7 working days before embarkation → Advance NOC (about 1 working day) → arrival inspection → Final NOC.
countries.private_aviation: The arrival airport must be one of the six notified ports (Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Hyderabad), and the AQCS officer must examine the pet on arrival. Coordinate with AQCS and customs at that airport.
countries.export: Apply to AQCS for the export veterinary health certificate / NOC (fee Rs 500). Keep the AQCS export certificate, because it is required for later re-import.
countries.authority: Animal Quarantine and Certification Services (AQCS), Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD)
vaccinations: Rabies: at least 30 days and not more than 1 year before travel (Indian consulate guidance). US 3-year vaccines older than 1 year must be repeated.

Other vaccinations per the AQCS veterinary health certificate (Annexure 1.1.1). The certificate covers freedom from rabies and distemper, and for dogs also Aujeszky's, leishmaniasis and leptospirosis.
documents: Advance NOC from AQCS through the ATITHI 2.0 portal (application Annexure 1.1). Fee Rs 1000. Airlines will not carry the pet without it.
Official veterinary health certificate in AQCS format (Annexure 1.1.1), signed by the exporting country's competent authority
Vaccination and microchip certificate / pet passport
Air ticket or airway bill, passport copy
Proof of eligibility: transfer of residence (2-year overseas stay, relocation proof), re-import (earlier AQCS export certificate), or a DGFT licence for short stays
Final NOC issued by AQCS at the port after inspection, then customs clearance

steps.what: Confirm eligibility: residence transfer, re-import, or DGFT licence for short stays
Rabies vaccine (repeat a US 3-year shot older than 1 year)
Apply for the Advance NOC on the ATITHI 2.0 portal
Official health certificate in AQCS format, government-signed
AQCS inspection and Final NOC, then customs clearance

key_points: Max 2 pets per passenger; more needs a DAHD permit or DGFT licence
Entry only via Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru or Hyderabad
Short stays need a DGFT import licence (about 1 month)
Pets failing the arrival exam face 15 days' quarantine at your cost
export_points: Apply to AQCS for the export health certificate/NOC (fee Rs 500)
Keep the AQCS export certificate: it is needed to re-import the pet
countries.private_jet_note: Pets may arrive only at the six notified ports (Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Hyderabad), with an AQCS examination on arrival. Coordinate with AQCS and customs at that airport.

at_a_glance.quarantine: لا يوجد إذا كان سليمًا ومستوفيًا

steps.what: التأكد من الأهلية: نقل الإقامة، أو إعادة الاستيراد، أو ترخيص DGFT للإقامات القصيرة
لقاح داء الكلب (يُعاد لقاح الـ3 سنوات الأمريكي إذا تجاوز عمره سنة 1)
التقدّم بطلب NOC المسبقة عبر بوابة ATITHI 2.0
شهادة صحية رسمية بصيغة AQCS، موقّعة حكوميًا
فحص AQCS وNOC النهائية، ثم التخليص الجمركي

key_points: الحد الأقصى 2 من الحيوانات لكل مسافر؛ والعدد الأكبر يتطلب تصريح DAHD أو ترخيص DGFT
الدخول فقط عبر دلهي أو مومباي أو تشيناي أو كولكاتا أو بنغالورو أو حيدر أباد
تحتاج الإقامات القصيرة إلى ترخيص استيراد من DGFT (نحو 1 شهر)
تخضع الحيوانات التي لا تجتاز فحص الوصول لحجر صحي مدته 15 يومًا على نفقتكم
export_points: التقدّم إلى AQCS بطلب الشهادة الصحية للتصدير/NOC (الرسوم 500 روبية Rs)
يُرجى الاحتفاظ بشهادة التصدير الصادرة عن AQCS: فهي مطلوبة لإعادة استيراد الحيوان الأليف
ar.private_jet_note: لا يجوز وصول الحيوانات الأليفة إلا عبر الموانئ الستة المُعلنة (دلهي، مومباي، تشيناي، كولكاتا، بنغالورو، حيدر آباد)، مع فحص من AQCS عند الوصول. يُرجى التنسيق مع AQCS والجمارك في ذلك المطار.
ar.summary: يجوز استيراد ما يصل إلى 2 من الكلاب أو القطط الأليفة لكل مسافر بموجب قواعد الأمتعة: نقل الإقامة (بعد 2+ سنة في الخارج)، أو إعادة الاستيراد، أو الإقامة القصيرة (تحتاج الإقامة القصيرة إلى ترخيص من DGFT). ويجب الحصول على شهادة عدم ممانعة مسبقة (Advance NOC) من AQCS عبر بوابة CBIC ATITHI 2.0 قبل الصعود إلى الطائرة بـ7 أيام عمل على الأقل. ولا يُسمح بالدخول إلا عبر المنافذ المعتمدة: دلهي، ومومباي، وتشيناي، وكولكاتا، وبنغالورو، وحيدر أباد.

steps.what: Berechtigung klären: Wohnsitzverlegung, Wiedereinfuhr oder DGFT-Lizenz für Kurzaufenthalte
Tollwutimpfung (eine über 1 Jahr alte US-3-Jahres-Impfung wiederholen)
Advance NOC im ATITHI-2.0-Portal beantragen
Amtliches Gesundheitszeugnis im AQCS-Format, staatlich unterzeichnet
AQCS-Kontrolle und Final NOC, danach Zollabfertigung

Tiere, die die Untersuchung bei Ankunft nicht bestehen, kommen 15 Tage auf Ihre Kosten in Quarantäne
export_points: Ausfuhrgesundheitszeugnis/NOC bei AQCS beantragen (Gebühr Rs 500)
AQCS-Ausfuhrzeugnis aufbewahren: es wird für die Wiedereinfuhr benötigt
de.private_jet_note: Heimtiere dürfen nur an den sechs notifizierten Eingangsorten ankommen (Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Hyderabad), mit einer AQCS-Untersuchung bei Ankunft. Stimmen Sie sich mit AQCS und dem Zoll an diesem Flughafen ab.
de.summary: Bis zu 2 Hunde oder Katzen pro Passagier dürfen nach den Gepäckbestimmungen eingeführt werden: bei Wohnsitzverlegung (mind. 2 Jahre im Ausland), Wiedereinfuhr oder Kurzaufenthalt (Kurzaufenthalt erfordert eine DGFT-Lizenz). Ein Advance NOC muss mindestens 7 Arbeitstage vor dem Einsteigen bei AQCS über das CBIC-Portal ATITHI 2.0 eingeholt werden. Einreise nur über die benannten Häfen: Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru und Hyderabad.

Inspección de la AQCS y Final NOC; después, despacho de aduanas

Entrada solo por Delhi, Bombay, Chennai, Calcuta, Bangalore o Hyderabad
Las estancias cortas requieren licencia de importación de la DGFT (aprox. 1 mes)
Las mascotas que no superen el examen a la llegada cumplen 15 días de cuarentena a su cargo
export_points: Solicite a la AQCS el certificado sanitario de exportación/NOC (tasa de Rs 500)

es.private_jet_note: Las mascotas solo pueden llegar a los seis puertos notificados (Delhi, Bombay, Chennai, Calcuta, Bangalore, Hyderabad), con un examen del AQCS a la llegada. Coordínese con el AQCS y la aduana de ese aeropuerto.
es.summary: Pueden importarse hasta 2 perros o gatos de compañía por pasajero conforme a las Baggage Rules: traslado de residencia (2+ años en el extranjero), reimportación o estancia corta (la estancia corta requiere licencia de la DGFT). Entrada solo por los puertos notificados: Delhi, Bombay, Chennai, Calcuta, Bangalore y Hyderabad.

I soggiorni brevi richiedono una licenza d'importazione DGFT (circa 1 mese)

Животные, не прошедшие осмотр по прибытии, помещаются в карантин на 15 дней за Ваш счёт

Сохраните экспортный сертификат AQCS: он нужен для повторного ввоза животного

countries.name: Iraq
countries.summary: The USDA–Iraq certificate requires a health certificate from a licensed veterinarian (valid 30 days, no USDA endorsement needed) with rabies vaccination details. From other origins, confirm the conditions with the Iraqi veterinary authorities before travel.
countries.microchip: Listed if present (the certificate verifies microchips but does not explicitly require one).
countries.timeline: Plan at least 1 month before travel: rabies vaccination → health certificate within 30 days of travel. For Kurdistan Region (Erbil) arrivals, confirm the procedure with the regional authorities before travel.
countries.authority: Ministry of Agriculture – Iraqi Veterinary Hospital / veterinary quarantine
vaccinations: Rabies: vaccination with date, vaccine name and validity period recorded on the certificate.
documents: Veterinary health certificate (US version: issued by a licensed vet, valid 30 days after issuance, USDA endorsement not required)
key_points: US origin: licensed-vet certificate, no USDA endorsement needed
From origins other than the US, confirm the conditions with the Iraqi veterinary authorities
For Erbil (Kurdistan Region) arrivals, confirm the procedure with the regional authorities

للقادمين إلى أربيل (إقليم كردستان)، يُرجى تأكيد الإجراءات مع السلطات الإقليمية
ar.summary: تشترط الشهادة الثنائية بين USDA والعراق شهادة صحية من طبيب بيطري مرخّص (صالحة 30 يومًا، دون حاجة إلى مصادقة USDA) تتضمن بيانات التطعيم ضد داء الكلب. ومن بلدان المنشأ الأخرى، يُرجى تأكيد الشروط مع السلطات البيطرية العراقية قبل السفر.

Bei anderen Herkunftsländern als den USA die Bedingungen bei den irakischen Veterinärbehörden bestätigen lassen
Bei Ankünften in Erbil (Region Kurdistan) das Verfahren bei den regionalen Behörden bestätigen lassen
de.summary: Das USDA-Irak-Zeugnis verlangt ein Gesundheitszeugnis eines zugelassenen Tierarztes (30 Tage gültig, keine USDA-Beglaubigung nötig) mit Angaben zur Tollwutimpfung. Bei anderen Herkunftsländern bitte die Bedingungen vor der Reise bei den irakischen Veterinärbehörden bestätigen lassen.

key_points: Origen EE. UU.: certificado de veterinario colegiado, sin refrendo del USDA
Desde orígenes distintos de EE. UU., confirme las condiciones con las autoridades veterinarias iraquíes
Para llegadas a Erbil (Región del Kurdistán), confirme el procedimiento con las autoridades regionales
es.summary: El certificado USDA–Irak exige un certificado sanitario de un veterinario colegiado (válido 30 días, sin necesidad de refrendo del USDA) con los datos de la vacunación antirrábica. Desde otros orígenes, confirme las condiciones con las autoridades veterinarias iraquíes antes del viaje.

key_points: Origine États-Unis : certificat d'un vétérinaire agréé, sans visa USDA
Pour les provenances autres que les États-Unis, confirmez les conditions auprès des autorités vétérinaires irakiennes
Pour les arrivées à Erbil (région du Kurdistan), confirmez la procédure auprès des autorités régionales
fr.summary: Le certificat USDA–Irak exige un certificat sanitaire établi par un vétérinaire agréé (valable 30 jours, sans visa USDA) mentionnant la vaccination antirabique. Pour les autres provenances, confirmez les conditions auprès des autorités vétérinaires irakiennes avant le voyage.

key_points: Provenienza USA: certificato di veterinario abilitato, vidimazione USDA non necessaria
Per provenienze diverse dagli Stati Uniti, verificare le condizioni con le autorità veterinarie irachene
Per gli arrivi a Erbil (Regione del Kurdistan), verificare la procedura con le autorità regionali
it.summary: Il certificato USDA–Iraq richiede un certificato sanitario rilasciato da un veterinario abilitato (valido 30 giorni, senza necessità di vidimazione USDA) con i dati della vaccinazione antirabbica. Per altre provenienze, verificare le condizioni con le autorità veterinarie irachene prima del viaggio.

key_points: Из США: сертификат лицензированного ветеринара, заверение USDA не требуется
Для стран отправления, кроме США, уточните условия в ветеринарных органах Ирака
При прибытии в Эрбиль (Курдистан) уточните процедуру в региональных органах власти

countries.export: Leaving Iran: domestic animals need a health certificate from the Iran Veterinary Organization (IATA Timatic).
