countries.name: Iceland
countries.summary: Strict national regime (not the EU pet passport system): import permit from MAST, origin from an approved country, rabies vaccination plus titer test, multiple vaccinations/tests/parasite treatments, arrival only via Keflavík and minimum 14-day quarantine at an approved station.
countries.microchip: ISO-compliant microchip; number verified at every veterinary procedure for import.
countries.rabies_titer: Required from all origins: sample at least 30 days after vaccination, result at least 0.5 IU/ml, EU-approved laboratory; valid while vaccination is kept up to date. For category 2 countries (e.g. Hungary, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Greenland, USA, Canada) travel only 90 days or more after sampling; animals qualify at earliest ~7 months old (category 1: ~4.5 months).
countries.parasite_treatment: Internal + external parasite treatment twice: 21-28 days and 5-10 days before import (products registered for roundworm, tapeworm, lice, fleas, ticks). Dogs: Angiostrongylus vasorum test within 30 days OR preventive imidacloprid+moxidectin treatment 5-10 days before.
countries.import_permit: Yes – MAST import permit required before import. Animal must have lived in an approved category 1 or 2 country since birth or for the last 6 months. Category 1 includes all EU states except HU, PL, RO, SK (category 2), plus NO (excl. Svalbard), CH, LI, FO, GB, AU, JP, SG, AE.
countries.quarantine: Minimum 14 days at an approved quarantine station (Reykjanesbær/Hafnir or Mósel/Hella), booked in advance; admissions only in set 3-day windows about 3 weeks apart; arrival at Keflavík 06:00-17:00 on admission dates; no overnight stays at the airport. Service dogs may apply for home quarantine.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 90 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA (category 2): titer blood sample, then travel no earlier than 90 days after sampling; meanwhile apply for the MAST import permit (at least 30 days before), book a quarantine slot, complete the other vaccinations, tests within 30 days of arrival and parasite treatments at 21–28 and 5–10 days before arrival, and send the certificate to MAST at least 5 days before arrival. From category 1 countries (most of the EU), the 90-day wait does not apply. From scratch, plan at least 4–6 months (category 2: pet at least about 7 months old): import permit application (≥ 30 days before) → book quarantine slot → rabies vaccination → titer test ≥ 30 days later → other vaccinations → tests within 30 days of arrival → parasite treatments → health exam and certificate 5–10 days before → send to MAST ≥ 5 days before → fly to Keflavík on an admission date.
countries.restricted_breeds: Banned: wolf hybrids (10 generations); Pit Bull Terrier/Staffordshire Bull Terrier (service-dog form also lists American Staffordshire Terrier and American Bulldog), Fila Brasileiro, Tosa Inu, Dogo Argentino, Cane Corso, Presa Canario, Boerboel and crosses (5 generations), plus dogs MAST assesses as comparable. Pregnant/lactating animals not accepted.
countries.private_aviation: Pets may only arrive by air at Keflavík Airport (only approved entry port; ferry arrival not permitted). Animals must be in a hard IATA-compliant crate (soft carriers not allowed); flight number and arrival time are recorded on the certificate; arrival must match a quarantine admission date and 06:00-17:00 window. Confirm with MAST and the quarantine station before planning a private-jet arrival.
countries.export: Leaving Iceland: destination-country rules apply (EU treats Iceland as an Annex I listed territory – EU pet passport/certificate, no titer). Contact MAST for export certification.
countries.authority: Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority (MAST)
vaccinations: Rabies: valid vaccination; per MAST overview given at least 45-60 days before import (titer sample at earliest 30 days after vaccination).
Dogs: leptospirosis, distemper, infectious canine hepatitis, parvovirus, parainfluenza – last dose at least 14 days before import.
Cats: feline panleukopenia, rhinotracheitis, calicivirus – last dose at least 14 days before import.
Dogs from category 2 countries USA, Canada or Singapore: canine influenza vaccination also required (per certificate form).
documents: MAST import permit (apply at least 30 days before; valid 1 year; fee payable).
MAST certificate of health and origin (D1/D2 dogs, C1/C2 cats by country category), completed by authorised vet 5-10 days before import after health exam.
Lab reports: rabies titer; dogs Brucella canis (within 30 days) and Leishmania (intact dogs, within 30 days); cats FeLV and FIV (within 30 days).
Scanned certificate + lab results to petimport@mast.is no later than 5 days before arrival (later submission may be rejected).
Originals travel with the animal; customs declaration (VAT if owned < 12 months).

ru.summary: Строгий национальный режим (не система европейских паспортов животных): разрешение MAST на ввоз, происхождение из одобренной страны, вакцинация против бешенства и тест на титр антител, многочисленные прививки/анализы/обработки от паразитов, прибытие только через Кефлавик и карантин не менее 14 дней в одобренной станции.

countries.name: Italy
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the Ministry of Health before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Italy and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Italy's list (updated September 2026) designates about 40 airports, including Rome Fiumicino and Ciampino, Milan Malpensa and Linate, Bergamo, Venice, Treviso, Florence, Pisa, Bologna, Naples, Olbia, Cagliari, Alghero, Catania, Palermo, Genoa, Turin, Verona, Rimini, Bari, Brindisi, Lampedusa, Pantelleria, Salerno, Comiso, Cuneo, Brescia, Parma, Perugia, Pescara, Trieste and Bolzano, plus ports. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Ministry of Health – Directorate General for Animal Health
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Young animals: Italy does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: EU passport, or EU certificate ≤10 days (non-EU)

steps.what: ISO microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12+ weeks old)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid
From the US: EU health certificate endorsed by USDA APHIS; from the EU: EU pet passport
Carry the signed non-commercial declaration (non-EU origins)
From outside the EU: document and identity check at a travellers' point of entry

key_points: Max 5 pets per movement; each travels with the owner or within 5 days
From unlisted countries (e.g. Türkiye, Morocco, Israel, Thailand, South Africa): titer test plus a 3-month wait
Old-model EU certificates are accepted only if issued before 1 Oct 2026
export_points: To EU/EEA countries: EU pet passport from an authorised vet
Dogs going to FI, IE, MT, NO or Northern Ireland also need tapeworm treatment
To non-EU countries: meet destination rules; the official vet service endorses certificates
countries.private_jet_note: From outside the EU, land at one of about 40 designated airports (e.g. Rome, Milan, Venice, Naples, Olbia) for the pet check. Cabin carriage is up to the operator.

at_a_glance.microchip: شريحة ISO، قبل لقاح داء الكلب
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: قبل الدخول بـ≥21 يومًا، بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا
at_a_glance.health_certificate: جواز أو شهادة أوروبية ≤10 أيام (خارج الاتحاد)

steps.what: شريحة ISO، ثم لقاح داء الكلب (للحيوان بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا)
يصبح التطعيم الأولي ضد داء الكلب صالحًا
من الولايات المتحدة: شهادة صحية أوروبية مصادق عليها من USDA APHIS؛ ومن الاتحاد الأوروبي: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف
حمل الإقرار الموقّع بأن النقل غير تجاري (للقادمين من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي)
من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: تدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين

key_points: الحد الأقصى 5 حيوانات لكل تنقّل؛ ويسافر كل منها مع المالك أو خلال 5 أيام
من الدول غير المُدرجة (مثل تركيا والمغرب وإسرائيل وتايلاند وجنوب أفريقيا): اختبار الأجسام المضادة مع انتظار 3 أشهر
لا تُقبل الشهادات الأوروبية بالنموذج القديم إلا إذا صدرت قبل 1 أكتوبر 2026
export_points: إلى دول الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف من طبيب بيطري معتمد
تحتاج الكلاب المتجهة إلى FI أو IE أو MT أو NO أو أيرلندا الشمالية أيضًا إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية
إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات
ar.private_jet_note: عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، يجب الهبوط في أحد المطارات المحددة البالغ عددها نحو 40 (مثل روما، ميلانو، البندقية، نابولي، أولبيا) لفحص الحيوان الأليف. ويعود نقله في المقصورة إلى تقدير المشغّل.
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين.

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
Die Tollwut-Erstimpfung wird gültig
Aus den USA: von USDA APHIS beglaubigtes EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; aus der EU: EU-Heimtierausweis
Die unterschriebene Erklärung zur nicht kommerziellen Verbringung mitführen (Nicht-EU-Herkunft)
Von außerhalb der EU: Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrolle an einem Eingangsort für Reisende

key_points: Max. 5 Heimtiere pro Verbringung; jedes reist mit dem Halter oder innerhalb von 5 Tagen
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern (z. B. Türkei, Marokko, Israel, Thailand, Südafrika): Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit
EU-Zeugnisse nach altem Muster werden nur akzeptiert, wenn sie vor dem 1. Okt. 2026 ausgestellt wurden
export_points: In EU-/EWR-Länder: EU-Heimtierausweis von einem ermächtigten Tierarzt
Hunde nach FI, IE, MT, NO oder Nordirland benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Bestimmungen des Ziellandes erfüllen; der amtliche Veterinärdienst beglaubigt die Zeugnisse
de.private_jet_note: Bei Anreise von außerhalb der EU landen Sie zur Heimtierkontrolle an einem von etwa 40 ausgewiesenen Flughäfen (z. B. Rom, Mailand, Venedig, Neapel, Olbia). Die Beförderung in der Kabine liegt im Ermessen des Betreibers.
de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende.

La primovacunación antirrábica pasa a ser válida
Desde EE. UU.: certificado sanitario de la UE refrendado por USDA APHIS; desde la UE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas
Lleve la declaración firmada de no comercialidad (orígenes fuera de la UE)
Desde fuera de la UE: control documental y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros

key_points: Máx. 5 mascotas por desplazamiento; cada una viaja con el propietario o en un plazo de 5 días
Desde países no incluidos en la lista (p. ej., Turquía, Marruecos, Israel, Tailandia, Sudáfrica): prueba de titulación más 3 meses de espera
Los certificados UE del modelo anterior solo se aceptan si se emitieron antes del 1 de octubre de 2026
export_points: A países de la UE/EEE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas de un veterinario autorizado
Los perros con destino a FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Norte necesitan además tratamiento contra la tenia
A países fuera de la UE: cumpla las normas del destino; el servicio veterinario oficial refrenda los certificados
es.private_jet_note: Desde fuera de la UE, aterrice en uno de los aproximadamente 40 aeropuertos designados (p. ej., Roma, Milán, Venecia, Nápoles, Olbia) para el control de la mascota. El transporte en cabina queda a criterio del operador.
es.summary: Normas de la UE (Reglamento Delegado (UE) 2026/131): desde otro Estado de la UE/EEE, mascota con microchip, vacunación antirrábica válida y pasaporte europeo para mascotas; desde fuera de la UE, certificado zoosanitario de la UE (más prueba de titulación antirrábica con 3 meses de espera si el país no figura en la lista) y controles documentales y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passeport UE ; hors UE, certificat ≤10 jours

steps.what: Puce électronique ISO, puis vaccin antirabique (animal âgé d'au moins 12 semaines)
La primovaccination antirabique devient valable
Depuis les États-Unis : certificat sanitaire UE visé par l'USDA APHIS ; depuis l'UE : passeport européen pour animal de compagnie
Munissez-vous de la déclaration signée attestant le caractère non commercial (origines hors UE)
Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE : contrôle documentaire et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs

key_points: 5 animaux max. par mouvement ; chacun voyage avec le propriétaire ou dans un délai de 5 jours
Depuis les pays non listés (p. ex. Turquie, Maroc, Israël, Thaïlande, Afrique du Sud) : titrage des anticorps antirabiques plus attente de 3 mois
Les certificats UE de l'ancien modèle ne sont acceptés que s'ils ont été délivrés avant le 1er oct. 2026
export_points: Vers les pays de l'UE/EEE : passeport européen délivré par un vétérinaire habilité
Les chiens à destination de FI, IE, MT, NO ou de l'Irlande du Nord nécessitent aussi un traitement contre le ténia
Vers les pays hors UE : respecter les règles du pays de destination ; le service vétérinaire officiel vise les certificats
fr.private_jet_note: En provenance de l'extérieur de l'UE, atterrissez dans l'un des quelque 40 aéroports désignés (p. ex. Rome, Milan, Venise, Naples, Olbia) pour le contrôle de l'animal. Le transport en cabine est laissé à l'appréciation de l'opérateur.
fr.summary: Règles de l'UE (règlement délégué (UE) 2026/131) : depuis un autre État de l'UE/EEE, animal identifié par puce électronique, avec vaccination antirabique valide et passeport européen pour animal de compagnie ; depuis l'extérieur de l'UE, certificat sanitaire de l'UE (plus titrage des anticorps antirabiques avec attente de 3 mois si le pays n'est pas listé) et contrôles documentaires et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs.

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, prima del vaccino antirabbico
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passaporto UE, o cert. UE ≤10 gg (extra UE)

La vaccinazione antirabbica primaria diventa valida
Dagli Stati Uniti: certificato sanitario UE vidimato da USDA APHIS; dall'UE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia
Portare con sé la dichiarazione firmata di movimentazione non commerciale (origini extra UE)
Da fuori UE: controllo documentale e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori

key_points: Max 5 animali per movimentazione; ciascuno viaggia con il proprietario o entro 5 giorni
Da Paesi non elencati (ad es. Turchia, Marocco, Israele, Thailandia, Sudafrica): titolazione più attesa di 3 mesi
I certificati UE del vecchio modello sono accettati solo se rilasciati prima del 1 ott 2026

I cani diretti in FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Nord necessitano anche del trattamento contro la tenia (Echinococcus)
Verso Paesi extra UE: rispettare le norme della destinazione; il servizio veterinario ufficiale vidima i certificati

it.summary: Norme UE (Regolamento delegato (UE) 2026/131): da un altro Stato UE/SEE, animale con microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica valida e passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia; da fuori UE, certificato sanitario UE per animali (più titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici con attesa di 3 mesi se il Paese non è elencato) e controlli documentali e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori.

at_a_glance.microchip: Чип ISO, до прививки от бешенства
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Паспорт или сертификат ЕС ≤10 дней (не из ЕС)

steps.what: Микрочип ISO, затем прививка от бешенства (животному 12+ недель)
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной
Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС, заверенный USDA APHIS; из ЕС: европейский паспорт животного
Имейте при себе подписанную декларацию о некоммерческом перемещении (не из ЕС)
Из-за пределов ЕС: проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников

key_points: Не более 5 животных за одно перемещение; каждое следует с владельцем или в пределах 5 дней
Из стран вне перечня (например, Турция, Марокко, Израиль, Таиланд, ЮАР): тест на титр плюс ожидание 3 месяца
Сертификаты ЕС старого образца принимаются, только если выданы до 1 октября 2026 г.
export_points: В страны ЕС/ЕЭЗ: европейский паспорт животного от уполномоченного ветеринара
Собакам, направляющимся в FI, IE, MT, NO или Северную Ирландию, также нужна обработка от ленточных червей
В страны вне ЕС: соблюдайте правила страны назначения; сертификаты заверяет официальная ветеринарная служба
ru.private_jet_note: При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС совершайте посадку в одном из примерно 40 назначенных аэропортов (например, Рим, Милан, Венеция, Неаполь, Ольбия) для контроля животного. Перевозка в салоне — на усмотрение оператора.
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников.

countries.name: Jersey
countries.summary: From UK, Isle of Man or other Channel Islands: no official health requirements. From EU/listed countries: microchip, rabies vaccination (21 days), EU pet passport or recent AHC, dog tapeworm treatment, non-commercial declaration; unlisted countries add a titer test. Pets may only arrive with approved carriers/routes – NOT by private aircraft.
countries.microchip: Microchip (or qualifying tattoo) before rabies vaccination.
countries.rabies_titer: Unlisted non-EU countries only: titer test passed, taken at least 30 days after vaccination and at least 3 months before travel into Jersey.
countries.parasite_treatment: Dogs: tapeworm treatment 24-120 h before scheduled arrival, recorded by the vet (product, date, time, stamp/signature). Exempt if travelling directly from Republic of Ireland, Malta, Finland or Norway.
countries.import_permit: Not for non-commercial pets; XL Bully type dogs need a licence to be imported/exported (since 24 Feb 2024, per gov.je).
countries.quarantine: None if compliant.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 5 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the EU: valid EU pet passport, dog tapeworm treatment 24–120 hours before arrival, and a booking with an approved carrier and route (not a private aircraft). From the UK, Isle of Man or other Channel Islands: no preparation. From scratch (EU/listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks; unlisted origins at least 4 months.
countries.restricted_breeds: Certain dog types are illegal to bring into Jersey (see gov.je 'Dogs not allowed in Jersey'); dogs showing banned-breed characteristics may be seized. XL Bully types require a licence.
countries.private_aviation: Pets CANNOT enter Jersey on a private aircraft or private boat (except private boats from the Republic of Ireland). Only approved air/sea carriers and routes may be used.
countries.export: To EU: AHC (UK pet passports not accepted for EU entry). To UK/IoM/Guernsey: no official health requirements, though carriers may ask for documents.
countries.authority: Government of Jersey – Animal Health and Welfare (States Veterinary)
vaccinations: Rabies: pet ≥12 weeks at vaccination, after microchipping, at least 21 days before travel.
documents: From EU: EU pet passport, or AHC issued in GB/Channel Islands/IoM within last 4 months (per gov.je), or GB pet health certificate, or GB pet passport issued before 1 Jan 2021.
Non-commercial declaration.
Australia (cats): Hendra certificate; Peninsular Malaysia: Nipah certificate.

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12+ weeks old)
Book an approved carrier and route
Dogs: tapeworm treatment, recorded by the vet
Carry the pet passport or AHC and the non-commercial declaration

key_points: From the UK, Isle of Man or Channel Islands: no official health requirements
Some dog types are illegal; dogs with banned-breed traits may be seized
XL Bully types need a licence to be imported
export_points: To the EU: Animal Health Certificate (UK pet passports not accepted)
To the UK, Isle of Man or Guernsey: no official requirements; carriers may ask for documents
countries.private_jet_note: Pets cannot enter Jersey on a private aircraft. Plan the pet's journey with an approved air or sea carrier and route instead.

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: قبل السفر بـ≥21 يومًا، بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا
at_a_glance.health_certificate: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان أو AHC

steps.what: الشريحة الإلكترونية، ثم لقاح داء الكلب (للحيوان بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا)
حجز ناقل ومسار معتمدين
الكلاب: علاج الدودة الشريطية، يسجّله الطبيب البيطري

countries.name: Jamaica
countries.summary: A strict permit regime applies. Get Preliminary Application approval, then a Veterinary Import Permit (J$5,000, valid 3 months). Pets need an ISO microchip, rabies vaccination, a FAVN of at least 0.5 IU/ml drawn 3–12 months before import, extensive tests and treatments, an officially endorsed certificate, arrival into Kingston, and at least 14 days' post-entry quarantine (Plumb Point).
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785 microchip, implanted before rabies vaccination (otherwise revaccinate). The number must match on all documents.
countries.rabies_titer: FAVN at an OIE/WOAH-approved lab, result at least 0.5 IU/ml. The pet is eligible for entry no less than 3 months and no more than 12 months after the successful blood draw. Send a copy to the Permit Unit at least 72 hours before export.
countries.parasite_treatment: Internal: fecal exam plus 2 broad-spectrum dewormings at least 14 days apart, the last within 7 days of export. External: 2 treatments, the first about 30 days before shipment and the second within 7 days of export. Dogs: heartworm prevention within 7 days.
countries.import_permit: Required, or the pet is refused entry. Submit the Preliminary Application at least 1 month before travel (6 months if requirements aren't yet met), to vsdpermits@moa.gov.jm. Don't start tests (except rabies and FAVN) before approval. Fee J$5,000, valid up to 3 months.
countries.quarantine: At least 14 days of post-entry quarantine at the National Quarantine Facility, Plumb Point, unless the inspector permits otherwise (e.g. service dogs or approved pet travel schemes at an approved place).
countries.timeline: Plan at least 6 months before travel: microchip and rabies, FAVN, then a 3-month wait, preliminary application, permit; tests and treatments in the final 45 days; 3 weeks' notice plus a 72-hour confirmation.
countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited: Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, Japanese Tosa, Pit Bull Terrier, and wolf or other hybrids.
countries.private_aviation: Pets must arrive directly into Kingston (Norman Manley/Palisadoes) unless the Chief Veterinary Officer authorizes another port. Pets normally travel as manifested cargo and are checked at the freight terminal (service dogs excepted), so obtain CVO approval for a private-jet or FBO arrival in advance. Arrive Mon–Thu 8:30 am–5:00 pm or Fri 8:30 am–4:00 pm; other times, weekends and holidays attract extra fees.
countries.export: Leaving Jamaica: follow the Ministry's 'Protocol for export of dogs and cats'. A pet that leaves loses its Jamaican health status, so discuss re-entry with the Veterinary Officer before departure, as a new import permit is needed. Jamaica isn't a CDC high-risk country, but it is on APHIS's screwworm-affected list, so dogs going to the US need a screwworm certificate.
countries.authority: Veterinary Services Division, Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Mining (Permit Unit)
vaccinations: Rabies: inactivated vaccine given at 90 days of age or older and valid at export. Primary vaccination 6–12 months before shipment, or a booster no more than 1 year before shipment (per the 2017 US guidelines).
Dogs: distemper, parvovirus, hepatitis/adenovirus-2 and parainfluenza at least 2 weeks before export. Leptospira canicola vaccination up to date, or treatment within 30 days.
Cats: FHV-1, calicivirus, panleukopenia (FeLV for kittens) at least 2 weeks before export.
documents: Approved Preliminary Application Form, then a Veterinary Import Permit (applied online via MOA trade system).
Official model veterinary health certificate for Jamaica, completed or endorsed by an official vet (USDA), every page signed and stamped. Exam within 7 days of export.

Dogs: negative heartworm antigen (6 months or older, within 30 days); Babesia, Lyme and Ehrlichia ELISA within 16 days; Leishmania within 45 days; Brucella canis within 45 days (intact dogs); coccidia test.
Animal Landing Notification Form; customs broker details.

countries.name: Japan
countries.summary: From non-designated regions (most of the world, incl. mainland US and EU): microchip, then at least two rabies vaccinations, then a FAVN titer of at least 0.5 IU/ml, then a 180-day wait from the blood draw. Notify AQS at least 40 days before arrival. From designated rabies-free regions (Iceland, Australia, New Zealand, Fiji, Hawaii, Guam): microchip, residence proof and a government health certificate, with no vaccination or titer.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785, 15-digit. Must be implanted BEFORE the first rabies vaccination, or that vaccine is invalid. Chips starting '900 202' are currently not accepted. Other '900'-prefix chips may be duplicates, so tell AQS early.
countries.rabies_titer: Non-designated regions: FAVN at an AQS-designated laboratory, blood drawn after the 2nd vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml. Valid 2 years from sampling. Arrival must be at least 180 days after the blood draw. Not required from designated regions.
countries.import_permit: No permit, but the 40-day advance notification and AQS approval are mandatory. Late notifications are generally refused. You cannot move the arrival date earlier or add or swap animals.
countries.quarantine: If fully compliant, released after arrival inspection, within about 12 hours. If not compliant (including certificate errors or an early arrival before the 180 days are up), detained at an AQS facility for up to 180 days at the owner's cost, or returned.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 190 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA or EU, if it already has two valid rabies doses given after the microchip: FAVN blood draw, then a 180-day wait, with the AQS notification at least 40 days before arrival inside that window. With only one prior dose, allow about 220 days. From scratch (non-designated regions), plan at least 7–8 months: microchip → rabies #1 → rabies #2 (≥ 30 days later) → FAVN blood draw → wait 180 days → notify AQS ≥ 40 days before arrival → vet exam ≤ 10 days before departure → government endorsement → fly. Designated regions: at least 2 months (40-day notice plus certificates).
countries.private_aviation: AQS has no separate rule for private or business aircraft. Dogs may enter only through 19 designated ports. The 11 airports are New Chitose, Narita, Haneda, Chubu, Kansai, Osaka-Itami, Kobe, Kitakyushu, Fukuoka, Kagoshima and Naha. Cats arriving elsewhere need advance contact with AQS. Coordinate the AQS arrival inspection with the airport's AQS office and the FBO in advance. Full requirements apply as for commercial flights.
countries.export: Apply to AQS in advance and present the pet for export inspection at the date and time AQS sets. AQS issues the export quarantine certificate after meeting the destination's rules. For pets that will return, AQS recommends doing Japan's import requirements (microchip, 2 rabies shots, FAVN) before departure so re-entry is possible without detention.
countries.authority: Animal Quarantine Service (AQS), Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF)
vaccinations: Rabies (non-designated regions): at least 2 doses of inactivated or recombinant vaccine. RNA and live vaccines are not accepted. Dose 1 at 91 days of age or older and after the microchip. Dose 2 at least 30 days after dose 1 and within dose 1's validity. Immunity must still be valid on arrival (booster if needed).
Designated regions: no rabies vaccination required.
documents: Advance notification to AQS at the port of entry (NACCS or email), at least 40 days before arrival, and the resulting approval

Health certificate Form AC (plus ATTACH if needed): completed by a vet and endorsed by the exporting country's government. Original in ink. E-certificates accepted only from USA, Brazil and Spain (designated regions: only Hawaii and Guam).
Clinical exam within 10 days before departure: no signs of rabies (dogs also no leptospirosis)

Designated regions: certificate of residence (since birth, 180+ days, or since import from Japan). Direct flight required, or an official crate seal plus a transport certificate if transiting a non-designated region.

ru.summary: Из неназначенных регионов (большая часть мира, включая континентальную часть США и ЕС): микрочип, затем не менее двух прививок от бешенства, затем титр FAVN не ниже 0.5 МЕ/мл, затем ожидание 180 дней с даты забора крови. Уведомите AQS не менее чем за 40 дней до прибытия. Из назначенных регионов, свободных от бешенства (Исландия, Австралия, Новая Зеландия, Фиджи, Гавайи, Гуам): микрочип, подтверждение проживания и государственный ветеринарный сертификат, без вакцинации и теста на титр.

countries.name: Kenya
countries.summary: Kenya requires an import permit from the Director of Veterinary Services, which must travel with the pet. The Ministry of Livestock Development's permit conditions require pets not from a WOAH rabies-free country to have a microchip, rabies vaccination and a rabies antibody titer of at least 0.5 IU/ml taken 3–24 months before shipment. Otherwise up to 6 months' quarantine may apply. The conditions also say pets must travel as manifest cargo in the hold, not in the cabin, which directly affects private-jet arrivals.
countries.microchip: Required for pets not from a rabies-free country (permanent mark such as a microchip; number stated on the certificate) per the Ministry of Livestock Development permit conditions. The UK certificate also records the microchip number.
countries.rabies_titer: Required for pets not kept since birth or for 6 months in a WOAH rabies-free country: antibody test of at least 0.5 IU/ml, sample taken 3–24 months before shipment (permit conditions). Without it, Kenya may quarantine the pet for up to 6 months at the owner's cost.
countries.parasite_treatment: The certificate (dated within 48 hours of embarkation) must attest the pet is free of internal and external parasites. No specific treatment window is stated.
countries.import_permit: Required. Issued by the Director of Veterinary Services (State Department for Livestock Development), Kabete, Nairobi, or via Kenyan missions (UK: Kenya High Commission, London). Valid 30 days maximum, single consignment, must accompany the animal. Recent embassy pages say applications go through the Kenya TradeNet (KenTrade) platform via accredited agents. Mission fees vary (e.g. USD 50 per animal).
countries.quarantine: None if compliant. Pets not meeting the microchip, vaccination and titer conditions may be quarantined for up to 6 months at the owner's expense. UK guidance says the same may apply if the animal lands in an intermediate country other than Australia, New Zealand, Norway, Sweden or Ireland without rabies vaccination in the past 6 months.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 90 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated from a non-rabies-free origin (the USA and most of the EU): titer blood sample at least 3 months before shipment → apply for the permit via KenTrade, an agent or a mission → vet exam within 48 hours of departure and government endorsement → captain's certificate on arrival. Primary-vaccinated pets need at least 6 months after vaccination.
countries.private_aviation: The Ministry of Livestock Development permit conditions say animals must travel as manifest cargo in the aircraft freight compartment, not as baggage or in passenger cabins. They also require a captain's certificate that the animal stayed on board and was isolated. The ports of entry are named on the permit (normally JKIA or Mombasa). Get written confirmation from DVS before booking a cabin-carriage private flight, and pre-arrange veterinary inspection at the arrival airport.
countries.authority: Directorate of Veterinary Services (State Department for Livestock Development), Kenya
vaccinations: Rabies (pets not from a WOAH rabies-free country): inactivated or recombinant vaccine. A primary vaccination must be given at 3+ months of age and 6–12 months before shipment; a booster no more than 1 year before shipment (Ministry of Livestock Development permit conditions, published by the Kenya Embassy Spain, 2024).
The certificate must state vaccine name, manufacturer, batch number, date and the animal's age at vaccination (UK NFG 2913, revised 11/2023).
The US-origin APHIS certificate asks for rabies vaccination within 12 months before export; the permit conditions above are stricter, so follow the permit.
documents: Kenyan import permit (Director of Veterinary Services). Valid 30 days maximum, one consignment, and must accompany the animal.

International veterinary health certificate: exam within 48 hours of embarkation (permit conditions). The UK certificate requires an exam within 5 days and is valid 7 days. The US APHIS certificate is valid 30 days.
Rabies vaccination certificate and rabies titer lab report (non-rabies-free origins)

Certificate from the captain of the aircraft or ship stating the animal did not leave the aircraft between embarkation and Kenya and was isolated from other dogs and cats (permit conditions; UK master's declaration 2913MAS)
For the permit: formal request letter and copy of the owner's passport (Kenyan missions). Embassy pages say applications go through the Kenya TradeNet platform via accredited agents.

at_a_glance.quarantine: None if compliant, else up to 6 mo
at_a_glance.parasites: Free of parasites at the exam

Apply for the DVS import permit via KenTrade, an agent or a mission
Vet exam and government-endorsed health certificate
Show the permit and captain's certificate; veterinary inspection

Primary-vaccinated pets need at least 6 months after the vaccine
Sources differ on the exam window (48 h to 5 days); the permit conditions say 48 h
countries.private_jet_note: Permit conditions require pets to fly as manifest cargo in the hold, not in the cabin. Get written DVS confirmation before booking cabin carriage.

at_a_glance.microchip: مطلوبة (منشأ غير خالٍ من داء الكلب)
at_a_glance.quarantine: لا يوجد عند الالتزام، وإلا حتى 6 أشهر

steps.what: سحب عينة الدم لاختبار الأجسام المضادة لحيوان مطعّم (≥0.5 IU/ml)
التقدّم بطلب تصريح الاستيراد من DVS عبر KenTrade أو وكيل أو بعثة دبلوماسية
فحص بيطري وشهادة صحية مصادق عليها حكوميًا
إبراز التصريح وشهادة قائد الطائرة؛ والفحص البيطري

key_points: التصريح لاستخدام واحد، صالح 30 يومًا ويجب أن يرافق الحيوان الأليف
تحتاج الحيوانات التي تلقت التطعيم الأولي فقط إلى مرور 6 أشهر على الأقل بعد اللقاح
تختلف المصادر بشأن مهلة الفحص (من 48 ساعة إلى 5 أيام)؛ وتنص شروط التصريح على 48 ساعة
ar.private_jet_note: تشترط شروط التصريح سفر الحيوانات الأليفة كشحنة مُدرجة في البيان في عنبر الطائرة، لا في المقصورة. يُرجى الحصول على تأكيد كتابي من DVS قبل حجز النقل في المقصورة.
ar.summary: تشترط كينيا تصريح استيراد من مدير الخدمات البيطرية، يجب أن يرافق الحيوان الأليف. وتشترط شروط التصريح الصادرة عن وزارة تنمية الثروة الحيوانية أن تحمل الحيوانات غير القادمة من دولة خالية من داء الكلب وفق WOAH شريحة إلكترونية، وتطعيمًا ضد داء الكلب، ومعايرة أجسام مضادة لداء الكلب لا تقل عن 0.5 IU/ml مأخوذة قبل الشحن بـ3–24 شهرًا. وإلا فقد يُطبَّق حجر صحي يصل إلى 6 أشهر. كما تنص الشروط على وجوب سفر الحيوانات الأليفة كشحنة مُدرجة في البيان في عنبر الطائرة، لا في المقصورة، وهو ما يؤثر مباشرة على الوصول بالطائرات الخاصة.

at_a_glance.quarantine: Keine bei Einhaltung, sonst bis 6 Mon.

steps.what: Titer-Blutentnahme bei einem geimpften Tier (≥0,5 IE/ml)
DVS-Einfuhrgenehmigung über KenTrade, einen Agenten oder eine Auslandsvertretung beantragen
Tierärztliche Untersuchung und staatlich beglaubigtes Gesundheitszeugnis
Genehmigung und Kapitänsbescheinigung vorzeigen; tierärztliche Kontrolle

key_points: Die Genehmigung gilt einmalig, 30 Tage lang und muss das Tier begleiten
Erstgeimpfte Tiere benötigen mindestens 6 Monate nach der Impfung
Quellen weichen beim Untersuchungsfenster ab (48 Std. bis 5 Tage); die Genehmigungsauflagen nennen 48 Std.
de.private_jet_note: Die Genehmigungsauflagen schreiben vor, dass Heimtiere als deklarierte Fracht im Frachtraum fliegen, nicht in der Kabine. Holen Sie vor der Buchung einer Kabinenbeförderung eine schriftliche Bestätigung des DVS ein.
de.summary: Kenia verlangt eine Einfuhrgenehmigung des Director of Veterinary Services, die das Tier begleiten muss. Nach den Genehmigungsauflagen des Ministry of Livestock Development benötigen Heimtiere, die nicht aus einem von der WOAH als tollwutfrei anerkannten Land stammen, einen Mikrochip, eine Tollwutimpfung und einen Tollwut-Antikörpertiter von mindestens 0,5 IE/ml aus einer Probe 3–24 Monate vor dem Transport. Andernfalls kann eine Quarantäne von bis zu 6 Monaten gelten. Die Auflagen schreiben zudem vor, dass Heimtiere als deklarierte Fracht im Frachtraum reisen, nicht in der Kabine – was Ankünfte im Privatjet unmittelbar betrifft.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: Examen ≤48 h antes de la salida
at_a_glance.quarantine: Ninguna si cumple; si no, hasta 6 meses
at_a_glance.parasites: Libre de parásitos en el examen

steps.what: Extracción para titulación en una mascota vacunada (≥0,5 UI/ml)
Solicite el permiso de importación DVS a través de KenTrade, un agente o una misión diplomática
Examen veterinario y certificado sanitario refrendado por el gobierno
Presente el permiso y el certificado del comandante; inspección veterinaria

key_points: El permiso es de un solo uso, válido 30 días y debe viajar con la mascota
Las mascotas en primovacunación necesitan al menos 6 meses desde la vacuna
Las fuentes difieren sobre el plazo del examen (de 48 h a 5 días); las condiciones del permiso indican 48 h
es.private_jet_note: Las condiciones del permiso exigen que las mascotas viajen como carga manifestada en bodega, no en cabina. Obtenga confirmación escrita del DVS antes de reservar el transporte en cabina.
es.summary: Kenia exige un permiso de importación del Director de Servicios Veterinarios, que debe viajar con la mascota. Las condiciones del permiso del Ministerio de Desarrollo Ganadero exigen que las mascotas no procedentes de un país libre de rabia según la OMSA tengan microchip, vacunación antirrábica y una titulación de anticuerpos antirrábicos de al menos 0,5 UI/ml realizada 3–24 meses antes del envío. De lo contrario, puede aplicarse una cuarentena de hasta 6 meses. Las condiciones indican además que las mascotas deben viajar como carga manifestada en bodega, no en cabina, lo que afecta directamente a las llegadas en jet privado.

steps.what: Prise de sang pour le titrage sur un animal vacciné (≥ 0,5 UI/ml)
Demander le permis d'importation DVS via KenTrade, un agent ou une mission diplomatique
Examen vétérinaire et certificat sanitaire visé officiellement
Présenter le permis et le certificat du commandant de bord ; inspection vétérinaire

key_points: Le permis est à usage unique, valable 30 jours et doit accompagner l'animal
Les animaux en primovaccination doivent attendre au moins 6 mois après le vaccin
Les sources divergent sur le délai de l'examen (48 h à 5 jours) ; les conditions du permis indiquent 48 h
fr.private_jet_note: Les conditions du permis imposent que les animaux voyagent en fret manifesté en soute, et non en cabine. Obtenez une confirmation écrite du DVS avant de réserver un transport en cabine.
fr.summary: Le Kenya exige un permis d'importation du Director of Veterinary Services, qui doit accompagner l'animal. Les conditions du permis du ministère du Développement de l'élevage imposent aux animaux ne provenant pas d'un pays indemne de rage selon l'OMSA (WOAH) une puce électronique, une vaccination antirabique et un titrage des anticorps antirabiques d'au moins 0,5 UI/ml effectué 3 à 24 mois avant l'expédition. À défaut, une quarantaine pouvant aller jusqu'à 6 mois peut s'appliquer. Les conditions précisent aussi que les animaux doivent voyager en fret manifesté en soute, et non en cabine, ce qui concerne directement les arrivées en jet privé.

at_a_glance.quarantine: Nessuna se in regola, o fino a 6 mesi

steps.what: Prelievo per la titolazione su animale vaccinato (≥0,5 UI/ml)
Richiedere il permesso d'importazione DVS tramite KenTrade, un agente o una rappresentanza diplomatica
Visita veterinaria e certificato sanitario vidimato dalle autorità governative
Esibire il permesso e il certificato del comandante; ispezione veterinaria

key_points: Il permesso è monouso, valido 30 giorni e deve accompagnare l'animale
Gli animali alla prima vaccinazione necessitano di almeno 6 mesi dal vaccino
Le fonti divergono sulla finestra per la visita (da 48 h a 5 giorni); le condizioni del permesso indicano 48 h
it.private_jet_note: Le condizioni del permesso prevedono che gli animali viaggino come merce a manifesto nella stiva, non in cabina. È opportuno ottenere una conferma scritta dal DVS prima di prenotare il trasporto in cabina.
it.summary: Il Kenya richiede un permesso d'importazione del Director of Veterinary Services, che deve accompagnare l'animale. Le condizioni del permesso del Ministry of Livestock Development prevedono che gli animali non provenienti da un Paese indenne da rabbia secondo il WOAH abbiano microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica e una titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici di almeno 0,5 UI/ml, con prelievo 3–24 mesi prima della spedizione. In caso contrario può applicarsi una quarantena fino a 6 mesi. Le condizioni stabiliscono inoltre che gli animali viaggino come merce a manifesto nella stiva, non in cabina, il che incide direttamente sugli arrivi in jet privato.

at_a_glance.quarantine: Нет при соответствии, иначе до 6 мес.

steps.what: Забор крови на титр у привитого животного (≥0.5 МЕ/мл)
Подайте заявку на разрешение DVS через KenTrade, агента или представительство
Ветеринарный осмотр и ветеринарный сертификат с государственным заверением
Предъявите разрешение и сертификат командира воздушного судна; ветеринарный досмотр

key_points: Разрешение одноразовое, действует 30 дней и должно сопровождать животное
Первично привитым животным нужно не менее 6 месяцев после прививки
Источники расходятся в сроке осмотра (от 48 ч до 5 дней); условия разрешения указывают 48 ч
ru.private_jet_note: Условия разрешения требуют перевозки животных как груза по манифесту в багажном отсеке, а не в салоне. Получите письменное подтверждение DVS до бронирования перевозки в салоне.
ru.summary: Кения требует разрешения на ввоз от Директора ветеринарных служб, которое должно сопровождать животное. Условия разрешения Министерства развития животноводства требуют, чтобы животные не из стран, свободных от бешенства по WOAH, имели микрочип, вакцинацию против бешенства и титр антител к бешенству не ниже 0.5 МЕ/мл по крови, взятой за 3–24 месяца до отправки. В противном случае возможен карантин до 6 месяцев. Условия также предусматривают, что животные должны перевозиться как груз по манифесту в багажном отсеке, а не в салоне, что напрямую влияет на прибытие частных самолётов.

countries.name: Kyrgyzstan

For US origin, APHIS allows up to 5 pets on Form 15 issued within 5 days of travel.
countries.microchip: Not mandated by EAEU rules; recommended
countries.rabies_titer: Not required (alternative only)
countries.import_permit: Not needed for ≤2 personal pets (EAEU); APHIS states up to 5 without special permission
countries.quarantine: None for compliant personal pets
countries.timeline: Plan at least 1 month: vaccines ≥20 days before → exam/certificate within 5 days
countries.authority: Veterinary authority of the Kyrgyz Republic, Ministry of Water Resources, Agriculture and Processing Industry (EAEU common veterinary requirements)

أكثر من 2 من الحيوانات: شهادة EAEU النموذج 15 (APHIS: حتى 5 حيوانات من الولايات المتحدة)
يُغني لقاح داء الكلب المُعطى خلال آخر 12 شهرًا عن فترة الانتظار البالغة 20 يومًا
ar.summary: عضو في الاتحاد الاقتصادي الأوراسي (EAEU) بالقواعد ذاتها المطبقة في روسيا. يمكن إدخال ما يصل إلى 2 من الكلاب/القطط الشخصية بجواز سفر دولي للحيوان يتضمن لقاح داء الكلب واللقاحات الأساسية وإثبات فحص سريري خلال 14 يومًا؛ وإلا فيلزم الحصول على شهادة EAEU النموذج 15. وبالنسبة للقادمين من الولايات المتحدة، تسمح APHIS بما يصل إلى 5 حيوانات على النموذج 15 الصادر خلال 5 أيام من السفر.

Aus den USA: EAWU-Zeugnis nach Formular 15, ausgestellt und beglaubigt

Mehr als 2 Heimtiere: EAWU-Zeugnis nach Formular 15 (APHIS: bis zu 5 Tiere aus den USA)
Eine Tollwutimpfung innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate entbindet von der 20-tägigen Wartezeit
de.summary: EAWU-Mitglied mit denselben Regeln wie Russland. Bis zu 2 private Hunde/Katzen dürfen mit einem internationalen Heimtierausweis einreisen, mit Tollwut- und Grundimpfungen sowie einem Vermerk über eine klinische Untersuchung innerhalb von 14 Tagen; andernfalls ist ein EAWU-Zeugnis nach Formular 15 erforderlich. steps.what: Vaccins antirabique et essentiels, au moins 20 jours avant le voyage

Depuis les États-Unis : certificat UEEA Form 15 délivré et visé

Un vaccin antirabique administré au cours des 12 derniers mois dispense de l'attente de 20 jours
fr.summary: Membre de l'UEEA appliquant les mêmes règles que la Russie. Jusqu'à 2 chiens/chats personnels peuvent entrer avec un passeport international portant les vaccins antirabique et essentiels et la mention d'un examen clinique datant de 14 jours au plus ; sinon, un certificat UEEA Form 15 est nécessaire. Для животных из США APHIS допускает до 5 животных по Форме 15, выданной в пределах 5 дней до поездки.

countries.name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
countries.summary: A Veterinary Services import permit is required. Pets from rabies-endemic countries (including the US) need an ISO microchip, current rabies vaccination, a FAVN of at least 0.5 IU/ml (lab sends results directly), a government-endorsed health certificate within 30 days, parasite treatment within 5 days, and 14 days of home confinement after arrival.
countries.microchip: ISO-compatible microchip (e.g. AVID, HomeAgain). The number must appear on the application, certificates, blood sample and titer result.
countries.rabies_titer: From rabies-endemic countries: one FAVN of at least 0.5 IU/ml at a WOAH-approved lab (in the US: Kansas State or Auburn), drawn at least 30 days after the most recent rabies vaccine and at least 3 months before that vaccine expires. The lab emails results directly to Veterinary Services (St Kitts: skbvet12@gmail.com; Nevis: ambi.james@gmail.com). If it fails, give a booster and retest after 30 days.
countries.parasite_treatment: Internal and external parasite treatment (broad-spectrum anthelmintic, product named) within 5 days of arrival, on a health certificate by an accredited vet.
countries.import_permit: Required. Apply to Veterinary Services, Department of Agriculture, La Guerite, Basseterre (tel. 869-465-2110). The application states the arrival date, flight and time.
countries.quarantine: 14 days of home confinement for new entrants, with 3 home visits; a completion certificate is issued at the end.
countries.timeline: Plan at least 6–8 weeks before travel: microchip, rabies, FAVN at least 30 days later, permit application, health certificate within 30 days, parasite treatment within 5 days of arrival.
countries.private_aviation: Non-compliance can lead to deportation or euthanasia (APHIS). Confirm the arrival port and inspector availability for private flights with Veterinary Services.
countries.authority: Veterinary Services, Department of Agriculture, St. Kitts (and Nevis office)
vaccinations: Rabies: current (1- or 3-year), approved monovalent killed vaccine, not given before 3 months of age. The health certificate lists the last 2 rabies vaccinations.
Core vaccines (dogs and cats) up to date.
documents: Import permit application (fee EC$55 or US$20 per animal, by international money order to 'Accountant General', or paid on arrival).
Government-issued international health certificate (USDA-endorsed) within 30 days of arrival. Required for first entry only.
Cats (first entry): FIV and FeLV negative within 30 days of arrival.
Rabies certificate; FAVN report with the microchip number.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.summary: ISO microchip plus a government-endorsed health certificate. Dogs and cats aged 90 days or older from non-rabies-free countries (incl. the USA) also need a current rabies vaccination and a rabies antibody test of at least 0.5 IU/ml. No post-titer waiting period. Pets missing the chip or titer are held in quarantine at the owner's cost until it is done.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785 compliant, number on the health certificate. If missing, it can be implanted after arrival during quarantine at the owner's cost.
countries.rabies_titer: Non-rabies-free origin, age 90 days or older: rabies-neutralising antibody result of at least 0.5 IU/ml, from an internationally approved lab or the exporting country's competent authority. Valid 24 months from blood draw. No waiting period after the result. If missing or under 0.5, the test is done in quarantine after arrival.
countries.import_permit: No import permit for personal pets. Larger groups need advance notification to APQA and prior approval of a quarantine facility. Confirm the threshold with APQA.
countries.quarantine: None if compliant (arrival inspection only). Pets missing the chip or titer, with a mismatched chip, or with a titer under 0.5 IU/ml are held at the owner's expense until it is resolved, typically about 10 days, sometimes longer. A missing health certificate can mean return to origin.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 30 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated: titer blood draw → lab result (usually 2–4 weeks) → Korea-specific health certificate (valid 30 days) and USDA/official endorsement. A titer result from the last 24 months can be reused.
countries.restricted_breeds: Korea has domestic 'dangerous dog' rules (e.g. Tosa, Pit Bull types, Rottweiler) that impose owner obligations after entry; confirm with APQA before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrange the APQA arrival inspection at the arrival airport (e.g. Incheon or Gimpo) in advance through the handler or FBO.
countries.export: APQA issues an export quarantine certificate after inspection at its airport or port office, based on the destination's requirements.
countries.authority: Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency (APQA / QIA), Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs
vaccinations: Rabies (age 90 days or older, non-rabies-free origin): current at arrival. The APQA FAQ indicates at least 30 days since vaccination and still within immunity. If under 30 days, the pet is held until 30 days have passed.
Pets under 90 days or from APQA-listed rabies-free countries: rabies vaccination not required, but chip and certificate still required.
documents: Health certificate issued or endorsed by the exporting country's veterinary authority, stating the microchip number, birth date, rabies vaccination and titer result. For US origin, USDA-endorsed within 30 days of export.
Rabies vaccination certificate
Rabies antibody test report (where required)
Cats from Australia and dogs/cats from Malaysia: extra Hendra/Nipah freedom certificate, otherwise quarantine is extended 21 days (older official guidance)

steps.what: Titer blood draw (common practice: 30+ days after rabies vaccine)

Korea-specific health certificate with USDA/official endorsement

Domestic dangerous-dog rules (e.g. Tosa, Pit Bull, Rottweiler) apply after entry
export_points: APQA issues the export certificate after inspection at its airport or port office

countries.name: Cayman Islands
countries.summary: A Department of Agriculture import permit is needed. Pets need an ISO microchip, rabies vaccination per Cayman guidelines and, unless coming from a 'no rabies-risk' territory, a FAVN titer: 'low-risk' origins (US mainland, Canada) may enter no sooner than 2 months after the blood draw, 'high-risk' origins (e.g. Mexico, Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic) 3 months. 'No-risk' territories include the UK, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, Netherlands, Portugal, Greece, Monaco, Bahamas, Barbados, Australia and New Zealand. No quarantine option: non-compliant pets are returned or destroyed. No direct imports from Asia (incl. UAE), Africa, or Central/South America.
countries.microchip: ISO-compliant 15-digit chip if implanted on or after 1 Mar 2019 (older chips: 10 or more characters), implanted BEFORE rabies vaccination, otherwise revaccinate. Scanned at each step.
countries.rabies_titer: Required unless coming from a 'no rabies-risk' territory (official 2026 list includes e.g. UK, Ireland, France, Germany, Italy, Spain incl. Balearics/Canaries, Portugal, Greece, Netherlands, Belgium, Switzerland, Monaco, Austria, Bahamas, Barbados, Bermuda, Jamaica, Hawaii, Australia, New Zealand). Blood drawn at least 30 days after vaccination at a Cayman-approved lab, result at least 0.5 IU/ml with the microchip number, repeated every 12 months. Earliest entry after the draw: 2 months for 'low risk' origins (US mainland, Canada, Bulgaria, Croatia, Hungary, Latvia, Estonia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Grenada, Trinidad & Tobago) and 3 months for 'high risk' origins (e.g. Mexico, Puerto Rico, Cuba, Dominican Republic, Haiti, Poland, Romania, Lithuania, Serbia, Montenegro, Greenland). Pets must have resided in the origin country for at least 3 months. Animals arriving by sea are treated as high risk.
countries.parasite_treatment: On the day of the vet examination, within 14 days before travel: praziquantel at 5 mg/kg (tapeworm) plus a systemic tick product with residual action. Shampoos, collars and flea-only products are not accepted.
countries.import_permit: Required. Email the application and documents to ci.agriculturevs@gov.ky, up to 6 months before travel. Fee CI$50 / US$61 per animal. Decision within 3 working days of a complete file. The health certificate must be added within 14 days before entry.
countries.quarantine: None available. Non-compliant animals are refused and returned immediately, or destroyed, at the importer's expense. Dogs staying more than 30 days must be licensed.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 65 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the US mainland: FAVN blood draw on a currently vaccinated pet, then a 2-month wait before entry. From 'no-risk' EU countries or the UK, allow about 3 weeks (permit, vet exam and treatments within 14 days). From scratch, plan at least 3 months (US mainland) or 4 months (higher-risk origins): microchip → rabies vaccine → FAVN at least 30 days later → wait 2–3 months; apply for the permit; vet exam and treatments within 14 days of travel; give 48 hours' notice of arrival. From the UAE there is no direct route (the flight must route via a non-Asian country).
countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited: Pit Bull Terrier types, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, Japanese Tosa, and dogs bred for fighting. Crosses are allowed only if spayed or neutered (proof required) and not pregnant. Purebreds not originating in Cayman are never admitted.
countries.private_aviation: Travel by the most direct route. No animal may be imported DIRECTLY from Asia (including the UAE/Dubai), Africa, or Central or South America. Transit through such a country requires a government-sealed crate. Give 48 hours' notice of arrival time and flight. DoA office hours are Mon–Fri 8:30 am–5:00 pm, so confirm inspector availability for FBO arrivals outside these hours.
countries.export: Leaving Cayman: DoA export permit/health certificate (fee CI$20 / US$25 per animal). Pets abroad for less than 14 days can re-enter on the export certificate plus a tick and tapeworm treatment.
countries.authority: Cayman Islands Department of Agriculture – Veterinary Services
vaccinations: Rabies: first vaccine at 12 weeks or older; booster 9–12 months later; 2- or 3-year intervals only after that second dose. Valid for entry 30 days after vaccination for 'no-risk' origins.
Dogs: distemper, hepatitis and parvovirus mandatory. Cats: panleukopenia, herpesvirus and calicivirus mandatory.
documents: Cayman Islands import permit (single entry, valid 14 days from the health-certificate exam date).

Veterinary health certificate completed within 14 days of travel. The new US VEHCS certificate (Sep 2026) includes a USDA endorsement block, and APHIS indicates endorsement applies from 1 Oct 2026; previously Cayman needed no APHIS endorsement for dogs and cats. Original presented on arrival.
FAVN report, rabies and routine vaccination certificates, signed breed declaration and full-body colour photo (dogs).

Les territoires « sans risque » comprennent le Royaume-Uni, la France, l'Allemagne, l'Italie, l'Espagne, la Suisse, les Pays-Bas, le Portugal, la Grèce, Monaco, les Bahamas, la Barbade, l'Australie et la Nouvelle-Zélande. countries.summary: A DLF import licence is required before shipment, plus the official Lao import health certificate (Form 3). countries.microchip: Required in practice: the certificate records a microchip (or ID) number scanned before export that matches the vaccination certificate.
countries.rabies_titer: Rabies neutralising antibody of at least 0.5 IU/ml by a WOAH-prescribed test. Blood drawn at least 30 days after rabies vaccination and within 6 months before export. The test report must go with the certificate. The form says 'whenever require'; if the rabies conditions are not met, the pet is vaccinated on arrival and confined separately at home for at least 21 days.
countries.parasite_treatment: External (fleas and ticks) and internal (nematodes and cestodes) treatment between 2 and 7 days before export, with product, active ingredient and date recorded.
countries.import_permit: Yes. A valid Department of Livestock and Fisheries (DLF) import licence must be obtained before shipment. Confirm the processing time and fees with the DLF before travel.
countries.quarantine: No routine quarantine for compliant pets. Pets not meeting the rabies conditions are vaccinated on arrival and confined at home for at least 21 days.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 30 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (vaccine at least 30 days old): titer blood draw → result → DLF licence → parasite treatments, exam and official endorsement within 7 days of export.

Cats: calicivirus, rhinotracheitis and panleukopenia, at least 14 days before export.

countries.name: Saint Lucia
countries.summary: Get a Veterinary Import Permit (EC$45, about 2 business days). Pets need an ISO microchip, rabies vaccination at least 30 days before export, and a FAVN of at least 0.5 IU/ml. countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785 microchip, or a non-ISO chip with the owner providing a reader. Implanted before rabies vaccination.
countries.rabies_titer: FAVN at an approved lab, blood drawn at least 30 days after rabies vaccination, result at least 0.5 IU/ml. Entry not allowed until 3 months after the successful blood draw. The original lab report accompanies the certificate.
countries.parasite_treatment: Endoparasites (including tapeworm) and ectoparasites (including ticks) treated 'not less than 14 days prior to export' (US certificate wording); confirm the exact window with VLSD before travel. The pet must be free of external parasites at the exam.
countries.import_permit: Required. Email the application form and documents to vlsdsec.agriculture@govt.lc. Processing about 2 business days; fee EC$45 paid on entry. Animals without a permit are refused or euthanized.
countries.timeline: Plan at least 4–5 months before travel: microchip, rabies, FAVN at least 30 days later, then a 3-month wait. In parallel, get the permit; vaccines and tests within 14 days; give 3 days' notice.

countries.private_aviation: Notify the Veterinary and Livestock Services Division of the port of entry (Hewanorra UVF or George F.L. Charles SLU), date, time and flight at least 3 days before arrival. Office hours are 8:00 am–4:30 pm. Pets must travel directly and not contact other animals on the flight.
countries.authority: Veterinary and Livestock Services Division, Ministry of Agriculture, Saint Lucia
vaccinations: Rabies: inactivated and adjuvanted, at 12 weeks or older, after the microchip, no less than 30 days before export.

Cats: FeLV, rhinotracheitis, calicivirus, panleukopenia and pneumonitis at least 14 days before export.

countries.name: Liechtenstein
countries.summary: Liechtenstein is an EU Annex I listed territory with an open border to Switzerland and no airport; pets arrive via Switzerland (or Austria) and must meet the rules of that entry country (Swiss rules: microchip, rabies vaccination, pet passport or health certificate).
countries.microchip: Microchip required before rabies vaccination (Swiss/EU rules).

countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA, as for Switzerland (health certificate endorsed by the exporting authority); from the EU, pet passport only. From scratch, plan at least 4 weeks from EU/low-risk origins and 4+ months from high-risk origins.
countries.private_aviation: No airport in Liechtenstein. Private jets land in Switzerland or Austria, and the landing country's entry rules apply. Direct flights from third countries with pets may land in Switzerland only at Zurich, Basel or Geneva (the Swiss pet entry airports), so regional airports such as St. Gallen-Altenrhein are not available for these arrivals; from the EU/Schengen area no veterinary border check applies.
countries.export: The EU treats Liechtenstein as an Annex I listed territory (pet passport, no titer). Contact the Office of Food Safety and Veterinary Affairs (ALKVW) for export certification.
countries.authority: Office of Food Safety and Veterinary Affairs (ALKVW), Liechtenstein; Swiss FSVO for border controls
vaccinations: Rabies: pet ≥ 12 weeks at vaccination, valid 21 days after primary vaccination (Swiss/EU rules).
documents: EU/Swiss pet passport (from EU/CH), or health certificate meeting Swiss rules from third countries.

countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the State Food and Veterinary Service (VMVT) before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Lithuania and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Airport points of entry: Vilnius, Kaunas, Palanga and Šiauliai (customs performs the checks). Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: State Food and Veterinary Service (VMVT)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

Young animals: Lithuania accepts non-commercial entry from other EU states of pets under 12 weeks that are unvaccinated, or 12–16 weeks old and vaccinated but before the 21-day wait ends, with the owner's declaration of no contact with rabies-susceptible wild animals, or accompanied by the vaccinated mother. Never allowed from outside the EU.

at_a_glance.microchip: شريحة ISO، قبل لقاح داء الكلب

يصبح التطعيم الأولي ضد داء الكلب صالحًا

من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: تدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين

key_points: الحد الأقصى 5 حيوانات لكل تنقّل؛ ويسافر كل منها مع المالك أو خلال 5 أيام

steps.what: شريحة ISO، ثم لقاح داء الكلب (للحيوان بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا)
يصبح التطعيم الأولي ضد داء الكلب صالحًا
من الولايات المتحدة: شهادة صحية أوروبية مصادق عليها من USDA APHIS؛ ومن الاتحاد الأوروبي: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف

من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: تدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين

إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات
ar.private_jet_note: عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، يُعد مطار لوكسمبورغ-فيندل مطار الدخول الوحيد للحيوانات الأليفة. وقد يؤدي عدم الاستيفاء إلى الرفض أو العزل على نفقتكم.
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين.

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
Die Tollwut-Erstimpfung wird gültig
Aus den USA: von USDA APHIS beglaubigtes EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; aus der EU: EU-Heimtierausweis
Die unterschriebene Erklärung zur nicht kommerziellen Verbringung mitführen (Nicht-EU-Herkunft)
Von außerhalb der EU: Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrolle an einem Eingangsort für Reisende

key_points: Max. 5 Heimtiere pro Verbringung; jedes reist mit dem Halter oder innerhalb von 5 Tagen
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern (z. B. Türkei, Marokko, Israel, Thailand, Südafrika): Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit
EU-Zeugnisse nach altem Muster werden nur akzeptiert, wenn sie vor dem 1. Okt. 2026 ausgestellt wurden
export_points: In EU-/EWR-Länder: EU-Heimtierausweis von einem ermächtigten Tierarzt
Hunde nach FI, IE, MT, NO oder Nordirland benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Bestimmungen des Ziellandes erfüllen; der amtliche Veterinärdienst beglaubigt die Zeugnisse
de.private_jet_note: Von außerhalb der EU ist Luxemburg-Findel der einzige Einreiseflughafen für Heimtiere. Bei Nichteinhaltung drohen Zurückweisung oder Isolation auf Ihre Kosten.
de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende.

steps.what: Microchip ISO y, después, vacuna antirrábica (mascota de 12+ semanas)
La primovacunación antirrábica pasa a ser válida
Desde EE. UU.: certificado sanitario de la UE refrendado por USDA APHIS; desde la UE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas
Lleve la declaración firmada de no comercialidad (orígenes fuera de la UE)
Desde fuera de la UE: control documental y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros

key_points: Máx. 5 mascotas por desplazamiento; cada una viaja con el propietario o en un plazo de 5 días
Desde países no incluidos en la lista (p. ej., Turquía, Marruecos, Israel, Tailandia, Sudáfrica): prueba de titulación más 3 meses de espera
Los certificados UE del modelo anterior solo se aceptan si se emitieron antes del 1 de octubre de 2026
export_points: A países de la UE/EEE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas de un veterinario autorizado

A países fuera de la UE: cumpla las normas del destino; el servicio veterinario oficial refrenda los certificados
es.private_jet_note: Desde fuera de la UE, el único aeropuerto de entrada de mascotas es Luxemburgo-Findel. El incumplimiento puede suponer el rechazo o el aislamiento a su cargo.
es.summary: Normas de la UE (Reglamento Delegado (UE) 2026/131): desde otro Estado de la UE/EEE, mascota con microchip, vacunación antirrábica válida y pasaporte europeo para mascotas; desde fuera de la UE, certificado zoosanitario de la UE (más prueba de titulación antirrábica con 3 meses de espera si el país no figura en la lista) y controles documentales y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros.
