at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passeport UE ; hors UE, certificat ≤10 jours

steps.what: Puce électronique ISO, puis vaccin antirabique (animal âgé d'au moins 12 semaines)
La primovaccination antirabique devient valable
Depuis les États-Unis : certificat sanitaire UE visé par l'USDA APHIS ; depuis l'UE : passeport européen pour animal de compagnie
Munissez-vous de la déclaration signée attestant le caractère non commercial (origines hors UE)
Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE : contrôle documentaire et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs

key_points: 5 animaux max. par mouvement ; chacun voyage avec le propriétaire ou dans un délai de 5 jours
Depuis les pays non listés (p. ex. Turquie, Maroc, Israël, Thaïlande, Afrique du Sud) : titrage des anticorps antirabiques plus attente de 3 mois
Les certificats UE de l'ancien modèle ne sont acceptés que s'ils ont été délivrés avant le 1er oct. 2026
export_points: Vers les pays de l'UE/EEE : passeport européen délivré par un vétérinaire habilité
Les chiens à destination de FI, IE, MT, NO ou de l'Irlande du Nord nécessitent aussi un traitement contre le ténia
Vers les pays hors UE : respecter les règles du pays de destination ; le service vétérinaire officiel vise les certificats
fr.private_jet_note: Hors UE, le seul aéroport d'entrée pour les animaux est Luxembourg-Findel. En cas de non-conformité : refus d'entrée ou isolement à vos frais.
fr.summary: Règles de l'UE (règlement délégué (UE) 2026/131) : depuis un autre État de l'UE/EEE, animal identifié par puce électronique, avec vaccination antirabique valide et passeport européen pour animal de compagnie ; depuis l'extérieur de l'UE, certificat sanitaire de l'UE (plus titrage des anticorps antirabiques avec attente de 3 mois si le pays n'est pas listé) et contrôles documentaires et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passaporto UE, o cert. UE ≤10 gg (extra UE)

steps.what: Microchip ISO, poi vaccino antirabbico (animale di 12+ settimane)
La vaccinazione antirabbica primaria diventa valida
Dagli Stati Uniti: certificato sanitario UE vidimato da USDA APHIS; dall'UE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia
Portare con sé la dichiarazione firmata di movimentazione non commerciale (origini extra UE)
Da fuori UE: controllo documentale e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori

key_points: Max 5 animali per movimentazione; ciascuno viaggia con il proprietario o entro 5 giorni
Da Paesi non elencati (ad es. Turchia, Marocco, Israele, Thailandia, Sudafrica): titolazione più attesa di 3 mesi
I certificati UE del vecchio modello sono accettati solo se rilasciati prima del 1 ott 2026
export_points: Verso Paesi UE/SEE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia rilasciato da un veterinario autorizzato
I cani diretti in FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Nord necessitano anche del trattamento contro la tenia (Echinococcus)
Verso Paesi extra UE: rispettare le norme della destinazione; il servizio veterinario ufficiale vidima i certificati
it.private_jet_note: Da fuori UE, l'unico aeroporto d'ingresso per animali da compagnia è Lussemburgo-Findel. In caso di mancata conformità, l'animale può essere respinto o isolato a Sue spese.
it.summary: Norme UE (Regolamento delegato (UE) 2026/131): da un altro Stato UE/SEE, animale con microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica valida e passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia; da fuori UE, certificato sanitario UE per animali (più titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici con attesa di 3 mesi se il Paese non è elencato) e controlli documentali e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori.

at_a_glance.microchip: Чип ISO, до прививки от бешенства
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Паспорт или сертификат ЕС ≤10 дней (не из ЕС)

steps.what: Микрочип ISO, затем прививка от бешенства (животному 12+ недель)
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной
Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС, заверенный USDA APHIS; из ЕС: европейский паспорт животного
Имейте при себе подписанную декларацию о некоммерческом перемещении (не из ЕС)
Из-за пределов ЕС: проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников

key_points: Не более 5 животных за одно перемещение; каждое следует с владельцем или в пределах 5 дней
Из стран вне перечня (например, Турция, Марокко, Израиль, Таиланд, ЮАР): тест на титр плюс ожидание 3 месяца
Сертификаты ЕС старого образца принимаются, только если выданы до 1 октября 2026 г.
export_points: В страны ЕС/ЕЭЗ: европейский паспорт животного от уполномоченного ветеринара
Собакам, направляющимся в FI, IE, MT, NO или Северную Ирландию, также нужна обработка от ленточных червей
В страны вне ЕС: соблюдайте правила страны назначения; сертификаты заверяет официальная ветеринарная служба
ru.private_jet_note: При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС единственный аэропорт въезда для животных — Люксембург-Финдель. Несоблюдение требований может повлечь отказ во въезде или изоляцию за Ваш счёт.
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников.

countries.name: Latvia
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Latvia and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Airport points of entry: Riga, Liepaja, Ventspils, Daugavpils and Tukums (customs performs the checks). Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Food and Veterinary Service (PVD)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Young animals: Latvia does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

countries.name: Monaco
countries.summary: Monaco is an EU Annex I listed territory (pets from it enter the EU without a titer test or point-of-entry check). Monaco has no airport, so pets arrive via France (Nice Côte d'Azur airport) and France's EU entry rules apply (microchip, rabies vaccination, EU pet passport or EU health certificate; titer test from unlisted countries). France's category 1 dog ban applies on arrival through France.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted), as required by France on arrival. Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid.
countries.rabies_titer: Under the EU rules applied in France on arrival: required only from unlisted third countries.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required under EU rules (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if EU requirements are met.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA via Nice: EU animal health certificate within 10 days before arrival. From the EU: pet passport only. From scratch, plan at least 4 weeks from EU/listed origins and 4+ months from unlisted origins.
countries.restricted_breeds: Arrival through France means France's category 1 dog import ban applies.
countries.private_aviation: No airport in Monaco (heliport only). Private jets land at Nice Côte d'Azur (LFMN), where French/EU entry rules apply: pets from third countries are presented to French Customs on arrival (customs check pets at points open to international passenger traffic; Nice is also a live-animal border control post). France's category 1 dog ban applies on arrival through France.
countries.export: Leaving: the EU treats Monaco as an Annex I listed territory (pet passport or certificate, no titer, no point-of-entry requirement).
countries.authority: Direction de l'Action Sanitaire (Monaco); at entry, the French authorities at Nice
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: EU pet passport (from EU) or EU animal health certificate + non-commercial declaration (from third countries), as required by the EU arrival country.

ar.summary: موناكو إقليم مُدرج في الملحق I للاتحاد الأوروبي (تدخل الحيوانات الأليفة القادمة منه إلى الاتحاد الأوروبي دون اختبار الأجسام المضادة أو فحص عند نقطة الدخول). ولا يوجد مطار في موناكو، لذا تصل الحيوانات الأليفة عبر فرنسا (مطار نيس كوت دازور) وتُطبَّق قواعد الدخول الأوروبية لفرنسا (شريحة إلكترونية، وتطعيم ضد داء الكلب، وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف أو شهادة صحية أوروبية؛ واختبار الأجسام المضادة للقادمين من دول غير مُدرجة). ويُطبَّق حظر فرنسا على كلاب الفئة 1 عند الوصول عبر فرنسا.

steps.what: Das Tier chippen, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier ab 12 Wochen)
Aus den USA: EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung, staatlich beglaubigt
Landung in Nizza; Heimtiere von außerhalb der EU werden dem französischen Zoll vorgeführt

key_points: Kein Flughafen: Anreise über Nizza, wo französische/EU-Regeln gelten
Das französische Verbot für Hunde der Kategorie 1 gilt bei Einreise über Frankreich
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern: Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit
export_points: Die EU behandelt Monaco als gelistet: Heimtierausweis oder Zeugnis, kein Titer
de.summary: Monaco ist ein in Anhang I der EU gelistetes Gebiet (Heimtiere von dort reisen ohne Titertest und ohne Kontrolle an einem Eingangsort in die EU ein). Monaco hat keinen Flughafen; daher reisen Heimtiere über Frankreich (Flughafen Nizza Côte d'Azur) ein, und es gelten die EU-Einreiseregeln Frankreichs (Mikrochip, Tollwutimpfung, EU-Heimtierausweis oder EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; Titertest bei nicht gelisteten Herkunftsländern). Das französische Verbot für Hunde der Kategorie 1 gilt bei Einreise über Frankreich.

Mónaco no tiene aeropuerto, por lo que las mascotas llegan vía Francia (aeropuerto de Niza-Costa Azul) y se aplican las normas de entrada en la UE de Francia (microchip, vacunación antirrábica, pasaporte europeo para mascotas o certificado sanitario de la UE; prueba de titulación desde países no incluidos en la lista). La prohibición francesa de perros de 1.ª categoría se aplica a la llegada a través de Francia.

fr.summary: Monaco est un territoire listé à l'annexe I de l'UE (les animaux qui en proviennent entrent dans l'UE sans titrage des anticorps antirabiques ni contrôle au point d'entrée). Monaco n'a pas d'aéroport : les animaux arrivent donc par la France (aéroport Nice Côte d'Azur) et les règles d'entrée UE de la France s'appliquent (puce électronique, vaccination antirabique, passeport européen pour animal de compagnie ou certificat sanitaire de l'UE ; titrage depuis les pays non listés). L'interdiction française des chiens de 1re catégorie s'applique à l'arrivée par la France.

Dagli Stati Uniti: certificato sanitario UE vidimato dalle autorità governative

Monaco non dispone di aeroporto: gli animali arrivano quindi via Francia (aeroporto di Nizza Costa Azzurra) e si applicano le norme UE d'ingresso della Francia (microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica, passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia o certificato sanitario UE; titolazione da Paesi non elencati). All'arrivo attraverso la Francia si applica il divieto francese sui cani di categoria 1.

Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС с государственным заверением
Посадка в Ницце; животные из-за пределов ЕС предъявляются французской таможне

key_points: Аэропорта нет: прибытие через Ниццу, где действуют правила Франции/ЕС
При прибытии через Францию действует французский запрет собак категории 1
Из стран вне перечня: тест на титр плюс ожидание 3 месяца
export_points: ЕС рассматривает Монако как включённое в перечень: паспорт животного или сертификат, без теста на титр
ru.summary: Монако — территория, включённая в Приложение I ЕС (животные из неё въезжают в ЕС без теста на титр антител и без проверки в пункте въезда). В Монако нет аэропорта, поэтому животные прибывают через Францию (аэропорт Ницца — Лазурный Берег), и применяются правила въезда в ЕС Франции (микрочип, вакцинация против бешенства, европейский паспорт животного или ветеринарный сертификат ЕС; тест на титр антител — для стран вне перечня). При прибытии через Францию действует французский запрет собак категории 1.

countries.name: Moldova
countries.summary: Microchip (before rabies vaccination), rabies vaccination at least 21 days before departure (pet ≥12 weeks at vaccination), a rabies antibody titer ≥0.5 IU/ml taken at least 30 days after the last vaccination and recorded in the pet passport, plus a veterinary health certificate. The titer is required by Moldovan Customs (via IATA Timatic) and the ANSA guide, but the APHIS certificate for US pets does not mention it, so plan for it and confirm with ANSA.
countries.microchip: Required: transponder implanted before rabies vaccination (ISO 11784/11785 recommended)
countries.rabies_titer: Required per Moldovan Customs (IATA Timatic) and ANSA: ≥0.5 IU/ml, sample ≥30 days after the last rabies vaccination, result recorded in the pet passport. The older ANSA guide also says the test must be ≤24 months old and done ≥3 months before shipment; confirm with ANSA whether the 3-month wait still applies under Government Decision 660/2022. Not mentioned on the APHIS US-origin certificate.
countries.timeline: Microchip → rabies vaccination (≥21 days before departure) → titer blood sample ≥30 days after vaccination → (possibly 3-month wait per older ANSA guide) → health certificate. Allow up to 4 months to be safe if no prior titer.
countries.private_aviation: Enter via a border point with veterinary inspection (Chișinău airport). ANSA Border Inspection Directorate +373 22 29-47-15
countries.export: ANSA 'Certificate for non-commercial movement of pets', applied for online (servicii.gov.md / EVO app) at least 3–5 days before travel. Requires ID, pet passport (microchip, rabies details), official titer lab report and clinical exam record; issued on paper by the ANSA territorial office.
countries.authority: National Food Safety Agency of Moldova (ANSA); Customs Service of Moldova
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an official veterinarian of the origin country, pet ≥12 weeks old at vaccination, at least 21 days before departure (IATA Timatic / Moldovan Customs). Under 3 months only if the dam was vaccinated (APHIS certificate)
Compliance with other preventive sanitary measures for diseases other than rabies (Customs)
documents: Veterinary health certificate from the origin country (APHIS US version: valid 30 days after issuance)
Pet passport with microchip, rabies vaccination and titer result
Declaration of the animal at the border to the border veterinary inspector

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccine
Titer blood draw; record the result in the pet passport
Older ANSA guidance requires a 3-month wait after the test: confirm
Vet health certificate (US version valid 30 days)
Declare the pet to the border vet at Chișinău airport

key_points: Titer required by Customs but not on the US certificate: plan for it and confirm with ANSA
Pets under 3 months only if the mother was vaccinated
export_points: ANSA certificate for non-commercial pet travel, applied for online 3–5 days before
Needs ID, pet passport, titer lab report and clinical exam record

steps.what: الشريحة الإلكترونية، ثم لقاح داء الكلب
سحب عينة الدم لاختبار الأجسام المضادة؛ وتسجيل النتيجة في جواز سفر الحيوان الأليف
تشترط إرشادات ANSA القديمة انتظار 3 أشهر بعد الاختبار: يُرجى التأكيد
شهادة صحية بيطرية (النسخة الأمريكية صالحة 30 يومًا)
التصريح عن الحيوان الأليف لدى الطبيب البيطري الحدودي في مطار كيشيناو

key_points: تشترط الجمارك اختبار الأجسام المضادة لكنه غير مذكور في الشهادة الأمريكية: يُرجى التخطيط له والتأكيد مع ANSA
الحيوانات دون 3 أشهر فقط إذا كانت الأم مطعّمة
export_points: شهادة ANSA لسفر الحيوانات الأليفة غير التجاري، يُتقدَّم بطلبها إلكترونيًا قبل 3–5 أيام
تتطلب الهوية، وجواز سفر الحيوان الأليف، وتقرير مختبر الأجسام المضادة، وسجل الفحص السريري
ar.summary: شريحة إلكترونية (قبل التطعيم ضد داء الكلب)، وتطعيم ضد داء الكلب قبل المغادرة بـ21 يومًا على الأقل (عمر الحيوان ≥12 أسبوعًا عند التطعيم)، ومعايرة أجسام مضادة لداء الكلب ≥0.5 IU/ml مأخوذة بعد آخر تطعيم بـ30 يومًا على الأقل ومُسجَّلة في جواز سفر الحيوان الأليف، إضافة إلى شهادة صحية بيطرية. وتشترط الجمارك المولدوفية (عبر IATA Timatic) ودليل ANSA اختبار الأجسام المضادة، لكن شهادة APHIS للحيوانات الأمريكية لا تذكره، لذا يُرجى التخطيط له والتأكيد مع ANSA.

steps.what: Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung
Titer-Blutentnahme; Ergebnis im Heimtierausweis eintragen
Älterer ANSA-Leitfaden verlangt 3 Monate Wartezeit nach dem Test: bestätigen lassen
Tierärztliches Gesundheitszeugnis (US-Version 30 Tage gültig)
Das Tier beim Grenztierarzt am Flughafen Chișinău anmelden

key_points: Titer vom Zoll verlangt, aber nicht im US-Zeugnis: einplanen und bei ANSA bestätigen lassen
Tiere unter 3 Monaten nur, wenn das Muttertier geimpft war
export_points: ANSA-Zeugnis für nicht kommerzielle Heimtierreisen, online 3–5 Tage vorher beantragen
Erforderlich: Ausweis, Heimtierausweis, Titer-Laborbericht und Nachweis der klinischen Untersuchung
de.summary: Mikrochip (vor der Tollwutimpfung), Tollwutimpfung mindestens 21 Tage vor Abflug (Tier bei Impfung ≥12 Wochen), ein Tollwut-Antikörpertiter ≥0,5 IE/ml, entnommen mindestens 30 Tage nach der letzten Impfung und im Heimtierausweis eingetragen, sowie ein tierärztliches Gesundheitszeugnis. Der Titer wird vom moldauischen Zoll (über IATA Timatic) und im ANSA-Leitfaden verlangt, das APHIS-Zeugnis für US-Tiere erwähnt ihn jedoch nicht; planen Sie ihn daher ein und bestätigen Sie dies bei ANSA.

Extracción para titulación; anote el resultado en el pasaporte para mascotas
Una guía anterior de la ANSA exige 3 meses de espera tras la prueba: confírmelo

Declare la mascota al veterinario fronterizo del aeropuerto de Chisináu

es.summary: Microchip (antes de la vacunación antirrábica), vacunación antirrábica al menos 21 días antes de la salida (mascota de ≥12 semanas al vacunarse), una titulación de anticuerpos antirrábicos ≥0,5 UI/ml realizada al menos 30 días después de la última vacunación y anotada en el pasaporte para mascotas, además de un certificado sanitario veterinario. La titulación la exigen la Aduana de Moldavia (vía IATA Timatic) y la guía de la ANSA, pero el certificado APHIS para mascotas de EE. UU. no la menciona, por lo que conviene preverla y confirmarla con la ANSA.

Prise de sang pour le titrage ; consigner le résultat dans le passeport de l'animal

Requiert l'identification, le passeport de l'animal, le rapport de titrage et le compte rendu d'examen clinique
fr.summary: Puce électronique (avant la vaccination antirabique), vaccination antirabique au moins 21 jours avant le départ (animal âgé de ≥ 12 semaines lors de la vaccination), titrage des anticorps antirabiques ≥ 0,5 UI/ml réalisé au moins 30 jours après la dernière vaccination et consigné dans le passeport de l'animal, ainsi qu'un certificat sanitaire vétérinaire. Le titrage est exigé par les douanes moldaves (via IATA Timatic) et par le guide de l'ANSA, mais le certificat APHIS pour les animaux venant des États-Unis ne le mentionne pas : prévoyez-le et confirmez auprès de l'ANSA.

steps.what: Microchip, poi vaccino antirabbico
Prelievo per la titolazione; registrare l'esito nel passaporto
Una precedente guida ANSA prevede 3 mesi di attesa dopo il test: verificare
Certificato sanitario veterinario (versione USA valida 30 giorni)
Dichiarare l'animale al veterinario di frontiera all'aeroporto di Chișinău

key_points: Titolazione richiesta dalla dogana ma assente dal certificato USA: prevederla e verificare con l'ANSA
Animali sotto i 3 mesi solo se la madre era vaccinata
export_points: Certificato ANSA per il trasporto non commerciale di animali da compagnia, da richiedere online 3–5 giorni prima
Richiede identificazione, passaporto dell'animale, referto della titolazione e verbale della visita clinica
it.summary: Microchip (prima della vaccinazione antirabbica), vaccinazione antirabbica almeno 21 giorni prima della partenza (animale di età ≥12 settimane alla vaccinazione), titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici ≥0,5 UI/ml eseguita almeno 30 giorni dopo l'ultima vaccinazione e registrata nel passaporto dell'animale, oltre a un certificato sanitario veterinario. La titolazione è richiesta dalla dogana moldava (tramite IATA Timatic) e dalla guida ANSA, ma il certificato APHIS per gli animali provenienti dagli Stati Uniti non la menziona: è quindi opportuno prevederla e verificare con l'ANSA.

steps.what: Микрочип, затем прививка от бешенства
Забор крови на титр; запишите результат в паспорт животного
Прежние рекомендации ANSA требуют ожидания 3 месяца после теста: уточните
Ветеринарный сертификат (версия для США действует 30 дней)
Задекларируйте животное пограничному ветеринару в аэропорту Кишинёва

Животные младше 3 месяцев — только если мать была привита
export_points: Сертификат ANSA для некоммерческой поездки с животным, онлайн-заявка за 3–5 дней
Нужны документ, удостоверяющий личность, паспорт животного, лабораторное заключение о титре и запись о клиническом осмотре
ru.summary: Микрочип (до вакцинации от бешенства), вакцинация против бешенства не менее чем за 21 день до вылета (животному ≥12 недель на момент прививки), титр антител к бешенству ≥0.5 МЕ/мл по крови, взятой не ранее чем через 30 дней после последней прививки, с записью в паспорте животного, а также ветеринарный сертификат. Тест на титр требуют таможня Молдовы (через IATA Timatic) и руководство ANSA, но сертификат APHIS для животных из США его не упоминает, поэтому заложите его в план и уточните в ANSA.

countries.name: Montenegro
countries.summary: Montenegro uses the EU Regulation 576/2013 model for non-commercial pets (up to 5). It requires a microchip and a rabies vaccine at least 21 days old. A titer test is needed only if the pet comes from, or transits, a country not listed in Annex II of Reg 577/2013.
countries.microchip: Required: transponder (ISO), or a legible tattoo applied before 3 July 2011
countries.rabies_titer: Only from, or via, non-listed countries: ≥0.5 IU/ml, sample ≥30 days after vaccination and ≥3 months before the certificate is issued. Not required for US/EU/other listed origins
countries.timeline: Plan at least 1 month from listed countries (4+ months otherwise): microchip → rabies (wait 21 days) → [titer + 3 months] → certificate shortly before travel
countries.private_aviation: Certificate names the Montenegro border inspection post of entry; arrange entry at an airport with veterinary border control (e.g. Podgorica/Tivat)
countries.authority: Administration for Food Safety, Veterinary and Phytosanitary Affairs of Montenegro
vaccinations: Rabies: at ≥12 weeks of age; ≥21 days must have elapsed since the primary vaccination; boosters within the validity period
documents: Montenegro animal health certificate for non-commercial movement (bilingual, EU 576/2013 model), signed by an official/authorised vet. US origin: APHIS-endorsed
Owner declaration that the movement is non-commercial (pet accompanies the owner within 5 days)

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccine
Vet issues the Montenegro certificate; US: APHIS endorsement
Sign the non-commercial declaration (pet within 5 days of owner)
Enter at an airport with veterinary border control (Podgorica/Tivat)

key_points: Max 5 pets per non-commercial movement
Transit through an unlisted country triggers the titer and a 3-month wait

توقيع الإقرار بأن النقل غير تجاري (الحيوان خلال 5 أيام من سفر المالك)
الدخول عبر مطار فيه رقابة بيطرية حدودية (بودغوريتسا/تيفات)

يستلزم العبور بدولة غير مُدرجة اختبار الأجسام المضادة وانتظار 3 أشهر

Ein Titertest ist nur nötig, wenn das Tier aus einem nicht in Anhang II der VO 577/2013 gelisteten Land kommt oder durch ein solches reist.

countries.name: Saint Martin (French part)
countries.summary: The French side of Saint Martin is an EU outermost region, so EU pet rules under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131 apply: microchip, rabies vaccination at least 21 days before travel, and an EU animal health certificate endorsed by the exporting country's official vet, checked at a travellers' point of entry. Most arrivals land at SXM on the Dutch side, where Sint Maarten's own permit rules also apply.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: French dangerous-dog law applies (category 1 attack dogs may not be imported). Confirm with DAAF Guadeloupe before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Grand Case–L'Espérance (SFG) is the French-side airport; Princess Juliana (SXM) is on the Dutch side. Arriving at SXM means meeting Sint Maarten's import permit and conditions (see SX), which include a ban on dogs and cats from South and Central America. Pets from outside the EU arriving on the French side need documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry; confirm with DAAF Guadeloupe (which covers Saint-Martin) and, for SXM, with Sint Maarten LVV before booking.
countries.authority: DAAF Guadeloupe (Direction de l'Alimentation, de l'Agriculture et de la Forêt), Saint-Martin/Saint-Barthélemy territorial unit
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

key_points: تعود الإرشادات الرسمية إلى عام 1996؛ يُرجى تأكيد القواعد الحالية مع الخدمات البيطرية في مدغشقر
ar.summary: وفق الإرشادات الرسمية البريطانية للتصدير، يلزم تصريح استيراد إلى مدغشقر للحيوانات الأليفة غير المرافقة. وتحتاج الحيوانات إلى تطعيم ضد داء الكلب قبل التصدير بـ30 يومًا–12 شهرًا، وعلاج الديدان الأسطوانية/الشريطية خلال 3 أيام من التصدير، وشهادة صحية رسمية صادرة خلال 48 ساعة من التصدير. وتعود تلك الإرشادات إلى عام 1996، لذا يُرجى تأكيد القواعد الحالية مع الخدمات البيطرية في مدغشقر قبل السفر.

steps.what: Tollwutimpfung (mind. 30 Tage vor der Ausfuhr)
DSV-Einreisebewilligung anfordern (auch bei Begleitung empfohlen)
Behandlung gegen Spul- und Bandwürmer
Amtstierärztliche Untersuchung und Gesundheitszeugnis

key_points: Offizieller Leitfaden stammt von 1996; aktuelle Regeln bei den Veterinärdiensten Madagaskars bestätigen lassen
de.summary: Laut offiziellem Ausfuhrleitfaden des Vereinigten Königreichs ist für unbegleitete Heimtiere eine Einfuhrgenehmigung für Madagaskar nötig. Tiere benötigen eine Tollwutimpfung 30 Tage bis 12 Monate vor der Ausfuhr, eine Behandlung gegen Spul-/Bandwürmer innerhalb von 3 Tagen vor der Ausfuhr und ein amtliches Gesundheitszeugnis, ausgestellt innerhalb von 48 Stunden vor der Ausfuhr. Dieser Leitfaden stammt von 1996; bitte die aktuellen Regeln vor der Reise bei den Veterinärdiensten Madagaskars bestätigen lassen.

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: 30 días–12 meses antes de la exportación
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Oficial, ≤48 h antes de la exportación

steps.what: Vacunación antirrábica (30+ días antes de la exportación)
Solicite la autorización de entrada de la DSV (recomendable aunque viaje acompañada)
Tratamiento contra ascáridos y tenia
Examen por veterinario oficial y certificado sanitario

key_points: La guía oficial data de 1996; confirme las normas vigentes con los servicios veterinarios de Madagascar
es.summary: Según la guía oficial de exportación del Reino Unido, el permiso de importación de Madagascar se exige para mascotas no acompañadas. Los animales necesitan vacunación antirrábica entre 30 días y 12 meses antes de la exportación, tratamiento contra ascáridos y tenia en los 3 días previos a la exportación y un certificado sanitario oficial emitido en las 48 horas previas a la exportación. Esa guía data de 1996, por lo que conviene confirmar las normas vigentes con los servicios veterinarios de Madagascar antes del viaje.

at_a_glance.permit: Requis pour les animaux non accompagnés

steps.what: Vaccination antirabique (30+ jours avant l'export)
Demander l'autorisation d'entrée de la DSV (recommandée même si accompagné)
Traitement contre les ascaris et le ténia
Examen vétérinaire officiel et certificat sanitaire

key_points: Consignes officielles datant de 1996 ; confirmez les règles actuelles auprès des services vétérinaires de Madagascar
fr.summary: Selon les consignes officielles d'exportation du Royaume-Uni, un permis d'importation à Madagascar est requis pour les animaux non accompagnés. Les animaux doivent être vaccinés contre la rage entre 30 jours et 12 mois avant l'export, traités contre les ascaris et le ténia dans les 3 jours précédant l'export, et munis d'un certificat sanitaire officiel délivré dans les 48 heures précédant l'export. Ces consignes datent de 1996 : confirmez les règles en vigueur auprès des services vétérinaires de Madagascar avant le voyage.

steps.what: Vaccinazione antirabbica (30+ giorni prima dell'esportazione)
Richiedere l'autorizzazione d'ingresso DSV (consigliata anche se accompagnato)
Trattamento contro ascaridi e tenia
Visita veterinaria ufficiale e certificato sanitario

key_points: Le indicazioni ufficiali risalgono al 1996; verificare le norme attuali con i servizi veterinari del Madagascar
it.summary: Secondo le indicazioni ufficiali britanniche sull'esportazione, il permesso d'importazione in Madagascar è necessario per gli animali non accompagnati. Gli animali necessitano di vaccinazione antirabbica tra 30 giorni e 12 mesi prima dell'esportazione, trattamento contro ascaridi e tenia entro 3 giorni dall'esportazione e un certificato sanitario ufficiale rilasciato entro 48 ore dall'esportazione. Tali indicazioni risalgono al 1996: verificare le norme vigenti con i servizi veterinari del Madagascar prima del viaggio.

steps.what: Вакцинация против бешенства (за 30+ дней до вывоза)
Запросите разрешение DSV на въезд (рекомендуется даже при сопровождении)
Обработка от аскарид и ленточных червей
Осмотр официальным ветеринаром и ветеринарный сертификат

key_points: Официальные рекомендации датированы 1996 годом; уточните актуальные правила в ветеринарных службах Мадагаскара
ru.summary: Согласно официальным экспортным рекомендациям Великобритании, разрешение на ввоз на Мадагаскар нужно для несопровождаемых животных. Животным необходимы вакцинация против бешенства за 30 дней–12 месяцев до вывоза, обработка от аскарид/ленточных червей в пределах 3 дней до вывоза и официальный ветеринарный сертификат, выданный в пределах 48 часов до вывоза. Эти рекомендации датированы 1996 годом, поэтому до поездки уточните актуальные правила в ветеринарных службах Мадагаскара.

countries.name: North Macedonia
countries.summary: EU-style health certificate for dogs and cats. A titer test is needed only if the pet does not come directly from, or transits, a country outside Annex II. For US origin, APHIS must endorse the certificate within 10 days of travel.
countries.microchip: Required (EU-model certificate: ISO microchip or pre-3 July 2011 tattoo)
countries.rabies_titer: Not required when travelling directly from, or only via, Annex II-listed countries. Otherwise required per the model certificate (≥0.5 IU/ml, ≥30 days after vaccination, ≥3 months before travel)
countries.timeline: Plan at least 1 month (4+ months if titer needed): microchip → rabies (21 days) → certificate within 10 days of travel
countries.authority: Food and Veterinary Agency of North Macedonia (AHV)
vaccinations: Rabies: must be current (EU-model timing: ≥12 weeks old, ≥21 days after primary vaccination)
documents: North Macedonia health certificate for dogs and cats (APHIS-endorsed within 10 days of travel for US origin)
Owner declarations where applicable (unvaccinated young pet; transit through non-Annex II country)

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccine
North Macedonia health certificate; US: APHIS endorsement
Sign owner declarations if they apply (young pet, transit)

key_points: Transit through a non-Annex II country triggers the titer (allow 4+ months)

steps.what: الشريحة الإلكترونية، ثم لقاح داء الكلب
الشهادة الصحية لمقدونيا الشمالية؛ الولايات المتحدة: مصادقة APHIS
توقيع إقرارات المالك عند الاقتضاء (حيوان صغير، عبور)

key_points: يستلزم العبور بدولة غير مُدرجة في الملحق II اختبار الأجسام المضادة (يُرجى ترك 4+ أشهر)
ar.summary: شهادة صحية على النمط الأوروبي للكلاب والقطط. ولا يلزم اختبار الأجسام المضادة إلا إذا لم يكن الحيوان قادمًا مباشرة من دولة مُدرجة في الملحق II، أو إذا عبر دولة غير مُدرجة فيه. وبالنسبة للقادمين من الولايات المتحدة، يجب أن تصادق APHIS على الشهادة خلال 10 أيام من السفر.

steps.what: Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung
Gesundheitszeugnis für Nordmazedonien; USA: APHIS-Beglaubigung
Erklärungen des Halters unterschreiben, falls zutreffend (Jungtier, Transit)

key_points: Transit durch ein Land außerhalb von Anhang II löst den Titertest aus (mind. 4 Monate einplanen)
de.summary: Gesundheitszeugnis nach EU-Muster für Hunde und Katzen. Ein Titertest ist nur nötig, wenn das Tier nicht direkt aus einem Land außerhalb von Anhang II kommt bzw. durch ein solches reist. Bei Herkunft USA muss APHIS das Zeugnis innerhalb von 10 Tagen vor der Reise beglaubigen.

at_a_glance.microchip: ISO (o tatuaje anterior a julio de 2011)
at_a_glance.titer: No se requiere desde EE. UU./UE

steps.what: Microchip y después vacuna antirrábica
Certificado sanitario para Macedonia del Norte; EE. UU.: refrendo de APHIS
Firme las declaraciones del propietario si procede (mascota joven, tránsito)

key_points: El tránsito por un país no incluido en el Anexo II exige titulación (prevea 4+ meses)
es.summary: Certificado sanitario de tipo UE para perros y gatos. Solo se necesita prueba de titulación si la mascota no procede directamente de un país del Anexo II o transita por un país no incluido en él. Para origen EE. UU., APHIS debe refrendar el certificado en los 10 días previos al viaje.

steps.what: Pose de la puce électronique, puis vaccin antirabique
Certificat sanitaire pour la Macédoine du Nord ; États-Unis : visa de l'APHIS
Signer les déclarations du propriétaire le cas échéant (jeune animal, transit)

key_points: Un transit par un pays hors annexe II entraîne le titrage (prévoir 4+ mois)
fr.summary: Certificat sanitaire de type UE pour chiens et chats. Un titrage n'est requis que si l'animal ne provient pas directement d'un pays de l'annexe II, ou transite par un pays hors annexe II. Au départ des États-Unis, l'APHIS doit viser le certificat dans les 10 jours précédant le voyage.

steps.what: Microchip, poi vaccino antirabbico
Certificato sanitario per la Macedonia del Nord; USA: vidimazione APHIS
Firmare, se pertinenti, le dichiarazioni del proprietario (animale giovane, transito)

key_points: Il transito per un Paese non incluso nell'Annex II comporta la titolazione (prevedere 4+ mesi)
it.summary: Certificato sanitario su modello UE per cani e gatti. La titolazione è necessaria solo se l'animale non proviene direttamente da un Paese incluso nell'Annex II o se transita per un Paese non incluso. Dagli Stati Uniti, l'APHIS deve vidimare il certificato entro 10 giorni dal viaggio.

steps.what: Микрочип, затем прививка от бешенства
Ветеринарный сертификат для Северной Македонии; США: заверение APHIS
Подпишите декларации владельца, если применимо (молодое животное, транзит)

key_points: Транзит через страну вне Приложения II влечёт тест на титр (заложите 4+ месяца)
ru.summary: Ветеринарный сертификат образца ЕС для собак и кошек. Тест на титр антител нужен, только если животное прибывает не напрямую из страны Приложения II или следует транзитом через страну вне его. Для животных из США APHIS должна заверить сертификат в пределах 10 дней до поездки.

countries.name: Mali
countries.summary: For US-origin pets (APHIS): rabies vaccination, a vet exam, and a bilingual USDA-endorsed health certificate valid 30 days after issuance. From other origins, confirm the conditions with Mali's veterinary services before travel.
countries.microchip: For US-origin pets (APHIS): microchip number recorded if present; not stated as mandatory.
countries.timeline: Plan at least 3–4 weeks before travel: rabies vaccination current → accredited-vet exam and certificate → APHIS endorsement (ink) → travel within 30 days of issuance.
countries.authority: Mali national veterinary services (US-origin certificate per USDA APHIS)
vaccinations: Rabies: required; certificate records date, vaccine, batch and validity end date (no specific timing stated on APHIS certificate)
documents: For US-origin pets (APHIS): Veterinary Health Certificate for Export of Dogs and Cats to Mali (English/French), signed by USDA-accredited vet and endorsed by APHIS (original ink endorsement and embossing required); valid 30 days after issuance

steps.what: Confirm the rabies vaccine is current
Accredited-vet exam and bilingual Mali certificate
APHIS ink endorsement; travel within 30 days of issue

key_points: From origins other than the US, confirm the conditions with Mali's veterinary services

steps.what: التأكد من سريان لقاح داء الكلب
فحص لدى طبيب بيطري معتمد وشهادة مالي ثنائية اللغة
مصادقة APHIS بالحبر؛ والسفر خلال 30 يومًا من الإصدار

key_points: من بلدان المنشأ غير الولايات المتحدة، يُرجى تأكيد الشروط مع الخدمات البيطرية في مالي
ar.summary: للحيوانات القادمة من الولايات المتحدة (APHIS): تطعيم ضد داء الكلب، وفحص بيطري، وشهادة صحية ثنائية اللغة مصادق عليها من USDA صالحة 30 يومًا من إصدارها. ومن بلدان المنشأ الأخرى، يُرجى تأكيد الشروط مع الخدمات البيطرية في مالي قبل السفر.

steps.what: Sicherstellen, dass die Tollwutimpfung gültig ist
Untersuchung durch akkreditierten Tierarzt und zweisprachiges Zeugnis für Mali
APHIS-Tintenbeglaubigung; Reise innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Ausstellung

key_points: Bei anderen Herkunftsländern als den USA die Bedingungen bei den Veterinärdiensten Malis bestätigen lassen
de.summary: Für Heimtiere aus den USA (APHIS): Tollwutimpfung, eine tierärztliche Untersuchung und ein zweisprachiges USDA-beglaubigtes Gesundheitszeugnis, gültig 30 Tage ab Ausstellung. Bei anderen Herkunftsländern bitte die Bedingungen vor der Reise bei den Veterinärdiensten Malis bestätigen lassen.

steps.what: Confirme que la vacuna antirrábica está vigente
Examen por veterinario acreditado y certificado bilingüe para Malí
Refrendo de APHIS en tinta; viaje en los 30 días siguientes a la emisión

key_points: Desde orígenes distintos de EE. UU., confirme las condiciones con los servicios veterinarios de Malí
es.summary: Para mascotas de origen EE. UU. (APHIS): vacunación antirrábica, examen veterinario y certificado sanitario bilingüe refrendado por el USDA, válido 30 días desde su emisión. Desde otros orígenes, confirme las condiciones con los servicios veterinarios de Malí antes del viaje.

steps.what: Vérifier que le vaccin antirabique est à jour
Examen par un vétérinaire accrédité et certificat bilingue pour le Mali
Visa à l'encre de l'APHIS ; voyager dans les 30 jours suivant la délivrance

key_points: Pour les provenances autres que les États-Unis, confirmez les conditions auprès des services vétérinaires du Mali
fr.summary: Pour les animaux en provenance des États-Unis (APHIS) : vaccination antirabique, examen vétérinaire et certificat sanitaire bilingue visé par l'USDA, valable 30 jours après sa délivrance. Pour les autres provenances, confirmez les conditions auprès des services vétérinaires du Mali avant le voyage.

steps.what: Verificare che il vaccino antirabbico sia in corso di validità
Visita da un veterinario accreditato e certificato bilingue per il Mali
Vidimazione APHIS a inchiostro; viaggiare entro 30 giorni dal rilascio

key_points: Per provenienze diverse dagli Stati Uniti, verificare le condizioni con i servizi veterinari del Mali
it.summary: Per gli animali provenienti dagli Stati Uniti (APHIS): vaccinazione antirabbica, visita veterinaria e certificato sanitario bilingue vidimato dall'USDA, valido 30 giorni dal rilascio. Per altre provenienze, verificare le condizioni con i servizi veterinari del Mali prima del viaggio.

steps.what: Убедитесь, что прививка от бешенства действительна
Осмотр аккредитованным ветеринаром и двуязычный сертификат для Мали
Заверение APHIS чернилами; поездка в пределах 30 дней с даты выдачи

key_points: Для стран отправления, кроме США, уточните условия в ветеринарных службах Мали
ru.summary: Для животных из США (APHIS): вакцинация против бешенства, ветеринарный осмотр и двуязычный ветеринарный сертификат с заверением USDA, действующий 30 дней с даты выдачи. Для других стран отправления уточните условия в ветеринарных службах Мали до поездки.

countries.name: Myanmar
countries.summary: Myanmar's LBVD dog and cat import regulation needs an import licence, an official health certificate, and rabies vaccination (or origin rabies-free for 12 months) plus distemper, hepatitis, leptospirosis and parvovirus vaccination at least 21 days before departure. Then at least 30 days of quarantine at approved premises on arrival. The published regulation is labelled 'purpose: breeding', so confirm the pet procedure with LBVD before travel.
countries.microchip: Not specified in the LBVD regulation. The certificate must fully identify each animal; a microchip is advised.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required in the published regulation.
countries.parasite_treatment: No treatment specified. The animal must be free of ectoparasites at export.
countries.import_permit: Yes. A valid Myanmar import licence must accompany the consignment (LBVD regulation). The pet application route and processing time are not published.
countries.quarantine: At least 30 days at approved premises on arrival, with tests or treatment if needed, at the owner's cost (LBVD regulation, stated for 'breeding' imports). Non-compliance means return or destruction without compensation. Animals landed in transit must not be exposed to other animals.
countries.timeline: Get the import licence first (lead time unpublished). Vaccines at least 21 days before departure, and the official health certificate shortly before travel.
countries.private_aviation: The 30-day post-arrival quarantine at approved premises still applies.
countries.authority: Livestock Breeding and Veterinary Department (LBVD), Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Irrigation
vaccinations: Rabies: official approved vaccine at least 21 days before departure, unless the origin region has been rabies-free for at least 12 months (LBVD regulation; UK certificate 7961EHC).
Distemper, hepatitis, leptospirosis and parvovirus: official approved vaccines at least 21 days before export (dogs).
documents: Myanmar import licence issued by a Government authority
Health certificate signed by an authorised official vet, describing each animal (UK version valid 7 days from signature)
Vaccination records

steps.what: Obtain the import licence (lead time unpublished)
Rabies and dog core vaccines
Official health certificate describing each animal
At least 30 days' quarantine at approved premises, at your cost

key_points: The published regulation is labelled for breeding: confirm the pet procedure with LBVD
Non-compliant animals are returned or destroyed without compensation

steps.what: الحصول على ترخيص الاستيراد (مدة التحضير غير منشورة)
لقاح داء الكلب واللقاحات الأساسية للكلاب
شهادة صحية رسمية تصف كل حيوان
حجر صحي لا يقل عن 30 يومًا في مرافق معتمدة، على نفقتكم

key_points: اللائحة المنشورة مُعنونة لأغراض التربية: يُرجى تأكيد إجراءات الحيوانات الأليفة مع LBVD
تُعاد الحيوانات غير المستوفية أو تُعدم دون تعويض
ar.summary: تشترط لائحة استيراد الكلاب والقطط الصادرة عن LBVD في ميانمار ترخيص استيراد، وشهادة صحية رسمية، وتطعيمًا ضد داء الكلب (أو خلو بلد المنشأ من داء الكلب لمدة 12 شهرًا) إضافة إلى لقاحات الديستمبر والتهاب الكبد وداء البريميات والبارفو قبل المغادرة بـ21 يومًا على الأقل. ثم حجر صحي لا يقل عن 30 يومًا في مرافق معتمدة عند الوصول. واللائحة المنشورة مُعنونة 'الغرض: التربية'، لذا يُرجى تأكيد إجراءات الحيوانات الأليفة مع LBVD قبل السفر.

steps.what: Einfuhrlizenz einholen (Vorlaufzeit nicht veröffentlicht)
Tollwut- und Grundimpfungen für Hunde
Amtliches Gesundheitszeugnis mit Beschreibung jedes Tieres
Mindestens 30 Tage Quarantäne in zugelassenen Räumlichkeiten, auf Ihre Kosten

key_points: Die veröffentlichte Verordnung gilt laut Vermerk für Zuchttiere: Verfahren für Heimtiere bei LBVD bestätigen lassen
Nicht konforme Tiere werden ohne Entschädigung zurückgeschickt oder getötet
de.summary: Die LBVD-Einfuhrverordnung für Hunde und Katzen in Myanmar verlangt eine Einfuhrlizenz, ein amtliches Gesundheitszeugnis und eine Tollwutimpfung (oder 12 Monate Tollwutfreiheit im Herkunftsland) sowie Impfungen gegen Staupe, Hepatitis, Leptospirose und Parvovirose mindestens 21 Tage vor Abflug. Danach mindestens 30 Tage Quarantäne in zugelassenen Räumlichkeiten nach der Ankunft. Die veröffentlichte Verordnung trägt den Vermerk „Zweck: Zucht“; bitte das Verfahren für Heimtiere vor der Reise bei LBVD bestätigen lassen.

steps.what: Obtenga la licencia de importación (plazo no publicado)
Vacuna antirrábica y vacunas básicas caninas
Certificado sanitario oficial que describa a cada animal
Al menos 30 días de cuarentena en instalaciones aprobadas, a su cargo

key_points: La normativa publicada se refiere a cría: confirme el procedimiento para mascotas con el LBVD
Los animales no conformes se devuelven o se sacrifican sin indemnización
es.summary: La normativa del LBVD de Myanmar sobre importación de perros y gatos exige licencia de importación, certificado sanitario oficial y vacunación antirrábica (o que el origen esté libre de rabia desde hace 12 meses), además de vacunación contra moquillo, hepatitis, leptospirosis y parvovirus al menos 21 días antes de la salida. A la llegada, al menos 30 días de cuarentena en instalaciones aprobadas. La normativa publicada indica «finalidad: cría», por lo que conviene confirmar el procedimiento para mascotas con el LBVD antes del viaje.

steps.what: Obtenir la licence d'importation (délai non publié)
Vaccins antirabique et essentiels du chien
Certificat sanitaire officiel décrivant chaque animal
Au moins 30 jours de quarantaine en locaux agréés, à vos frais

key_points: Le texte publié vise l'élevage : confirmez la procédure pour les animaux de compagnie auprès du LBVD
Les animaux non conformes sont renvoyés ou euthanasiés sans indemnisation
fr.summary: La réglementation du LBVD sur l'importation de chiens et chats au Myanmar exige une licence d'importation, un certificat sanitaire officiel et la vaccination antirabique (ou une provenance indemne de rage depuis 12 mois), ainsi que la vaccination contre la maladie de Carré, l'hépatite, la leptospirose et la parvovirose au moins 21 jours avant le départ. Puis au moins 30 jours de quarantaine dans des locaux agréés à l'arrivée. Le texte publié porte la mention « purpose: breeding » (élevage) : confirmez la procédure pour les animaux de compagnie auprès du LBVD avant le voyage.

steps.what: Ottenere la licenza d'importazione (tempi non pubblicati)
Vaccini antirabbico e di base per cani
Certificato sanitario ufficiale con la descrizione di ciascun animale
Almeno 30 giorni di quarantena in strutture autorizzate, a Sue spese

key_points: Il regolamento pubblicato riguarda la riproduzione: verificare con l'LBVD la procedura per gli animali da compagnia
Gli animali non in regola vengono rimpatriati o soppressi senza indennizzo
it.summary: Il regolamento dell'LBVD del Myanmar sull'importazione di cani e gatti richiede una licenza d'importazione, un certificato sanitario ufficiale e la vaccinazione antirabbica (o Paese d'origine indenne da rabbia da 12 mesi), oltre alle vaccinazioni contro cimurro, epatite, leptospirosi e parvovirosi almeno 21 giorni prima della partenza. All'arrivo seguono almeno 30 giorni di quarantena presso strutture autorizzate. countries.microchip: Required. Implanted before the rabies vaccination.

countries.private_aviation: Arrange the IAM vet inspection at Macau International Airport in advance. Note: Macao is in Hong Kong's Group IIIA, so onward travel to Hong Kong means at least 30 days of HK quarantine.

countries.name: Northern Mariana Islands
countries.summary: CNMI entry permit (Division of Agriculture) required. From the USA: at least two rabies vaccinations, an FAVN titer above 1.0 IU/mL at a CDC-approved lab, core vaccines, parasite treatment within 14 days of arrival, and a health certificate within 10 days of travel. From non-US, non-rabies-free origins (e.g. EU), at least 120 days must pass from the FAVN blood draw. Dogs also need a CDC Dog Import Form, must be 6 months or older, and need an ISO chip. Foreign-vaccinated dogs that were in a CDC high-risk rabies country in the past 6 months cannot enter the US through a US territory, so they cannot fly directly to the CNMI.
countries.microchip: Required. The health certificate must show the microchip number and implant date. International dogs: ISO-compatible microchip.
countries.rabies_titer: FAVN required unless the pet comes from a recognised rabies-free area (Hawaii, Guam, Japan). Use a CDC-approved lab, with the result greater than 1.0 IU/mL and destination listed as 'CNMI'. Draw blood at least 30 days after the second rabies vaccine. Non-US, non-rabies-free origin: at least 120 days from the FAVN draw before entry.
countries.parasite_treatment: Internal (helminths, heartworm) and external (fleas, ticks) treatment within 14 days of arrival, with date, product and method on the health certificate.
countries.import_permit: Yes. CNMI Entry Permit from DLNR Division of Agriculture (cnmianimalhealth@gmail.com, +1 670 256-3319/20). Submit documents at least 14 days before arrival; they need at least 1 week to prepare the permit.
countries.quarantine: None for compliant pets from the USA or rabies-free areas. Cats from international high-risk rabies areas: quarantine on Guam before arriving in the CNMI, plus re-vaccination with a US-made rabies vaccine. Foreign-vaccinated dogs from CDC high-risk countries cannot enter the US through a US territory (CDC).
countries.timeline: Allow at least 120 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (two lifetime shots) travelling from the EU or another non-US, non-rabies-free origin: FAVN blood draw, then at least 120 days before entry. From the USA, about 4–6 weeks (FAVN result in 2–4 weeks; permit documents at least 14 days before arrival).
countries.private_aviation: The entry permit and itinerary (including foreign layovers) must be approved in advance. US CDC dog-import rules apply to dogs coming from abroad: foreign-vaccinated dogs that were in a CDC high-risk country in the past 6 months cannot enter the US through a US territory, because no territory has a CDC-registered animal care facility.
countries.export: For export to New Zealand, MPI treats the Northern Mariana Islands as Category 3 (same as the US mainland), per USDA.
countries.authority: CNMI Department of Lands and Natural Resources, Division of Agriculture (Animal Health)
vaccinations: Rabies: at least two lifetime vaccinations (primary + booster), each with a formal vet-signed certificate. Do not re-vaccinate after the FAVN draw before import.
Dogs: DHPP (DHLPP), Leptospirosis and Bordetella current.
Cats: FVRCP current.
documents: CNMI Entry Permit Application (Cat/Dog) with travel itinerary (note foreign layovers). Fee USD 50 per sterilised animal, USD 500 per unsterilised animal. Permit valid 60 days.

countries.name: Martinique
countries.summary: Martinique is a French overseas department in the EU, so EU pet rules under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131 apply, as for France: ISO microchip, rabies vaccination at least 21 days before entry, and an EU animal health certificate (endorsed by APHIS for US pets) checked at a travellers' point of entry. A titer test is needed only from countries that are not EU-listed.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.import_permit: Not required under EU non-commercial rules. Ask DAAF Martinique before travel whether a prior declaration is needed.
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: French dangerous-dog law: category 1 attack-type dogs cannot be imported. Confirm with DAAF Martinique before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Pets from outside the EU must pass documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry. Confirm with DAAF Martinique before routing that the arrival airport can carry out the check for a private arrival.
countries.authority: DAAF Martinique / French Ministry of Agriculture
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

countries.name: Malta
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry. Dogs also need tapeworm treatment 24–120 h before entry. Pre-notification of every pet arrival to the Veterinary Regulation Directorate is mandatory.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: Dogs only: treatment against Echinococcus multilocularis (praziquantel or proven equivalent) given by a vet 24–120 hours before scheduled entry and recorded in the passport or certificate. Not required for dogs coming directly from Finland, Ireland, Norway or Northern Ireland. Cats: none.
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued). Dogs: tapeworm treatment 24–120 hours before arrival. Send the Pets Arrival Notification to the VRD before travel.
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the Veterinary Regulation Directorate (VRD) before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Malta and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Air point of entry: Malta International Airport (Luqa). Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Veterinary Regulation Directorate (VRD)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Mandatory 'Pets Arrival Notification' (pre-notification of arrival) to the VRD for commercial and non-commercial movements; entry is denied if not done. Submit it well ahead of travel.
Young animals: Malta does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.
