Dogs: tapeworm treatment by a vet, recorded in the passport or certificate
Carry the signed non-commercial declaration (non-EU origins)
From outside the EU: document and identity check at a travellers' point of entry

key_points: No arrival notification to the VRD means entry is denied
Max 5 pets per movement; each travels with the owner or within 5 days
From unlisted countries (e.g. Türkiye, Morocco, Israel, Thailand, South Africa): titer test plus a 3-month wait
Old-model EU certificates are accepted only if issued before 1 Oct 2026
export_points: To EU/EEA countries: EU pet passport from an authorised vet
Dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Norway or N. Ireland also need tapeworm treatment
To non-EU countries: meet destination rules; the official vet service endorses certificates
countries.private_jet_note: From outside the EU, land at Malta International Airport (Luqa), the travellers' point of entry, and present the pet in the customs red channel.

at_a_glance.microchip: شريحة ISO، قبل لقاح داء الكلب
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: قبل الدخول بـ≥21 يومًا، بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا
at_a_glance.health_certificate: جواز أو شهادة أوروبية ≤10 أيام (خارج الاتحاد)

steps.what: شريحة ISO، ثم لقاح داء الكلب (للحيوان بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا)
يصبح التطعيم الأولي ضد داء الكلب صالحًا
من الولايات المتحدة: شهادة صحية أوروبية مصادق عليها من USDA APHIS؛ ومن الاتحاد الأوروبي: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف
إرسال إشعار وصول الحيوانات الأليفة (Pets Arrival Notification) إلى VRD
الكلاب: علاج الدودة الشريطية على يد طبيب بيطري، مع تسجيله في الجواز أو الشهادة
حمل الإقرار الموقّع بأن النقل غير تجاري (للقادمين من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي)
من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: تدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين

key_points: عدم إخطار VRD بالوصول يعني رفض الدخول
الحد الأقصى 5 حيوانات لكل تنقّل؛ ويسافر كل منها مع المالك أو خلال 5 أيام
من الدول غير المُدرجة (مثل تركيا والمغرب وإسرائيل وتايلاند وجنوب أفريقيا): اختبار الأجسام المضادة مع انتظار 3 أشهر
لا تُقبل الشهادات الأوروبية بالنموذج القديم إلا إذا صدرت قبل 1 أكتوبر 2026
export_points: إلى دول الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف من طبيب بيطري معتمد
تحتاج الكلاب المتجهة إلى فنلندا أو أيرلندا أو النرويج أو أيرلندا الشمالية أيضًا إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية
إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات
ar.private_jet_note: عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، يجب الهبوط في مطار مالطا الدولي (لوقا)، نقطة دخول المسافرين، وتقديم الحيوان الأليف عند المسار الأحمر في الجمارك.
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين. كما تحتاج الكلاب إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية قبل الدخول بـ24–120 ساعة. والإخطار المسبق بوصول كل حيوان أليف إلى مديرية التنظيم البيطري إلزامي.

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
Die Tollwut-Erstimpfung wird gültig
Aus den USA: von USDA APHIS beglaubigtes EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; aus der EU: EU-Heimtierausweis
Pets Arrival Notification an das VRD senden
Hunde: Bandwurmbehandlung durch einen Tierarzt, eingetragen im Ausweis oder Zeugnis
Die unterschriebene Erklärung zur nicht kommerziellen Verbringung mitführen (Nicht-EU-Herkunft)
Von außerhalb der EU: Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrolle an einem Eingangsort für Reisende

key_points: Ohne Ankunftsmeldung beim VRD wird die Einreise verweigert
Max. 5 Heimtiere pro Verbringung; jedes reist mit dem Halter oder innerhalb von 5 Tagen
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern (z. B. Türkei, Marokko, Israel, Thailand, Südafrika): Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit
EU-Zeugnisse nach altem Muster werden nur akzeptiert, wenn sie vor dem 1. Okt. 2026 ausgestellt wurden
export_points: In EU-/EWR-Länder: EU-Heimtierausweis von einem ermächtigten Tierarzt
Hunde nach Finnland, Irland, Norwegen oder Nordirland benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Bestimmungen des Ziellandes erfüllen; der amtliche Veterinärdienst beglaubigt die Zeugnisse
de.private_jet_note: Bei Anreise von außerhalb der EU landen Sie am Malta International Airport (Luqa), dem Eingangsort für Reisende, und führen das Tier im roten Zollkanal vor.
de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende. Hunde benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung 24–120 Std. vor der Einreise. Die Voranmeldung jeder Heimtierankunft beim Veterinary Regulation Directorate ist Pflicht.

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, antes de la vacuna antirrábica
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ≥21 días antes de entrar, con 12+ semanas
at_a_glance.titer: No se requiere desde EE. UU./UE
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Pasaporte UE o certif. UE ≤10 días (no UE)
at_a_glance.quarantine: Ninguna si se cumplen los requisitos

steps.what: Microchip ISO y, después, vacuna antirrábica (mascota de 12+ semanas)
La primovacunación antirrábica pasa a ser válida
Desde EE. UU.: certificado sanitario de la UE refrendado por USDA APHIS; desde la UE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas
Envíe la Pets Arrival Notification a la VRD
Perros: tratamiento contra la tenia administrado por un veterinario y registrado en el pasaporte o el certificado
Lleve la declaración firmada de no comercialidad (orígenes fuera de la UE)
Desde fuera de la UE: control documental y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros

key_points: Sin notificación de llegada a la VRD, se deniega la entrada
Máx. 5 mascotas por desplazamiento; cada una viaja con el propietario o en un plazo de 5 días
Desde países no incluidos en la lista (p. ej., Turquía, Marruecos, Israel, Tailandia, Sudáfrica): prueba de titulación más 3 meses de espera
Los certificados UE del modelo anterior solo se aceptan si se emitieron antes del 1 de octubre de 2026
export_points: A países de la UE/EEE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas de un veterinario autorizado
Los perros con destino a Finlandia, Irlanda, Noruega o Irlanda del Norte necesitan además tratamiento contra la tenia
A países fuera de la UE: cumpla las normas del destino; el servicio veterinario oficial refrenda los certificados
es.private_jet_note: Desde fuera de la UE, aterrice en el Aeropuerto Internacional de Malta (Luqa), el punto de entrada de viajeros, y presente la mascota en el canal rojo de aduanas.
es.summary: Normas de la UE (Reglamento Delegado (UE) 2026/131): desde otro Estado de la UE/EEE, mascota con microchip, vacunación antirrábica válida y pasaporte europeo para mascotas; desde fuera de la UE, certificado zoosanitario de la UE (más prueba de titulación antirrábica con 3 meses de espera si el país no figura en la lista) y controles documentales y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros. Los perros necesitan además tratamiento contra la tenia 24–120 h antes de la entrada. Es obligatorio notificar previamente cada llegada de mascotas a la Veterinary Regulation Directorate.

at_a_glance.microchip: Puce ISO, avant le vaccin antirabique
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passeport UE ; hors UE, certificat ≤10 jours

steps.what: Puce électronique ISO, puis vaccin antirabique (animal âgé d'au moins 12 semaines)
La primovaccination antirabique devient valable
Depuis les États-Unis : certificat sanitaire UE visé par l'USDA APHIS ; depuis l'UE : passeport européen pour animal de compagnie
Envoyer la Pets Arrival Notification à la VRD
Chiens : traitement contre le ténia par un vétérinaire, consigné dans le passeport ou le certificat
Munissez-vous de la déclaration signée attestant le caractère non commercial (origines hors UE)
Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE : contrôle documentaire et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs

key_points: Sans notification d’arrivée à la VRD, l’entrée est refusée
5 animaux max. par mouvement ; chacun voyage avec le propriétaire ou dans un délai de 5 jours
Depuis les pays non listés (p. ex. Turquie, Maroc, Israël, Thaïlande, Afrique du Sud) : titrage des anticorps antirabiques plus attente de 3 mois
Les certificats UE de l'ancien modèle ne sont acceptés que s'ils ont été délivrés avant le 1er oct. 2026
export_points: Vers les pays de l'UE/EEE : passeport européen délivré par un vétérinaire habilité
Les chiens à destination de la Finlande, de l'Irlande, de la Norvège ou de l'Irlande du Nord doivent aussi recevoir un traitement contre le ténia
Vers les pays hors UE : respecter les règles du pays de destination ; le service vétérinaire officiel vise les certificats
fr.private_jet_note: En provenance de l’extérieur de l’UE, atterrissez à l’aéroport international de Malte (Luqa), point d’entrée des voyageurs, et présentez l’animal au circuit rouge de la douane.
fr.summary: Règles de l'UE (règlement délégué (UE) 2026/131) : depuis un autre État de l'UE/EEE, animal identifié par puce électronique, avec vaccination antirabique valide et passeport européen pour animal de compagnie ; depuis l'extérieur de l'UE, certificat sanitaire de l'UE (plus titrage des anticorps antirabiques avec attente de 3 mois si le pays n'est pas listé) et contrôles documentaires et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs. Les chiens doivent également recevoir un traitement contre le ténia 24 à 120 h avant l'entrée. La notification préalable de toute arrivée d'animal à la Veterinary Regulation Directorate est obligatoire.

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, prima del vaccino antirabbico
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passaporto UE, o cert. UE ≤10 gg (extra UE)

steps.what: Microchip ISO, poi vaccino antirabbico (animale di 12+ settimane)
La vaccinazione antirabbica primaria diventa valida
Dagli Stati Uniti: certificato sanitario UE vidimato da USDA APHIS; dall'UE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia
Inviare la Pets Arrival Notification alla VRD
Cani: trattamento contro la tenia effettuato da un veterinario e registrato nel passaporto o nel certificato
Portare con sé la dichiarazione firmata di movimentazione non commerciale (origini extra UE)
Da fuori UE: controllo documentale e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori

key_points: In assenza di notifica d'arrivo alla VRD l'ingresso viene negato
Max 5 animali per movimentazione; ciascuno viaggia con il proprietario o entro 5 giorni
Da Paesi non elencati (ad es. Turchia, Marocco, Israele, Thailandia, Sudafrica): titolazione più attesa di 3 mesi
I certificati UE del vecchio modello sono accettati solo se rilasciati prima del 1 ott 2026
export_points: Verso Paesi UE/SEE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia rilasciato da un veterinario autorizzato
I cani diretti in Finlandia, Irlanda, Norvegia o Irlanda del Nord necessitano anche del trattamento contro la tenia
Verso Paesi extra UE: rispettare le norme della destinazione; il servizio veterinario ufficiale vidima i certificati
it.private_jet_note: Provenendo da fuori dell'UE, l'atterraggio va effettuato al Malta International Airport (Luqa), punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori, presentando l'animale al canale rosso della dogana.
it.summary: Norme UE (Regolamento delegato (UE) 2026/131): da un altro Stato UE/SEE, animale con microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica valida e passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia; da fuori UE, certificato sanitario UE per animali (più titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici con attesa di 3 mesi se il Paese non è elencato) e controlli documentali e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori. I cani necessitano inoltre di un trattamento contro la tenia 24–120 h prima dell'ingresso. È obbligatoria la notifica preventiva di ogni arrivo di animali alla Veterinary Regulation Directorate.

at_a_glance.microchip: Чип ISO, до прививки от бешенства
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Паспорт или сертификат ЕС ≤10 дней (не из ЕС)

steps.what: Микрочип ISO, затем прививка от бешенства (животному 12+ недель)
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной
Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС, заверенный USDA APHIS; из ЕС: европейский паспорт животного
Направьте уведомление о прибытии животных (Pets Arrival Notification) в VRD
Собаки: обработка от ленточных червей у ветеринара с отметкой в паспорте или сертификате
Имейте при себе подписанную декларацию о некоммерческом перемещении (не из ЕС)
Из-за пределов ЕС: проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников

key_points: Без уведомления VRD о прибытии во въезде отказывают
Не более 5 животных за одно перемещение; каждое следует с владельцем или в пределах 5 дней
Из стран вне перечня (например, Турция, Марокко, Израиль, Таиланд, ЮАР): тест на титр плюс ожидание 3 месяца
Сертификаты ЕС старого образца принимаются, только если выданы до 1 октября 2026 г.
export_points: В страны ЕС/ЕЭЗ: европейский паспорт животного от уполномоченного ветеринара
Собакам, направляющимся в Финляндию, Ирландию, Норвегию или Северную Ирландию, также нужна обработка от ленточных червей
В страны вне ЕС: соблюдайте правила страны назначения; сертификаты заверяет официальная ветеринарная служба
ru.private_jet_note: При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС совершайте посадку в Международном аэропорту Мальты (Лука) — пункте въезда для путешественников — и предъявите животное в красном коридоре таможни.
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников. Собакам также нужна обработка от ленточных червей за 24–120 ч до въезда. Предварительное уведомление Директората ветеринарного регулирования о каждом прибытии животного обязательно.

countries.name: Mauritius
countries.summary: Import permit from the Veterinary Services (Ministry of Agro-Industry) is required before shipment. Requirements include a rabies titer at least 3 months before travel, a sterilisation certificate, manifest-cargo arrival with a local broker, and a minimum 5-day quarantine at Réduit. Several dog breeds are banned.
countries.microchip: Required (checked on the certificate). ISO 11784/11785 recommended.
countries.rabies_titer: Required for dogs and cats: FAVN or RFFIT ≥0.5 IU/ml at a lab approved by the exporting country, or a WOAH reference lab. Blood sample at least 4 weeks after vaccination. Travel no earlier than 3 months after sampling, and the test must be no more than 12 months before shipment. The lab must also send results directly to the Mauritius veterinary services. Alternative: 6 months in an approved quarantine station in the exporting country.
countries.parasite_treatment: External parasite treatment, within coverage at export (US certificate).
countries.import_permit: Mandatory: 'No animal should be embarked for Mauritius without an import permit.' Apply to petimport@govmu.org at least 3 months before departure. Issue depends on quarantine kennel availability. Fees: Rs 500 import fee plus Rs 500 veterinary clearance per animal.
countries.quarantine: Minimum 5 days at the government Quarantine Facility, Réduit, at the owner's cost (kennel Rs 15/day; the owner supplies food and litter).
countries.timeline: Allow at least 90 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated: titer test (at least 4 weeks after vaccination), then travel no earlier than 3 months after sampling; apply for the permit at least 3 months ahead; dog Ehrlichia/Brucella tests within 45 days; health certificate and endorsement; email flight details at least 4 days before arrival. From scratch, plan at least 4–5 months.
countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited (Animal Welfare Act 2013, 4th Schedule): American Pit Bull Terrier, American Staffordshire Terrier, Staffordshire Terrier, Blue Nose Pit Bull, Red Nose Pit Bull, Japanese Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, Boerboel. Other 'dangerous' breeds (e.g. Rottweiler, Doberman, Cane Corso, Bull Mastiff, Rhodesian Ridgeback, Alaskan Malamute, Kangal) are allowed only if pure-bred.
countries.private_aviation: Official guidelines: all pets must arrive as manifest CARGO ONLY (not in cabin, not as excess luggage), with a local customs broker present at the airport. Without a broker, the animal may be sent back at the owner's cost. A private flight must manifest the pet as cargo and arrange the broker and veterinary pickup at SSR International.
countries.authority: Ministry of Agro-Industry, Food Security, Blue Economy and Fisheries – Division of Veterinary Services / Livestock and Veterinary Division (petimport@govmu.org)
vaccinations: Rabies: inactivated vaccine per manufacturer. US-origin certificate: at least 3 months of age, more than 2 months before export for a primary vaccination, or at least 30 days for a booster.
Dogs: distemper, infectious hepatitis, leptospirosis, parvovirus – up to date, given more than 14 days before dispatch
Cats: feline enteritis (panleukopenia), rhinotracheitis, calicivirus – between 14 days and 12 months before export
documents: Import permit (number and date shown on the veterinary certificate)
International veterinary certificate from the exporting country's competent authority (US: APHIS-endorsed)
Rabies vaccination certificate and RNATT lab report (endorsed by the competent authority)
Dogs: Ehrlichia canis (IFAT, negative at 1:40) within 45 days before departure, and a negative Brucella canis test
Sterilisation certificate (except breeding animals with a pedigree and breeder's licence)
Application form per animal, motivation letter to the Principal Veterinary Officer, owner's passport copy, copy of the vaccination book

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccination
Titer test 4+ weeks after the vaccine; lab sends results to Mauritius directly
Email the import permit application to petimport@govmu.org
Dogs: Ehrlichia canis and Brucella canis tests
Health certificate and endorsement; book a local customs broker
Email flight details to the veterinary services

key_points: Banned: Pit Bull types, Am Staff, Staffordshire Terrier, Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, Boerboel
Sterilisation certificate required, except licensed pedigree breeding animals
Travel ≥3 months after titer sampling, and within 12 months of the test
Permit depends on quarantine kennel availability
countries.private_jet_note: Pets must arrive as manifest cargo, never in the cabin, with a local customs broker at SSR International. Without a broker the pet may be sent back at the owner's cost.

steps.what: الشريحة الإلكترونية، ثم التطعيم ضد داء الكلب
اختبار الأجسام المضادة بعد اللقاح بـ4+ أسابيع؛ ويرسل المختبر النتائج مباشرة إلى موريشيوس
إرسال طلب تصريح الاستيراد بالبريد الإلكتروني إلى petimport@govmu.org
الكلاب: فحصا Ehrlichia canis وBrucella canis
الشهادة الصحية والمصادقة؛ وحجز مخلّص جمركي محلي
إرسال تفاصيل الرحلة بالبريد الإلكتروني إلى الخدمات البيطرية

key_points: محظورة: أنواع البيتبول، والأمستاف، وستافوردشاير تيرير، والتوسا، والدوغو الأرجنتيني، والفيلا البرازيلي، والبوربويل
شهادة التعقيم مطلوبة، إلا لحيوانات التربية الأصيلة المرخّصة
السفر بعد ≥3 أشهر من سحب عينة الأجسام المضادة، وخلال 12 شهرًا من الاختبار
يعتمد التصريح على توفر أماكن في مرافق الحجر الصحي
ar.private_jet_note: يجب أن تصل الحيوانات الأليفة كشحنة مُدرجة في البيان، لا في المقصورة أبدًا، مع مخلّص جمركي محلي في مطار SSR الدولي. ودون مخلّص قد يُعاد الحيوان على نفقة المالك.
ar.summary: يلزم الحصول على تصريح استيراد من الخدمات البيطرية (وزارة الصناعات الزراعية) قبل الشحن. وتشمل المتطلبات اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب قبل السفر بـ3 أشهر على الأقل، وشهادة تعقيم، والوصول كشحنة مُدرجة في البيان مع مخلّص جمركي محلي، وحجرًا صحيًا لا يقل عن 5 أيام في ريدوي. وعدة سلالات من الكلاب محظورة.

steps.what: Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung
Titertest mind. 4 Wochen nach der Impfung; das Labor sendet die Ergebnisse direkt nach Mauritius
Antrag auf Einfuhrgenehmigung per E-Mail an petimport@govmu.org senden
Hunde: Tests auf Ehrlichia canis und Brucella canis
Gesundheitszeugnis und Beglaubigung; örtlichen Zollmakler buchen
Flugdaten per E-Mail an die Veterinärdienste senden

key_points: Verboten: Pitbull-Typen, Am Staff, Staffordshire Terrier, Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, Boerboel
Sterilisationsbescheinigung erforderlich, außer für lizenzierte Zuchttiere mit Stammbaum
Reise ≥3 Monate nach der Titer-Probe und innerhalb von 12 Monaten nach dem Test

countries.name: Maldives
countries.summary: DOGS ARE PROHIBITED (no exceptions). Cats need an import permit from the Ministry of Fisheries and Agriculture, rabies and core vaccinations, parasite treatment and an official health certificate.
countries.parasite_treatment: Cats: internal and external parasite treatment between 1 month and 14 days before expected arrival (UK DEFRA export guidance).

From scratch, allow at least 6 weeks: vaccinations (rabies at least 30 days before export) → import permit → parasite treatment → exam and certificate. Dogs cannot enter.
countries.restricted_breeds: All dogs prohibited ('import of dogs and dangerous animals is strictly prohibited', Velana airport customs guide).
countries.private_aviation: The dog ban applies to all arrivals, including private jets and resort transfers. Cats are cleared by the quarantine officer at the arrival port (Velana International Airport), who needs a commercial invoice approved by Maldives Customs plus the airway bill or bill of lading.

documents: Import permit (application with pet passport or vaccination card showing rabies, FCV, FVR and FPL vaccinations)

On arrival: commercial invoice approved by Maldives Customs, plus airway bill or bill of lading, given to the port quarantine officer

countries.name: Malawi
countries.summary: Malawi's Animal (Import) Rules require a written import permit from the Chief Veterinary Officer for any animal. UK official guidance adds rabies vaccination 30 days–12 months before export and an official health certificate issued within 14 days of export. That guidance dates from 1996, so confirm current details with the CVO.

countries.timeline: Allow at least 14 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (at least 30 days before export): apply to the CVO for the permit → official health certificate within 14 days of export → notify the CVO of the arrival date and flight. From scratch, plan at least 6 weeks.
countries.private_aviation: UK guidance: for air travel, report the arrival date and flight number to the Chief Veterinary Officer, Lilongwe, before departure. For a private flight, give the aircraft registration/flight details and arrival airport.
countries.authority: Chief Veterinary Officer, Department of Animal Health and Livestock Development (Malawi)
vaccinations: Rabies: at least 30 days and at most 12 months before export; certificate must show animal description, vaccine batch number and production laboratory (UK official guidance). Cats must be vaccinated before export; dogs from rabies-free Great Britain may instead be vaccinated on arrival.
documents: Import permit from Chief Veterinary Officer, Malawi
Official export health certificate (exam ≤14 days before export, UK model)
Rabies vaccination certificate
Owner declaration of no contact with a rabid animal in the 6 months before export

countries.name: Mexico
countries.summary: From the US: cats need no health certificate (since 16 Dec 2019), but since 3 Aug 2026 dogs need an 'NWS Inspection Certificate for Pet Dogs' signed by a USDA-accredited vet no more than 5 days before entry (no APHIS endorsement). SENASICA (OISA) inspects all dogs and cats on arrival for disease signs, ectoparasites and wounds. From other origins, confirm the conditions with SENASICA before travel.
countries.parasite_treatment: The pet must be free of ectoparasites at the SENASICA inspection. If ticks are found, they are sampled and removed, and the pet is held at OISA until cleared, at the importer's cost. Other ectoparasites must be treated by a vet of the owner's choice.
countries.import_permit: Not required for personal pets. A 'Pet Program – Frequent Traveler' registration is available.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 7 days for a dog already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA: a USDA-accredited vet signs the NWS inspection certificate within 5 days before entry (no endorsement). Cats from the US need no certificate. Arrange the Mexican-side screwworm certificate for the return to the US. From other origins, confirm the conditions with SENASICA before travel.
countries.private_aviation: SENASICA/OISA inspects at the point of entry, so confirm with the FBO and handler that SENASICA inspection is available at the arrival airport and time.
countries.export: Returning or entering the US from Mexico: dogs need a screwworm-freedom certificate. For Mexico, a SENASICA-authorized clinical vet (MVRA directory) may sign it, with inspection within 5 days. Mexico is NOT on the CDC high-risk list, so the CDC Dog Import Form route applies.
countries.authority: SENASICA (Servicio Nacional de Sanidad, Inocuidad y Calidad Agroalimentaria), OISA inspection offices
vaccinations: No rabies certificate is listed as an entry requirement on the APHIS Mexico page (Sep 2026). Carry rabies proof anyway for the US return.
documents: Dogs: NWS (New World screwworm) Inspection Certificate for Pet Dogs, issued no more than 5 days before entry by a USDA-accredited vet. No APHIS endorsement. Don't list cats on the dog form, or the form becomes invalid.
Cats: none.
Carriers must be clean; bedding, toys and food beyond the arrival day are removed.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: Dogs: NWS cert ≤5 days before entry

steps.what: Book a USDA-accredited vet for the dog screwworm (NWS) inspection
Vet signs the NWS certificate for dogs; no APHIS endorsement needed
Plan the screwworm certificate for the US return; carry rabies proof
SENASICA inspection for disease, ectoparasites and wounds

key_points: Cats from the US need no health certificate
Never list cats on the dog form, or the form becomes invalid
If ticks are found, the pet is held at OISA until cleared, at your cost
From origins other than the US, confirm the conditions with SENASICA before travel
export_points: Dogs going to the US need a screwworm-freedom certificate, inspection within 5 days
A SENASICA-authorised vet may sign the certificate
Mexico is not CDC high-risk: the CDC Dog Import Form route applies

at_a_glance.health_certificate: الكلاب: شهادة NWS قبل الدخول بـ≤5 أيام

steps.what: حجز موعد لدى طبيب بيطري معتمد من USDA لفحص دودة الحلزون (NWS) للكلب
يوقّع الطبيب البيطري شهادة NWS للكلاب؛ دون حاجة إلى مصادقة APHIS
التخطيط لشهادة دودة الحلزون للعودة إلى الولايات المتحدة؛ وحمل إثبات لقاح داء الكلب
فحص SENASICA للكشف عن الأمراض والطفيليات الخارجية والجروح

key_points: لا تحتاج القطط القادمة من الولايات المتحدة إلى شهادة صحية
لا تُدرج القطط أبدًا في نموذج الكلاب، وإلا يصبح النموذج باطلًا
عند العثور على قراد، يُحتجز الحيوان لدى OISA حتى تخليصه، على نفقتكم
من بلدان المنشأ غير الولايات المتحدة، يُرجى تأكيد الشروط مع SENASICA قبل السفر
export_points: تحتاج الكلاب المتجهة إلى الولايات المتحدة إلى شهادة خلو من دودة الحلزون، مع فحص خلال 5 أيام
يجوز لطبيب بيطري معتمد من SENASICA توقيع الشهادة
المكسيك غير مصنفة عالية المخاطر لدى CDC: يُطبَّق مسار نموذج CDC لاستيراد الكلاب
ar.summary: من الولايات المتحدة: لا تحتاج القطط إلى شهادة صحية (منذ 16 ديسمبر 2019)، لكن منذ 3 أغسطس 2026 تحتاج الكلاب إلى 'شهادة فحص دودة الحلزون (NWS) للكلاب الأليفة' موقّعة من طبيب بيطري معتمد من USDA قبل الدخول بما لا يزيد على 5 أيام (دون مصادقة APHIS). وتفحص SENASICA (OISA) جميع الكلاب والقطط عند الوصول بحثًا عن علامات الأمراض والطفيليات الخارجية والجروح. ومن بلدان المنشأ الأخرى، يُرجى تأكيد الشروط مع SENASICA قبل السفر.

steps.what: Termin bei einem USDA-akkreditierten Tierarzt für die Schraubenwurm-(NWS-)Untersuchung des Hundes buchen
Tierarzt unterschreibt das NWS-Zeugnis für Hunde; keine APHIS-Beglaubigung nötig
Schraubenwurm-Bescheinigung für die Rückkehr in die USA einplanen; Tollwutnachweis mitführen
SENASICA-Kontrolle auf Krankheiten, Ektoparasiten und Wunden

key_points: Katzen aus den USA benötigen kein Gesundheitszeugnis
Katzen niemals auf dem Hundeformular angeben, sonst wird das Formular ungültig
Werden Zecken gefunden, bleibt das Tier bis zur Freigabe auf Ihre Kosten bei OISA
Bei anderen Herkunftsländern als den USA die Bedingungen vor der Reise bei SENASICA bestätigen lassen
export_points: Hunde in die USA benötigen eine Bescheinigung über Schraubenwurmfreiheit, Untersuchung innerhalb von 5 Tagen
Ein von SENASICA ermächtigter Tierarzt kann die Bescheinigung unterschreiben
Mexiko ist kein CDC-Hochrisikoland: es gilt das Verfahren mit dem CDC Dog Import Form
de.summary: Aus den USA: Katzen benötigen kein Gesundheitszeugnis (seit 16. Dez. 2019), Hunde benötigen jedoch seit 3. Aug. 2026 ein „NWS Inspection Certificate for Pet Dogs“, unterschrieben von einem USDA-akkreditierten Tierarzt höchstens 5 Tage vor der Einreise (keine APHIS-Beglaubigung). SENASICA (OISA) kontrolliert alle Hunde und Katzen bei Ankunft auf Krankheitsanzeichen, Ektoparasiten und Wunden. Bei anderen Herkunftsländern bitte die Bedingungen vor der Reise bei SENASICA bestätigen lassen.

steps.what: Reserve un veterinario acreditado por el USDA para la inspección de gusano barrenador (NWS) del perro
El veterinario firma el certificado NWS de los perros; no se necesita refrendo de APHIS
Prevea el certificado de gusano barrenador para el regreso a EE. UU.; lleve el comprobante de vacunación antirrábica
Inspección del SENASICA para detectar enfermedades, ectoparásitos y heridas

key_points: Los gatos procedentes de EE. UU. no necesitan certificado sanitario
Nunca incluya gatos en el formulario de perros, o el formulario dejará de ser válido
Si se detectan garrapatas, la mascota queda retenida en la OISA hasta su liberación, a su cargo
Desde orígenes distintos de EE. UU., confirme las condiciones con el SENASICA antes del viaje
export_points: Los perros con destino a EE. UU. necesitan un certificado de ausencia de gusano barrenador, con inspección en los 5 días previos
Un veterinario autorizado por el SENASICA puede firmar el certificado
México no es de alto riesgo según los CDC: se aplica la vía del CDC Dog Import Form
es.summary: Desde EE. UU.: los gatos no necesitan certificado sanitario (desde el 16 de diciembre de 2019), pero desde el 3 de agosto de 2026 los perros necesitan un «NWS Inspection Certificate for Pet Dogs» firmado por un veterinario acreditado por el USDA como máximo 5 días antes de la entrada (sin refrendo de APHIS). El SENASICA (OISA) inspecciona a todos los perros y gatos a la llegada para detectar signos de enfermedad, ectoparásitos y heridas. Desde otros orígenes, confirme las condiciones con el SENASICA antes del viaje.

steps.what: Réserver un vétérinaire accrédité USDA pour l’inspection lucilie bouchère (NWS) du chien
Le vétérinaire signe le certificat NWS des chiens ; aucun visa de l’APHIS requis
Prévoir le certificat lucilie bouchère pour le retour aux États-Unis ; emporter la preuve de vaccination antirabique
Inspection SENASICA : maladies, ectoparasites et plaies

key_points: Les chats en provenance des États-Unis n’ont besoin d’aucun certificat sanitaire
Ne jamais inscrire de chat sur le formulaire chien, sous peine de l’invalider
En cas de tiques, l’animal est retenu à l’OISA jusqu’à sa libération, à vos frais
Pour les provenances autres que les États-Unis, confirmez les conditions auprès du SENASICA avant le voyage
export_points: Chiens à destination des États-Unis : certificat d’absence de lucilie bouchère, inspection dans les 5 jours
Un vétérinaire autorisé par le SENASICA peut signer le certificat
Le Mexique n’est pas un pays à haut risque selon le CDC : la procédure CDC Dog Import Form s’applique
fr.summary: Depuis les États-Unis : les chats n’ont besoin d’aucun certificat sanitaire (depuis le 16 décembre 2019), mais depuis le 3 août 2026 les chiens doivent être munis d’un « NWS Inspection Certificate for Pet Dogs » signé par un vétérinaire accrédité USDA au plus 5 jours avant l’entrée (sans visa de l’APHIS). Le SENASICA (OISA) inspecte tous les chiens et chats à l’arrivée (signes de maladie, ectoparasites, plaies). Pour les autres provenances, confirmez les conditions auprès du SENASICA avant le voyage.

steps.what: Prenotare un veterinario accreditato USDA per l'ispezione del cane per il verme avvitatore (Cochliomyia hominivorax) (NWS)
Il veterinario firma il certificato NWS per i cani; non serve vidimazione APHIS
Predisporre il certificato per il verme avvitatore per il rientro negli Stati Uniti; portare la prova della vaccinazione antirabbica
Ispezione SENASICA per malattie, ectoparassiti e ferite

key_points: I gatti provenienti dagli Stati Uniti non necessitano di certificato sanitario
Non indicare mai i gatti sul modulo per i cani, pena l'invalidità del modulo
Se vengono trovate zecche, l'animale è trattenuto presso l'OISA fino al nulla osta, a Sue spese
Per provenienze diverse dagli Stati Uniti, verificare le condizioni con SENASICA prima del viaggio
export_points: I cani diretti negli Stati Uniti necessitano di un certificato di indennità dal verme avvitatore, con ispezione entro 5 giorni
Il certificato può essere firmato da un veterinario autorizzato SENASICA
Il Messico non è un Paese ad alto rischio CDC: si applica la procedura CDC Dog Import Form
it.summary: Dagli Stati Uniti: per i gatti non serve alcun certificato sanitario (dal 16 dic 2019), ma dal 3 ago 2026 i cani necessitano di un 'NWS Inspection Certificate for Pet Dogs' firmato da un veterinario accreditato USDA non oltre 5 giorni prima dell'ingresso (senza vidimazione APHIS). SENASICA (OISA) ispeziona all'arrivo tutti i cani e i gatti per verificare segni di malattia, ectoparassiti e ferite. Per altre provenienze, verificare le condizioni con SENASICA prima del viaggio.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: Собаки: сертификат NWS ≤5 дней до въезда

steps.what: Запишитесь к ветеринару, аккредитованному USDA, на осмотр собаки на винтовую муху (NWS)
Ветеринар подписывает сертификат NWS для собак; заверение APHIS не нужно
Предусмотрите сертификат об отсутствии винтовой мухи для возвращения в США; имейте при себе подтверждение прививки от бешенства
Осмотр SENASICA на болезни, эктопаразитов и раны

key_points: Кошкам из США ветеринарный сертификат не нужен
Никогда не вписывайте кошек в форму для собак, иначе форма станет недействительной
При обнаружении клещей животное задерживается в OISA до завершения обработки за Ваш счёт
Для стран отправления, кроме США, уточните условия в SENASICA до поездки
export_points: Собакам, направляющимся в США, нужен сертификат об отсутствии винтовой мухи, осмотр в пределах 5 дней
Сертификат может подписать ветеринар, уполномоченный SENASICA
Мексика не относится к странам высокого риска по CDC: применяется порядок с формой CDC на ввоз собаки
ru.summary: Из США: кошкам ветеринарный сертификат не нужен (с 16 декабря 2019 г.), но с 3 августа 2026 г. собакам нужен «Сертификат осмотра на NWS для домашних собак» (NWS Inspection Certificate for Pet Dogs), подписанный ветеринаром, аккредитованным USDA, не ранее чем за 5 дней до въезда (без заверения APHIS). SENASICA (OISA) осматривает всех собак и кошек по прибытии на признаки болезней, эктопаразитов и ран. Для других стран отправления уточните условия в SENASICA до поездки.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.summary: A MAQIS import permit is needed. Pets from 'scheduled' countries (list updated by DVS on 11 Dec 2025) can enter without quarantine. Pets from all other countries need a rabies vaccination before export and at least 7 days of quarantine on arrival, which DVS can extend up to 6 months. Sabah and Sarawak have their own state veterinary authorities and rules.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip required under the DVS regulations for non-scheduled countries.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required in the DVS regulations for Peninsular Malaysia (antibody levels may be tested at random during quarantine). Sabah and Sarawak may apply different rules; confirm with their veterinary services before travel.
countries.import_permit: Yes: MAQIS import permit. Restricted dog breeds also need prior written approval from the MAQIS Director General.
countries.quarantine: Non-scheduled countries: at least 7 days in quarantine, which can be extended up to 6 months case by case. Scheduled countries: no quarantine per the DVS pet portal. Scheduled list (DVS notice of 11 Dec 2025): United Kingdom, Eire, Northern Ireland, New Zealand, Japan, Sweden, Brunei, Singapore, Greece, Luxembourg, Czech Republic, Malta, Slovenia, Estonia, Bahrain, Austria, Belgium, Germany, Portugal, Montenegro, Bulgaria, Lithuania. Australia appeared in the older list but is not in the Dec 2025 list; confirm with DVS.
countries.timeline: Plan at least 6-8 weeks before travel: microchip, rabies vaccine (30+ days before entry), MAQIS permit, government-endorsed health certificate within 7 days of export, then quarantine on arrival unless from a scheduled country.
countries.restricted_breeds: Banned dogs: Akita, American Bulldog, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, Japanese Tosa, Neapolitan Mastiff, Pit Bull types (American Pit Bull Terrier, American Staffordshire Terrier, Staffordshire Bull Terrier). Restricted dogs (need MAQIS approval, pedigree, premises inspection, personal pet or security use only): Bull Mastiff, Bull Terrier, Doberman, German/Belgian/East European Shepherd, Perro de Presa Canario, Rottweiler. Minimum age 3 months.
countries.private_aviation: The DVS regulation says pets must be carried by aircraft or other transport directly to the prescribed landing place or any other airport in Malaysia. No rule specific to private aircraft was found. Confirm the arrival airport and the quarantine officer's attendance with MAQIS/DVS.
countries.authority: Department of Veterinary Services (DVS) and Malaysian Quarantine and Inspection Services (MAQIS). Sabah and Sarawak: state veterinary departments (Sarawak: dvs@sarawak.gov.my)
vaccinations: Rabies (non-scheduled countries): approved vaccine before export. The DVS pet portal says at least 30 days before entry.
Other core vaccines given within 12 months before export, as recommended by a licensed vet.
documents: MAQIS import permit (ePermit)
Pet passport or certificate with full description and identification

Veterinary health certificate from the exporting country's government veterinary authority: examination within 7 days before export, no rabies in the country for the previous 6 months, not imported into the country within the previous 6 months
Rabies vaccination certificate
Scheduled countries: Malaysian veterinary certificate and airline captain's affidavit (per DVS portal)

steps.what: Microchip and rabies vaccination at least 30 days before entry
Apply for the MAQIS import permit (ePermit)
Health certificate from the government veterinary authority
Quarantine of 7+ days unless arriving from a scheduled country

key_points: No quarantine from scheduled countries incl. UK, Ireland, Germany, Belgium, Austria, Portugal; not the USA
Non-scheduled quarantine can be extended up to 6 months
Banned: Akita, American Bulldog, Dogo Argentino, Fila, Tosa, Neapolitan Mastiff, Pit Bull types
Minimum age 3 months; Sabah and Sarawak have their own rules

at_a_glance.quarantine: 7+ أيام ما لم تكن دولة مُدرجة

steps.what: الشريحة الإلكترونية والتطعيم ضد داء الكلب قبل الدخول بـ30 يومًا على الأقل
التقدّم بطلب تصريح الاستيراد من MAQIS (ePermit)
شهادة صحية من السلطة البيطرية الحكومية
حجر صحي لمدة 7+ أيام ما لم يكن الوصول من دولة مُدرجة في الجدول

key_points: لا حجر صحي من الدول المُدرجة ومنها المملكة المتحدة وأيرلندا وألمانيا وبلجيكا والنمسا والبرتغال؛ وليس منها الولايات المتحدة
يمكن تمديد الحجر الصحي لغير المُدرجة حتى 6 أشهر
محظورة: الأكيتا، والبولدوغ الأمريكي، والدوغو الأرجنتيني، والفيلا، والتوسا، والماستيف النابولي، وأنواع البيتبول
الحد الأدنى للعمر 3 أشهر؛ ولصباح وساراواك قواعد خاصة بهما
ar.summary: يلزم تصريح استيراد من MAQIS. ويمكن للحيوانات القادمة من الدول 'المُدرجة في الجدول' (القائمة المحدّثة من DVS في 11 ديسمبر 2025) الدخول دون حجر صحي. أما الحيوانات القادمة من جميع الدول الأخرى فتحتاج إلى تطعيم ضد داء الكلب قبل التصدير وحجر صحي لا يقل عن 7 أيام عند الوصول، ويجوز لـDVS تمديده حتى 6 أشهر. ولولايتي صباح وساراواك سلطات وقواعد بيطرية خاصة بهما.

steps.what: Mikrochip und Tollwutimpfung mindestens 30 Tage vor der Einreise
MAQIS-Einfuhrgenehmigung beantragen (ePermit)
Gesundheitszeugnis der staatlichen Veterinärbehörde
Quarantäne von mind. 7 Tagen, außer bei Ankunft aus einem gelisteten Land

key_points: Keine Quarantäne aus gelisteten Ländern, u. a. Vereinigtes Königreich, Irland, Deutschland, Belgien, Österreich, Portugal; nicht USA
Quarantäne für nicht gelistete Länder kann auf bis zu 6 Monate verlängert werden
Verboten: Akita, American Bulldog, Dogo Argentino, Fila, Tosa, Mastino Napoletano, Pitbull-Typen
Mindestalter 3 Monate; Sabah und Sarawak haben eigene Regeln
de.summary: Eine MAQIS-Einfuhrgenehmigung ist erforderlich. Heimtiere aus „gelisteten“ Ländern (Liste vom DVS am 11. Dez. 2025 aktualisiert) können ohne Quarantäne einreisen. Heimtiere aus allen anderen Ländern benötigen eine Tollwutimpfung vor der Ausfuhr und mindestens 7 Tage Quarantäne nach Ankunft, die der DVS auf bis zu 6 Monate verlängern kann. Sabah und Sarawak haben eigene staatliche Veterinärbehörden und Regeln.

at_a_glance.quarantine: 7+ días salvo país de la lista

steps.what: Microchip y vacunación antirrábica al menos 30 días antes de la entrada
Solicite el permiso de importación del MAQIS (ePermit)
Certificado sanitario de la autoridad veterinaria gubernamental
Cuarentena de 7+ días salvo llegada desde un país de la lista

key_points: Sin cuarentena desde países de la lista, incl. R. U., Irlanda, Alemania, Bélgica, Austria, Portugal; no EE. UU.
Fuera de la lista, la cuarentena puede prolongarse hasta 6 meses
Prohibidos: Akita, Bulldog Americano, Dogo Argentino, Fila, Tosa, Mastín Napolitano, tipos Pit Bull
Edad mínima 3 meses; Sabah y Sarawak tienen sus propias normas
es.summary: Se necesita un permiso de importación del MAQIS. Las mascotas de países de la lista oficial («scheduled», actualizada por el DVS el 11 de diciembre de 2025) pueden entrar sin cuarentena. Las mascotas de todos los demás países necesitan vacunación antirrábica antes de la exportación y al menos 7 días de cuarentena a la llegada, que el DVS puede prolongar hasta 6 meses. Sabah y Sarawak tienen sus propias autoridades veterinarias estatales y normas.

steps.what: Puce électronique et vaccination antirabique au moins 30 jours avant l’entrée
Demander le permis d’importation MAQIS (ePermit)
Certificat sanitaire de l’autorité vétérinaire gouvernementale
Quarantaine de 7+ jours sauf en provenance d’un pays listé

key_points: Pas de quarantaine depuis les pays listés, dont Royaume-Uni, Irlande, Allemagne, Belgique, Autriche, Portugal ; pas les États-Unis
La quarantaine hors pays listés peut être prolongée jusqu’à 6 mois
Interdits : Akita, American Bulldog, Dogo Argentino, Fila, Tosa, mâtin napolitain, types Pit Bull
Âge minimum 3 mois ; le Sabah et le Sarawak ont leurs propres règles
fr.summary: Un permis d’importation MAQIS est nécessaire. Les animaux en provenance des pays « listés » (liste mise à jour par le DVS le 11 décembre 2025) peuvent entrer sans quarantaine. Ceux de tous les autres pays doivent être vaccinés contre la rage avant l’export et effectuer au moins 7 jours de quarantaine à l’arrivée, durée que le DVS peut prolonger jusqu’à 6 mois. Le Sabah et le Sarawak disposent de leurs propres autorités vétérinaires et règles.

steps.what: Microchip e vaccinazione antirabbica almeno 30 giorni prima dell'ingresso
Richiedere il permesso d'importazione MAQIS (ePermit)
Certificato sanitario dell'autorità veterinaria governativa
Quarantena di 7+ giorni, salvo arrivo da un Paese 'scheduled'

key_points: Nessuna quarantena dai Paesi 'scheduled', tra cui Regno Unito, Irlanda, Germania, Belgio, Austria, Portogallo; non gli Stati Uniti
La quarantena per i Paesi non 'scheduled' può essere prorogata fino a 6 mesi
Vietati: Akita, American Bulldog, Dogo Argentino, Fila, Tosa, Mastino Napoletano, tipi Pit Bull
Età minima 3 mesi; Sabah e Sarawak hanno norme proprie
it.summary: È necessario un permesso d'importazione MAQIS. Gli animali provenienti da Paesi 'scheduled' (elenco aggiornato dal DVS l'11 dic 2025) possono entrare senza quarantena. Gli animali provenienti da tutti gli altri Paesi necessitano di vaccinazione antirabbica prima dell'esportazione e di almeno 7 giorni di quarantena all'arrivo, prorogabili dal DVS fino a 6 mesi. Sabah e Sarawak hanno autorità veterinarie e norme proprie.

at_a_glance.quarantine: 7+ дней, если страна не в перечне

steps.what: Микрочип и вакцинация против бешенства не менее чем за 30 дней до въезда
Подайте заявку на разрешение MAQIS на ввоз (ePermit)
Ветеринарный сертификат государственного ветеринарного органа
Карантин 7+ дней, если прибытие не из страны перечня

key_points: Без карантина из стран перечня, включая Великобританию, Ирландию, Германию, Бельгию, Австрию, Португалию; США в перечень не входят
Карантин для стран вне перечня может быть продлён до 6 месяцев
Запрещены: акита, американский бульдог, аргентинский дог, фила, тоса, неаполитанский мастиф, типы питбулей
Минимальный возраст 3 месяца; в Сабахе и Сараваке свои правила
ru.summary: Требуется разрешение MAQIS на ввоз. Животные из «включённых в перечень» стран (перечень обновлён DVS 11 декабря 2025 г.) могут въезжать без карантина. Животным из всех прочих стран нужны вакцинация против бешенства до вывоза и карантин не менее 7 дней по прибытии, который DVS может продлить до 6 месяцев. В Сабахе и Сараваке действуют собственные государственные ветеринарные органы и правила.

countries.name: Mozambique
countries.summary: Pets need rabies vaccination within 12 months before export and an official health certificate (US: valid 30 days; UK: exam within 48 h of export). Since April 2024, Mozambique bans the import of listed dangerous dog breeds and their crosses unless authorized by the National Director of Livestock Development.
countries.parasite_treatment: For US-origin pets (APHIS): animal must be free of external parasites at exam; routine treatments up to date.
countries.import_permit: General pet import permit not stated in APHIS/UK guidance. Dangerous-breed dogs need prior authorization from the National Director of Livestock Development (MADER).
countries.timeline: Allow at least 28 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (at least 30 days before export): check the breed list and apply for any authorisation → official health certificate (US: within 30 days; UK: exam within 48 h). Listed breeds need longer.
countries.restricted_breeds: April 2024 MADER measure (announced via the state news agency AIM) bans import of potentially dangerous breeds and crosses, including Fila Brasileiro, Dogo Argentino, Pit Bull, Rottweiler, American Staffordshire Terrier, Tosa Inu, Saint Bernard, Bull Terrier, Akita Inu, Doberman, Kangal, Bullmastiff, and others. Exceptions need authorization, e.g. assistance dogs, security dogs, and sterilized companion dogs over 2 years. Dogs must be at least 3 months old and registered within 10 days of entry. Sterilization is required.
countries.authority: National Directorate of Livestock Development (DNDP), Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MADER)
vaccinations: Rabies: within 12 months before export (US/APHIS); UK guidance: at least 30 days and at most 12 months before export. US certificate allows pups/kittens under 3 months travelling with the mother's rabies certificate.
Routine vaccinations/treatments up to date (APHIS certificate)
documents: Official export health certificate: For US-origin pets (APHIS): USDA-endorsed certificate (April 2024 form) valid 30 days after issuance, attesting no rabies on premises of origin for 12 months; UK: OV exam within 48 h of export
Rabies vaccination certificate
Authorization from National Director of Livestock Development for dangerous breeds (where allowed)

at_a_glance.parasites: Free of external parasites at exam

steps.what: Check the dangerous-breed list and request authorisation if needed
Rabies vaccination
US: USDA-endorsed health certificate. UK: official vet exam within 48 h

key_points: Dangerous breeds banned unless authorised, incl. Pit Bull, Rottweiler, Doberman, Akita, Saint Bernard
Dogs must be at least 3 months old and registered within 10 days of entry

at_a_glance.health_certificate: أمريكا: صالحة 30 يومًا؛ UK: فحص ≤48 ساعة
at_a_glance.parasites: خلو من الطفيليات الخارجية عند الفحص

steps.what: مراجعة قائمة السلالات الخطرة وطلب الإذن عند الحاجة
التطعيم ضد داء الكلب
الولايات المتحدة: شهادة صحية مصادق عليها من USDA. المملكة المتحدة: فحص من طبيب بيطري رسمي خلال 48 ساعة

key_points: السلالات الخطرة محظورة ما لم يُؤذن بها، ومنها البيتبول والروت وايلر والدوبرمان والأكيتا والسان برنارد
يجب ألا يقل عمر الكلاب عن 3 أشهر وأن تُسجَّل خلال 10 أيام من الدخول
ar.summary: تحتاج الحيوانات الأليفة إلى تطعيم ضد داء الكلب خلال 12 شهرًا قبل التصدير وشهادة صحية رسمية (الولايات المتحدة: صالحة 30 يومًا؛ المملكة المتحدة: فحص خلال 48 ساعة من التصدير). ومنذ أبريل 2024، تحظر موزمبيق استيراد سلالات الكلاب الخطرة المُدرجة وهجائنها ما لم يأذن بذلك المدير الوطني لتنمية الثروة الحيوانية.

steps.what: Liste gefährlicher Rassen prüfen und ggf. Genehmigung beantragen
Tollwutimpfung
USA: USDA-beglaubigtes Gesundheitszeugnis. UK: amtstierärztliche Untersuchung innerhalb von 48 Std.

key_points: Gefährliche Rassen verboten, sofern nicht genehmigt, u. a. Pit Bull, Rottweiler, Dobermann, Akita, Bernhardiner
Hunde müssen mindestens 3 Monate alt sein und innerhalb von 10 Tagen nach Einreise registriert werden
de.summary: Heimtiere benötigen eine Tollwutimpfung innerhalb von 12 Monaten vor der Ausfuhr und ein amtliches Gesundheitszeugnis (USA: 30 Tage gültig; UK: Untersuchung innerhalb von 48 Std. vor der Ausfuhr). Seit April 2024 verbietet Mosambik die Einfuhr gelisteter gefährlicher Hunderassen und ihrer Mischlinge, sofern keine Genehmigung des National Director of Livestock Development vorliegt.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: EE. UU.: válido 30 días; R. U.: examen ≤48 h

Los perros deben tener al menos 3 meses y registrarse en los 10 días siguientes a la entrada
es.summary: Las mascotas necesitan vacunación antirrábica en los 12 meses previos a la exportación y un certificado sanitario oficial (EE. UU.: válido 30 días; R. U.: examen en las 48 h previas a la exportación). at_a_glance.parasites: Exempt de parasites externes à l’examen

États-Unis : certificat sanitaire visé par l’USDA. Royaume-Uni : examen vétérinaire officiel dans les 48 h

Les chiens doivent avoir au moins 3 mois et être enregistrés dans les 10 jours suivant l’entrée

Depuis avril 2024, le Mozambique interdit l’importation des races de chiens dangereuses listées et de leurs croisements, sauf autorisation du Directeur national du développement de l’élevage.

steps.what: Verificare l'elenco delle razze pericolose e, se necessario, richiedere l'autorizzazione
Vaccinazione antirabbica
USA: certificato sanitario vidimato dall'USDA. Regno Unito: visita del veterinario ufficiale entro 48 h

key_points: Razze pericolose vietate salvo autorizzazione, tra cui Pit Bull, Rottweiler, Dobermann, Akita, San Bernardo
I cani devono avere almeno 3 mesi ed essere registrati entro 10 giorni dall'ingresso
it.summary: Gli animali necessitano di vaccinazione antirabbica nei 12 mesi precedenti l'esportazione e di un certificato sanitario ufficiale (USA: valido 30 giorni; Regno Unito: visita entro 48 h dall'esportazione). Da aprile 2024 il Mozambico vieta l'importazione delle razze canine pericolose elencate e dei loro incroci, salvo autorizzazione del National Director of Livestock Development.

steps.what: Проверьте перечень опасных пород и при необходимости запросите разрешение
Вакцинация против бешенства
США: ветеринарный сертификат с заверением USDA. Великобритания: осмотр официальным ветеринаром в пределах 48 ч

key_points: Опасные породы запрещены без разрешения, включая питбуля, ротвейлера, добермана, акиту, сенбернара
Собакам должно быть не менее 3 месяцев; их необходимо зарегистрировать в течение 10 дней после въезда
ru.summary: Животным нужны вакцинация против бешенства в течение 12 месяцев до вывоза и официальный ветеринарный сертификат (США: действует 30 дней; Великобритания: осмотр в пределах 48 ч до вывоза). С апреля 2024 г. Мозамбик запрещает ввоз опасных пород собак из перечня и их помесей без разрешения Национального директора по развитию животноводства.

countries.name: Namibia
countries.summary: Pets from countries other than South Africa and Botswana need a veterinary import permit from the Directorate of Veterinary Services, Windhoek. The permit is valid 4 months and single use. After the exporting vet endorses it, the owner must obtain a 'landing permit' before travel. Pets from South Africa need only an inter-territorial movement permit and rabies vaccination.
countries.microchip: Not mandated by the DVS portal (microchip if transiting a country requiring it). The US dog certificate uses tag/tattoo/description.
countries.parasite_treatment: US-origin dogs: heartworm treatment (ivermectin, milbemycin, moxidectin, selamectin or DEC) from the negative test until export, and continued for 6 months after arrival. The owner must bring 6 months of supply because it is not easily available in Namibia.
countries.import_permit: Required except for South Africa-origin pets (residence of 3+ months). Apply via Vet.Permits@mawlr.gov.na. Fee N$150 (or €50 at a Namibian mission). Processed within a maximum of 3 working days. Valid 4 months, single use.
countries.quarantine: None for EU/USA, South Africa and SADC origins. 30-day quarantine on arrival for pets from other countries (per the Namibia Trade Portal).
countries.timeline: Allow at least 42 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (at least 30 days ahead): apply for the permit (up to 3 days) → courier the permit to the exporting vet → dog blood tests within 30 days of export → health certificate and endorsement within 10 days → email documents to obtain the landing permit before departure.
countries.private_aviation: The permit names the state veterinary office responsible for inspection. Arrange inspection at the arrival airport (normally Hosea Kutako International) in advance.
countries.export: To South Africa: inter-territorial movement permit from a local state vet. To Botswana: health certificate from a state vet. To the EU: state vet health certificate, microchip and rabies titer. Others: destination permit required.
countries.authority: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Water and Land Reform – Directorate of Veterinary Services (Vet.Permits@mawlr.gov.na)
vaccinations: Rabies: at least 30 days and no more than 12 months before travel. Under 3 months old: the dam's vaccination is accepted and the pet must be vaccinated at 3 months in Namibia.
Full vaccination status expected (EU/USA origin)
documents: Namibian veterinary import permit (number on the health certificate)
Health certificate from the exporting country's state vet (US: USDA-endorsed, exam within 10 days of export)
Rabies vaccination record
Dogs (US/EU and other origins): negative tests within 30 days of export for Brucella canis, Babesia gibsoni, Dirofilaria immitis, Leishmania (and T. evansi for non-US origins)
Landing permit from the Namibian state vet (send the endorsed permit, pet passport and lab results before travel)
From South Africa: inter-territorial movement permit from the local state vet. From Botswana: Veterinary Certificate of Identity, Rabies Vaccination and Movement Permit.

at_a_glance.parasites: US dogs: heartworm meds, 6 months on

steps.what: Rabies vaccination at least 30 days before travel
Apply for the import permit via Vet.Permits@mawlr.gov.na (≤3 working days)
Dogs: negative tests for Brucella, Babesia, heartworm and Leishmania
State-vet health certificate and endorsement
Email endorsed permit, passport and lab results to get the landing permit
Inspection by the state vet named on the permit

key_points: The landing permit must be in hand before departure
US dogs: bring 6 months of heartworm medication, hard to find in Namibia
From South Africa: only a movement permit and rabies vaccination
Pets under 3 months must be vaccinated at 3 months in Namibia
export_points: To South Africa: inter-territorial movement permit from a local state vet
To Botswana: state vet health certificate
To the EU: state vet certificate, microchip and rabies titer; others need a destination permit

at_a_glance.health_certificate: أمريكا: فحص قبل التصدير بـ≤10 أيام
at_a_glance.parasites: كلاب أمريكا: دواء الدودة القلبية لـ6 أشهر

steps.what: التطعيم ضد داء الكلب قبل السفر بـ30 يومًا على الأقل
التقدّم بطلب تصريح الاستيراد عبر Vet.Permits@mawlr.gov.na (≤3 أيام عمل)
الكلاب: نتائج سلبية لفحوص البروسيلا والبابيزيا والدودة القلبية والليشمانيا
شهادة صحية من طبيب بيطري حكومي والمصادقة عليها
إرسال التصريح المصادق عليه وجواز السفر والنتائج المخبرية بالبريد الإلكتروني للحصول على تصريح الإنزال
فحص من الطبيب البيطري الحكومي المذكور في التصريح

key_points: يجب أن يكون تصريح الإنزال في حوزتكم قبل المغادرة
الكلاب الأمريكية: يُرجى إحضار دواء الدودة القلبية لمدة 6 أشهر، إذ يصعب العثور عليه في ناميبيا
من جنوب أفريقيا: تصريح تنقل وتطعيم ضد داء الكلب فقط
يجب تطعيم الحيوانات دون 3 أشهر عند بلوغها 3 أشهر في ناميبيا
export_points: إلى جنوب أفريقيا: تصريح تنقل بين الأقاليم من طبيب بيطري حكومي محلي
إلى بوتسوانا: شهادة صحية من طبيب بيطري حكومي
إلى الاتحاد الأوروبي: شهادة من طبيب بيطري حكومي، وشريحة إلكترونية، واختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب؛ وتحتاج الوجهات الأخرى إلى تصريح من بلد الوجهة
ar.summary: تحتاج الحيوانات الأليفة القادمة من دول غير جنوب أفريقيا وبوتسوانا إلى تصريح استيراد بيطري من مديرية الخدمات البيطرية في ويندهوك. والتصريح صالح 4 أشهر ولاستخدام واحد. وبعد أن يصادق عليه الطبيب البيطري في بلد التصدير، يجب على المالك الحصول على 'تصريح إنزال' قبل السفر. ولا تحتاج الحيوانات القادمة من جنوب أفريقيا إلا إلى تصريح تنقل بين الأقاليم وتطعيم ضد داء الكلب.

Einfuhrgenehmigung über Vet.Permits@mawlr.gov.na beantragen (≤3 Arbeitstage)
Hunde: negative Tests auf Brucellose, Babesiose, Herzwurm und Leishmaniose
Amtstierärztliches Gesundheitszeugnis und Beglaubigung
Beglaubigte Genehmigung, Reisepass und Laborergebnisse per E-Mail senden, um die Landing Permit zu erhalten
Kontrolle durch den in der Genehmigung genannten Amtstierarzt

Aus Südafrika: nur eine Verbringungsgenehmigung und Tollwutimpfung
Heimtiere unter 3 Monaten müssen im Alter von 3 Monaten in Namibia geimpft werden

Nach Botswana: amtstierärztliches Gesundheitszeugnis

Die Genehmigung ist 4 Monate gültig und nur einmal verwendbar. Nach der Beglaubigung durch den Tierarzt im Ausfuhrland muss der Halter vor der Reise eine „Landing Permit“ einholen. Heimtiere aus Südafrika benötigen nur eine Genehmigung für die grenzüberschreitende Verbringung und eine Tollwutimpfung.

A Botsuana: certificado sanitario del veterinario oficial
A la UE: certificado del veterinario oficial, microchip y titulación antirrábica; otros destinos necesitan un permiso del país de destino
es.summary: Las mascotas procedentes de países distintos de Sudáfrica y Botsuana necesitan un permiso veterinario de importación de la Directorate of Veterinary Services, Windhoek. El permiso es válido 4 meses y de un solo uso. Una vez refrendado por el veterinario del país exportador, el propietario debe obtener un «permiso de desembarque» (landing permit) antes del viaje. Las mascotas procedentes de Sudáfrica solo necesitan un permiso de traslado interterritorial y la vacunación antirrábica.

steps.what: Vaccination antirabique au moins 30 jours avant le voyage
Demander le permis d’importation via Vet.Permits@mawlr.gov.na (≤ 3 jours ouvrés)
Chiens : tests négatifs pour Brucella, Babesia, dirofilariose et Leishmania
Certificat sanitaire du vétérinaire officiel et visa
Envoyer par e-mail le permis visé, le passeport et les résultats de laboratoire pour obtenir le landing permit
Inspection par le vétérinaire officiel désigné sur le permis

Chiens des États-Unis : emporter 6 mois de traitement contre la dirofilariose, difficile à trouver en Namibie
Depuis l’Afrique du Sud : seulement un permis de mouvement et la vaccination antirabique

fr.summary: Les animaux en provenance de pays autres que l’Afrique du Sud et le Botswana nécessitent un permis d’importation vétérinaire de la Directorate of Veterinary Services, à Windhoek. Le permis est valable 4 mois et à usage unique. Une fois le permis visé par le vétérinaire du pays exportateur, le propriétaire doit obtenir un « landing permit » avant le voyage. Les animaux en provenance d’Afrique du Sud nécessitent seulement un permis de mouvement inter-territorial et la vaccination antirabique.

Il permesso è valido 4 mesi e monouso. Dopo la vidimazione da parte del veterinario del Paese di esportazione, il proprietario deve ottenere un 'landing permit' prima del viaggio. Per gli animali provenienti dal Sudafrica bastano un permesso di movimentazione interterritoriale e la vaccinazione antirabbica.

countries.name: Nigeria
countries.summary: Pets need an import permit from the Federal Department of Veterinary and Pest Control Services (FMARD, Abuja). Required documents: an officially endorsed health certificate, rabies vaccination within 1 year (inactivated vaccine), and a rabies serology result. NAQS verifies the permit and inspects the animal on arrival.
countries.microchip: For US-origin pets (APHIS): all pets must be microchipped. UK certificate accepts a microchip or permanent tattoo.
countries.rabies_titer: FMARD lists a laboratory rabies serology result as a permit document. UK certificate requires ≥0.5 IU/ml, with the sample taken 3–24 months before export. The APHIS US certificate does not include a titer statement. Plan for a titer regardless of origin.
countries.import_permit: Required. Apply to the Director, Dept of Veterinary and Pest Control Services, FMARD Abuja (hard copy or vpcs@fmard.gov.ng) using the application form with travel date. Fee: N5,000 per dog/cat via Remita. Processing ~3 working days; permit valid 14 days from issue.
countries.quarantine: NAQS inspects imported dogs/cats at the port of entry and verifies the permit and veterinary certificate. Under the NAQS SOP, live animals may be held for quarantine observation (NAQS or owner's facility); animals suspected of disease may be held 2–3 weeks; non-compliant or illegal animals may be seized or destroyed.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 90 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated when a titer is needed (UK model: sample at least 3 months before export): titer → apply for the FMARD permit (about 3 days, valid 14 days) → endorsed health certificate → notify NAQS of the permit and arrival date.
countries.private_aviation: NAQS SOP: notify NAQS of the import permit details and arrival date, and declare the animal for NAQS inspection at the point of entry. Arrange NAQS presence at the arrival airport/FBO in advance.

countries.name: Netherlands
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Ear cropping and tail docking are banned in the Netherlands; owners of cropped or docked dogs should confirm any conditions with the NVWA before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by the Netherlands and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Airport points of entry (NVWA list v1.0.4): Amsterdam Schiphol, Eindhoven, Rotterdam, Maastricht-Aachen, Groningen Eelde and Lelystad. Passengers with animals must use the red 'something to declare' exit. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Young animals: The Netherlands does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين.

Собакам, направляющимся в FI, IE, MT, NO или Северную Ирландию, также нужна обработка от ленточных червей

ru.private_jet_note: При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС совершайте посадку в аэропорту-пункте въезда (Схипхол, Эйндховен, Роттердам, Маастрихт-Ахен, Гронинген-Элде или Лелистад) и проходите через красный коридор.
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников.

countries.name: Norway
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry. Dogs also need tapeworm treatment 24–120 h before entry. Norway applies EU pet rules via the EEA; the customs red channel is mandatory.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: Dogs only: Echinococcus treatment (praziquantel) by a vet 24–120 h before arrival, recorded in the passport, even for day trips (e.g. from Sweden). Exempt: dogs arriving directly from Finland, Ireland, Malta or Northern Ireland. Frequent travellers may use a regular treatment schedule at intervals of at most 28 days (at least two treatments before entry). Cats: none.
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued). Dogs: tapeworm treatment 24–120 hours before arrival.
countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited (incl. any cross): Pit Bull Terrier, American Staffordshire Terrier, Fila Brasileiro, Tosa Inu, Dogo Argentino, Czechoslovakian Wolfdog. Customs says import requires a special police permit applied for in advance; police may order euthanasia or removal of non-compliant dogs.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU/EEA (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Norway and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Pets from outside the EU/EEA may only arrive via Oslo Airport Gardermoen (or the Storskog road crossing, Kirkenes). Always use the customs red channel (by air, even from Sweden). Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: Leaving Norway for EU/EEA: EU pet passport (EEA rules). To third countries: destination rules; contact Mattilsynet.
countries.authority: Norwegian Food Safety Authority (Mattilsynet); Norwegian Customs
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Young animals: Norway does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: EU passport, or EU certificate ≤10 days (non-EU)

steps.what: ISO microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12+ weeks old)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid
