Ветеринарный сертификат от лицензированного ветеринара с указанием микрочипа и прививки от бешенства

key_points: Для стран отправления, кроме США, уточните условия в Министерстве национальной продовольственной безопасности и исследований
До поездки уточните, нужно ли NOC на ввоз
ru.summary: Для собак и кошек из США USDA указывает ветеринарный сертификат для Пакистана: выдаётся лицензированным ветеринаром (заверение USDA не требуется), с указанием микрочипа, результатов осмотра, происхождения вне карантинных по бешенству зон и действующей прививки от бешенства. Действует 30 дней. До поездки уточните в Министерстве национальной продовольственной безопасности и исследований, нужно ли NOC на ввоз.

countries.name: Poland
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the General Veterinary Inspectorate (GIW) before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Poland and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Airport points of entry: Warsaw Chopin (Okęcie), Warsaw Modlin, Kraków, Katowice, Gdańsk, Poznań, Wrocław, Łódź, Rzeszów, Szczecin-Goleniów, Bydgoszcz and Lublin (Świdnik); customs performs the checks. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: General Veterinary Inspectorate (GIW)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Young animals: Poland does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: EU passport, or EU certificate ≤10 days (non-EU)

steps.what: ISO microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12+ weeks old)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid
From the US: EU health certificate endorsed by USDA APHIS; from the EU: EU pet passport
Carry the signed non-commercial declaration (non-EU origins)
From outside the EU: document and identity check at a travellers' point of entry

key_points: Max 5 pets per movement; each travels with the owner or within 5 days
From unlisted countries (e.g. Türkiye, Morocco, Israel, Thailand, South Africa): titer test plus a 3-month wait
Old-model EU certificates are accepted only if issued before 1 Oct 2026
export_points: To EU/EEA countries: EU pet passport from an authorised vet
Dogs going to FI, IE, MT, NO or Northern Ireland also need tapeworm treatment
To non-EU countries: meet destination rules; the official vet service endorses certificates
countries.private_jet_note: From outside the EU, land at a point-of-entry airport such as Warsaw Chopin, Kraków, Gdańsk or Katowice and present the pet at customs (red channel).

at_a_glance.microchip: شريحة ISO، قبل لقاح داء الكلب
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: قبل الدخول بـ≥21 يومًا، بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا
at_a_glance.health_certificate: جواز أو شهادة أوروبية ≤10 أيام (خارج الاتحاد)

steps.what: شريحة ISO، ثم لقاح داء الكلب (للحيوان بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا)
يصبح التطعيم الأولي ضد داء الكلب صالحًا
من الولايات المتحدة: شهادة صحية أوروبية مصادق عليها من USDA APHIS؛ ومن الاتحاد الأوروبي: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف
حمل الإقرار الموقّع بأن النقل غير تجاري (للقادمين من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي)
من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: تدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين

key_points: الحد الأقصى 5 حيوانات لكل تنقّل؛ ويسافر كل منها مع المالك أو خلال 5 أيام
من الدول غير المُدرجة (مثل تركيا والمغرب وإسرائيل وتايلاند وجنوب أفريقيا): اختبار الأجسام المضادة مع انتظار 3 أشهر
لا تُقبل الشهادات الأوروبية بالنموذج القديم إلا إذا صدرت قبل 1 أكتوبر 2026
export_points: إلى دول الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف من طبيب بيطري معتمد
تحتاج الكلاب المتجهة إلى FI أو IE أو MT أو NO أو أيرلندا الشمالية أيضًا إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية
إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات
ar.private_jet_note: عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، يجب الهبوط في مطار نقطة دخول مثل وارسو شوبان أو كراكوف أو غدانسك أو كاتوفيتسه، وتقديم الحيوان الأليف للجمارك (المسار الأحمر).
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين.

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
Die Tollwut-Erstimpfung wird gültig
Aus den USA: von USDA APHIS beglaubigtes EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; aus der EU: EU-Heimtierausweis
Die unterschriebene Erklärung zur nicht kommerziellen Verbringung mitführen (Nicht-EU-Herkunft)
Von außerhalb der EU: Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrolle an einem Eingangsort für Reisende

key_points: Max. 5 Heimtiere pro Verbringung; jedes reist mit dem Halter oder innerhalb von 5 Tagen
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern (z. B. Türkei, Marokko, Israel, Thailand, Südafrika): Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit
EU-Zeugnisse nach altem Muster werden nur akzeptiert, wenn sie vor dem 1. Okt. 2026 ausgestellt wurden
export_points: In EU-/EWR-Länder: EU-Heimtierausweis von einem ermächtigten Tierarzt
Hunde nach FI, IE, MT, NO oder Nordirland benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Bestimmungen des Ziellandes erfüllen; der amtliche Veterinärdienst beglaubigt die Zeugnisse
de.private_jet_note: Bei Anreise von außerhalb der EU landen Sie an einem Eingangsort-Flughafen wie Warschau Chopin, Krakau, Danzig oder Kattowitz und führen das Tier beim Zoll vor (roter Kanal).
de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende.

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, antes de la vacuna antirrábica
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ≥21 días antes de entrar, con 12+ semanas
at_a_glance.titer: No se requiere desde EE. UU./UE
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Pasaporte UE o certif. UE ≤10 días (no UE)
at_a_glance.quarantine: Ninguna si se cumplen los requisitos

steps.what: Microchip ISO y, después, vacuna antirrábica (mascota de 12+ semanas)
La primovacunación antirrábica pasa a ser válida
Desde EE. UU.: certificado sanitario de la UE refrendado por USDA APHIS; desde la UE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas
Lleve la declaración firmada de no comercialidad (orígenes fuera de la UE)
Desde fuera de la UE: control documental y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros

key_points: Máx. 5 mascotas por desplazamiento; cada una viaja con el propietario o en un plazo de 5 días
Desde países no incluidos en la lista (p. ej., Turquía, Marruecos, Israel, Tailandia, Sudáfrica): prueba de titulación más 3 meses de espera
Los certificados UE del modelo anterior solo se aceptan si se emitieron antes del 1 de octubre de 2026
export_points: A países de la UE/EEE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas de un veterinario autorizado
Los perros con destino a FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Norte necesitan además tratamiento contra la tenia
A países fuera de la UE: cumpla las normas del destino; el servicio veterinario oficial refrenda los certificados
es.private_jet_note: Desde fuera de la UE, aterrice en un aeropuerto de punto de entrada, como Varsovia-Chopin, Cracovia, Gdansk o Katowice, y presente la mascota en la aduana (canal rojo).
es.summary: Normas de la UE (Reglamento Delegado (UE) 2026/131): desde otro Estado de la UE/EEE, mascota con microchip, vacunación antirrábica válida y pasaporte europeo para mascotas; desde fuera de la UE, certificado zoosanitario de la UE (más prueba de titulación antirrábica con 3 meses de espera si el país no figura en la lista) y controles documentales y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros.

at_a_glance.microchip: Puce ISO, avant le vaccin antirabique
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passeport UE ; hors UE, certificat ≤10 jours

steps.what: Puce électronique ISO, puis vaccin antirabique (animal âgé d'au moins 12 semaines)
La primovaccination antirabique devient valable
Depuis les États-Unis : certificat sanitaire UE visé par l'USDA APHIS ; depuis l'UE : passeport européen pour animal de compagnie
Munissez-vous de la déclaration signée attestant le caractère non commercial (origines hors UE)
Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE : contrôle documentaire et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs

key_points: 5 animaux max. par mouvement ; chacun voyage avec le propriétaire ou dans un délai de 5 jours
Depuis les pays non listés (p. ex. Turquie, Maroc, Israël, Thaïlande, Afrique du Sud) : titrage des anticorps antirabiques plus attente de 3 mois
Les certificats UE de l'ancien modèle ne sont acceptés que s'ils ont été délivrés avant le 1er oct. 2026
export_points: Vers les pays de l'UE/EEE : passeport européen délivré par un vétérinaire habilité
Les chiens à destination de FI, IE, MT, NO ou de l'Irlande du Nord nécessitent aussi un traitement contre le ténia
Vers les pays hors UE : respecter les règles du pays de destination ; le service vétérinaire officiel vise les certificats
fr.private_jet_note: En provenance de l’extérieur de l’UE, atterrissez dans un aéroport point d’entrée tel que Varsovie-Chopin, Cracovie, Gdańsk ou Katowice et présentez l’animal à la douane (circuit rouge).
fr.summary: Règles de l'UE (règlement délégué (UE) 2026/131) : depuis un autre État de l'UE/EEE, animal identifié par puce électronique, avec vaccination antirabique valide et passeport européen pour animal de compagnie ; depuis l'extérieur de l'UE, certificat sanitaire de l'UE (plus titrage des anticorps antirabiques avec attente de 3 mois si le pays n'est pas listé) et contrôles documentaires et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs.

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, prima del vaccino antirabbico
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passaporto UE, o cert. UE ≤10 gg (extra UE)

steps.what: Microchip ISO, poi vaccino antirabbico (animale di 12+ settimane)
La vaccinazione antirabbica primaria diventa valida
Dagli Stati Uniti: certificato sanitario UE vidimato da USDA APHIS; dall'UE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia
Portare con sé la dichiarazione firmata di movimentazione non commerciale (origini extra UE)
Da fuori UE: controllo documentale e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori

key_points: Max 5 animali per movimentazione; ciascuno viaggia con il proprietario o entro 5 giorni
Da Paesi non elencati (ad es. Turchia, Marocco, Israele, Thailandia, Sudafrica): titolazione più attesa di 3 mesi
I certificati UE del vecchio modello sono accettati solo se rilasciati prima del 1 ott 2026
export_points: Verso Paesi UE/SEE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia rilasciato da un veterinario autorizzato
I cani diretti in FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Nord necessitano anche del trattamento contro la tenia (Echinococcus)
Verso Paesi extra UE: rispettare le norme della destinazione; il servizio veterinario ufficiale vidima i certificati
it.private_jet_note: Provenendo da fuori dell'UE, l'atterraggio va effettuato in un aeroporto punto d'ingresso, come Varsavia Chopin, Cracovia, Danzica o Katowice, presentando l'animale alla dogana (canale rosso).
it.summary: Norme UE (Regolamento delegato (UE) 2026/131): da un altro Stato UE/SEE, animale con microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica valida e passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia; da fuori UE, certificato sanitario UE per animali (più titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici con attesa di 3 mesi se il Paese non è elencato) e controlli documentali e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori.

at_a_glance.microchip: Чип ISO, до прививки от бешенства
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Паспорт или сертификат ЕС ≤10 дней (не из ЕС)

steps.what: Микрочип ISO, затем прививка от бешенства (животному 12+ недель)
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной
Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС, заверенный USDA APHIS; из ЕС: европейский паспорт животного
Имейте при себе подписанную декларацию о некоммерческом перемещении (не из ЕС)
Из-за пределов ЕС: проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников

key_points: Не более 5 животных за одно перемещение; каждое следует с владельцем или в пределах 5 дней
Из стран вне перечня (например, Турция, Марокко, Израиль, Таиланд, ЮАР): тест на титр плюс ожидание 3 месяца
Сертификаты ЕС старого образца принимаются, только если выданы до 1 октября 2026 г.
export_points: В страны ЕС/ЕЭЗ: европейский паспорт животного от уполномоченного ветеринара
Собакам, направляющимся в FI, IE, MT, NO или Северную Ирландию, также нужна обработка от ленточных червей
В страны вне ЕС: соблюдайте правила страны назначения; сертификаты заверяет официальная ветеринарная служба
ru.private_jet_note: При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС совершайте посадку в аэропорту-пункте въезда, например Варшава-Шопен, Краков, Гданьск или Катовице, и предъявите животное на таможне (красный коридор).
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников.

countries.name: Puerto Rico
countries.summary: A US territory. From the US mainland (interstate): no permit, but an official CVI from an accredited vet (valid 30 days), rabies vaccination for pets over 4 months, external-parasite treatment within 72 hours, and ID are required. International arrivals must also meet CDC/USDA federal rules.
countries.microchip: Official individual ID required: microchip OR collar with metal tag.
countries.parasite_treatment: External parasite treatment within 72 hours before entry, recorded on the health certificate.
countries.import_permit: Not required for dogs and cats moving interstate.
countries.timeline: Plan at least 1–2 weeks before travel: rabies status check, CVI within 30 days, parasite treatment within 72 hours of arrival.
countries.private_aviation: Foreign-vaccinated dogs from CDC high-risk countries CANNOT enter the US via Puerto Rico (no CDC-registered facility in US territories).
countries.export: Puerto Rico to the US mainland is domestic travel (no CDC form). The Cayman Islands classes Puerto Rico as high rabies risk (3-month titer wait).
countries.authority: Departamento de Agricultura de Puerto Rico – Oficina del Oficial Estatal de Sanidad Animal (SAHO)
vaccinations: Rabies: dogs and cats over 4 months must be vaccinated and carry a rabies certificate. The Puerto Rico Department of Agriculture document says the vaccination must be given 'within six (6) months prior to shipment', which is unusually strict, so confirm with the PR State Veterinarian.
documents: Official certificate of veterinary inspection (e.g. APHIS 7001 or a state CVI) by an accredited vet, valid 30 days from inspection, stating the animal doesn't come from a rabies-quarantined area.
Rabies vaccination certificate.
International arrivals: CDC Dog Import Form and other federal requirements (see the US entry).

at_a_glance.microchip: Microchip or collar with metal tag

steps.what: Check rabies status with your vet
Official health certificate (CVI) from an accredited vet
External parasite treatment, recorded on the certificate

key_points: Official text says rabies within 6 months of shipment: confirm with the PR State Veterinarian
International arrivals must also meet CDC/USDA federal rules
export_points: To the US mainland: domestic travel, no CDC form
Cayman Islands treats Puerto Rico as high rabies risk (3-month titer wait)
countries.private_jet_note: Foreign-vaccinated dogs from CDC high-risk countries cannot enter the US via Puerto Rico, which has no CDC-registered facility. Plan a different routing for these dogs.

at_a_glance.microchip: شريحة إلكترونية أو طوق بلوحة معدنية
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: مطلوب فوق 4 أشهر؛ يُرجى تأكيد التوقيت

steps.what: التحقق من وضع داء الكلب مع طبيبكم البيطري
شهادة صحية رسمية (CVI) من طبيب بيطري معتمد
علاج الطفيليات الخارجية، مع تسجيله في الشهادة

key_points: ينص النص الرسمي على لقاح داء الكلب خلال 6 أشهر من الشحن: يُرجى التأكيد مع الطبيب البيطري الرسمي لبورتوريكو
يجب على القادمين دوليًا استيفاء القواعد الاتحادية لـCDC/USDA أيضًا

تعامل جزر كايمان بورتوريكو كمنطقة عالية المخاطر لداء الكلب (انتظار 3 أشهر بعد اختبار الأجسام المضادة)

countries.name: Portugal
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry. 48-hour advance notice to DGAV for non-EU arrivals.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued). Non-EU arrivals: send the written arrival notice to DGAV at least 48 hours before arrival.
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the DGAV before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Portugal and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Airport points of entry (DGAV list): Lisbon, Porto, Faro, Beja, Cascais, Funchal (Madeira), Ponta Delgada, Terceira and Santa Maria (Azores). Contact emails per airport are on the DGAV list (e.g. Lisbon pcflisboaa@dgav.pt, Faro pets.entrypoint.fao@dgav.pt). Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Directorate-General for Food and Veterinary (DGAV)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Arrivals from non-EU countries: Portugal requires owners to contact the authorities at least 48 hours before arrival using the written arrival notice form (per USDA APHIS).
Young animals: Portugal does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

من الدول غير المُدرجة (مثل تركيا والمغرب وإسرائيل وتايلاند وجنوب أفريقيا): اختبار الأجسام المضادة مع انتظار 3 أشهر

تحتاج الكلاب المتجهة إلى FI أو IE أو MT أو NO أو أيرلندا الشمالية أيضًا إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية
إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات
ar.private_jet_note: عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، يجب الهبوط في مطار نقطة دخول (لشبونة، بورتو، فارو، بيجا، كاشكايش، فونشال أو جزر الأزور) وإخطار DGAV كتابيًا قبل 48 ساعة.
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين. إخطار مسبق لـDGAV قبل 48 ساعة للقادمين من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي.

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
Die Tollwut-Erstimpfung wird gültig
Aus den USA: von USDA APHIS beglaubigtes EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; aus der EU: EU-Heimtierausweis
Ankünfte aus Nicht-EU-Ländern: schriftliche Ankunftsmeldung an die DGAV senden
Die unterschriebene Erklärung zur nicht kommerziellen Verbringung mitführen (Nicht-EU-Herkunft)
Von außerhalb der EU: Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrolle an einem Eingangsort für Reisende

key_points: Max. 5 Heimtiere pro Verbringung; jedes reist mit dem Halter oder innerhalb von 5 Tagen
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern (z. B. Türkei, Marokko, Israel, Thailand, Südafrika): Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit
EU-Zeugnisse nach altem Muster werden nur akzeptiert, wenn sie vor dem 1. Okt. 2026 ausgestellt wurden
export_points: In EU-/EWR-Länder: EU-Heimtierausweis von einem ermächtigten Tierarzt
Hunde nach FI, IE, MT, NO oder Nordirland benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Bestimmungen des Ziellandes erfüllen; der amtliche Veterinärdienst beglaubigt die Zeugnisse
de.private_jet_note: Bei Anreise von außerhalb der EU landen Sie an einem Eingangsort-Flughafen (Lissabon, Porto, Faro, Beja, Cascais, Funchal oder die Azoren) und melden sich 48 Stunden vorher schriftlich bei der DGAV an.
de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende. Voranmeldung bei der DGAV 48 Stunden im Voraus bei Ankünften von außerhalb der EU.

countries.microchip: Required: NZ MPI guidance requires the microchip to be scanned and verified before the rabies vaccination. ISO 15-digit is recommended.
countries.rabies_titer: Required: the import permit application must include a laboratory report for a rabies titre test (NZ MPI, Aug 2024). Confirm the required result and any waiting period with the Ministry of Municipality before travel.
countries.import_permit: Required. Apply to the Ministry of Municipality (Livestock Department / Department of Animal Resources) as a hybrid online or offline service. Processing about 1 working day. countries.quarantine: No mandatory quarantine if health requirements are met. Otherwise quarantine at the owner's expense (NZ MPI).
countries.timeline: Steps: microchip → rabies vaccination (at least 30 days before travel) → rabies titre blood test → Ministry of Municipality import permit (issued at least 30 days before arrival, valid 30 days) → official health certificate → arrive via Hamad International Airport. countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited dogs (NZ MPI Aug 2024 list): Afghan Hound, American Staffordshire Terrier, Boerboel, Boxer, Bull Terrier, Bulldog, Chinese Shar-Pei, Doberman, Great Dane, Japanese Akita, Neapolitan Mastiff, Rottweiler, Staffordshire Bull Terrier.
countries.private_aviation: NZ MPI states dogs and cats may enter only via Hamad International Airport (DOH). In-cabin travel is accepted with written airline permission. countries.name: Réunion
countries.summary: Réunion is a French overseas department in the EU, so EU pet rules under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131 apply: from mainland France or another EU state, a microchip, valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry. A rabies titer with a 3-month wait is needed from every African origin except Mauritius and Saint Helena.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: French law: category 1 'attack' dogs (pit-bull, Boerbull and Tosa types without a pedigree) may not be imported into France. Category 2 dogs are subject to conditions.
countries.private_aviation: Pets from outside the EU must pass documentary and identity checks at a designated travellers' point of entry. Confirm with DAAF Réunion before routing that the arrival airport (Roland Garros or Pierrefonds) and the private/FBO terminal can carry out the check. Max 5 animals for a non-commercial movement.
countries.export: Leaving for other countries follows the destination's rules. The EU pet passport is issued by a Réunion vet.
countries.authority: DAAF de La Réunion (Direction de l'alimentation, de l'agriculture et de la forêt) – French Ministry of Agriculture
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the ANSVSA before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Romania and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Airport points of entry: Bucharest Henri Coandă (24/7) and Cluj Avram Iancu (on request); no other airport is listed. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: National Sanitary Veterinary and Food Safety Authority (ANSVSA)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

Young animals: Romania accepts non-commercial entry from other EU states of pets under 12 weeks that are unvaccinated, or 12–16 weeks old and vaccinated but before the 21-day wait ends, with the owner's declaration of no contact with rabies-susceptible wild animals, or accompanied by the vaccinated mother. Never allowed from outside the EU.

key_points: Plus de 5 animaux : formulaire distinct, certificat dans les 24 h précédant le voyage
Animaux de moins de 16 semaines uniquement avec une déclaration du propriétaire ou une mère vaccinée
Évitez de transiter par l'Allemagne ou la Hongrie tant qu'il n'est pas confirmé que la restriction liée à la fièvre aphteuse (FMD) ne s'applique pas aux animaux de compagnie
fr.summary: Certificat sur modèle UE pour 5 animaux maximum : puce électronique et vaccination antirabique valide (délai de 21 jours après la primovaccination). Un titrage n'est exigé qu'en provenance ou via un pays non listé. Pour une origine États-Unis, le certificat doit être délivré et visé par l'APHIS dans les 10 jours précédant le voyage (dans les 24 heures au-delà de 5 animaux).

at_a_glance.titer: Solo da/via Paesi non in elenco

steps.what: Microchip, poi vaccinazione antirabbica
La vaccinazione antirabbica primaria diventa valida dopo 21 giorni
Certificato su modello UE rilasciato e vidimato da APHIS (USA)

key_points: Più di 5 animali: modulo separato, certificato entro 24 h dal viaggio
Animali sotto le 16 settimane solo con dichiarazione del proprietario o madre vaccinata
Evitare transiti via Germania o Ungheria finché non sarà confermato che la restrizione per afta epizootica (FMD) non si applica agli animali da compagnia
it.summary: Certificato su modello UE per un massimo di 5 animali: microchip e vaccinazione antirabbica valida (attesa di 21 giorni dopo la primaria). La titolazione anticorpale è richiesta solo in provenienza da, o in transito per, Paesi non in elenco. Per l'origine USA, il certificato va rilasciato e vidimato da APHIS entro 10 giorni dal viaggio (entro 24 ore se gli animali sono più di 5).

steps.what: Микрочип, затем вакцинация против бешенства
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной через 21 день
Сертификат образца ЕС, выданный и заверенный APHIS (США)

key_points: Более 5 животных: отдельная форма, сертификат в пределах 24 ч до поездки
Животные младше 16 недель — только с декларацией владельца или от привитой матери
Избегайте маршрутов через Германию или Венгрию, пока не подтверждено, что ограничение по ящуру не распространяется на домашних животных
ru.summary: Сертификат образца ЕС для не более 5 животных: микрочип и действующая прививка от бешенства (ожидание 21 день после первичной). Тест на титр антител нужен только при прибытии из стран вне перечня или через них. Для животных из США сертификат должен быть выдан и заверен APHIS в пределах 10 дней до поездки (в пределах 24 часов, если животных более 5).

countries.name: Russia
countries.summary: EAEU rules: up to 2 personal dogs/cats with an international pet passport (rabies and core vaccines, clinical-exam mark within 14 days of departure) need no permit or quarantine. Without a passport, or for unaccompanied pets, an EAEU Form 15 certificate is needed. More than 2 pets needs a permit (annual Form 1 permit covers up to 5). Flights are heavily restricted by sanctions.
countries.microchip: Not required by Rosselkhoznadzor for import (unidentified pets may be imported for home keeping); recommended
countries.rabies_titer: Not required (only an alternative to proof of valid vaccination)
countries.parasite_treatment: Not required
countries.import_permit: None for ≤2 personal dogs/cats with owner. >2 animals or unaccompanied: Rosselkhoznadzor permit via Argus system; annual generic Form No. 1 permit covers up to 5 pets from listed countries (non-commercial)
countries.quarantine: None for compliant personal pets
countries.timeline: Allow at least 5 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (rabies and core vaccines at least 20 days before travel): clinical exam stamped in the pet passport within 14 days, or an EAEU Form 15 certificate within 5 days, then entry at a border point with veterinary control.
countries.private_aviation: Heavily restricted: reciprocal airspace bans with EU/UK/US/Canada and others; US/EU/UK export controls and sanctions bar many business jets (US-origin or Western-registered/operated) from flying to Russia. Check with Elysium Jet operations before quoting. Entry only at border points with veterinary control. APHIS also notes temporary transit restrictions via Germany/Hungary for FMD-susceptible animals (not dog/cat specific)
countries.export: Rosselkhoznadzor: check destination rules; microchip (ISO) and rabies vaccination as required by destination; titer at approved lab for EU, Switzerland, UAE, Japan, Israel, Turkey, US (dogs) etc. Obtain Form No. 1 veterinary certificate from district state vet station (СББЖ) via Mercury, ≤5 days before departure. At airport veterinary control (or in advance at Rosselkhoznadzor offices/VGNKI, up to 5 days ahead, or online via ecert.vetrf.ru) exchange for EU certificate, Form 5a or destination-specific export certificate. No permit for owner-accompanied pets. Within EAEU (BY/KZ/AM/KG) Form 1 suffices.
countries.authority: Rosselkhoznadzor (Federal Service for Veterinary and Phytosanitary Surveillance), applying EAEU common veterinary requirements
vaccinations: Rabies: all dogs/cats ≥3 months, ≥20 days before dispatch unless vaccinated within last 12 months; 3-year vaccine accepted if vet confirms still valid; or titer ≥0.5 IU/ml
Dogs: distemper, hepatitis, parvovirus, adenovirus, leptospirosis (or dihydrostreptomycin prophylaxis) — ≥20 days before, within last 12 months
Cats: panleukopenia — ≥20 days before, within last 12 months
Unvaccinated puppies/kittens <3 months: only with Form 15 certificate
documents: ≤2 pets accompanied by owner: international veterinary passport with vaccination records and stamp of the origin country's competent authority confirming clinical exam within 14 days before shipment (serves as the veterinary certificate)
Otherwise: EAEU Veterinary Certificate Form 15 (US: APHIS-endorsed, exam within 5 days per APHIS guidance; APHIS page states Russia allows exam up to 14 days before)

steps.what: Check sanctions and airspace feasibility with Elysium Jet operations
Rabies and core vaccines at least 20 days before travel
Clinical exam stamped in the pet passport by the competent authority
Enter at a border point with veterinary control

key_points: Many business jets are barred by sanctions and airspace bans: check before quoting
More than 2 pets needs a Rosselkhoznadzor permit; the annual Form 1 permit covers up to 5
No passport or unaccompanied: EAEU Form 15 certificate instead
export_points: Form No. 1 certificate from the district state vet, ≤5 days before departure
Exchange it at airport vet control (or up to 5 days ahead) for the destination certificate
Titer at an approved lab for the EU, Switzerland, UAE, Japan, Israel, Turkey, US (dogs) and others

at_a_glance.permit: لا يوجد لـ≤2 من الحيوانات المرافقة

steps.what: التحقق من العقوبات وإمكانية استخدام المجال الجوي مع فريق العمليات في Elysium Jet
لقاح داء الكلب واللقاحات الأساسية قبل السفر بـ20 يومًا على الأقل
فحص سريري مختوم في جواز سفر الحيوان الأليف من السلطة المختصة
الدخول عبر منفذ حدودي فيه رقابة بيطرية

key_points: كثير من طائرات رجال الأعمال ممنوعة بسبب العقوبات وحظر المجال الجوي: يُرجى التحقق قبل تقديم العرض
أكثر من 2 من الحيوانات يتطلب تصريحًا من Rosselkhoznadzor؛ ويغطي التصريح السنوي النموذج 1 حتى 5
دون جواز أو دون مرافق: شهادة EAEU النموذج 15 بدلًا من ذلك
export_points: شهادة النموذج رقم 1 من الطبيب البيطري الحكومي في المنطقة، قبل المغادرة بـ≤5 أيام
تُستبدل في نقطة الرقابة البيطرية بالمطار (أو قبل ما يصل إلى 5 أيام) بشهادة بلد الوجهة
اختبار الأجسام المضادة في مختبر معتمد للاتحاد الأوروبي وسويسرا والإمارات واليابان وإسرائيل وتركيا والولايات المتحدة (الكلاب) وغيرها
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الاقتصادي الأوراسي (EAEU): لا يحتاج ما يصل إلى 2 من الكلاب/القطط الشخصية بجواز سفر دولي للحيوان الأليف (لقاح داء الكلب واللقاحات الأساسية، وإثبات فحص سريري خلال 14 يومًا من المغادرة) إلى تصريح أو حجر صحي. ودون جواز، أو للحيوانات غير المرافقة، تلزم شهادة EAEU النموذج 15. وأكثر من 2 من الحيوانات يتطلب تصريحًا (يغطي التصريح السنوي النموذج 1 حتى 5). الرحلات مقيدة بشدة بسبب العقوبات.

steps.what: Sanktionen und Luftraum-Machbarkeit mit Elysium Jet Operations prüfen
Tollwut- und Grundimpfungen mindestens 20 Tage vor der Reise
Klinische Untersuchung, von der zuständigen Behörde im Heimtierausweis abgestempelt
Einreise an einem Grenzübergang mit tierärztlicher Kontrolle

key_points: Viele Business Jets sind durch Sanktionen und Luftraumsperren ausgeschlossen: vor dem Angebot prüfen
Mehr als 2 Heimtiere erfordern eine Rosselchosnadsor-Genehmigung; die jährliche Genehmigung nach Formular 1 gilt für bis zu 5
Kein Heimtierausweis oder unbegleitet: stattdessen EAWU-Zeugnis nach Formular 15
export_points: Zeugnis nach Formular Nr. 1 vom staatlichen Bezirkstierarzt, ≤5 Tage vor Abflug
Bei der Veterinärkontrolle am Flughafen (oder bis zu 5 Tage vorher) gegen das Zeugnis für das Zielland eintauschen
Titer in einem zugelassenen Labor für EU, Schweiz, VAE, Japan, Israel, Türkei, USA (Hunde) u. a.
de.summary: EAWU-Regeln: bis zu 2 private Hunde/Katzen mit internationalem Heimtierausweis (Tollwut- und Grundimpfungen, Vermerk über klinische Untersuchung innerhalb von 14 Tagen vor Abflug) benötigen weder Genehmigung noch Quarantäne. Ohne Heimtierausweis oder bei unbegleiteten Tieren ist ein EAWU-Zeugnis nach Formular 15 erforderlich. Mehr als 2 Heimtiere erfordern eine Genehmigung (die jährliche Genehmigung nach Formular 1 gilt für bis zu 5). Flüge sind durch Sanktionen stark eingeschränkt.

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ≥20 días antes, en los 12 meses previos
at_a_glance.quarantine: Ninguna si se cumplen los requisitos

steps.what: Compruebe con operaciones de Elysium Jet la viabilidad respecto a sanciones y espacio aéreo
Vacunas antirrábica y básicas al menos 20 días antes del viaje
Examen clínico sellado en el pasaporte de la mascota por la autoridad competente
Entre por un paso fronterizo con control veterinario

key_points: Muchos jets ejecutivos tienen vetada la entrada por sanciones y prohibiciones de espacio aéreo: compruébelo antes de presupuestar
Más de 2 mascotas requieren un permiso del Rosselkhoznadzor; el permiso anual Form 1 cubre hasta 5
Sin pasaporte o no acompañadas: certificado EAEU Form 15 en su lugar
export_points: Certificado Form No. 1 del veterinario oficial del distrito, ≤5 días antes de la salida
Cámbielo en el control veterinario del aeropuerto (o hasta 5 días antes) por el certificado del destino
Titulación en un laboratorio autorizado para la UE, Suiza, EAU, Japón, Israel, Turquía, EE. UU. (perros) y otros
es.summary: Normas de la EAEU: hasta 2 perros/gatos personales con pasaporte internacional para mascotas (vacunas antirrábica y básicas, anotación del examen clínico en los 14 días previos a la salida) no necesitan permiso ni cuarentena. Sin pasaporte, o para mascotas no acompañadas, se necesita un certificado EAEU Form 15. Más de 2 mascotas requieren permiso (el permiso anual Form 1 cubre hasta 5). Los vuelos están muy restringidos por las sanciones.

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ≥ 20 jours avant, de moins de 12 mois

steps.what: Vérifier la faisabilité (sanctions et espace aérien) avec les opérations d'Elysium Jet
Vaccins antirabique et essentiels au moins 20 jours avant le voyage
Examen clinique tamponné dans le passeport de l'animal par l'autorité compétente
Entrer par un poste frontière doté d'un contrôle vétérinaire

key_points: De nombreux jets d'affaires sont exclus par les sanctions et interdictions d'espace aérien : à vérifier avant tout devis
Au-delà de 2 animaux, un permis du Rosselkhoznadzor est requis ; le permis annuel formulaire 1 couvre jusqu'à 5
Sans passeport ou non accompagné : certificat UEEA formulaire 15 à la place
export_points: Certificat formulaire n° 1 du vétérinaire d'État du district, ≤ 5 jours avant le départ
À échanger au contrôle vétérinaire de l'aéroport (ou jusqu'à 5 jours à l'avance) contre le certificat de destination
Titrage dans un laboratoire agréé pour l'UE, la Suisse, les Émirats arabes unis, le Japon, Israël, la Turquie, les États-Unis (chiens) et d'autres pays
fr.summary: Règles de l'UEEA : jusqu'à 2 chiens/chats personnels munis d'un passeport international pour animal de compagnie (vaccins antirabique et essentiels, mention d'examen clinique dans les 14 jours précédant le départ) ne nécessitent ni permis ni quarantaine. Sans passeport, ou pour un animal non accompagné, un certificat UEEA formulaire 15 est requis. Au-delà de 2 animaux, un permis est nécessaire (le permis annuel formulaire 1 couvre jusqu'à 5). Les vols sont fortement restreints par les sanctions.

steps.what: Verificare sanzioni e fattibilità dello spazio aereo con le operazioni di Elysium Jet
Vaccino antirabbico e vaccini essenziali almeno 20 giorni prima del viaggio
Visita clinica timbrata sul passaporto dell'animale dall'autorità competente
Ingresso da un valico di frontiera con controllo veterinario

key_points: Molti business jet sono esclusi da sanzioni e divieti di sorvolo: verificare prima di formulare un preventivo
Oltre 2 animali serve un permesso Rosselkhoznadzor; il permesso annuale Form 1 copre fino a 5
Senza passaporto o non accompagnati: certificato EAEU Form 15
export_points: Certificato Modulo n. 1 dal veterinario statale distrettuale, ≤5 giorni prima della partenza
Da convertire al controllo veterinario aeroportuale (o fino a 5 giorni prima) nel certificato per la destinazione
Titolazione presso un laboratorio approvato per UE, Svizzera, Emirati Arabi Uniti, Giappone, Israele, Turchia, USA (cani) e altri
it.summary: Norme EAEU: fino a 2 cani/gatti personali con passaporto internazionale per animali da compagnia (vaccino antirabbico e vaccini essenziali, annotazione della visita clinica entro 14 giorni dalla partenza) non necessitano di permesso né di quarantena. I voli sono fortemente limitati dalle sanzioni.

steps.what: Уточните возможности с учётом санкций и воздушного пространства в операционном отделе Elysium Jet
Прививки от бешенства и основные не менее чем за 20 дней до поездки
Отметка компетентного органа о клиническом осмотре в паспорте животного
Въезд через пограничный пункт с ветеринарным контролем

key_points: Многие бизнес-джеты ограничены санкциями и запретами на использование воздушного пространства: проверьте до расчёта стоимости
Для более чем 2 животных нужно разрешение Россельхознадзора; ежегодное разрешение по Форме 1 покрывает до 5
Без паспорта или без сопровождения: вместо этого сертификат ЕАЭС по Форме 15
export_points: Ветеринарное свидетельство Форма № 1 от районного госветеринара, ≤5 дней до вылета
Обменяйте его в ветеринарном контроле аэропорта (или не ранее чем за 5 дней) на сертификат страны назначения
Тест на титр в одобренной лаборатории для ЕС, Швейцарии, ОАЭ, Японии, Израиля, Турции, США (собаки) и других стран
ru.summary: Правила ЕАЭС: до 2 собак/кошек для личных целей с международным паспортом животного (прививки от бешенства и основные, отметка о клиническом осмотре в пределах 14 дней до вылета) — без разрешения и карантина. Без паспорта или для несопровождаемых животных требуется сертификат ЕАЭС по Форме 15. Для более чем 2 животных нужно разрешение (ежегодное разрешение по Форме 1 покрывает до 5). Авиасообщение существенно ограничено санкциями.

countries.export: Pets leaving Rwanda need an international veterinary certificate signed by an official veterinarian of RAB (Rwanda migration authority travel page).
countries.authority: Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board (RAB)
documents: Veterinary import permit (RAB)

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.summary: A MEWA pet entry/exit permit is required, applied for through the Naama platform (naama.sa) before shipment and valid 30 days. Cats and dogs must be at least 4 months old, microchipped, and carry an original government health certificate and a rabies vaccination with at least 6 months of validity remaining.
countries.microchip: Electronic microchip or other means of identification (MEWA Naama guide). The 2021 MEWA rules require a passport and an electronic microchip, and the microchip number must appear on the vaccination record uploaded with the application.
countries.rabies_titer: MEWA's rules (2021 rules and Naama guide) do not list a titer test. Confirm on Naama for the specific origin country before travel.
countries.parasite_treatment: Pets must be free of external parasites and diseases (2021 MEWA rules). No specific treatment window is stated.
countries.import_permit: Required: 'Pet entry and exit permit (dogs, cats)' on naama.sa (login via Nafath). Apply 15 days before shipment (MEWA Naama user guide). Valid 30 days from issue. Entry only through the port named on the permit. Individuals: one permit every 6 months, maximum 2 animals per permit. Applicant age: at least 21 for dogs and at least 18 for cats (the older 2021 rules said at least 30 for dogs). Diplomats are exempt from the age rule with an official letter. Commercial dog imports are not allowed. Import only from countries listed as permitted on the platform. MEWA may set arrival times according to quarantine capacity.
countries.quarantine: No routine quarantine is stated for compliant pets. MEWA may schedule arrival according to port quarantine capacity. The GCC veterinary quarantine law applies.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 21 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA or EU: apply for the Naama permit at least 15 days before shipment (valid 30 days), then the government health certificate and certificate of origin. The rabies vaccination must still have at least 6 months of validity at entry, so a booster may be needed first. From scratch, plan at least 6–8 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination → Naama permit → health certificate → enter only via the named port.
countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited (including crosses): Pit Bull, Rottweiler, Boxer, Mastiff, Tosa, Bulldog, Perro de Presa Canario.
countries.private_aviation: MEWA requires entry through the port named on the permit and IATA-compliant containers for air imports, and may set arrival times according to port quarantine capacity. Make sure the permit names the actual private-aviation arrival airport (e.g. Riyadh or Jeddah) and confirm MEWA veterinary inspection at the executive terminal with the handler before the flight.
countries.export: The same Naama 'pet entry and exit permit (dogs, cats)' service covers departures, with the same conditions (30-day validity, apply about 15 days ahead). The destination country's rules also apply.
countries.authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA), Naama platform
vaccinations: Rabies: valid vaccination, with at least 6 months of validity remaining (MEWA Naama service conditions). MEWA checks validity when issuing the permit.
Other vaccines according to the exporting country's approved vaccination programme (2021 MEWA rules).
documents: MEWA/Naama pet entry permit (copy or original)
Original government veterinary health certificate from the exporting country, or a digitally endorsed copy for US origin
Original or electronic certificate of origin (no Saudi embassy attestation needed, per the 2021 rules)
Vaccination record or pet passport
For the application: owner's ID, passport or iqama, pet photo, and passport or vaccination page showing the microchip number

steps.what: Microchip and rabies vaccination; booster if under 6 months validity left
Apply for the MEWA pet entry permit on naama.sa
Government health certificate and certificate of origin
