key_points: Max 2 pets per permit; one permit per person every 6 months
Pets at least 4 months old; applicant 21+ for dogs, 18+ for cats
Banned incl. crosses: Pit Bull, Rottweiler, Boxer, Mastiff, Tosa, Bulldog, Presa Canario
Permit must name the actual private-aviation arrival airport
export_points: The same Naama permit covers departures (valid 30 days, apply about 15 days ahead)
The destination country's rules also apply
countries.private_jet_note: Entry only through the port named on the Naama permit: make sure it names the actual arrival airport and confirm MEWA veterinary inspection at the executive terminal with the handler.

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ساري لـ≥6 أشهر إضافية عند الدخول

steps.what: الشريحة الإلكترونية والتطعيم ضد داء الكلب؛ وجرعة معززة إذا تبقى أقل من 6 أشهر من الصلاحية
التقدّم بطلب تصريح دخول الحيوان الأليف من MEWA عبر naama.sa
شهادة صحية حكومية وشهادة منشأ
الدخول فقط عبر المنفذ المذكور في التصريح

key_points: الحد الأقصى 2 من الحيوانات لكل تصريح؛ وتصريح واحد لكل شخص كل 6 أشهر
عمر الحيوان 4 أشهر على الأقل؛ وعمر مقدم الطلب 21+ للكلاب و18+ للقطط
محظورة بما فيها الهجائن: البيتبول، والروت وايلر، والبوكسر، والماستيف، والتوسا، والبولدوغ، والبريسا كاناريو
يجب أن يذكر التصريح مطار الوصول الفعلي للطيران الخاص
export_points: يغطي تصريح نعمى ذاته المغادرة (صالح 30 يومًا، ويُقدَّم الطلب قبل نحو 15 يومًا)
تُطبَّق أيضًا قواعد بلد الوجهة
ar.private_jet_note: الدخول فقط عبر المنفذ المذكور في تصريح نعمة (Naama): تأكّد من أنه يذكر مطار الوصول الفعلي، ويُرجى تأكيد الفحص البيطري من MEWA في صالة الطيران الخاص مع وكيل الخدمات الأرضية.
ar.summary: يلزم تصريح دخول/خروج للحيوانات الأليفة من MEWA، يُتقدَّم بطلبه عبر منصة نعمى (naama.sa) قبل الشحن وهو صالح 30 يومًا. ويجب ألا يقل عمر القطط والكلاب عن 4 أشهر، وأن تحمل شريحة إلكترونية، وشهادة صحية حكومية أصلية، وتطعيمًا ضد داء الكلب متبقيًا من صلاحيته 6 أشهر على الأقل.

steps.what: Mikrochip und Tollwutimpfung; Auffrischung bei weniger als 6 Monaten Restgültigkeit
MEWA-Einreisegenehmigung für Heimtiere auf naama.sa beantragen
Amtliches Gesundheitszeugnis und Ursprungszeugnis
Einreise nur über den in der Genehmigung genannten Eingangsort

key_points: Max. 2 Heimtiere pro Genehmigung; eine Genehmigung pro Person alle 6 Monate
Heimtiere mindestens 4 Monate alt; Antragsteller ab 21 Jahren für Hunde, ab 18 für Katzen
Verboten inkl. Mischlinge: Pit Bull, Rottweiler, Boxer, Mastiff, Tosa, Bulldogge, Presa Canario
Die Genehmigung muss den tatsächlichen Ankunftsflughafen der Privatluftfahrt nennen
export_points: Dieselbe Naama-Genehmigung gilt für die Ausreise (30 Tage gültig, ca. 15 Tage vorab beantragen)
Zudem gelten die Regeln des Ziellandes
de.private_jet_note: Einreise nur über den in der Naama-Genehmigung genannten Eingangsort: Stellen Sie sicher, dass dort der tatsächliche Ankunftsflughafen steht, und bestätigen Sie mit dem Handling-Agenten die MEWA-Veterinärkontrolle am Executive Terminal.
de.summary: Vor dem Transport ist eine MEWA-Ein-/Ausreisegenehmigung für Heimtiere erforderlich, zu beantragen über die Plattform Naama (naama.sa), 30 Tage gültig. Katzen und Hunde müssen mindestens 4 Monate alt und gechippt sein und ein amtliches Original-Gesundheitszeugnis sowie eine Tollwutimpfung mit mindestens 6 Monaten Restgültigkeit vorweisen.

at_a_glance.microchip: Obligatorio, número en la cartilla de vacunas
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: Validez restante ≥6 meses a la entrada
at_a_glance.titer: No figura en las normas del MEWA

steps.what: Microchip y vacunación antirrábica; refuerzo si quedan menos de 6 meses de validez
Solicite el permiso de entrada de mascotas del MEWA en naama.sa
Certificado sanitario oficial y certificado de origen
Entre solo por el puerto indicado en el permiso

key_points: Máximo 2 mascotas por permiso; un permiso por persona cada 6 meses
Mascotas de al menos 4 meses; solicitante de 21+ años para perros, 18+ para gatos
Prohibidos, incl. cruces: Pit Bull, Rottweiler, Bóxer, Mastín, Tosa, Bulldog, Presa Canario
El permiso debe indicar el aeropuerto real de llegada de la aviación privada
export_points: El mismo permiso Naama cubre las salidas (válido 30 días; solicítelo unos 15 días antes)
También se aplican las normas del país de destino
es.private_jet_note: Entrada solo por el puerto indicado en el permiso Naama: asegúrese de que indique el aeropuerto de llegada real y confirme con el handler la inspección veterinaria del MEWA en la terminal ejecutiva.
es.summary: Se requiere un permiso de entrada/salida de mascotas del MEWA, que se solicita a través de la plataforma Naama (naama.sa) antes del envío y es válido 30 días. Perros y gatos deben tener al menos 4 meses, llevar microchip y contar con un certificado sanitario oficial original y una vacunación antirrábica con al menos 6 meses de validez restante.

at_a_glance.microchip: Requise, n° sur le carnet de vaccination

steps.what: Puce électronique et vaccination antirabique ; rappel si moins de 6 mois de validité restante
Demander le permis d'entrée du MEWA sur naama.sa
Certificat sanitaire gouvernemental et certificat d'origine
Entrer uniquement par le point d'entrée indiqué sur le permis

key_points: 2 animaux maximum par permis ; un permis par personne tous les 6 mois
Animaux d'au moins 4 mois ; demandeur de 21+ ans pour les chiens, 18+ ans pour les chats
Interdits, croisements compris : Pit Bull, Rottweiler, Boxer, Mastiff, Tosa, Bulldog, Presa Canario
Le permis doit mentionner l'aéroport d'arrivée effectif de l'aviation privée
export_points: Le même permis Naama couvre les départs (valable 30 jours, à demander environ 15 jours à l'avance)
Les règles du pays de destination s'appliquent également
fr.private_jet_note: Entrée uniquement par le port indiqué sur le permis Naama : assurez-vous qu'il mentionne l'aéroport d'arrivée réel et confirmez avec l'agent d'assistance l'inspection vétérinaire du MEWA au terminal d'aviation d'affaires.
fr.summary: Un permis d'entrée/de sortie pour animal de compagnie du MEWA est requis ; il se demande via la plateforme Naama (naama.sa) avant l'expédition et est valable 30 jours. Chats et chiens doivent avoir au moins 4 mois, être identifiés par puce électronique et être accompagnés d'un certificat sanitaire gouvernemental original et d'une vaccination antirabique encore valable au moins 6 mois.

steps.what: Microchip e vaccinazione antirabbica; richiamo se la validità residua è inferiore a 6 mesi
Richiedere il permesso MEWA di ingresso su naama.sa
Certificato sanitario governativo e certificato di origine
Ingresso solo dallo scalo indicato nel permesso

key_points: Massimo 2 animali per permesso; un permesso per persona ogni 6 mesi
Animali di almeno 4 mesi; richiedente di almeno 21 anni per i cani, 18 per i gatti
Vietati, incl. incroci: Pit Bull, Rottweiler, Boxer, Mastiff, Tosa, Bulldog, Presa Canario
Il permesso deve indicare l'effettivo aeroporto di arrivo dell'aviazione privata
export_points: Lo stesso permesso Naama vale per le partenze (valido 30 giorni, da richiedere circa 15 giorni prima)
Si applicano anche le norme del Paese di destinazione
it.private_jet_note: Ingresso solo attraverso il porto indicato nel permesso Naama: assicurarsi che indichi l'effettivo aeroporto di arrivo e confermare con l'handler l'ispezione veterinaria MEWA presso il terminal executive.
it.summary: È necessario un permesso MEWA di ingresso/uscita per animali da compagnia, da richiedere tramite la piattaforma Naama (naama.sa) prima della spedizione e valido 30 giorni. Cani e gatti devono avere almeno 4 mesi, essere dotati di microchip ed essere accompagnati da un certificato sanitario governativo originale e da una vaccinazione antirabbica con almeno 6 mesi di validità residua.

at_a_glance.microchip: Обязателен, номер в записи о прививках
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: Действует ещё ≥6 месяцев на дату въезда

steps.what: Микрочип и вакцинация против бешенства; ревакцинация, если до окончания срока менее 6 месяцев
Подайте заявку на разрешение MEWA на въезд животного на naama.sa
Государственный ветеринарный сертификат и сертификат происхождения
Въезд только через пункт, указанный в разрешении

key_points: Не более 2 животных на разрешение; одно разрешение на человека раз в 6 месяцев
Животным не менее 4 месяцев; заявителю 21+ год для собак, 18+ лет для кошек
Запрещены, включая помеси: питбуль, ротвейлер, боксёр, мастиф, тоса, бульдог, перро де преса канарио
В разрешении должен быть указан фактический аэропорт прибытия частного рейса
export_points: То же разрешение Naama распространяется на выезд (действует 30 дней, заявка примерно за 15 дней)
Также применяются правила страны назначения
ru.private_jet_note: Въезд только через пункт, указанный в разрешении Naama: убедитесь, что в нём указан фактический аэропорт прибытия, и подтвердите у хендлинга ветеринарный досмотр MEWA в терминале деловой авиации.
ru.summary: Требуется разрешение MEWA на въезд/выезд животного, оформляемое через платформу Naama (naama.sa) до отправки и действующее 30 дней. Кошкам и собакам должно быть не менее 4 месяцев; они должны иметь микрочип, оригинал государственного ветеринарного сертификата и прививку от бешенства с оставшимся сроком действия не менее 6 месяцев.

countries.name: Solomon Islands
countries.summary: Solomon Islands needs an import permit, a statutory declaration and a government vet health certificate. Dogs and cats must be desexed. The dog certificate (May 2021 permit) requires that rabies and canine brucellosis have not been diagnosed in the exporting country in the 5 years before export. In practice this excludes non-rabies-free origins such as the USA. Only dogs and cats from Australia or New Zealand are exempt from vet inspection before release from port.
countries.import_permit: Yes. Biosecurity Solomon Islands (enquiries@biosecurity.gov.sb). Permit conditions take precedence.
countries.quarantine: Biosecurity may inspect, test, detain or treat. Animals other than dogs and cats from Australia or NZ must be inspected by an approved vet before release. Non-compliant animals are destroyed or re-exported at the importer's cost.
countries.restricted_breeds: Dogs and cats must be desexed before import.
countries.private_aviation: The origin condition (no rabies diagnosed in the exporting country for 5 years) blocks direct entry from the USA and other rabies-affected origins.
countries.authority: Biosecurity Solomon Islands (Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock)
vaccinations: Dogs: distemper, hepatitis, canine parvovirus and parainfluenza (per the permit-based certificate).
documents: Import permit (Biosecurity Solomon Islands)
Owner/exporter statutory declaration (no disease signs and no contact with sick animals in the 30 days before export)
Government vet health certificate, one per animal
key_points: Dogs and cats must be desexed
Origin must have had no rabies for 5 years: excludes the USA
Statutory declaration: no disease signs or sick contacts in the last 30 days
Non-compliant animals are destroyed or re-exported at the importer's cost
countries.private_jet_note: Direct entry from the USA and other rabies-affected origins is blocked by the 5-year rabies-free origin rule. Confirm eligibility with Biosecurity Solomon Islands before planning.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: طبيب بيطري حكومي، شهادة لكل حيوان

key_points: يجب أن تكون الكلاب والقطط مُعقَّمة
يجب أن يكون بلد المنشأ خاليًا من داء الكلب لـ5 سنوات: يستبعد الولايات المتحدة
إقرار قانوني: لا علامات مرض ولا مخالطة لحيوانات مريضة خلال آخر 30 يومًا
تُعدم الحيوانات غير المستوفية أو يُعاد تصديرها على نفقة المستورد
ar.private_jet_note: يمنع شرط خلو بلد المنشأ من داء الكلب لـ5 سنوات الدخول المباشر من الولايات المتحدة وغيرها من البلدان المتأثرة بداء الكلب. يُرجى تأكيد الأهلية مع هيئة الأمن الحيوي في جزر سليمان قبل التخطيط.
ar.summary: تشترط جزر سليمان تصريح استيراد، وإقرارًا قانونيًا، وشهادة صحية من طبيب بيطري حكومي. ويجب أن تكون الكلاب والقطط مُعقَّمة. وتشترط شهادة الكلاب (تصريح مايو 2021) عدم تشخيص داء الكلب وداء البروسيلات الكلبي في بلد التصدير خلال الـ5 سنوات السابقة للتصدير. وعمليًا يستبعد ذلك بلدان المنشأ غير الخالية من داء الكلب مثل الولايات المتحدة. ولا تُعفى من الفحص البيطري قبل الإفراج من المنفذ إلا الكلاب والقطط القادمة من أستراليا أو نيوزيلندا.

key_points: Hunde und Katzen müssen kastriert sein
Herkunftsland muss 5 Jahre tollwutfrei sein: schließt die USA aus
Eidesstattliche Erklärung: keine Krankheitsanzeichen oder Kontakt zu kranken Tieren in den letzten 30 Tagen
Nicht konforme Tiere werden auf Kosten des Einführers getötet oder wieder ausgeführt
de.private_jet_note: Die Direkteinreise aus den USA und anderen tollwutbetroffenen Herkunftsländern ist durch die Regel der 5-jährigen Tollwutfreiheit ausgeschlossen. Bitte die Berechtigung vor der Planung mit Biosecurity Solomon Islands klären.
de.summary: Die Salomonen verlangen eine Einfuhrgenehmigung, eine eidesstattliche Erklärung und ein Gesundheitszeugnis eines Amtstierarztes. Hunde und Katzen müssen kastriert sein. Das Hundezeugnis (Genehmigung von Mai 2021) verlangt, dass Tollwut und Hunde-Brucellose im Ausfuhrland in den 5 Jahren vor der Ausfuhr nicht diagnostiziert wurden. In der Praxis schließt dies nicht tollwutfreie Herkunftsländer wie die USA aus. Nur Hunde und Katzen aus Australien oder Neuseeland sind vor der Freigabe im Hafen von der tierärztlichen Kontrolle befreit.

key_points: Perros y gatos deben estar esterilizados
El origen debe llevar 5 años sin rabia: excluye EE. UU.
Declaración jurada: sin signos de enfermedad ni contacto con animales enfermos en los últimos 30 días
Los animales no conformes se sacrifican o se reexpiden a cargo del importador
es.private_jet_note: La entrada directa desde EE. UU. y otros orígenes con rabia queda bloqueada por la norma de origen libre de rabia durante 5 años. Confirme la admisibilidad con Biosecurity Solomon Islands antes de planificar.
es.summary: Las Islas Salomón exigen un permiso de importación, una declaración jurada (statutory declaration) y un certificado sanitario de un veterinario oficial. Perros y gatos deben estar esterilizados. El certificado para perros (permiso de mayo de 2021) exige que no se haya diagnosticado rabia ni brucelosis canina en el país exportador en los 5 años previos a la exportación. En la práctica, esto excluye orígenes no libres de rabia como EE. UU. Solo los perros y gatos procedentes de Australia o Nueva Zelanda están exentos de la inspección veterinaria antes de su liberación en el puerto.

key_points: Chiens et chats doivent être stérilisés
Le pays d'origine doit être indemne de rage depuis 5 ans : les États-Unis sont exclus
Déclaration sur l'honneur : aucun signe de maladie ni contact avec un animal malade au cours des 30 derniers jours
Les animaux non conformes sont euthanasiés ou réexportés aux frais de l'importateur
fr.private_jet_note: L'entrée directe depuis les États-Unis et d'autres pays touchés par la rage est impossible en raison de la règle d'origine indemne de rage depuis 5 ans. Confirmez l'éligibilité auprès de Biosecurity Solomon Islands avant toute planification.
fr.summary: Les Îles Salomon exigent un permis d'importation, une déclaration sur l'honneur officielle et un certificat sanitaire d'un vétérinaire officiel. Chiens et chats doivent être stérilisés. Le certificat pour chiens (permis de mai 2021) exige que ni la rage ni la brucellose canine n'aient été diagnostiquées dans le pays exportateur au cours des 5 années précédant l'exportation. En pratique, cela exclut les pays non indemnes de rage, comme les États-Unis. Seuls les chiens et chats en provenance d'Australie ou de Nouvelle-Zélande sont dispensés d'inspection vétérinaire avant leur sortie du port.

key_points: Cani e gatti devono essere sterilizzati
L'origine deve essere indenne da rabbia da 5 anni: esclusi gli USA
Dichiarazione giurata: nessun segno di malattia né contatti con animali malati negli ultimi 30 giorni
Gli animali non in regola vengono soppressi o rispediti a spese dell'importatore
it.private_jet_note: L'ingresso diretto dagli USA e da altre origini colpite dalla rabbia è precluso dalla regola dei 5 anni di indennità da rabbia. Si raccomanda di confermare l'ammissibilità con Biosecurity Solomon Islands prima di pianificare il viaggio.
it.summary: Le Isole Salomone richiedono un permesso d'importazione, una dichiarazione giurata e un certificato sanitario di un veterinario governativo. Cani e gatti devono essere sterilizzati. Il certificato per i cani (permesso di maggio 2021) richiede che rabbia e brucellosi canina non siano state diagnosticate nel Paese esportatore nei 5 anni precedenti l'esportazione. In pratica ciò esclude le origini non indenni da rabbia, come gli USA. Solo cani e gatti provenienti da Australia o Nuova Zelanda sono esentati dall'ispezione veterinaria prima del rilascio dal porto.

key_points: Собаки и кошки должны быть стерилизованы
В стране отправления не должно быть бешенства 5 лет: исключает США
Официальная декларация: отсутствие признаков болезни и контактов с больными животными за последние 30 дней
Несоответствующие животные уничтожаются или реэкспортируются за счёт импортёра
ru.private_jet_note: Прямой въезд из США и других стран, неблагополучных по бешенству, невозможен из-за правила 5 лет без бешенства в стране отправления. Уточните допустимость в Biosecurity Solomon Islands до планирования.
ru.summary: Соломоновы Острова требуют разрешения на ввоз, официальной декларации (statutory declaration) и ветеринарного сертификата государственного ветеринара. Собаки и кошки должны быть стерилизованы. Сертификат для собак (разрешение от мая 2021 г.) требует, чтобы в стране вывоза за 5 лет до вывоза не диагностировались бешенство и бруцеллёз собак. На практике это исключает страны, не свободные от бешенства, такие как США. Только собаки и кошки из Австралии или Новой Зеландии освобождены от ветеринарного осмотра перед выпуском из порта.

countries.name: Seychelles
countries.summary: A veterinary import permit from the National Biosecurity Agency is required for every dog and cat. Apply at least 4 months ahead from rabies-infected countries, or 4 weeks ahead from rabies-free countries. Confirm the health, quarantine and transport conditions with the National Biosecurity Agency before travel; they are set on the permit.
countries.microchip: Microchip number required on the permit application.
countries.import_permit: Mandatory. Apply to the Chief Executive Officer of the National Biosecurity Agency at least 4 months ahead (rabies-infected countries) or 4 weeks ahead (rabies-free countries). Permits are valid for a limited period and one consignment only; the conditions on the permit must be followed. Phone the veterinary services if the permit has not arrived two weeks after applying.
countries.timeline: Apply for the import permit at least 4 months before entry from rabies-infected countries (such as the USA and most of the EU), or 4 weeks before from rabies-free countries, then follow the conditions on the permit.
countries.authority: National Biosecurity Agency (formerly Seychelles Agricultural Agency – Veterinary Services)
documents: Veterinary import permit (National Biosecurity Agency)
Original veterinary certificates as set on the permit, presented at the port of entry

steps.what: Apply for the import permit to the National Biosecurity Agency (4 weeks from rabies-free countries)
Phone the veterinary services if the permit has not arrived
Meet the conditions on the permit; originals go to the port of entry

key_points: Permits cover one consignment only and are not transferable
Health, quarantine and transport conditions are set on the permit
countries.private_jet_note: Confirm with the National Biosecurity Agency, when applying for the permit, how a pet on a private flight will be cleared.

at_a_glance.permit: التقديم قبل 4 أشهر (منشأ موبوء بداء الكلب)

steps.what: التقدّم بطلب تصريح الاستيراد إلى الوكالة الوطنية للأمن الحيوي (قبل 4 أسابيع من الدول الخالية من داء الكلب)
الاتصال هاتفيًا بالخدمات البيطرية إذا لم يصل التصريح
استيفاء الشروط الواردة في التصريح؛ وتُسلَّم النسخ الأصلية في منفذ الدخول

key_points: يغطي التصريح شحنة واحدة فقط وغير قابل للتحويل
تُحدَّد الشروط الصحية وشروط الحجر الصحي والنقل في التصريح
ar.private_jet_note: يُرجى التأكد مع الوكالة الوطنية للأمن الحيوي، عند التقدّم بطلب التصريح، من كيفية تخليص الحيوان الأليف القادم على رحلة خاصة.
ar.summary: يلزم تصريح استيراد بيطري من الوكالة الوطنية للأمن الحيوي لكل كلب وقطة. ويُقدَّم الطلب قبل 4 أشهر على الأقل للقادمين من دول موبوءة بداء الكلب، أو قبل 4 أسابيع للقادمين من دول خالية منه. يُرجى تأكيد الشروط الصحية وشروط الحجر الصحي والنقل مع الوكالة الوطنية للأمن الحيوي قبل السفر؛ إذ تُحدَّد في التصريح.

steps.what: Einfuhrgenehmigung bei der National Biosecurity Agency beantragen (4 Wochen aus tollwutfreien Ländern)
Veterinärdienste anrufen, falls die Genehmigung nicht eingetroffen ist
Auflagen der Genehmigung erfüllen; Originale gehen an den Eingangsort

key_points: Genehmigungen gelten nur für eine Sendung und sind nicht übertragbar
Gesundheits-, Quarantäne- und Transportbedingungen werden in der Genehmigung festgelegt
de.private_jet_note: Klären Sie bei der Beantragung der Genehmigung mit der National Biosecurity Agency, wie ein Tier auf einem Privatflug abgefertigt wird.
de.summary: Für jeden Hund und jede Katze ist eine Veterinär-Einfuhrgenehmigung der National Biosecurity Agency erforderlich. Aus tollwutbetroffenen Ländern mindestens 4 Monate im Voraus beantragen, aus tollwutfreien Ländern 4 Wochen im Voraus. Bitte Gesundheits-, Quarantäne- und Transportbedingungen vor der Reise bei der National Biosecurity Agency bestätigen lassen; sie werden in der Genehmigung festgelegt.

steps.what: Solicite el permiso de importación a la National Biosecurity Agency (4 semanas desde países libres de rabia)
Llame a los servicios veterinarios si el permiso no ha llegado
Cumpla las condiciones del permiso; los originales van al puerto de entrada

key_points: Los permisos cubren un solo envío y no son transferibles
Las condiciones sanitarias, de cuarentena y de transporte se fijan en el permiso
es.private_jet_note: Al solicitar el permiso, confirme con la National Biosecurity Agency cómo se despachará una mascota que llegue en vuelo privado.
es.summary: Se requiere un permiso veterinario de importación de la National Biosecurity Agency para cada perro y gato. Solicítelo con al menos 4 meses de antelación desde países afectados por la rabia, o 4 semanas desde países libres de rabia. Confirme con la National Biosecurity Agency las condiciones sanitarias, de cuarentena y de transporte antes del viaje; se fijan en el permiso.

steps.what: Demander le permis d'importation à la National Biosecurity Agency (4 semaines avant depuis les pays indemnes de rage)
Téléphoner aux services vétérinaires si le permis n'est pas arrivé
Respecter les conditions du permis ; les originaux sont remis au port d'entrée

key_points: Chaque permis ne couvre qu'un seul envoi et n'est pas transférable
Les conditions sanitaires, de quarantaine et de transport sont fixées dans le permis
fr.private_jet_note: Lors de la demande de permis, confirmez auprès de la National Biosecurity Agency les modalités de dédouanement d'un animal arrivant par vol privé.
fr.summary: Un permis d'importation vétérinaire de la National Biosecurity Agency est requis pour chaque chien et chat. Faites la demande au moins 4 mois à l'avance depuis les pays touchés par la rage, ou 4 semaines à l'avance depuis les pays indemnes de rage. Confirmez les conditions sanitaires, de quarantaine et de transport auprès de la National Biosecurity Agency avant le voyage ; elles sont fixées dans le permis.

steps.what: Richiedere il permesso d'importazione alla National Biosecurity Agency (4 settimane prima dai Paesi indenni da rabbia)
Telefonare ai servizi veterinari se il permesso non è arrivato
Rispettare le condizioni del permesso; gli originali vanno al porto d'ingresso

key_points: I permessi coprono una sola spedizione e non sono trasferibili
Le condizioni sanitarie, di quarantena e di trasporto sono stabilite nel permesso
it.private_jet_note: Al momento della domanda del permesso, verificare con la National Biosecurity Agency come verrà sdoganato un animale su un volo privato.
it.summary: Per ogni cane e gatto è necessario un permesso veterinario d'importazione della National Biosecurity Agency. La domanda va presentata almeno 4 mesi prima dai Paesi con presenza di rabbia, o 4 settimane prima dai Paesi indenni da rabbia. Prima del viaggio, verificare con la National Biosecurity Agency le condizioni sanitarie, di quarantena e di trasporto, che sono stabilite nel permesso.

steps.what: Подайте заявку на разрешение на ввоз в Национальное агентство биобезопасности (за 4 недели из стран, свободных от бешенства)
Позвоните в ветеринарную службу, если разрешение не поступило
Выполните условия разрешения; оригиналы направляются в пункт въезда

key_points: Разрешение действует только на одну партию и не подлежит передаче
Ветеринарные, карантинные и транспортные условия устанавливаются в разрешении
ru.private_jet_note: При подаче заявки на разрешение уточните в Национальном агентстве биобезопасности, как будет оформлено животное на частном рейсе.
ru.summary: Для каждой собаки и кошки требуется ветеринарное разрешение на ввоз от Национального агентства биобезопасности. Подайте заявку не менее чем за 4 месяца из стран, неблагополучных по бешенству, или за 4 недели из стран, свободных от бешенства. До поездки уточните ветеринарные, карантинные и транспортные условия в Национальном агентстве биобезопасности; они устанавливаются в разрешении.

countries.name: Sweden
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the Swedish Board of Agriculture before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Sweden and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Only two points of entry: Stockholm-Arlanda and Gothenburg-Landvetter airports. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Swedish Board of Agriculture (Jordbruksverket)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.
Young animals: Sweden does not accept unvaccinated or insufficiently vaccinated young pets (under about 15 weeks) from other EU states; they are never allowed from outside the EU.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: EU passport, or EU certificate ≤10 days (non-EU)

steps.what: ISO microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12+ weeks old)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid
From the US: EU health certificate endorsed by USDA APHIS; from the EU: EU pet passport
Carry the signed non-commercial declaration (non-EU origins)
From outside the EU: document and identity check at a travellers' point of entry

key_points: Max 5 pets per movement; each travels with the owner or within 5 days
From unlisted countries (e.g. Türkiye, Morocco, Israel, Thailand, South Africa): titer test plus a 3-month wait
Old-model EU certificates are accepted only if issued before 1 Oct 2026
export_points: To EU/EEA countries: EU pet passport from an authorised vet
Dogs going to FI, IE, MT, NO or Northern Ireland also need tapeworm treatment
To non-EU countries: meet destination rules; the official vet service endorses certificates
countries.private_jet_note: From outside the EU, land at Stockholm-Arlanda or Gothenburg-Landvetter, the only pet points of entry, and present the pet for checks.

at_a_glance.microchip: شريحة ISO، قبل لقاح داء الكلب
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: قبل الدخول بـ≥21 يومًا، بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا
at_a_glance.health_certificate: جواز أو شهادة أوروبية ≤10 أيام (خارج الاتحاد)

steps.what: شريحة ISO، ثم لقاح داء الكلب (للحيوان بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا)
يصبح التطعيم الأولي ضد داء الكلب صالحًا
من الولايات المتحدة: شهادة صحية أوروبية مصادق عليها من USDA APHIS؛ ومن الاتحاد الأوروبي: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف
حمل الإقرار الموقّع بأن النقل غير تجاري (للقادمين من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي)
من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: تدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين

key_points: الحد الأقصى 5 حيوانات لكل تنقّل؛ ويسافر كل منها مع المالك أو خلال 5 أيام
من الدول غير المُدرجة (مثل تركيا والمغرب وإسرائيل وتايلاند وجنوب أفريقيا): اختبار الأجسام المضادة مع انتظار 3 أشهر
لا تُقبل الشهادات الأوروبية بالنموذج القديم إلا إذا صدرت قبل 1 أكتوبر 2026
export_points: إلى دول الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف من طبيب بيطري معتمد
تحتاج الكلاب المتجهة إلى FI أو IE أو MT أو NO أو أيرلندا الشمالية أيضًا إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية
إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات
ar.private_jet_note: عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، يجب الهبوط في ستوكهولم-أرلاندا أو غوتنبرغ-لاندفيتر، وهما نقطتا الدخول الوحيدتان للحيوانات الأليفة، وتقديم الحيوان الأليف للفحص.
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين.

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
Die Tollwut-Erstimpfung wird gültig
Aus den USA: von USDA APHIS beglaubigtes EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; aus der EU: EU-Heimtierausweis
Die unterschriebene Erklärung zur nicht kommerziellen Verbringung mitführen (Nicht-EU-Herkunft)
Von außerhalb der EU: Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrolle an einem Eingangsort für Reisende

key_points: Max. 5 Heimtiere pro Verbringung; jedes reist mit dem Halter oder innerhalb von 5 Tagen
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern (z. B. Türkei, Marokko, Israel, Thailand, Südafrika): Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit
EU-Zeugnisse nach altem Muster werden nur akzeptiert, wenn sie vor dem 1. Okt. 2026 ausgestellt wurden
export_points: In EU-/EWR-Länder: EU-Heimtierausweis von einem ermächtigten Tierarzt
Hunde nach FI, IE, MT, NO oder Nordirland benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Bestimmungen des Ziellandes erfüllen; der amtliche Veterinärdienst beglaubigt die Zeugnisse
de.private_jet_note: Bei Anreise von außerhalb der EU landen Sie in Stockholm-Arlanda oder Göteborg-Landvetter, den einzigen Eingangsorten für Heimtiere, und führen das Tier zur Kontrolle vor.
de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende.

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, antes de la vacuna antirrábica
at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: ≥21 días antes de entrar, con 12+ semanas
at_a_glance.titer: No se requiere desde EE. UU./UE
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Pasaporte UE o certif. UE ≤10 días (no UE)
at_a_glance.quarantine: Ninguna si se cumplen los requisitos

steps.what: Microchip ISO y, después, vacuna antirrábica (mascota de 12+ semanas)
La primovacunación antirrábica pasa a ser válida
Desde EE. UU.: certificado sanitario de la UE refrendado por USDA APHIS; desde la UE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas
Lleve la declaración firmada de no comercialidad (orígenes fuera de la UE)
Desde fuera de la UE: control documental y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros

key_points: Máx. 5 mascotas por desplazamiento; cada una viaja con el propietario o en un plazo de 5 días
Desde países no incluidos en la lista (p. ej., Turquía, Marruecos, Israel, Tailandia, Sudáfrica): prueba de titulación más 3 meses de espera
Los certificados UE del modelo anterior solo se aceptan si se emitieron antes del 1 de octubre de 2026
export_points: A países de la UE/EEE: pasaporte europeo para mascotas de un veterinario autorizado
Los perros con destino a FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Norte necesitan además tratamiento contra la tenia
A países fuera de la UE: cumpla las normas del destino; el servicio veterinario oficial refrenda los certificados
es.private_jet_note: Desde fuera de la UE, aterrice en Estocolmo-Arlanda o Gotemburgo-Landvetter, los únicos puntos de entrada para mascotas, y presente la mascota para los controles.
es.summary: Normas de la UE (Reglamento Delegado (UE) 2026/131): desde otro Estado de la UE/EEE, mascota con microchip, vacunación antirrábica válida y pasaporte europeo para mascotas; desde fuera de la UE, certificado zoosanitario de la UE (más prueba de titulación antirrábica con 3 meses de espera si el país no figura en la lista) y controles documentales y de identidad en un punto de entrada de viajeros.

at_a_glance.microchip: Puce ISO, avant le vaccin antirabique
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passeport UE ; hors UE, certificat ≤10 jours

steps.what: Puce électronique ISO, puis vaccin antirabique (animal âgé d'au moins 12 semaines)
La primovaccination antirabique devient valable
Depuis les États-Unis : certificat sanitaire UE visé par l'USDA APHIS ; depuis l'UE : passeport européen pour animal de compagnie
Munissez-vous de la déclaration signée attestant le caractère non commercial (origines hors UE)
Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE : contrôle documentaire et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs

key_points: 5 animaux max. par mouvement ; chacun voyage avec le propriétaire ou dans un délai de 5 jours
Depuis les pays non listés (p. ex. Turquie, Maroc, Israël, Thaïlande, Afrique du Sud) : titrage des anticorps antirabiques plus attente de 3 mois
Les certificats UE de l'ancien modèle ne sont acceptés que s'ils ont été délivrés avant le 1er oct. 2026
export_points: Vers les pays de l'UE/EEE : passeport européen délivré par un vétérinaire habilité
Les chiens à destination de FI, IE, MT, NO ou de l'Irlande du Nord nécessitent aussi un traitement contre le ténia
Vers les pays hors UE : respecter les règles du pays de destination ; le service vétérinaire officiel vise les certificats
fr.private_jet_note: Depuis l'extérieur de l'UE, atterrissez à Stockholm-Arlanda ou à Göteborg-Landvetter, seuls points d'entrée pour animaux de compagnie, et présentez l'animal aux contrôles.
fr.summary: Règles de l'UE (règlement délégué (UE) 2026/131) : depuis un autre État de l'UE/EEE, animal identifié par puce électronique, avec vaccination antirabique valide et passeport européen pour animal de compagnie ; depuis l'extérieur de l'UE, certificat sanitaire de l'UE (plus titrage des anticorps antirabiques avec attente de 3 mois si le pays n'est pas listé) et contrôles documentaires et d'identité à un point d'entrée des voyageurs.

at_a_glance.microchip: Chip ISO, prima del vaccino antirabbico
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Passaporto UE, o cert. UE ≤10 gg (extra UE)

steps.what: Microchip ISO, poi vaccino antirabbico (animale di 12+ settimane)
La vaccinazione antirabbica primaria diventa valida
Dagli Stati Uniti: certificato sanitario UE vidimato da USDA APHIS; dall'UE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia
Portare con sé la dichiarazione firmata di movimentazione non commerciale (origini extra UE)
Da fuori UE: controllo documentale e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori

key_points: Max 5 animali per movimentazione; ciascuno viaggia con il proprietario o entro 5 giorni
Da Paesi non elencati (ad es. Turchia, Marocco, Israele, Thailandia, Sudafrica): titolazione più attesa di 3 mesi
I certificati UE del vecchio modello sono accettati solo se rilasciati prima del 1 ott 2026
export_points: Verso Paesi UE/SEE: passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia rilasciato da un veterinario autorizzato
I cani diretti in FI, IE, MT, NO o Irlanda del Nord necessitano anche del trattamento contro la tenia (Echinococcus)
Verso Paesi extra UE: rispettare le norme della destinazione; il servizio veterinario ufficiale vidima i certificati
it.private_jet_note: Da fuori UE, l'atterraggio va previsto a Stoccolma-Arlanda o Göteborg-Landvetter, unici punti d'ingresso per animali da compagnia, presentando l'animale per i controlli.
it.summary: Norme UE (Regolamento delegato (UE) 2026/131): da un altro Stato UE/SEE, animale con microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica valida e passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia; da fuori UE, certificato sanitario UE per animali (più titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici con attesa di 3 mesi se il Paese non è elencato) e controlli documentali e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori.

at_a_glance.microchip: Чип ISO, до прививки от бешенства
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Паспорт или сертификат ЕС ≤10 дней (не из ЕС)

steps.what: Микрочип ISO, затем прививка от бешенства (животному 12+ недель)
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной
Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС, заверенный USDA APHIS; из ЕС: европейский паспорт животного
Имейте при себе подписанную декларацию о некоммерческом перемещении (не из ЕС)
Из-за пределов ЕС: проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников

key_points: Не более 5 животных за одно перемещение; каждое следует с владельцем или в пределах 5 дней
Из стран вне перечня (например, Турция, Марокко, Израиль, Таиланд, ЮАР): тест на титр плюс ожидание 3 месяца
Сертификаты ЕС старого образца принимаются, только если выданы до 1 октября 2026 г.
export_points: В страны ЕС/ЕЭЗ: европейский паспорт животного от уполномоченного ветеринара
Собакам, направляющимся в FI, IE, MT, NO или Северную Ирландию, также нужна обработка от ленточных червей
В страны вне ЕС: соблюдайте правила страны назначения; сертификаты заверяет официальная ветеринарная служба
ru.private_jet_note: При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС совершайте посадку в Стокгольме-Арланде или Гётеборге-Ландветтере — единственных пунктах въезда для животных — и предъявите животное для проверки.
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.summary: Rules depend on the origin's AVS schedule. Schedule I (AU, NZ, IE, UK): no quarantine. Schedule II (e.g. USA, Canada, Japan, Hong Kong, most of Western Europe, New Caledonia): no quarantine if the pet arrives within 5 days of the owner and has lived with them for 6+ months, otherwise at least 10 days of quarantine. Schedule III (everywhere else): at least 30 days at the Animal Quarantine Centre (AQC). Every pet needs a dog/cat licence and an AVS import licence.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784 or ISO 11785 Annex A. The chip number must appear on all vaccination and treatment records.
countries.rabies_titer: Schedule II and III: rabies serology of at least 0.5 IU/ml. The blood sample must be taken at least 28 days after a valid vaccination, and between 90 days and 12 months before export. The lab must be a WOAH reference lab or one approved by the competent authority of a Schedule I or II country.
countries.parasite_treatment: Parasite treatments and the veterinary health certificate must both be done 2 to 7 days before export, as set out in the schedule-specific veterinary conditions.
countries.import_permit: Yes: an AVS import licence (personal: S$50 normal, 2 working days; S$100 express, 1 working day), valid 90 days. The dog or cat licence must be obtained first. The USDA summary says to apply 30 days before arrival.
countries.quarantine: Schedule I: none. Schedule II: none if the pet arrives less than 5 days after the owner's entry and has lived at the owner's address for 6+ months; otherwise at least 10 days of home quarantine (smart collar, S$29/animal/day, apply via FormSG first) for personal imports, or 10 days at AQC for commercial imports. Schedule III: at least 30 days at AQC (Sembawang), booked through the Quarantine Management System once the serology result is ready.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 100 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA or EU (Schedule II) without serology on file: the blood sample must be taken at least 90 days before export (and at least 28 days after a valid vaccination). With valid serology already on file, or from the UK (Schedule I), about 2–3 weeks. Steps: serology → AQC booking if Schedule III → dog/cat licence → AVS import licence → inspection booked at least 5 days before arrival → vet certificate and parasite treatments 2–7 days before export. From scratch, plan at least 4–7 months for Schedule II/III and about 1 month for Schedule I. UAE (Schedule III): add 30 days at AQC.
countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited dogs: Pit Bull types (American Pit Bull Terrier, American Staffordshire Terrier, Staffordshire Bull Terrier, American Bulldog), Akita, Boerboel, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, Neapolitan Mastiff, Tosa, Perro de Presa Canario, and crosses of any of these. Cats: F1-F4 Bengal or Savannah crosses are prohibited. Housing limits apply (e.g. HDB flats). Minimum age 12 weeks at export.
countries.private_aviation: AVS describes air clearance only at the Changi Animal & Plant Quarantine Station (Changi Airfreight Centre); for arrivals at other checkpoints, AVS advises on clearance when the import licence is issued. In-cabin or excess-baggage pets must be in a rigid IATA crate (no soft bags). Before routing a private flight to Seletar, confirm with AVS and the FBO where the inspection will take place.
countries.export: AVS publishes separate 'Exporting dogs and cats' procedures (avs.nparks.gov.sg); follow them and the destination's rules.
countries.authority: Animal & Veterinary Service (AVS), National Parks Board (NParks)
vaccinations: Rabies (Schedule II and III only): valid inactivated or recombinant vaccine, with no lapse in cover. Schedule I pets need no rabies vaccine or serology.
Dogs: canine distemper, adenovirus type 1, parvovirus type 2.
Cats: feline calicivirus, herpesvirus-1, panleukopaenia.
Schedule III pets are vaccinated against rabies again on arrival at AQC.
documents: Dog licence or cat licence (PALS), obtained before the import licence
AVS import licence via GoBusiness (valid 90 days, cannot be extended)
Veterinary health certificate in the schedule-specific format: Sections I-III by the treating vet, Section IV endorsed by an official government vet, issued 2-7 days before export
Vaccination records and rabies serology report
Signed captain's declaration endorsed by the airline (Schedule I/II)
Customs GST In-Payment permit where applicable
Inspection appointment booked at least 5 days before arrival via AVS e-services

countries.name: Saint Helena
countries.summary: St Helena accepts dogs and cats directly only from the UK (and Ascension). Since 2011, pets from South Africa or anywhere else must first go to the UK and travel on the UK export health certificate 3921EHC. That certificate requires a pet passport or 6 months' UK/Ireland residence, an age of more than 24 weeks, heartworm, Brucella, Leptospira, Ehrlichia, Babesia and hookworm testing, and deworming and fipronil treatments. Four dog types are banned, and there is no quarantine facility on the island.
countries.microchip: Required (ISO recommended). The Official Veterinarian reads the chip at every exam (UK EHC 3921 v5).
countries.rabies_titer: Not on St Helena's UK certificate. A titer may be needed to enter the UK first from non-listed countries (UK rules), and is advised for return to the UK.
countries.parasite_treatment: Within 30 days before export: 2 broad-spectrum dewormings at least 14 days apart (nematodes and cestodes; praziquantel advised for trematodes). Dogs: milbemycin or moxidectin within 4 days before export. Fipronil topical 2–10 days before export. Exam within 4 days of shipment, free of external parasites.
countries.import_permit: An import licence from SHG Biosecurity (ANRD) is required. Contact ANRD/Biosecurity on +290 24724.
countries.quarantine: No quarantine service on St Helena (abolished in 2011). Pets that do not comply cannot be held on the island.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 35 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the UK with a validated pet passport or 6 months' UK/Ireland residence: apply for the SHG import licence → within 30 days of export, dog blood tests and 2 faecal tests 14 days apart plus 2 dewormings → Babesia tests within 10 days → fipronil 2–10 days before → heartworm treatment and Official Veterinarian exam within 4 days. A pet from the USA or the EU must first enter the UK under UK rules; a US pet without a validated pet passport needs 6 months' UK/Ireland residence.
countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited: Pit Bull Terrier, Dogo Argentino, Japanese Tosa and Fila Brasileiro, and crosses of these types (UK NFG 3921). Pets must be more than 24 weeks old and not pregnant.
countries.private_aviation: Only direct imports from the UK (and Ascension) are eligible, so a private flight straight from Africa, Europe or the US with a pet will not be accepted. A flight from the UK carrying a pet with a valid 3921EHC may be possible: get written confirmation and an import licence from SHG Biosecurity before booking.
countries.export: 2013 guidance: pets could not return directly from St Helena to South Africa and had to travel via the UK. Check current South African permit conditions.
countries.authority: St Helena Government – Biosecurity / Veterinary Section, Agriculture & Natural Resources Division (ANRD)
vaccinations: Rabies: no rabies vaccination clause on UK certificate 3921 (the UK is rabies-free). Vaccination plus a titer is advised if the pet will return to the UK.

Leptospira: dogs tested (MAT) within 30 days of export. If the first result is positive (≤1:400), a paired sample at least 14 days later must show no rise, or the dog is treated with doxycycline or dihydrostreptomycin.
documents: UK export health certificate 3921EHC (v5), signed by a UK Official Veterinarian
Owner declarations: residence (or fully validated pet passport), not pregnant, more than 24 weeks old, dog not a prohibited type

Original lab reports (within 30 days of export): dogs, heartworm microfilaria and antigen ELISA, Brucella canis, Leptospira canicola MAT and Ehrlichia canis IFAT; dogs, Babesia gibsoni/canis IFAT plus blood smear within 10 days; dogs and cats, 2 faecal hookworm tests at least 14 days apart
St Helena import licence (SHG Biosecurity).

ar.summary: لا تقبل سانت هيلينا الكلاب والقطط مباشرة إلا من المملكة المتحدة (وجزيرة أسينشن). ومنذ عام 2011، يجب على الحيوانات القادمة من جنوب أفريقيا أو أي مكان آخر الذهاب أولًا إلى المملكة المتحدة والسفر بشهادة التصدير الصحية البريطانية 3921EHC. وتشترط تلك الشهادة جواز سفر للحيوان الأليف أو إقامة 6 أشهر في المملكة المتحدة/أيرلندا، وعمرًا يزيد على 24 أسبوعًا، وفحوص الدودة القلبية والبروسيلا واللبتوسبيرا والإيرليخيا والبابيزيا والدودة الشصية، وعلاجات الديدان والفيبرونيل. وأربعة أنواع من الكلاب محظورة، ولا توجد منشأة حجر صحي في الجزيرة.

de.private_jet_note: Nur Flüge aus dem Vereinigten Königreich (oder Ascension) sind zulässig; ein Direktflug mit Heimtier aus Afrika, Europa oder den USA wird abgewiesen. Holen Sie vor der Buchung die schriftliche Zustimmung und eine Lizenz von SHG Biosecurity ein.
de.summary: St. Helena akzeptiert Hunde und Katzen direkt nur aus dem Vereinigten Königreich (und Ascension). Seit 2011 müssen Heimtiere aus Südafrika oder anderen Ländern zunächst ins Vereinigte Königreich und mit dem britischen Ausfuhrgesundheitszeugnis 3921EHC reisen. Dieses Zeugnis verlangt einen Heimtierausweis oder 6 Monate Aufenthalt im Vereinigten Königreich/Irland, ein Alter von über 24 Wochen, Tests auf Herzwurm, Brucella, Leptospira, Ehrlichia, Babesia und Hakenwürmer sowie Entwurmungen und Fipronil-Behandlungen. Vier Hundetypen sind verboten, und auf der Insel gibt es keine Quarantäneeinrichtung.

Quatre types de chiens sont interdits et l'île ne dispose d'aucune installation de quarantaine.

it.summary: Sant'Elena accetta cani e gatti direttamente solo dal Regno Unito (e da Ascensione). Dal 2011, gli animali provenienti dal Sudafrica o da qualsiasi altro luogo devono prima recarsi nel Regno Unito e viaggiare con il certificato sanitario di esportazione britannico 3921EHC. Tale certificato richiede un passaporto per animali da compagnia o 6 mesi di residenza nel Regno Unito/Irlanda, un'età superiore a 24 settimane, test per filariosi cardiopolmonare, Brucella, Leptospira, Ehrlichia, Babesia e anchilostomi, nonché sverminazioni e trattamenti con fipronil. Quattro tipi di cane sono vietati e sull'isola non esiste una struttura di quarantena.

ru.summary: Остров Святой Елены принимает собак и кошек напрямую только из Великобритании (и с острова Вознесения). С 2011 года животные из ЮАР или любой другой страны должны сначала прибыть в Великобританию и следовать по британскому экспортному ветеринарному сертификату 3921EHC. countries.name: Slovenia
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the UVHVVR before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Slovenia and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Slovenia's points of entry are listed on gov.si; confirm with the UVHVVR before travel that the arrival airport is on the list. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: Administration for Food Safety, Veterinary Sector and Plant Protection (UVHVVR)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

Young animals: Slovenia accepts non-commercial entry from other EU states of pets under 12 weeks that are unvaccinated, or 12–16 weeks old and vaccinated but before the 21-day wait ends, with the owner's declaration of no contact with rabies-susceptible wild animals, or accompanied by the vaccinated mother. Never allowed from outside the EU.

يصبح التطعيم الأولي ضد داء الكلب صالحًا
من الولايات المتحدة: شهادة صحية أوروبية مصادق عليها من USDA APHIS؛ ومن الاتحاد الأوروبي: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف

من الدول غير المُدرجة (مثل تركيا والمغرب وإسرائيل وتايلاند وجنوب أفريقيا): اختبار الأجسام المضادة مع انتظار 3 أشهر
لا تُقبل الشهادات الأوروبية بالنموذج القديم إلا إذا صدرت قبل 1 أكتوبر 2026
export_points: إلى دول الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية: جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف من طبيب بيطري معتمد
تحتاج الكلاب المتجهة إلى FI أو IE أو MT أو NO أو أيرلندا الشمالية أيضًا إلى علاج الدودة الشريطية
إلى الدول خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي: استيفاء قواعد بلد الوجهة؛ وتُصادق الخدمة البيطرية الرسمية على الشهادات
ar.private_jet_note: عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، يجب الهبوط فقط في نقطة دخول مُدرجة في قائمة gov.si. يُرجى تأكيد مطار الوصول مع UVHVVR قبل تحديد المسار.
ar.summary: قواعد الاتحاد الأوروبي (اللائحة المفوَّضة (EU) 2026/131): من دولة أخرى في الاتحاد الأوروبي/المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، حيوان أليف بشريحة إلكترونية وتطعيم ساري ضد داء الكلب وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف؛ ومن خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، شهادة صحة حيوانية أوروبية (إضافة إلى اختبار الأجسام المضادة لداء الكلب مع انتظار 3 أشهر إذا كانت الدولة غير مُدرجة) وتدقيق المستندات والهوية عند نقطة دخول مخصصة للمسافرين.

steps.what: ISO-Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
Die Tollwut-Erstimpfung wird gültig
Aus den USA: von USDA APHIS beglaubigtes EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; aus der EU: EU-Heimtierausweis
Die unterschriebene Erklärung zur nicht kommerziellen Verbringung mitführen (Nicht-EU-Herkunft)
Von außerhalb der EU: Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrolle an einem Eingangsort für Reisende

key_points: Max. 5 Heimtiere pro Verbringung; jedes reist mit dem Halter oder innerhalb von 5 Tagen
Aus nicht gelisteten Ländern (z. B. Türkei, Marokko, Israel, Thailand, Südafrika): Titertest plus 3 Monate Wartezeit
EU-Zeugnisse nach altem Muster werden nur akzeptiert, wenn sie vor dem 1. Okt. 2026 ausgestellt wurden
export_points: In EU-/EWR-Länder: EU-Heimtierausweis von einem ermächtigten Tierarzt
Hunde nach FI, IE, MT, NO oder Nordirland benötigen zudem eine Bandwurmbehandlung
In Nicht-EU-Länder: Bestimmungen des Ziellandes erfüllen; der amtliche Veterinärdienst beglaubigt die Zeugnisse
de.private_jet_note: Bei Anreise von außerhalb der EU landen Sie ausschließlich an einem Eingangsort auf der Liste von gov.si. Bitte den Ankunftsflughafen vor der Routenplanung mit der UVHVVR abstimmen.
de.summary: EU-Regeln (Delegierte VO (EU) 2026/131): aus einem anderen EU-/EWR-Staat ein gechiptes Heimtier mit gültiger Tollwutimpfung und EU-Heimtierausweis; von außerhalb der EU eine EU-Tiergesundheitsbescheinigung (plus Tollwut-Titertest mit 3 Monaten Wartezeit, wenn das Land nicht gelistet ist) sowie Dokumenten- und Identitätskontrollen an einem Eingangsort für Reisende.

countries.name: Slovakia
countries.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted). Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid. If the chip is not ISO-compliant, the owner must supply a reader.
countries.rabies_titer: Not required from EU/EEA states, Northern Ireland, or the territories and countries listed in Annexes I and II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/636. Annex I: Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City. Annex II: Ascension Island, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Aruba, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Barbados, Bahrain, Bermuda, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Canada, Chile, Curaçao, Fiji, Falkland Islands, United Kingdom (Great Britain), Guernsey, Hong Kong, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Japan, Jersey, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Cayman Islands, Saint Lucia, Montenegro, Montserrat, North Macedonia, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Caledonia, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Serbia, Singapore, Saint Helena, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, Taiwan, United States (including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands), Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, British Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Wallis and Futuna. From any other country: blood sample taken by an authorised vet at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination, result of at least 0.5 IU/ml at an EU-approved laboratory, and the sample taken at least 3 months (90 days) before the animal health certificate is issued; a copy of the lab report accompanies the certificate. No retest is needed while the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The 3-month wait does not apply to an EU pet re-entering whose passport records a favourable test done before it left the EU.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required for entry (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if requirements are met. Non-compliant pets can be returned to origin, isolated under official control at the owner's expense, or, as a last resort, euthanised.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (more than 21 days ago) travelling from the USA: EU animal health certificate issued and endorsed by USDA APHIS within 10 days before arrival. From another EU state: no lead time beyond a valid EU pet passport. From scratch (EU or listed origin), plan at least 4 weeks: microchip → rabies vaccination (pet ≥ 12 weeks) → 21-day wait → EU pet passport or health certificate. From an unlisted country: at least 4 months (titer blood test ≥ 30 days after vaccination, then 3 months from the sample date before the certificate is issued).
countries.restricted_breeds: Local dangerous-dog rules may apply; confirm any breed restrictions with the State Veterinary and Food Administration before travel.
countries.private_aviation: Arrivals from outside the EU (other than the Annex I territories Andorra, Switzerland, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Greenland, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, and Northern Ireland) must land at a travellers' point of entry designated by Slovakia and present the pet for documentary and identity checks (customs red channel). Airport points of entry: Bratislava, Košice, Piešťany, Poprad, Sliač and Žilina. Arrivals from another EU/EEA state: no veterinary border check, but documents must be carried. EU pet rules do not require cargo carriage; cabin carriage is up to the operator. Non-compliance at a point of entry can lead to refusal, return or isolation at the owner's cost.
countries.export: To other EU/EEA states: EU pet passport from an authorised vet (plus tapeworm treatment for dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland). To non-EU countries: meet the destination's rules; export certificates are endorsed by the official veterinary service.
countries.authority: State Veterinary and Food Administration (ŠVPS SR)
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; the primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: From another EU/EEA state, Switzerland or an Annex I territory: EU pet passport (new model in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705). Passports on the Regulation (EU) No 577/2013 model issued before 22 April 2026 remain valid, and passports on the transitional model issued before 1 January 2028 are accepted.

From a third country: EU animal health certificate (model in Annex III to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705, under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131), completed by an official veterinarian, or by an authorised veterinarian and endorsed by the exporting country's competent authority. It is valid for 10 days from issue until the documentary and identity checks on entry, then for onward travel within the EU for 6 months or until the rabies vaccination expires, whichever is earlier. Certificates on the old model (Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 577/2013) are accepted only if issued before 1 October 2026.
Owner's written declaration that the movement is non-commercial (model in Annex V, Part 2 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/705).

Non-commercial means at most 5 dogs, cats or ferrets per movement (more only for competitions, shows or sporting events, with written proof of registration and animals over 6 months old), travelling with the owner or an authorised person, or within 5 days of the owner's journey (written declaration). Otherwise commercial rules apply.

Young animals: Slovakia accepts non-commercial entry from other EU states of pets under 12 weeks that are unvaccinated, or 12–16 weeks old and vaccinated but before the 21-day wait ends, with the owner's declaration of no contact with rabies-susceptible wild animals, or accompanied by the vaccinated mother. Never allowed from outside the EU.

it.private_jet_note: Da fuori UE, l'atterraggio va previsto in un punto d'ingresso per animali da compagnia: Bratislava, Košice, Piešťany, Poprad, Sliač o Žilina.
it.summary: Norme UE (Regolamento delegato (UE) 2026/131): da un altro Stato UE/SEE, animale con microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica valida e passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia; da fuori UE, certificato sanitario UE per animali (più titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici con attesa di 3 mesi se il Paese non è elencato) e controlli documentali e d'identità presso un punto d'ingresso per viaggiatori.

at_a_glance.microchip: Чип ISO, до прививки от бешенства
at_a_glance.health_certificate: Паспорт или сертификат ЕС ≤10 дней (не из ЕС)

steps.what: Микрочип ISO, затем прививка от бешенства (животному 12+ недель)
Первичная вакцинация против бешенства становится действительной
Из США: ветеринарный сертификат ЕС, заверенный USDA APHIS; из ЕС: европейский паспорт животного
Имейте при себе подписанную декларацию о некоммерческом перемещении (не из ЕС)
Из-за пределов ЕС: проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников

key_points: Не более 5 животных за одно перемещение; каждое следует с владельцем или в пределах 5 дней
Из стран вне перечня (например, Турция, Марокко, Израиль, Таиланд, ЮАР): тест на титр плюс ожидание 3 месяца
Сертификаты ЕС старого образца принимаются, только если выданы до 1 октября 2026 г.

Собакам, направляющимся в FI, IE, MT, NO или Северную Ирландию, также нужна обработка от ленточных червей
В страны вне ЕС: соблюдайте правила страны назначения; сертификаты заверяет официальная ветеринарная служба
ru.private_jet_note: При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС совершайте посадку в пункте въезда для животных: Братислава, Кошице, Пьештяни, Попрад, Слиач или Жилина.
ru.summary: Правила ЕС (Делегированный регламент (ЕС) 2026/131): из другого государства ЕС/ЕЭЗ — животное с микрочипом, действующей прививкой от бешенства и европейским паспортом животного; из-за пределов ЕС — ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (плюс тест на титр антител к бешенству с ожиданием 3 месяца, если страна не включена в перечень) и проверка документов и идентификации в пункте въезда для путешественников.

countries.name: Sierra Leone
countries.summary: Official UK guidance (certificate 6548, cleared 2005, still listed on GOV.UK) says to apply for a Sierra Leone import permit at least 6 weeks before export. The pet then travels with an official health certificate: exam within 48 hours, valid 7 days, rabies vaccination stated if given. Confirm the current rules with Sierra Leone's Ministry of Agriculture before booking.
countries.microchip: Not required by the UK certificate: identification by tattoo, microchip, or full description. Microchip recommended.
countries.parasite_treatment: Exam within 48 hours before export must find the pet free of clinical signs of disease, including distemper, rabies and external parasites (UK certificate 6548).
countries.import_permit: Advised by UK official guidance: apply to the Sierra Leone authorities (Ministry of Agriculture, livestock/veterinary services) at least 6 weeks before export. Confirm the issuing office and process with the Ministry before travel.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 42 days: apply for the import permit at least 6 weeks before export → keep the rabies vaccination current → vet exam within 48 hours of departure and government endorsement (UK certificate valid 7 days).
countries.authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security, Sierra Leone (livestock/veterinary services)
vaccinations: Rabies: the UK certificate records rabies vaccination (date window set by the OV), or a statement that no rabies vaccine was given. A current rabies vaccination is strongly recommended because Sierra Leone is rabies-endemic.
documents: Sierra Leone import permit (apply at least 6 weeks before export)
Official veterinary health certificate (UK model 6548: exam within 48 hours, valid 7 days)
Rabies vaccination certificate (if vaccinated)

at_a_glance.parasites: Free of external parasites at exam

steps.what: Apply to the Sierra Leone authorities for an import permit
Keep the rabies vaccination current
Vet exam and government-endorsed health certificate

key_points: Confirm the current rules with the Ministry of Agriculture before booking
