steps.what: التقدّم إلى سلطات سيراليون بطلب تصريح استيراد
الإبقاء على سريان التطعيم ضد داء الكلب
فحص بيطري وشهادة صحية مصادق عليها حكوميًا

key_points: يُرجى تأكيد القواعد الحالية مع وزارة الزراعة قبل الحجز
ar.summary: تنص الإرشادات الرسمية البريطانية (الشهادة 6548، المعتمدة عام 2005، ولا تزال مُدرجة على GOV.UK) على التقدّم بطلب تصريح استيراد إلى سيراليون قبل التصدير بـ6 أسابيع على الأقل. ثم يسافر الحيوان الأليف بشهادة صحية رسمية: فحص خلال 48 ساعة، وصالحة 7 أيام، مع ذكر التطعيم ضد داء الكلب إن أُعطي. يُرجى تأكيد القواعد الحالية مع وزارة الزراعة في سيراليون قبل الحجز.

steps.what: Einfuhrgenehmigung bei den Behörden von Sierra Leone beantragen
Tollwutimpfung gültig halten
Tierärztliche Untersuchung und staatlich beglaubigtes Gesundheitszeugnis

key_points: Aktuelle Regeln vor der Buchung beim Landwirtschaftsministerium bestätigen lassen
de.summary: Ein offizieller britischer Leitfaden (Zeugnis 6548, freigegeben 2005, weiterhin auf GOV.UK gelistet) empfiehlt, mindestens 6 Wochen vor der Ausfuhr eine Einfuhrgenehmigung für Sierra Leone zu beantragen. Das Tier reist dann mit einem amtlichen Gesundheitszeugnis: Untersuchung innerhalb von 48 Stunden, 7 Tage gültig, Tollwutimpfung angegeben, falls verabreicht. Bitte die aktuellen Regeln vor der Buchung beim Landwirtschaftsministerium von Sierra Leone bestätigen lassen.

at_a_glance.parasites: Sin parásitos externos en el examen

steps.what: Solicite el permiso de importación a las autoridades de Sierra Leona
Mantenga vigente la vacunación antirrábica
Examen veterinario y certificado sanitario refrendado por el gobierno

key_points: Confirme las normas vigentes con el Ministerio de Agricultura antes de reservar
es.summary: La guía oficial del Reino Unido (certificado 6548, aprobado en 2005 y aún publicado en GOV.UK) indica solicitar un permiso de importación de Sierra Leona al menos 6 semanas antes de la exportación. La mascota viaja después con un certificado sanitario oficial: examen en las 48 horas previas, validez de 7 días y mención de la vacunación antirrábica si se ha administrado. Confirme las normas vigentes con el Ministerio de Agricultura de Sierra Leona antes de reservar.

at_a_glance.parasites: Exempt de parasites externes à l’examen

steps.what: Demander un permis d'importation aux autorités sierra-léonaises
Maintenir la vaccination antirabique à jour
Examen vétérinaire et certificat sanitaire visé officiellement

key_points: Confirmez les règles en vigueur auprès du ministère de l'Agriculture avant de réserver
fr.summary: Les recommandations officielles britanniques (certificat 6548, validé en 2005, toujours répertorié sur GOV.UK) prévoient de demander un permis d'importation de la Sierra Leone au moins 6 semaines avant l'exportation. L'animal voyage ensuite avec un certificat sanitaire officiel : examen dans les 48 heures, valable 7 jours, mentionnant la vaccination antirabique si elle a été effectuée. Confirmez les règles en vigueur auprès du ministère de l'Agriculture de la Sierra Leone avant de réserver.

at_a_glance.parasites: Privo di parassiti esterni alla visita

steps.what: Richiedere un permesso d'importazione alle autorità della Sierra Leone
Mantenere in corso di validità la vaccinazione antirabbica
Visita veterinaria e certificato sanitario vidimato dalle autorità governative

key_points: Confermare le norme vigenti con il Ministero dell'Agricoltura prima della prenotazione
it.summary: Le indicazioni ufficiali britanniche (certificato 6548, approvato nel 2005, ancora presente su GOV.UK) prevedono di richiedere un permesso d'importazione della Sierra Leone almeno 6 settimane prima dell'esportazione. L'animale viaggia poi con un certificato sanitario ufficiale: visita entro 48 ore, validità 7 giorni, vaccinazione antirabbica indicata se effettuata. Confermare le norme vigenti con il Ministero dell'Agricoltura della Sierra Leone prima della prenotazione.

steps.what: Подайте заявку на разрешение на ввоз в органы власти Сьерра-Леоне
Поддерживайте действие прививки от бешенства
Ветеринарный осмотр и ветеринарный сертификат с государственным заверением

key_points: До бронирования уточните актуальные правила в Министерстве сельского хозяйства
ru.summary: Официальные рекомендации Великобритании (сертификат 6548, одобрен в 2005 г., по-прежнему размещён на GOV.UK) предписывают подать заявку на разрешение на ввоз в Сьерра-Леоне не менее чем за 6 недель до вывоза. Затем животное путешествует с официальным ветеринарным сертификатом: осмотр в пределах 48 часов, действует 7 дней, с указанием вакцинации против бешенства, если она проводилась. До бронирования уточните актуальные правила в Министерстве сельского хозяйства Сьерра-Леоне.

countries.name: San Marino
countries.summary: San Marino is an EU Annex I listed territory (pets from it enter the EU without a titer test or point-of-entry check). San Marino has no airport, so pets arrive via Italy and that country's EU entry rules apply (microchip, rabies vaccination, EU pet passport or EU health certificate; titer test from unlisted countries).
countries.microchip: ISO 11784/11785-compliant microchip, implanted or read before the rabies vaccination (a clearly readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 is still accepted), as required by the EU country of arrival. Microchips implanted before 22 April 2026 under Regulation (EU) No 576/2013 remain valid.
countries.rabies_titer: Under the EU rules of the arrival country: required only from unlisted third countries.
countries.parasite_treatment: None required under EU rules (the EU tapeworm treatment applies only to dogs going to Finland, Ireland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland).
countries.quarantine: None if EU requirements are met.
countries.timeline: As for the EU arrival country: at least 4 weeks from EU/listed origin; 4+ months from unlisted origin.
countries.private_aviation: No airport in San Marino. Nearest jet airports are in Italy; Rimini (Miramare) and Bologna are on Italy's September 2026 list of pet points of entry for third-country arrivals.
countries.export: Leaving: the EU treats this territory as Annex I listed (pet passport or certificate, no titer, no point-of-entry requirement).
countries.authority: San Marino veterinary service (Istituto per la Sicurezza Sociale); at entry, the Italian authorities
vaccinations: Rabies: given by an authorised vet when the pet is at least 12 weeks old, on or after the microchip date; primary vaccination becomes valid 21 days after the primary protocol is completed; boosters given within the validity of the previous vaccination need no new waiting period.
documents: EU pet passport (from EU) or EU animal health certificate + non-commercial declaration (from third countries), as required by the EU arrival country.

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet at least 12 weeks old)
EU pet passport (from EU) or EU health certificate (from outside EU)
From outside the EU, land at an Italian point of entry such as Rimini or Bologna

key_points: No airport: pets arrive via Italy, and Italy's EU entry rules apply
Titer test needed only from unlisted countries
export_points: EU treats San Marino as listed: passport or certificate, no titer

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: صالح بعد 21 يومًا من الجرعة الأولى
at_a_glance.health_certificate: جواز سفر أوروبي أو شهادة أوروبية
at_a_glance.quarantine: لا يوجد عند استيفاء قواعد الاتحاد

steps.what: الشريحة الإلكترونية، ثم لقاح داء الكلب (للحيوان بعمر 12 أسبوعًا على الأقل)
جواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف (من الاتحاد الأوروبي) أو شهادة صحية أوروبية (من خارجه)
عند القدوم من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، الهبوط في نقطة دخول إيطالية مثل ريميني أو بولونيا

key_points: لا يوجد مطار: تصل الحيوانات الأليفة عبر إيطاليا، وتُطبَّق قواعد الدخول الأوروبية لإيطاليا
لا يلزم اختبار الأجسام المضادة إلا من الدول غير المُدرجة
export_points: يعامل الاتحاد الأوروبي سان مارينو كإقليم مُدرج: جواز أو شهادة، دون اختبار أجسام مضادة
ar.summary: سان مارينو إقليم مُدرج في الملحق I للاتحاد الأوروبي (تدخل الحيوانات الأليفة القادمة منه إلى الاتحاد الأوروبي دون اختبار الأجسام المضادة أو فحص عند نقطة الدخول). ولا يوجد مطار في سان مارينو، لذا تصل الحيوانات الأليفة عبر إيطاليا وتُطبَّق قواعد الدخول الأوروبية لذلك البلد (شريحة إلكترونية، وتطعيم ضد داء الكلب، وجواز سفر أوروبي للحيوان الأليف أو شهادة صحية أوروبية؛ واختبار الأجسام المضادة للقادمين من دول غير مُدرجة).

steps.what: Mikrochip, danach Tollwutimpfung (Tier mindestens 12 Wochen alt)
EU-Heimtierausweis (aus der EU) oder EU-Gesundheitszeugnis (von außerhalb der EU)
Von außerhalb der EU: Landung an einem italienischen Eingangsort wie Rimini oder Bologna

key_points: Kein Flughafen: Heimtiere reisen über Italien ein, und es gelten Italiens EU-Einreiseregeln
Titertest nur aus nicht gelisteten Ländern nötig
export_points: Die EU behandelt San Marino als gelistet: Ausweis oder Zeugnis, kein Titer
de.summary: San Marino ist ein in Anhang I der EU gelistetes Gebiet (Heimtiere von dort reisen ohne Titertest und ohne Kontrolle an einem Eingangsort in die EU ein). San Marino hat keinen Flughafen; daher reisen Heimtiere über Italien ein, und es gelten die EU-Einreiseregeln dieses Landes (Mikrochip, Tollwutimpfung, EU-Heimtierausweis oder EU-Gesundheitszeugnis; Titertest bei nicht gelisteten Herkunftsländern).

at_a_glance.microchip: ISO, antes de la vacuna antirrábica
at_a_glance.titer: No se requiere desde EE. UU./UE
at_a_glance.quarantine: Ninguna si se cumplen las normas de la UE

steps.what: Microchip y después vacuna antirrábica (mascota de al menos 12 semanas)
Pasaporte europeo para mascotas (desde la UE) o certificado zoosanitario de la UE (desde fuera de la UE)
Desde fuera de la UE, aterrice en un punto de entrada italiano como Rímini o Bolonia

key_points: Sin aeropuerto: las mascotas llegan vía Italia y se aplican las normas de entrada de la UE de Italia
Prueba de titulación necesaria solo desde países no incluidos en la lista
export_points: La UE considera San Marino incluido en la lista: pasaporte o certificado, sin titulación
es.summary: San Marino es un territorio incluido en el Anexo I de la UE (sus mascotas entran en la UE sin prueba de titulación ni control en el punto de entrada). San Marino no tiene aeropuerto, por lo que las mascotas llegan a través de Italia y se aplican las normas de entrada de la UE de ese país (microchip, vacunación antirrábica, pasaporte europeo para mascotas o certificado zoosanitario de la UE; prueba de titulación desde países no incluidos en la lista).

steps.what: Puce électronique, puis vaccin antirabique (animal âgé d'au moins 12 semaines)
Passeport européen (depuis l'UE) ou certificat sanitaire de l'UE (hors UE)
Hors UE, atterrir dans un point d'entrée italien tel que Rimini ou Bologne

key_points: Pas d'aéroport : les animaux arrivent via l'Italie, dont les règles d'entrée de l'UE s'appliquent
Titrage requis uniquement depuis les pays non listés
export_points: L'UE considère Saint-Marin comme listé : passeport ou certificat, sans titrage
fr.summary: Saint-Marin est un territoire listé à l'annexe I de l'UE (les animaux qui en proviennent entrent dans l'UE sans titrage des anticorps antirabiques ni contrôle au point d'entrée). Saint-Marin n'a pas d'aéroport : les animaux arrivent donc via l'Italie et les règles d'entrée de l'UE appliquées par ce pays s'imposent (puce électronique, vaccination antirabique, passeport européen ou certificat sanitaire de l'UE ; titrage depuis les pays non listés).

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: Valido 21 giorni dopo la prima dose

steps.what: Microchip, poi vaccino antirabbico (animale di almeno 12 settimane)
Passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia (dall'UE) o certificato sanitario UE (da fuori UE)
Da fuori UE, atterrare in un punto d'ingresso italiano, come Rimini o Bologna

key_points: Nessun aeroporto: gli animali arrivano attraverso l'Italia e si applicano le norme UE d'ingresso italiane
Titolazione anticorpale richiesta solo dai Paesi non in elenco
export_points: L'UE considera San Marino come territorio elencato: passaporto o certificato, nessuna titolazione
it.summary: San Marino è un territorio elencato nell'Allegato I UE (gli animali provenienti da San Marino entrano nell'UE senza titolazione anticorpale né controllo al punto d'ingresso). San Marino non dispone di aeroporto: gli animali arrivano quindi attraverso l'Italia e si applicano le norme UE d'ingresso italiane (microchip, vaccinazione antirabbica, passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia o certificato sanitario UE; titolazione anticorpale dai Paesi non in elenco).

steps.what: Микрочип, затем прививка от бешенства (животному не менее 12 недель)
Европейский паспорт животного (из ЕС) или ветеринарный сертификат ЕС (из-за пределов ЕС)
При прилёте из-за пределов ЕС совершите посадку в пункте въезда Италии, например в Римини или Болонье

key_points: Аэропорта нет: животные прибывают через Италию, и применяются правила въезда в ЕС Италии
Тест на титр нужен только из стран вне перечня
export_points: ЕС рассматривает Сан-Марино как включённое в перечень: паспорт или сертификат, без теста на титр
ru.summary: Сан-Марино — территория, включённая в Приложение I ЕС (животные из неё въезжают в ЕС без теста на титр антител и без проверки в пункте въезда). В Сан-Марино нет аэропорта, поэтому животные прибывают через Италию, и применяются правила въезда в ЕС этой страны (микрочип, вакцинация против бешенства, европейский паспорт животного или ветеринарный сертификат ЕС; тест на титр антител — для стран вне перечня).

countries.name: Senegal
countries.summary: Senegal requires an import permit (valid 3 months) and a health certificate. Under Decree 2002-1094 on animal health police, imported dogs and cats need an international zoo-sanitary certificate from an official vet of the exporting country plus an international rabies vaccination certificate dated more than 15 days and less than 1 year before import. For US-origin pets, APHIS says a health certificate (APHIS 7001) issued within 21 days of travel is accepted.
countries.import_permit: Required. Issued by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Livestock and valid 3 months from issue. Per APHIS, apply by email to dsvmepa@gmail.com (cc wadesanou@gmail.com) with country of origin, species and breed, owner's name and address of origin.
countries.quarantine: None stated for compliant pets. Animals are inspected at the entry post by the livestock service (Art. 177). Landing is allowed only after the zoo-sanitary certificate is presented to customs.
countries.timeline: Plan at least 4–6 weeks before travel: apply for the import permit (processing time is not published) → make sure the rabies vaccination is more than 15 days and less than 1 year old at import (US-origin pets: a primary vaccination at least 21 days before travel, per APHIS) → health certificate within 21 days of travel.
countries.private_aviation: Decree 2002-1094 Art. 176: the authorised sea, air and land entry routes for animal imports are set by ministerial order, and inspection takes place at the entry post. Confirm that veterinary inspection is available at the planned arrival airport (e.g. Dakar Blaise Diagne).
countries.authority: Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Livestock (Direction des Services Vétérinaires)
vaccinations: Rabies: required. Decree 2002-1094 Art. 173: the international rabies vaccination certificate must be dated more than 15 days and less than 1 year before import. For pets from the USA, APHIS is stricter: a primary vaccination must be given at least 21 days before travel.
documents: Import permit from the Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Livestock (valid 3 months)

International zoo-sanitary health certificate from an official veterinarian of the exporting country (Decree 2002-1094 Art. 173). For US-origin pets, APHIS 7001 issued within 21 days of travel is accepted, and no APHIS endorsement is needed if a USDA-accredited vet signs it with their national accreditation number.
International rabies vaccination certificate dated >15 days and <1 year before import (Art. 173)

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: Over 15 days to under 1 year (US: 21+ days)

steps.what: Email the ministry for an import permit (processing time is not published)
Check the rabies vaccine is old enough and under 1 year old at entry
Health certificate from an official or accredited vet
Show the certificate to customs; livestock service inspects the pet

key_points: No APHIS endorsement needed if a USDA-accredited vet signs with their national accreditation number
Confirm vet inspection is available at the arrival airport (e.g. Dakar Blaise Diagne)

steps.what: مراسلة الوزارة بالبريد الإلكتروني لطلب تصريح استيراد (مدة المعالجة غير منشورة)
التحقق من أن لقاح داء الكلب مضى عليه وقت كافٍ وأن عمره أقل من سنة 1 عند الدخول
شهادة صحية من طبيب بيطري رسمي أو معتمد
إبراز الشهادة للجمارك؛ وتفحص مصلحة الثروة الحيوانية الحيوان الأليف

Para mascotas de origen EE. UU., APHIS indica que se acepta un certificado sanitario (APHIS 7001) emitido en los 21 días previos al viaje.

countries.name: Suriname
countries.summary: Cats need a veterinary import permit from the Veterinary Inspection of Suriname (LVV, Directoraat Veeteelt). They also need an official health certificate in Dutch or English, a clinical exam and parasite treatment within 7 days of export, and rabies vaccination. From countries not free of rabies (including the USA), a titer test of at least 0.5 IU/ml done 3–12 months before shipment is required. Arrival must be notified 48 h ahead, followed by 2 weeks' isolation. The official document covers cats only, so confirm dog conditions with LVV.
countries.microchip: Not mentioned in the official LVV conditions for cats.
countries.rabies_titer: From countries not free of rabies: a WOAH-method antibody titration test of at least 0.5 IU/ml, done not less than 3 months and not more than 12 months before export. Not required from rabies-free countries.
countries.parasite_treatment: Within 7 days before export: a broad-spectrum anthelmintic and a treatment against external parasites.
countries.import_permit: Required: veterinary import permit from the Head of the Veterinary Service (Ministerie van LVV, Directoraat Veeteelt, Letitia Vriesdelaan 8–10, Paramaribo; tel. +597 479112; secrdirvee@gmail.com). If any condition is breached, entry can be refused and the permit withdrawn at the holder's cost.
countries.quarantine: No quarantine facility stay. The animal must be kept separate from other animals for at least 2 weeks after arrival, and may not be moved, sold or given away during that time without the Head of the Veterinary Service's permission. Inspectors may take blood or faecal samples at any time.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 90 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from a rabies-affected country such as the USA: titer blood draw at least 3 months before export, then the import permit application, the exam and parasite treatment within 7 days of export, and the endorsed health certificate. Notify the Veterinary Service at least 48 h before arrival.
countries.private_aviation: The Head of the Veterinary Service must be told the time and place of import at least 48 hours before arrival. Give the exact airport (e.g. Johan Adolf Pengel, PBM) and ETA.
countries.authority: Ministerie van Landbouw, Veeteelt en Visserij (LVV), Directoraat Veeteelt, Veterinary Service / Veterinary Inspection, Paramaribo
vaccinations: Rabies: vaccinated or revaccinated according to the vaccine manufacturer's recommendations (LVV conditions for cats, 2026).
documents: Valid veterinary import permit issued by the Veterinary Inspection of Suriname. Apply on paper or by email to secrdirvee@gmail.com.

Health certificate in Dutch or English from the origin country's competent veterinary authority. It must certify a clinical exam within 7 days before export with no signs of contagious disease or ectoparasites, the rabies vaccination, the titer (where required) and the parasite treatments.

de.summary: Katzen benötigen eine Veterinär-Einfuhrgenehmigung der Veterinärinspektion Surinames (LVV, Directoraat Veeteelt). Zudem sind ein amtliches Gesundheitszeugnis auf Niederländisch oder Englisch, eine klinische Untersuchung und Parasitenbehandlung innerhalb von 7 Tagen vor der Ausfuhr sowie eine Tollwutimpfung erforderlich. Aus nicht tollwutfreien Ländern (einschließlich der USA) ist ein Titertest von mindestens 0,5 IE/ml, durchgeführt 3–12 Monate vor dem Transport, erforderlich. Die Ankunft ist 48 Std. vorab zu melden, anschließend 2 Wochen Isolation. Das offizielle Dokument betrifft nur Katzen; Bedingungen für Hunde bitte bei LVV bestätigen lassen.

es.summary: Los gatos necesitan un permiso veterinario de importación de la Inspección Veterinaria de Surinam (LVV, Directoraat Veeteelt). También necesitan un certificado sanitario oficial en neerlandés o inglés, un examen clínico y tratamiento antiparasitario en los 7 días previos a la exportación, y vacunación antirrábica. Desde países no libres de rabia (incluido EE. UU.), se exige una prueba de titulación de al menos 0,5 UI/ml realizada entre 3 y 12 meses antes del envío. La llegada debe notificarse con 48 h de antelación, seguida de 2 semanas de aislamiento. El documento oficial solo contempla gatos, por lo que las condiciones para perros deben confirmarse con la LVV.

Ils doivent également avoir un certificat sanitaire officiel en néerlandais ou en anglais, un examen clinique et un traitement antiparasitaire dans les 7 jours précédant l'exportation, ainsi qu'une vaccination antirabique. Depuis les pays non indemnes de rage (dont les États-Unis), un titrage d'au moins 0,5 UI/ml réalisé 3 à 12 mois avant l'expédition est exigé. L'arrivée doit être notifiée 48 h à l'avance, suivie de 2 semaines d'isolement. Le document officiel ne couvre que les chats : confirmez les conditions pour les chiens auprès du LVV.

it.summary: I gatti necessitano di un permesso veterinario d'importazione rilasciato dall'Ispettorato Veterinario del Suriname (LVV, Directoraat Veeteelt). Occorrono inoltre un certificato sanitario ufficiale in olandese o inglese, una visita clinica e un trattamento antiparassitario entro 7 giorni dall'esportazione, e la vaccinazione antirabbica. Dai Paesi non indenni da rabbia (inclusi gli USA) è richiesta una titolazione anticorpale di almeno 0,5 UI/ml effettuata 3–12 mesi prima della spedizione. L'arrivo va notificato con 48 h di anticipo, seguito da 2 settimane di isolamento. Il documento ufficiale riguarda solo i gatti: confermare con l'LVV le condizioni per i cani.

countries.name: Sint Maarten (Dutch part)
countries.summary: Get an Animal Movement/Import permit from Inspectorate TEATT (Unit LVV), valid for entry within 30 days, plus an endorsed international health certificate. Pets must be 15 weeks or older, microchipped, rabies-vaccinated at least 21 days before departure and parasite-treated. Dogs and cats from South and Central America (except Suriname) are prohibited.
countries.microchip: ISO microchip, or a readable tattoo applied before July 2011. The number must be on the certificate.
countries.parasite_treatment: Internal: negative fecal flotation, or if positive, treatment 21 days before departure. External: parasiticide (e.g. Frontline, NexGard, Bravecto) 7–14 days before departure; free of Amblyomma and Boophilus ticks.
countries.import_permit: Required. Apply to Inspectorate TEATT – Unit LVV (LVV@sintmaartengov.org) via sintmaartengov.org.
countries.timeline: Plan at least 4–5 weeks before travel: rabies at least 21 days before departure, fecal test and deworming, permit, tick treatment 7–14 days before departure, APHIS endorsement.
countries.restricted_breeds: Pit bull terrier types are permitted only if neutered or spayed (stated on the certificate).
countries.private_aviation: No private-aviation specifics are published. The USDA-hosted version mentions inspection by a licensed vet within 24 hours of arrival, which isn't in the 2022 conditions, so confirm with LVV.
countries.authority: Ministry of Tourism, Economic Affairs, Transport & Telecommunication (TEATT) – Inspectorate, Unit LVV
vaccinations: Rabies: at least 21 days and no more than 1 or 3 years (per the vaccine) before departure.
Dogs: distemper, hepatitis, leptospirosis, Bordetella and parvovirus.
Cats: FeLV, rhinotracheitis, calicivirus, panleukopenia and pneumonitis.
documents: Sint Maarten import permit (valid 30 days from issue).
International health certificate in English or Dutch, from an accredited vet and endorsed by the exporting country's Chief Veterinary Officer (APHIS, via VEHCS). EU pet passports are NOT accepted.
Copy of the owner's passport; Animal Movement Authorization Form if the owner isn't travelling.

countries.name: Turks and Caicos Islands
countries.summary: An import permit from the Department of Agriculture (Animal Health Services) is required, applied for with an APHIS-endorsed international health certificate that is valid 10 days from issue. The US and Canada are treated as NOT rabies-free. Several dog breeds are banned.
countries.import_permit: Required for all pets. Email, fax or post the application to the Department of Agriculture, Animal Health Services Division, Providenciales (agriculture@gov.tc, +1 649 946 5801).
countries.quarantine: No standard quarantine is published. Non-compliant animals may be held, deported within 48 hours at the owner's expense, or euthanized.
countries.timeline: Plan at least 3–4 weeks before travel: vet certificate and APHIS endorsement, then the permit application within the 10-day certificate validity, then at least 48 hours' notice of arrival.
countries.restricted_breeds: Prohibited: Dogo Argentino, American Pit Bull Terrier, American Bulldog, American Staffordshire Terrier, Japanese Tosa, Perro de Presa Canario, Fila Brasileiro. Restricted (contact TCI first): Appenzeller, Aryan Molossus, Bandog, Beauceron, Belgian Mastiff, Bull Mastiff, Danish Broholmer, Dogue de Bordeaux, Great Swiss Mountain Dog, Korean Jindo, Kuvasz, Leonberger, Moscow Watchdog, Neapolitan Mastiff, Perro de Presa Mallorquin, Boerboel, Tibetan Mastiff.
countries.private_aviation: Must enter through an official port of entry. Give at least 48 hours' notice to the Inspection Unit of the confirmed arrival date, time, aircraft/flight and port of entry.
countries.authority: Turks and Caicos Islands Department of Agriculture – Animal Health Services Division
vaccinations: Rabies and other conditions are set out on the TCI import application and permit. The APHIS page doesn't state the timing, so confirm with the Department of Agriculture.
documents: TCI import permit.
International health certificate by a USDA-accredited vet, signed in non-black ink, endorsed by APHIS (original ink endorsement) BEFORE submitting the permit application. Valid 10 days from issue.
If the pet stays 24 hours or more in a transit country: a vet certificate covering that stay.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.summary: Apply to the Animal Quarantine Station (AQS) at the arrival airport for a DLD import permit, at least 7 and no more than 60 days before departure (30 days recommended). The pet needs a government-endorsed health certificate and is inspected at the AQS on arrival. There is no titre test and normally no quarantine when documents are complete.
countries.microchip: Microchip number required on the application and records. The DLD advises implanting it before or on the same day as the rabies vaccination.
countries.import_permit: Yes: DLD import permit, emailed by the AQS at the port of entry. Processing takes 5-7 Thai business days and the permit is valid 60 days. Owners travelling with their pet may apply on arrival if all originals are ready, but airlines may refuse boarding without a permit.
countries.quarantine: No fixed quarantine when documents are complete. The pet is inspected at the AQS on arrival. If documents are incomplete, the pet may be held at the quarantine station.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 14 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA or EU: apply for the import permit at least 7 days before departure (5–7 Thai business days' processing; 30 days ahead is recommended), then the health certificate endorsed within 10 days of arrival. From scratch, plan at least 5–6 weeks: microchip and vaccines (at least 21 days before applying) → permit request → endorsed health certificate.
countries.restricted_breeds: The Thai Embassy (Washington) says no dog breeds are banned, but airlines may restrict some. Minimum age 4 months (USDA summary).
countries.private_aviation: AQS offices are at Suvarnabhumi, Don Mueang, Chiang Mai, Phuket, Samui and Krabi (all 24 hours for hand-carried pets; the Suvarnabhumi cargo AQS is open 08:30-16:30 Mon-Fri). The permit names the port of entry. Coordinate the arrival airport's AQS inspection and the FBO in advance.
countries.export: DLD: the microchip must be implanted before or on the same day as the rabies vaccine. Present the pet and documents at the departure port's quarantine station, ideally 2-3 days before departure, to get the export certificate.
countries.authority: Department of Livestock Development (DLD), Animal Quarantine Stations
vaccinations: Rabies: at least 21 days before departure for a primary vaccine, given at 12 weeks of age or older. Boosters need no wait. Pets from rabies-free countries may be exempt.

Dogs: distemper, hepatitis, parvovirus, leptospirosis. If the leptospirosis vaccine is not valid or not 21+ days old, a negative leptospirosis test within 30 days before departure is accepted instead.
Cats: feline panleukopenia.
documents: Application Form R.1/1 with pet details and microchip implantation certificate
Copy of owner's passport and flight itinerary
Colour photo of the pet
English vaccination certificates
Official health certificate endorsed by the exporting country's veterinary authority (US: valid 10 days from USDA endorsement; originals only)
Printed import permit; Form R-6 and Import License R-7 issued at the AQS on arrival (500 THB per animal)

export_points: Microchip must be implanted before or on the day of the rabies vaccine

countries.summary: Dogs and cats need an official health certificate (good health, no clinical signs of species-specific diseases) and a valid rabies vaccination given at least 30 days and at most 12 months before entry (Belgian foreign ministry). countries.name: Tonga
countries.summary: Tonga needs an import permit from MAFF, a signed owner/exporter declaration (identification, history, origin) and an international health certificate from the exporting country's official vet. On arrival, animals go straight into veterinary control at an approved quarantine ground or premises until released by a veterinary officer. Detailed conditions are set per permit; only Australian-origin permits (2019) are published, e.g. a cat exam within 24 hours of shipment.
countries.import_permit: Yes. Ministry of Agriculture and Food, Forests and Fisheries (info@mafff.gov.to).
countries.quarantine: On arrival, held under veterinary control at an approved quarantine ground or premises until released by a veterinary officer. Duration is per permit.

يُرجى ترتيب مرفق حجر صحي معتمد قبل الوصول
ar.summary: تشترط تونغا تصريح استيراد من MAFF، وإقرارًا موقّعًا من المالك/المُصدِّر (التعريف، والتاريخ، والمنشأ)، وشهادة صحية دولية من الطبيب البيطري الرسمي في بلد التصدير. وعند الوصول، تنتقل الحيوانات مباشرة إلى الرقابة البيطرية في أرض أو مرفق حجر صحي معتمد حتى يُفرج عنها طبيب بيطري رسمي. وتُحدَّد الشروط التفصيلية لكل تصريح؛ ولم تُنشر إلا تصاريح المنشأ الأسترالي (2019)، ومنها فحص القطط خلال 24 ساعة من الشحن.

key_points: Bedingungen werden je Genehmigung festgelegt; nur Bedingungen für australische Herkunft sind veröffentlicht
Zugelassene Quarantäneräumlichkeiten vor der Ankunft organisieren
de.summary: Tonga verlangt eine Einfuhrgenehmigung von MAFF, eine unterschriebene Erklärung des Halters/Exporteurs (Kennzeichnung, Vorgeschichte, Herkunft) und ein internationales Gesundheitszeugnis des Amtstierarztes des Ausfuhrlandes. Bei Ankunft kommen die Tiere direkt unter tierärztliche Kontrolle auf ein zugelassenes Quarantänegelände bzw. in zugelassene Räumlichkeiten, bis ein Veterinärbeamter sie freigibt. Detaillierte Bedingungen werden je Genehmigung festgelegt; veröffentlicht sind nur Genehmigungen für australische Herkunft (2019), z. B. eine Untersuchung von Katzen innerhalb von 24 Stunden vor dem Transport.

Reserve una instalación de cuarentena aprobada antes de la llegada
es.summary: Tonga exige un permiso de importación del MAFF, una declaración firmada del propietario/exportador (identificación, historial, origen) y un certificado sanitario internacional de un veterinario oficial del país exportador. A la llegada, los animales pasan directamente a control veterinario en un recinto o instalación de cuarentena aprobados hasta que un funcionario veterinario autorice su salida. Las condiciones detalladas se fijan en cada permiso; solo se publican los permisos para origen australiano (2019), p. ej., examen de los gatos en las 24 horas previas al envío.

key_points: Conditions fixées permis par permis ; seules celles pour une origine australienne sont publiées
Prévoyez des locaux de quarantaine agréés avant l'arrivée
fr.summary: Les Tonga exigent un permis d'importation du MAFF, une déclaration signée du propriétaire/de l'exportateur (identification, historique, origine) et un certificat sanitaire international délivré par le vétérinaire officiel du pays exportateur. À l'arrivée, les animaux sont placés directement sous contrôle vétérinaire dans un lieu ou des locaux de quarantaine agréés jusqu'à leur libération par un agent vétérinaire. Les conditions détaillées sont fixées permis par permis ; seuls les permis pour une origine australienne (2019) sont publiés, p. ex. un examen des chats dans les 24 heures précédant l'expédition.

key_points: Condizioni stabilite per ciascun permesso; pubblicate solo quelle per l'origine australiana
Predisporre una struttura di quarantena approvata prima dell'arrivo
it.summary: Tonga richiede un permesso d'importazione rilasciato dal MAFF, una dichiarazione firmata del proprietario/esportatore (identificazione, anamnesi, provenienza) e un certificato sanitario internazionale emesso dal veterinario ufficiale del paese esportatore. All'arrivo, gli animali sono posti direttamente sotto controllo veterinario presso un'area o una struttura di quarantena approvata, fino al rilascio da parte di un funzionario veterinario. Le condizioni dettagliate sono stabilite per ciascun permesso; sono pubblicati soltanto i permessi per l'origine australiana (2019), ad esempio una visita del gatto entro 24 ore dalla spedizione.

key_points: Условия устанавливаются в каждом разрешении; опубликованы только условия для Австралии
До прибытия договоритесь об одобренном карантинном помещении
ru.summary: Тонга требует разрешения на ввоз от MAFF, подписанной декларации владельца/экспортёра (идентификация, история, происхождение) и международного ветеринарного сертификата официального ветеринара страны вывоза. По прибытии животные сразу поступают под ветеринарный контроль на одобренной карантинной площадке или в одобренном помещении до выпуска ветеринарным инспектором. Подробные условия устанавливаются в каждом разрешении; опубликованы только разрешения для животных из Австралии (2019), например осмотр кошки в пределах 24 часов до отправки.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.summary: Max 2 pets per passenger. Each needs a microchip (before rabies vaccination), rabies vaccination, a rabies titer of at least 0.5 IU/ml (blood drawn 30+ days after vaccination, then a 90-day wait) and a health certificate issued within 2 days of travel. Several dog breeds are banned from entry.
countries.microchip: Required: ISO 11784/11785 microchip (or legible tattoo) applied before rabies vaccination; owner must supply reader if non-ISO
countries.rabies_titer: Required: at least 0.5 IU/ml at an accredited (EU-approved) lab, blood sampled at least 30 days after vaccination. Waiting period: 90 days counted from the date of the test RESULT (Istanbul Airport veterinary border post page); not required on later trips if the rabies vaccination is kept valid. The Ministry page states no country exemption (APHIS mentions a 21-day quarantine with on-arrival testing if the titer is missing).
countries.parasite_treatment: APHIS guidance (US origin): tick (ectoparasite) treatment and Echinococcus (tapeworm) treatment within 30 days before travel, signed by vet
countries.quarantine: None if compliant; 21 days possible if titer missing or for young unvaccinated pets
countries.timeline: Allow at least 110 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the USA or EU without a previous titer: titer blood draw, then 90 days from the result; tick and tapeworm treatment within 30 days (APHIS, US origin); health certificate within 2 days of travel. With a prior valid titer and rabies boosters that never lapsed, about 7 days. Return to the EU/GB: Türkiye is not EU-listed, so do the titer before leaving the EU.
countries.restricted_breeds: Import banned (Law 5199 Art. 14(1)(l) and Ministry dangerous-animals circular): American Pit Bull Terrier, Japanese Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, American Staffordshire Terrier, American Bully, and their crosses.
countries.private_aviation: Pets must enter through a Ministry-approved veterinary border post; Istanbul Airport is confirmed by the Ministry, and APHIS links the list of approved ports. Before routing to business-aviation terminals such as Bodrum, Dalaman or Antalya, confirm with the handler that a veterinary border post is on duty. Since 17 Jul 2026 Türkiye restricts dogs and cats from Texas and New Mexico (New World screwworm).
countries.export: Pet must be microchipped and registered in PETVET with a Turkish pet passport (foreign pets keep existing chip/passport). Rabies vaccine at ≥12 weeks, on/after chip date. FAVN titer (Etlik VKMAEM, ≥30 days after vaccination) if destination requires. Veterinary Health Certificate from the Provincial/District Directorate of Agriculture within 48 hours before departure. Protected native breeds (Kangal, Akbaş, Kars dog, Çatalburun, Zağar, Ankara cat, Van cat) need prior permission to leave; passports listing breed/colour only as 'mix' are rejected. Banned dangerous breeds may leave only if registered and destination accepts
countries.authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry of the Republic of Türkiye (General Directorate of Food and Control; Veterinary Border Control Posts)
vaccinations: Rabies: inactivated or recombinant vaccine (not modified live), given on/after microchip date; booster after lapse counts as primary. Canada's CFIA notes Türkiye does not accept 3-year vaccine validity
Pets <3 months unvaccinated: admitted only under Ministry conditions (APHIS: 21-day home quarantine, or no-wildlife-contact declaration, or accompanied by vaccinated mother)
documents: Veterinary Health and Origin Certificate for cats/dogs/ferrets with passenger (one certificate per pet), issued by origin competent authority within 2 days before travel (US: APHIS endorsement ≤2 days before departure)
Pet passport or ID showing ownership
Original rabies titer report
Rabies vaccination certificate

countries.private_aviation: Transshipment through countries Taiwan does not recognise as rabies-free is not allowed for rabies-free-origin pets. The APHIA airport branch inspection and the quarantine booking apply as for any arrival.

Passage par voie terrestre à un poste frontière doté d'un contrôle vétérinaire

key_points: Espace aérien fermé aux vols civils : rejoignez un pays voisin (p. ex. Pologne, Moldavie) et franchissez la frontière par voie terrestre
Jusqu'à 5 animaux par mouvement non commercial
Les animaux de moins de 12 semaines ne doivent pas être vaccinés ; de 12 à 16 semaines, une déclaration ou une mère vaccinée est requise
Depuis l'UE, confirmez l'exigence de titrage auprès du DPSS avant le voyage
fr.summary: Certificat international pour mouvement non commercial (jusqu'à 5 animaux) : puce électronique ISO, vaccination antirabique à jour et, selon le modèle de certificat pour une origine États-Unis, un titrage des anticorps antirabiques. L'espace aérien ukrainien est fermé aux vols civils : l'entrée se fait uniquement par voie terrestre.

at_a_glance.microchip: ISO, o tatuaggio prima del 3 lug 2011

steps.what: Microchip, poi vaccino antirabbico
Titolazione presso un laboratorio approvato (obbligatoria dagli Stati Uniti)
Termina il periodo di attesa; l'animale può essere esportato
Certificato internazionale rilasciato da un veterinario accreditato, vidimato
Attraversamento via terra presso un valico di frontiera con controllo veterinario

key_points: Spazio aereo chiuso ai voli civili: volare verso un paese confinante (ad es. Polonia, Moldavia) e proseguire via terra
Fino a 5 animali per movimentazione non commerciale
Gli animali sotto le 12 settimane non devono essere vaccinati; tra le 12 e le 16 settimane occorre una dichiarazione o una madre vaccinata
Dall'UE, verificare con il DPSS il requisito della titolazione prima del viaggio
it.summary: Certificato internazionale per movimentazione non commerciale (fino a 5 animali): microchip ISO, vaccinazione antirabbica in corso di validità e, secondo il modello di certificato per l'origine statunitense, titolazione degli anticorpi antirabbici. Lo spazio aereo ucraino è chiuso ai voli civili, pertanto l'ingresso è possibile solo via terra.

at_a_glance.microchip: ISO или татуировка до 3 июля 2011 г.

steps.what: Микрочип, затем прививка от бешенства
Тест на титр в одобренной лаборатории (обязателен из США)
Период ожидания завершён; животное может быть вывезено
Международный сертификат от аккредитованного ветеринара, с заверением
Пересечение границы по суше в пункте с ветеринарным контролем

key_points: Воздушное пространство закрыто для гражданских рейсов: прилёт в соседнюю страну (например, Польшу, Молдову) и пересечение границы по суше
До 5 животных за одно некоммерческое перемещение
Животных младше 12 недель прививать нельзя; в возрасте 12–16 недель нужны декларация или привитая мать
Для стран ЕС уточните требование о тесте на титр в DPSS до поездки
ru.summary: Международный сертификат для некоммерческого перемещения (до 5 животных): микрочип ISO, действующая прививка от бешенства и, согласно образцу сертификата для США, тест на титр антител к бешенству. Воздушное пространство Украины закрыто для гражданских рейсов, поэтому въезд возможен только по суше.

countries.name: Uganda
countries.summary: Apply in writing to MAAIF's Commissioner for Animal Health for an import permit at least 7 days before arrival. Travel with an official English-language health certificate and vaccinations done at least 30 days before arrival; imported animals may be held in quarantine for 21-30 days.
countries.import_permit: Required. Written application to the Commissioner for Animal Health at least 7 days before import, stating country of origin, supplier, and animal type, breed, sex and quantity. The permit is then sent to the origin veterinary authority for inspection and certification. It may be refused if the disease risk is unmanageable.
countries.quarantine: MAAIF's general post-import procedure (which its dogs-and-cats page says applies) puts imported animals in quarantine or holding for 21-30 days, with release after tests. The page does not state this specifically for pets accompanying their owners, so confirm with MAAIF.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated (at least 30 days before arrival): permit application at least 7 days before, health certificate within 10 days of shipment, and confirmation of arrival with the port veterinary officer at least 3 days before.
countries.private_aviation: Confirm the arrival date with the port-of-entry veterinary official at least 3 days before arrival; pets must be crated individually with no contact with other animals.
countries.export: Apply to the Commissioner for Animal Health at least 15 days before export for a veterinary health certificate. Dogs need records of vaccination against rabies, distemper, parvovirus, infectious hepatitis, parainfluenza and tracheobronchitis. The destination country's import permit is also required.
countries.authority: Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry and Fisheries (MAAIF), Commissioner for Animal Health
vaccinations: Dogs: rabies, distemper, hepatitis, leptospirosis, parvovirus, at least 30 days before arrival (Uganda Embassy Washington)
Cats: rabies and feline enteritis (panleukopenia), at least 30 days before arrival (Uganda Embassy Washington)

UK official guidance (NFG 3925, revised 12/2023): rabies, and for dogs distemper, hepatitis, leptospirosis and parvovirus, or for cats feline enteritis, each at least 30 days and at most 12 months before export
documents: Import permit from the Commissioner for Animal Health (MAAIF)

Official veterinary health certificate from the origin country's veterinary authority, in English or with an English translation (the embassy says signed and stamped within 10 days of shipment, stating the pet is free from disease)
Movement permit from the veterinary authority of the area of origin (embassy)
Certificate or letter from the local veterinary authority that the area of origin is rabies-free (embassy)
Invoice or price list, packing list, and air waybill (MAAIF general procedure)
UK model certificate 3925: exam within 48 hours, valid 7 days, microchip number recorded, owner declaration of 6 months' residence

steps.what: Rabies and core vaccines, at least 30 days before arrival
Write to the Commissioner for Animal Health for an import permit
Official health certificate in English
Confirm arrival date with the port-of-entry veterinary officer

key_points: Pets must be crated individually with no contact with other animals
Embassy also lists an origin movement permit and a rabies-free area letter
export_points: Apply to the Commissioner for Animal Health 15+ days before for a health certificate
Dogs need rabies, distemper, parvo, hepatitis, parainfluenza and tracheobronchitis records
The destination country's import permit is also required

steps.what: لقاح داء الكلب واللقاحات الأساسية، قبل الوصول بـ30 يومًا على الأقل
مراسلة مفوض الصحة الحيوانية كتابيًا لطلب تصريح استيراد
شهادة صحية رسمية باللغة الإنجليزية
تأكيد تاريخ الوصول مع الطبيب البيطري الرسمي في منفذ الدخول

key_points: يجب وضع كل حيوان في قفص منفرد دون مخالطة حيوانات أخرى
تذكر السفارة أيضًا تصريح تنقل من بلد المنشأ وخطابًا يُثبت خلو المنطقة من داء الكلب
export_points: التقدّم إلى مفوض الصحة الحيوانية قبل 15+ يومًا للحصول على شهادة صحية
تحتاج الكلاب إلى سجلات لقاحات داء الكلب، والديستمبر، والبارفو، والتهاب الكبد، ونظير الإنفلونزا، والتهاب الرغامى والقصبات
يلزم أيضًا تصريح الاستيراد من بلد الوجهة
ar.summary: يُرجى التقدّم كتابيًا إلى مفوض الصحة الحيوانية في MAAIF بطلب تصريح استيراد قبل الوصول بـ7 أيام على الأقل. والسفر بشهادة صحية رسمية باللغة الإنجليزية وتطعيمات أُجريت قبل الوصول بـ30 يومًا على الأقل؛ وقد تُحتجز الحيوانات المستوردة في الحجر الصحي لمدة 21-30 يومًا.

steps.what: Tollwut- und Grundimpfungen, mindestens 30 Tage vor Ankunft
Schriftlich beim Commissioner for Animal Health eine Einfuhrgenehmigung beantragen
Amtliches Gesundheitszeugnis in englischer Sprache
Ankunftsdatum mit dem Veterinärbeamten am Eingangsort bestätigen

key_points: Heimtiere müssen einzeln in Transportboxen ohne Kontakt zu anderen Tieren reisen
Die Botschaft nennt zudem eine Verbringungsgenehmigung des Herkunftslandes und eine Bescheinigung über ein tollwutfreies Gebiet
export_points: Gesundheitszeugnis mind. 15 Tage vorher beim Commissioner for Animal Health beantragen
Hunde benötigen Nachweise über Tollwut, Staupe, Parvovirose, Hepatitis, Parainfluenza und Tracheobronchitis
Zudem ist die Einfuhrgenehmigung des Ziellandes erforderlich
de.summary: Beantragen Sie mindestens 7 Tage vor Ankunft schriftlich beim Commissioner for Animal Health des MAAIF eine Einfuhrgenehmigung. Reisen Sie mit einem amtlichen Gesundheitszeugnis in englischer Sprache und Impfungen, die mindestens 30 Tage vor Ankunft erfolgt sind; eingeführte Tiere können 21-30 Tage in Quarantäne gehalten werden.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: En inglés, ≤10 días antes del envío

steps.what: Vacuna antirrábica y vacunas básicas, al menos 30 días antes de la llegada
Escriba al Commissioner for Animal Health para solicitar un permiso de importación
Certificado sanitario oficial en inglés
Confirme la fecha de llegada con el funcionario veterinario del puerto de entrada

key_points: Las mascotas deben ir en transportines individuales, sin contacto con otros animales
La embajada indica además un permiso de traslado en origen y una carta de zona libre de rabia
export_points: Solicite el certificado sanitario al Commissioner for Animal Health con 15+ días de antelación
Los perros necesitan registros de vacunación contra rabia, moquillo, parvovirus, hepatitis, parainfluenza y traqueobronquitis
También se requiere el permiso de importación del país de destino
es.summary: Solicite por escrito al Commissioner for Animal Health del MAAIF un permiso de importación al menos 7 días antes de la llegada. Viaje con un certificado sanitario oficial en inglés y vacunas administradas al menos 30 días antes de la llegada; los animales importados pueden permanecer en cuarentena durante 21-30 días.

steps.what: Vaccins antirabique et essentiels, au moins 30 jours avant l'arrivée
Écrire au Commissioner for Animal Health pour obtenir un permis d'importation
Certificat sanitaire officiel en anglais
Confirmer la date d'arrivée auprès de l'agent vétérinaire du point d'entrée

key_points: Chaque animal doit voyager dans une caisse individuelle, sans contact avec d'autres animaux
L'ambassade mentionne également un permis de mouvement du pays d'origine et une attestation de zone indemne de rage
export_points: Demandez un certificat sanitaire au Commissioner for Animal Health 15+ jours à l'avance
Les chiens doivent justifier des vaccinations contre la rage, la maladie de Carré, la parvovirose, l'hépatite, la parainfluenza et la trachéobronchite
Le permis d'importation du pays de destination est également requis
fr.summary: Adressez une demande écrite de permis d'importation au Commissioner for Animal Health du MAAIF au moins 7 jours avant l'arrivée. Voyagez avec un certificat sanitaire officiel en anglais et des vaccinations effectuées au moins 30 jours avant l'arrivée ; les animaux importés peuvent être placés en quarantaine pendant 21 à 30 jours.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: In inglese, ≤10 giorni prima della spedizione

steps.what: Vaccino antirabbico e vaccini di base, almeno 30 giorni prima dell'arrivo
Scrivere al Commissioner for Animal Health per il permesso d'importazione
Certificato sanitario ufficiale in inglese
Confermare la data di arrivo al funzionario veterinario del punto d'ingresso

key_points: Gli animali devono viaggiare in trasportini individuali, senza contatto con altri animali
L'Ambasciata indica inoltre un permesso di movimentazione dall'origine e una lettera attestante l'area indenne da rabbia
export_points: Richiedere il certificato sanitario al Commissioner for Animal Health con 15+ giorni di anticipo
I cani necessitano dei certificati di vaccinazione contro rabbia, cimurro, parvovirosi, epatite, parainfluenza e tracheobronchite
È richiesto anche il permesso d'importazione del paese di destinazione
it.summary: Presentare domanda scritta al Commissioner for Animal Health del MAAIF per un permesso d'importazione almeno 7 giorni prima dell'arrivo. Viaggiare con un certificato sanitario ufficiale in lingua inglese e con vaccinazioni effettuate almeno 30 giorni prima dell'arrivo; gli animali importati possono essere trattenuti in quarantena per 21-30 giorni.

steps.what: Прививки от бешенства и основные не менее чем за 30 дней до прибытия
Направьте Уполномоченному по здоровью животных письмо с запросом разрешения на ввоз
Официальный ветеринарный сертификат на английском языке
Подтвердите дату прибытия у ветеринарного инспектора пункта въезда

key_points: Животные должны перевозиться в отдельных переносках без контакта с другими животными
Посольство также указывает разрешение на перемещение в стране отправления и справку о том, что район свободен от бешенства
export_points: Подайте заявку Уполномоченному по здоровью животных на ветеринарный сертификат за 15+ дней
Собакам нужны записи о прививках от бешенства, чумы плотоядных, парвовироза, гепатита, парагриппа и трахеобронхита
Также требуется разрешение на ввоз страны назначения
ru.summary: Подайте письменную заявку на разрешение на ввоз Уполномоченному по здоровью животных MAAIF не менее чем за 7 дней до прибытия. Путешествуйте с официальным ветеринарным сертификатом на английском языке и прививками, сделанными не менее чем за 30 дней до прибытия; ввезённые животные могут быть помещены в карантин на 21-30 дней.

countries.name: United States
countries.summary: Dogs (CDC, since 1 Aug 2024) need a CDC Dog Import Form receipt, must be at least 6 months old and microchipped; dogs that were in a CDC high-risk dog-rabies country in the past 6 months have extra rabies paperwork and port rules. Cats have no federal USDA requirements, but state rules apply. Dogs from screwworm-affected regions also need a USDA screwworm certificate.
countries.microchip: Dogs: required, readable by a universal scanner. For the high-risk-country routes it must be implanted before the rabies vaccine, or the vaccine is invalid. Cats: no federal requirement.
countries.rabies_titer: Only for foreign-vaccinated dogs from high-risk countries: serology at a CDC-approved lab, drawn at least 30 days after the first valid vaccine and at least 28 days before entry. It stays valid as long as vaccination doesn't lapse. Without a valid titer, the dog does a 28-day quarantine at a CDC-registered animal care facility.
countries.import_permit: None for personal pets. Dogs imported for resale or adoption have additional USDA APHIS Animal Care permit and health requirements.
countries.quarantine: None for compliant dogs. Foreign-vaccinated high-risk-country dogs without a valid titer: 28 days at a CDC-registered facility. HAWAII (state rule): up to 120 days' quarantine unless the 5-Day-Or-Less program is met: 2 rabies vaccinations (latest at least 30 days before arrival), a passing FAVN with arrival at least 30 days after the test, tick treatment, and documents received at least 10 days before arrival. Hawaii certificates also need a New World screwworm statement.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 7 days for a dog already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated travelling from the EU/UK or another low-risk country: CDC Dog Import Form (dog at least 6 months old, microchipped); cats need no federal paperwork. Foreign-vaccinated dogs that were in a CDC high-risk country (e.g. UAE) need a CDC-approved titer at least 28 days before entry plus a facility reservation: plan at least 2 months (microchip, rabies vaccine at 12 weeks or older, titer at least 30 days later, facility reservation at least 30 days before travel). Hawaii direct release: plan 3–4+ months, because FAVN results can take 1–2 months.
countries.private_aviation: CDC rules apply equally to private and charter flights; the arrival airport must match the CDC Dog Import Form. Dogs from low-risk countries and US-vaccinated dogs returning from high-risk countries may use any airport, land border or seaport. FOREIGN-VACCINATED dogs that were in a CDC high-risk country in the past 6 months (list of 15 Apr 2026 includes the UAE, Qatar, Türkiye, Israel, Morocco, Thailand and South Africa; not Saudi Arabia, Mexico, Bahamas, Japan, Singapore or Hong Kong) may enter ONLY through an airport with a CDC-registered animal care facility: ATL, DFW, LAX, MIA, JFK (not Teterboro, Newark or LaGuardia), PHL, SEA, IAD (CDC list updated 1 Sep 2026). Some facilities (SEA, LAX) work cargo-only or prefer cargo. This rules out typical FBO airports such as Teterboro, Van Nuys or Opa-locka for Dubai-vaccinated dogs. Hawaii: HNL direct airport release 8:30 am-4:30 pm daily; neighbor-island arrivals need a permit 30 days ahead; for private aircraft, contact the Animal Quarantine Station before the flight.
countries.export: Leaving the US: a USDA-accredited vet issues the destination-specific health certificate, preferably in VEHCS, and APHIS endorses it. Most endorsements are digital, but some destinations still require an original ink signature and embossing; a few (e.g. Bermuda, Belize, El Salvador, Honduras) need no APHIS endorsement. Before taking a dog to a CDC high-risk country, get the USDA-endorsed Certification of U.S.-issued Rabies Vaccination; otherwise re-entry requires the foreign-vaccinated route.
countries.authority: CDC Division of Global Migration Health (dogs); USDA APHIS Veterinary Services; state veterinarians (Hawaii Department of Agriculture & Biosecurity, Animal Quarantine Station)
vaccinations: Dogs only in dog-rabies-free/low-risk countries in the past 6 months: no federal rabies certificate required (CDC recommends vaccination; states and airlines may require it).

Dogs in a CDC high-risk country in the past 6 months: valid rabies vaccination given at 12 weeks (84 days) of age or older, after the microchip. US-vaccinated dogs: a first vaccine must be at least 28 days old when the CDC certification form is completed.
Cats: no federal USDA/APHIS requirement. Many states require rabies vaccination.
documents: CDC Dog Import Form receipt for every dog. Free, online, one per dog. Low-risk route: receipt valid 6 months. High-risk routes: single entry on the listed date and port.

US-vaccinated dogs returning from a high-risk country: Certification of U.S.-issued Rabies Vaccination, completed in USDA's system by a USDA-accredited vet and endorsed by USDA BEFORE the dog leaves the US.

Foreign-vaccinated dogs from a high-risk country: Certification of Foreign Rabies Vaccination and Microchip, endorsed by an official government vet and completed no more than 30 days before travel; titer report; reservation at a CDC-registered animal care facility (exam and US revaccination on arrival).

Dogs from screwworm (NWS)-affected regions, including US dogs returning from Mexico: certificate signed by a full-time official government vet of the region (Mexico: a SENASICA-authorized vet may sign) stating the dog was inspected within 5 days of shipment and is free of screwworm. APHIS's affected list includes most of Central America, Cuba, the Dominican Republic, Haiti, Jamaica, Trinidad and Tobago, Aruba and the UAE; Mexico is under a separate temporary restriction.
Dogs from FMD-affected countries: no document, but coat and bedding must be free of excess dirt or straw, bathe on arrival, and keep away from livestock for 5 days.

steps.what: 2 rabies shots, FAVN test, documents in 10+ days before arrival
Microchip the dog and submit the free CDC Dog Import Form (one per dog)
Carry the CDC receipt; arrival airport must match the form
Cats need no federal paperwork, but check state rules

key_points: Dogs must be at least 6 months old, microchipped, with a CDC Dog Import Form receipt
Foreign-vaccinated dogs from CDC high-risk countries: only ATL, DFW, LAX, MIA, JFK, PHL, SEA, IAD
US-vaccinated dogs visiting high-risk countries: get USDA-endorsed rabies certification before leaving
Dogs from screwworm regions (e.g. Mexico, most of Central America) need a screwworm certificate
export_points: A USDA-accredited vet issues the certificate (preferably in VEHCS); APHIS endorses it
Some destinations need an ink signature and embossing; a few need no endorsement
Before taking a dog to a CDC high-risk country, get the USDA rabies certification
countries.private_jet_note: CDC rules apply to private flights. Foreign-vaccinated dogs from high-risk countries must land at ATL, DFW, LAX, MIA, JFK, PHL, SEA or IAD, not Teterboro, Van Nuys or Opa-locka.

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: كلاب الدول عالية المخاطر: بعمر 12+ أسبوعًا
at_a_glance.titer: فقط لكلاب عالية المخاطر مطعّمة بالخارج

steps.what: 2 من جرعات لقاح داء الكلب، واختبار FAVN، وتسليم المستندات قبل الوصول بـ10+ أيام
زرع شريحة إلكترونية للكلب وتقديم نموذج CDC المجاني لاستيراد الكلاب (نموذج لكل كلب)
حمل إيصال CDC؛ ويجب أن يطابق مطار الوصول ما ورد في النموذج
لا تحتاج القطط إلى مستندات اتحادية، لكن يُرجى مراجعة قواعد الولاية

key_points: يجب ألا يقل عمر الكلاب عن 6 أشهر، وأن تحمل شريحة إلكترونية، مع إيصال نموذج CDC لاستيراد الكلاب
الكلاب المطعّمة بالخارج القادمة من دول عالية المخاطر لدى CDC: فقط ATL أو DFW أو LAX أو MIA أو JFK أو PHL أو SEA أو IAD
الكلاب المطعّمة في الولايات المتحدة التي تزور دولًا عالية المخاطر: الحصول على شهادة داء الكلب مصادق عليها من USDA قبل المغادرة
تحتاج الكلاب القادمة من مناطق دودة الحلزون (مثل المكسيك ومعظم أمريكا الوسطى) إلى شهادة بشأن دودة الحلزون
export_points: يُصدر طبيب بيطري معتمد من USDA الشهادة (ويُفضَّل عبر VEHCS)؛ وتصادق عليها APHIS
تشترط بعض الوجهات توقيعًا بالحبر وختمًا بارزًا؛ ولا يشترط بعضها أي مصادقة
قبل اصطحاب كلب إلى دولة عالية المخاطر لدى CDC، يُرجى الحصول على شهادة داء الكلب من USDA
ar.private_jet_note: تُطبَّق قواعد CDC على الرحلات الخاصة. ويجب أن تهبط الكلاب المطعّمة بالخارج القادمة من دول عالية المخاطر في ATL أو DFW أو LAX أو MIA أو JFK أو PHL أو SEA أو IAD، لا في تيتربورو أو فان نايز أو أوبا-لوكا.
ar.summary: تحتاج الكلاب (CDC، منذ 1 أغسطس 2024) إلى إيصال نموذج CDC لاستيراد الكلاب، ويجب ألا يقل عمرها عن 6 أشهر وأن تحمل شريحة إلكترونية؛ وتخضع الكلاب التي كانت في دولة عالية المخاطر لداء الكلب لدى CDC خلال آخر 6 أشهر لمستندات إضافية بشأن داء الكلب وقواعد خاصة بالمنافذ. ولا توجد متطلبات اتحادية من USDA للقطط، لكن تُطبَّق قواعد الولايات. كما تحتاج الكلاب القادمة من المناطق المتأثرة بدودة الحلزون إلى شهادة USDA بشأن دودة الحلزون.

steps.what: 2 Tollwutimpfungen, FAVN-Test, Unterlagen mind. 10 Tage vor Ankunft einreichen
Den Hund chippen und das kostenlose CDC Dog Import Form einreichen (eines pro Hund)
CDC-Empfangsbestätigung mitführen; der Ankunftsflughafen muss mit dem Formular übereinstimmen
Katzen benötigen keine Bundesdokumente, aber die Regeln des Bundesstaates prüfen

key_points: Hunde müssen mindestens 6 Monate alt und gechippt sein und eine Empfangsbestätigung des CDC Dog Import Form haben
Im Ausland geimpfte Hunde aus CDC-Hochrisikoländern: nur ATL, DFW, LAX, MIA, JFK, PHL, SEA, IAD
In den USA geimpfte Hunde, die Hochrisikoländer besuchen: vor der Ausreise USDA-beglaubigte Tollwutbescheinigung einholen

export_points: Ein USDA-akkreditierter Tierarzt stellt das Zeugnis aus (vorzugsweise in VEHCS); APHIS beglaubigt es

Aug. 2024) benötigen eine Empfangsbestätigung des CDC Dog Import Form, müssen mindestens 6 Monate alt und gechippt sein; für Hunde, die sich in den letzten 6 Monaten in einem CDC-Hochrisikoland für Hundetollwut aufgehalten haben, gelten zusätzliche Tollwutdokumente und Hafenregeln. countries.name: Uruguay
countries.summary: Dogs and cats need a CVI (Mercosur model) or validated official passport from the origin country's veterinary authority; dogs additionally need an ISO microchip, praziquantel deworming and (from non-free countries) a negative leishmaniasis test within 60 days. No MGAP entry authorization if travelling with the pet; no fee.
countries.microchip: Dogs: mandatory ISO 11784/11785 microchip (MGAP Res. 273/2018), with implantation or reading certificate. Cats: not listed.
countries.parasite_treatment: Internal and external deworming within 15 days before CVI issue/passport endorsement (date and product recorded); for dogs the internal product must contain praziquantel.
countries.import_permit: Not required for dogs and cats travelling with owner. Pets arriving as cargo at Carrasco: notify aeropuertoic@mgap.gub.uy at least 72 working hours before arrival with scanned documents.
countries.timeline: Allow at least 10 days for a pet already microchipped and rabies-vaccinated: leishmaniasis test for dogs (within 60 days), deworming within 15 days of the CVI (praziquantel for dogs), vet exam within 10 days of the CVI, official CVI, then the MGAP check at entry. From scratch, plan at least 4–6 weeks.
countries.private_aviation: No prior MGAP authorization for accompanied pets; documents checked at the border point. For Carrasco cargo arrivals, 72 working hours notice to MGAP airport office.
countries.export: Leaving Uruguay: MGAP issues the CVI. Mercosur destinations: digital only via VUCE (since 04/01/2025) through an accredited private vet. Other destinations: accredited vet health certificate within 10 days of travel, dog microchip + INBA registration, pre-filled CVI, payment (UYU 666 per page), at an MGAP Sanidad Animal office by appointment (Montevideo, Carrasco cargo terminal). Mercosur CVI valid 60 days, multiple trips.
countries.authority: MGAP (Ministerio de Ganadería, Agricultura y Pesca) – Dirección General de Servicios Ganaderos
vaccinations: Rabies: current, origin-approved vaccine; CVI states date, type, serial, brand; first vaccination at least 21 days before entry.
Under 3 months: age and no exposure to urban rabies in the 90 days before shipment certified.
Animals from WOAH rabies-free countries may enter unvaccinated if certified.
documents: CVI from origin official authority (Mercosur model, valid 60 days) or official passport validated by the official authority (unvalidated passports refused)
Clinical exam by registered vet within 10 days before CVI issue

Dogs (over 90 days) from countries not WOAH-free of leishmaniasis: negative test (IFAT, ELISA, direct agglutination or molecular) within 60 days before entry; dogs diagnosed/under treatment not admitted
